3la('a la—pasnyespu(spulhadzi/lta//galha4 (spyo/zu45(spyorinadzi(/byusketso zhelkephubastaspyi'i 'don thengs 20pa/bod rang skyor+sha hūm̐ngs srida~X sa lo rgyus /sna gnas dpyad gartsokā rnyi r+sha sbya sa nā /lhan khang sa mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
ra nga ba mas pal 'bar

lho brag lha khang rdzong gi khral bsdu khrims gnon byed phyogs dang rebrel yod 'khar chu dgon pa'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ lho kha sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus rgyu cha 'tshol bsdu tshogs chung / (154)stod mnga' ris skor gsum khul de snga gser dpon dang gzhung tshong zhes pa gtong srol gyi lo rgyus skor/ blo thabazang ru sa/(177)lha sa snang rtse shag las khungs kyi lo rgyus dang / sgrig srol/95thab khurabakacad rngabathe5rnga5 /) shesazen/ (189)spyi lo 1kha46lor 'jar man gyi mi yul gyar ba gnyis lha sar 'byor ba'i skor/ thang sma ba 'a la nga (201)nga tsho se grong g.yul smad pa'itshokhyim tshang gi 'byung khungs dang /gcen po skal bzang shes rab la dran gso dang chabs cig rang nyid kyi lo rgyus la phyi mig rags tsam lta ba/ se grong dbang rgyal/ (210)rtse rig gnas slob grwa chen mo'i skor/ rnam rgyal sgrol dkar/ (259)lha sa grong khyer nang de snga sger btsugs slob grwa khag 'ga' zhig yod pa'i nang tshan ‘‘tar khang ’’slob grwa'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ dge rgyas pa bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ (267)lha' rta ra thab bstan bstan dar rang nyid kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ ༄ ༄la'urtad+ngharathabab ba ra/(272)bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyi lo rgyus/don dbang bsod stobs/ (277)ru thog rdzong dpon gyi khral bsdu byed stangs dang / phyi phyogs tshong /rabrel/ khrims srol bcas kyi skor/ mnga'
chos mdza thab ba ma rgyal

dngos do dam u yon lhan rtsom sgyur sde tshan gyi lhag pa don grub/ (366)lha sar sdod pa'i brag g.yab bla brang gi lde 'chang bla med kyi lo rgyus rag bsdus/ thub bstan chos sku nas rgyu cha mkho 'don byas pa dang / bsod nams dar rgyas kyis bris/ (387)

pha stag sna mda' dpon rnam rgyal che dbang la dran gso byas pa/g.yung drung sgrol mas/stag sna'i gdung rgyud ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i snga rjes la bod du gdung drug dang / nang so bcu gsum/ nang pa bcu gsum du dbye ba'i rus rgyud khag mang po yod pa'i nang tshan nang pa bcu gsum gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i sa gnas lha rtse rdzong 'og gzhis chen stag sna nang pa zhes su grags pa'i mi thog rim can gyis bod kyi chos rgyal rim byon dang / sa skyong /sa skya/ phag gru/ dga' ldan pho brang bcas kyi zhabs 'bring du gyur ba red/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa sku zhi bar gshegs pa'i rjes su sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang / rgyal po lha bzang han gnyis 'gal ba che zhing rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyis rkyen pas lha bzang han lha sar byang lam bar ma brgyud yong ba dang / btsun mo dang dpung khag gcig stod lung brgyud lha sar yong skabs sde srid kyi dgongs par lha bzang han dang thug 'phrad du song tshe nyen kha shin tu che zhing / de las btsun mo'i sar bskyod de skad cha byas na nyen kha chung bar dgongs pas sde srid dang / zhabs 'bring du phran tsho'i pha mes gong ma stag sna ba sogs lhan du phebs skabs stod lung snang rtser lha 1

bzang gi btsun mo dang 'phrad ma nyid du btsun mo nas 'ja bzang byas thog ༄ ༄‘‘sde srid kyi srog khyod stag sna bas gcod dgos/ gal te ka kor byas tshe khyod kyi srog len rgyu yin ’’zhes 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrogs bzhin par btsan po'i bka' yis rang gi srog la nyen kha byung stabs sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i sku srog gcod dgos byung 'dug de'i rjes tsam nas stag sna'i mi rgyud chad pa red/stag sna'i rus rgyud chad de bu mo sha stag la thug stabs rang gi rus dang mnyam pa zhig dgos gal che bas gdung rus nang so bcu gsum gyi nang tshan phan po rgyal grong nang sor bu bzhi yod pa'i che ba de stag snar go mag tu bsus/ nas sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung zhabs zhus pa red/ de'i rigs myug phran gyi pha rnam rgyal tshe dbang spyi lo 1〈91bod lcags yos lor sku 'khrungs/de rjes sger gyi slob grwa dang / rtsis khang du rig gnas dang / rtsis kyi slob sbyong gnang ba red/ dgung lo bcu drug tu son skabs sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung zhabs zhus te chu shur rdzong dang / mtsho sna rdzong gi las 'gan snga rjes su bzhes/spyi lo 1kha1 2chu byi rgya bod nang zing skabs mda' dpon phu lung pa'i las byas gnang zhing / phu lung mda' dpon ri bo che lcags zam khar dmag 'khrug nang srog shor ba'i rjes su mdo spyi bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar gyis phran gyi pha stag sna bar mda' tshab dang de nas ja dang dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon bsko bzhag byas pa nas bzung mdo khams khul ldan khog dang / sde dge/ rmar khams/ chab ma do sogs su sa srung gi las 'gan 'khur/ spyi lo 1rdzo2 2chu phag lor lha sar gzhis 'khor du phebs/ de'i du~X lha sar dmag spyi tsha rong pa zla bzang dgra 'dul gyis gtsos drag po'i

dpon rigs rnams kha mthun byas te gsang ba'i thog srid 'gyur bya rgyu'i grabs gshoms byed pa dang skabs 'khel nas tsha rong sogs kyis srid 'gyur bya rgyu'i bya bar zhugs dgos pa'i skul slong byas shing / drag po'i dpon rigs thun mong thog spyir btang shod yas la ‘‘drag po'i dpon rigs rnams la chab srid kyi dbang cha gtan nas med khar bya ba che chung gang zhig yin kyang bka' shag nas srid dbang gcig gcod byed pa 'di 'grig thabs med ’’ces brjod pa dang don ngo mar tsha rong sogs drag dpon nyung shas la dmigs yul dang / 'char gzhi nges can zhig yod nges shing / 'on kyang pha dam pa de khams nas phebs ma thag yin stabs rtsa ba'i gnas tshul de'i skor zhib phra mkhyen rtogs med par brten bar ma mdor lus pa'i mur spyi lo 1rdzo2 4shing byi lo'i bod zla dang po'i nang drag po'i dpon rigs rnams kyis mna' gan bzhag ste tshang ma mdung shugs gcig sgril bya rgyu'i ched yig ge bzos pa dang der rang so so'i ming dang / thel rtse lag bskor byas pa'i d+nghadon rkyen tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas mkhyen rtogs byung 'phral grwa bzhi rtsis bsher gyi nyin der rtsis bsher mdzad sgo grol rjes sku drag rnams lha sa gtsug lag khang gi bla brang thog khar dpal lha lcog gzab gsol du 'dzoms skabs rtse mkhan mgron bstan pa dar rgyas (mgron che a sob zer )kyis glo bur du drag po'i dpon rigs bka' blon dang dmag spyi gcig lcogs tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul dang / mda' dpon shan kha ba/ dma' dpon mtsho sgo ba/ mda' dpon lcang can bsod nams rgyal po/ mda' dpon sne stod pa/ mda' dpon zur khang pa/ mda' dpon sa lung pa/mda' dpon stag sna pa bcas dang / sku srung ru dpon snye lung pa sogs bskongs 'gugs kyis twa la'i bla ma'i bka' brgyud bsgrags byas pa ste ‘‘drag 3

po'i dpon rigs rnams kyis sgrigs srol gtor bshig byed kyi 'dug ’’ces zhi 'jam po'i ngang nas mda' dpon bshad zur dang / mtsho sgo ba/ sne stod/ sa lung ba bzhi skabs de rang la gnas dbyung btang ba dang / de 'phros drag po'i dpon rigs rnams 'a4 byas nyes ji ltar bsags pa'i skor zhu ba 'bul dgos pa'i bka' bsgyur btang ba brgyud zhib dpyod tshugs te rim bzhin drag po'i dpon rigs tshang ma gnas dbyung btang zhing bka' blon dam ga spyi gcig lcogs tsha rong ba gong gsal srid 'gyur gyi don rkyen nang yod pa ma zad/ rang mtshams kyis pha ran si nas dmag chas dang / go mtshon nyos pa'i byed 'dzol la bka' blon nas dza sag la gnas dbyung dang /dmag spyi'i go gnas med par bzos pa red/skabs der drag po'i dpon rigs rnams dang ngan pa lag sbrel yod nga/ dang / rgyab rtsa ni rtsis dpon lung shar ba rdo rje tshe rgya'/ yin pas bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms zhig gi thog lung shar 'dzin bzung byed nyer se 'bras mkhan pos gtsos 'thus mi khag cig gis rgyab langs byas te 'dzin bzung mi dgos pa dang / bka' zhib rim pas gnang 'thus chog pas zhus te 'dzin bzang dang gnas dbyang ma 'khel tsam byang ba red/༄shi ra ra ru dpon snye lung pa drag po'i srid 'gyur nang zhugs pa ma zad mgar ra bla ma dang ngan sbrel yod gshis gyod gzhi khag gnyis la brten las zhabs gnas dbyung thog rjes su nor gling sding cha'i steng rta lcag btang ba dang rtse la sgang rdzong du sa 'dzin rgyang 'bud du btang ba red/ de 'phros mda' dpon rnams gnas dbyung gis drung dkyus su phab cing / gnas tshul rnams mtha' gsal mthil rtogs byung rjes nyin zhig gus mo'i pha dam par bka' phedīs don du ‘‘stag sna mda' dpon rnam rgyal tshe dbang da lam gyi don rkyen

'di nang 'brel ba cher mi 'dug pas khyod rang 'phral du khams ri bo cher sa srung du thon bskyod byed dgos ’’zhes bka' bsgyur gnang don bzhin spyi lo 1925bod shing glang lo'i zla ba dang po nang lha sa nas rdog thon gnang song /dus de tsam la mdo smad phogs dpon ru tsha mkhan chung gi ngo tshab mi bcu gnyis spo bo rdzong gzhis khag la sdod skabs spo khul chab 'bangs mi ser thog brdab gsig mnar gcod tshod med btang rkyen spo pas gong gsal ngo tshab rnams dmar gsod btang ba red/ de'i skabs mdo spyi sman stod pas spyi lo 1927bod me yos lor pha dam pa stag sna mda' dpon ja dang dmag sgar dang bcas pa ri bo che nas spo bor byed gte brtsad zhib bya rgyu dang sbrags sa srung du btang 'dug pha dam pa spo bor phebs rjes spo bo ka: gnam sde pa dang / blon sras po drug (sde pa'ang zer )yod pa khong tshor 'brel ba gnang ste byed gte lag dmar ba rtsis sprod dgos pa ma zad/ gzhung sa'i dmag phogs chad lus zha chags med pa sgrubs dgos pa sogs khrims lugs kyi 'da' 'ded gnang mus su ka: gnam sde pas bsam ngan khog bcangs kyis lkog tu dmag gra bsgrig pa dang / gcig nas kha btags sras po rgyun du pha dam pa'i sar bcar te ‘‘byed gte rtsis sprod bya rgyu dang / gzhung sa'i 'bru 'bab chad lus med pa rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu yin ’’zhes kha mkhas 'dra chags kho na bshad de nyin 'gyangs zhag 'bud byas pa/ gnyis nas ka: gnam sde pas spo pa'i btsun mo lha sar tsha rong du gnyen 'phrad la phebs rgyur brten rang nyid kyang chabs cig 'gro rtsis yod pas dgongs 'phrol yong ba zhu nan che mdog byas par pha dam pas gsung don ‘‘btsun mo phebs na 'grig pa dang / sde pa khyed rang lag dmar ba rnams rtsis sprod dang / gzhung 'bru chad lus song ba rnams gtsang 'bul ma byang bar phebs na 'grig thabs ra 5

med ’’ces gsungs rjes de nas dus tshod ma 'gyangs ba me yos zla 10pa'i tshes 2 2kyi mtshan mo spo bo ka: gnam pa'i dmag gis mda' zhing du ja dang dmag sgar mtha' bskor ma/sa drag po'i tshur rgol byas pa red/ der brten pha dam pa'i 'go khrid 'og bod dmag gis phar rgol byas te go mtshon sogs gang cir bsdur thabs bral bas tshes 2 2kyi snga dro nyi dros mtshams spo dmag rnams pham nyes su song ba red/ 'on kyang spo bo'i khul shing nags mang ba dang / sa rong rtsub pas spo pa rnam sa ri la 'jab ste slar yang tshur rgol byed srid par dgongs te pha dam pas ‘‘nga tsho 'go dmag tshang mas ri bsher rgyag dgos pa dang / spo dmag gtsang dag bzo dgos ’’zhes gsungs pa dang 'brel pha dam pa rang nyid gdong len du thon te ri bsher gnang skabs spo dmag gis nags khrod nas 'jab mda' rgyab ste sku srog shor ba red/ de nas ja dang dmag sgar ru brgya dang bcas lho rdzong sa khongs khang yul bar phyir 'then byas te mdo smad spyi khyab sa dbang sman stod par gnas lugs snyan 'bul zhu mi rta shad btang ba bod zla 10pa'i tshes 26nyin chab mdor 'byor song /lo der nga rang sku srung ru dpon bde smon rnam rgyal phun tshogs kyi bag mar phyin pa yin/ bde smon la khams sa ngan rdzong dpon bsko gzhag byas nas thon gra sgrig bzhin 'dug pas bod zla 〈pa'i nang lha sa nas thon te chab mdor bod zla 10pa'i tshes 'gor 'byor ba dang / sa ngan du ma bskyod gong mdo spyis spo bo'i gyen log gi gnas tshul thag gcod byed phyogs thad ‘‘chab mdor yod pa'i drung rigs ser skya yongs kyis bsam 'char snyan zhu 'bul dgos ’’zhes bka' phebs song bas tshang maskyushrī don gnad de skor bsam 'char snyan zhu phul rjes mdo spyi sman stod pas ‘‘khyod shod drung bde smon 6

pa snga 'phros sa ngan du thon bskyod byed mi dgos par spo bor stag sna mda' dpon dgra shor gyur pa'i ja dang dmag sgar da lta lho rdzong sa khongs khang yul du yod pa de rnams kyi 'go khrid de spo bor zing 'khrug lhing 'jags dang /gzhung sa'i khrims lugs sgrig gzhi slar gso byed par 'phral du thon dgos ’’zhes bka' phab don ltar bod zla 11pa'i tshes 2nyin chab mdo nas rdog thon gnang / bod zla 12nang mda' tshab bde smon gyis gtsos ja dang dmag sgar 'go dmag rnams lho rdzong sa gnas khang yul nas thon pa dang /mkhan chung zla ba lags kyis sho star lho gsum gyi yul dmag grangs gsum brgya skor 'khrid de sho pa mdo nas spo bo chu mdo brgyud sa khul khag gnyis nas dmag 'thab kyis zing 'khrug lhing 'jags btang ba dang 'brel gzhung sa'i drag chas lhag lus rtsad gcod dang khrims srol slar gso bya rgyu bcas la spyi lo spyi lo 192〈bod sa 'brug zla 6pa'i tshes shar bar phyag las gnang / de nas bde smon zhabs 'bam gyi snyun gzhi lci tsam phog nas lha sa bka' shag dang / chab mdo bka' shag gnyis la dgongs zhu'i snyan zhu phul mthar mtsho sgo ba ja dang dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon du bsko gzhag byas par dmag sgar 'go dmag dang / go lag rnams rtsis sprod byas te nga tsho bde smon ngo g.yog rnams bod zla brgyad pa nang chab mdor 'byor nas sa ngan rdzong du shar thon gyi las 'khur rtsis len zin mtshams chab mdo bka' shag gi bka' drung sreg shing ba bsnyun mnar la brten mdo spyi'i bka' dgongs ltar chab mdor bka' drung las tshab zla ba brgyad tsam gnang ba dang / de rjes nya dang mda' dpon gyi las 'gan 'khur te dkar mdzes dang / nyag rong dus zing / skam thog gru kha'i ching yig ji ltar bzhag pa'i skor gzhan du zhu rgyu bcas so/7

sger hor khang gsar pa'i mi nabs kyi byung ba dang phran hor khang pa bsod nams dpal 'bar rang nyid kyi gnas chul mdo tsam bkod pa/zado khang ba mas/ pa95 'odibazas traṭabod yul gangs can ljongs 'di'i rgyal rabs chos 'byung du ma'i nang 'khod pa ltar sog po gu shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis karma pa'i rgyal rabs chams la phab thog bod sa gnas kyi chos srid dbang cha tā la'i sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang rgya mtshor phul te dga' ldan pho brang ste/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gsar du tshugs pa de'i zhabs 'bring du gtogs pa rang rigs sger hor khang gsar gyi 'byung khungs la rags rim dpyad nas brjod pa la/

dang po/ hor khang gsar pa'i mi rabs kyi byung ba mdo tsam/rigs 'di'i thog ma'i thug sa ni jir gir gnam gyi rgyal po zhes grags pa dbyar rnga ltar ldir ba 'di nyid kyi skor/ sum pa ye shes dpal 'byor gyis mdzad pa'i 〈chos 'byung yongs 'dus ljon bzang 〉zhes bya ba dpar ma zhig tu ‘‘ye su kho'i bā thur la btsun mo khu lun nam/ u ge len dang / tha nag shi bya ba gnyis yod pa'i chen ma la sras bzhi dang sras mo gcig chun ma la sras gnyis yod pa'i sras che ba the ce na mtshan can phyag rdor gyi sprul par grags pa 'di nyid rab byung gsum pa'i chu rta la 'khrungs nas sa khyi lo ong khi rad kyi ta nī chi chin gyi bu mo khyi lo ma por ta rgyu shig ces bya ba btsun mor bzhes la sa bya yul khyad 'phags kher lun mu ran gyi 'gram du gnas pa'i sde de'i mnga' dbang bsgyur/ phyis su hor yul gyi chos rgyal dngos kyi thog mar yang gyur pa'i mthus de nyid kyi ring la phyogs kun tu bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston ltar gyur pa 'di ni yul sde 'ga' zhig tu 'bangs khyim dbul po stong phrag lnga drug sogs la dbang ba'i dpon chung re la stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal zhes sgro btags ltar min par don ldan gyi sa'i tshangs pa stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i gnam bsko/sa rgyal chen yin nges so ’’zhes gsal ba de ni spyi lo 11shrī2lor 'khrungs pa yin zhing / yang 〈lho brag chos 'byung 〉las 4tha'i dzu jing ger rgyal po ni chu pho stag la 'khrungs/ sa paṇa dang 'khrungs lo gcig ’’ces gsal ba dang / 〈mdo smad chos 'byung 〉las 9

‘‘hor jing ger rgyal po bod du byon/ stod mnga' ris tshun chad dbang du 'dus ’’zhes dang / sa chen kun dga' snying po'i dus mchod yon 'brel ba'i sgros 'byung lugs gsal/ 〈bstan rtsis kun btus 〉nang ‘‘spyi lo 1162chu rta lor hon rgyal po jing ger 'khrungs ’’zhes gsal/ 〈deb sngon 〉du ‘‘jing ger rgyal po chu stag la 'khrungs/ dgung lo re gcig pa chu stag la mi nyag la grwa rur gnam du gshegs ’’zhes kyang gsal/ jing ger rgyal po pa'am sog skad du ‘‘jing ge se khang ’’zhes 'bod pa des tha gru'i rgyal khams dbang du bsdus pa'i brgyud rim nang du rgya nag gong ma'i khrir 'dzegs na/sa de'i rigs mtsho sngon du 'phel ba ni 〈deb sngon 〉du ‘‘jing ger rgyal po gshegs rjes/ yo/ ras lo drug de'i sras go yug rgyal pos zla ba drugamong gol gan gyis lo drug se chen gan gyis lo so lnga srid bskyangs nas de'i skabs sa skya ba 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa dang mjal zhing / sa skya'i dpon chen nyi shu'i bar bod kyi srid bskyangs pa'i ring hor rgyud kyis gong ma byas pa dang / tho gan thi mur gyi dus twa ming rgyal pos srid blangs te tho gan thi mur hor yul du bros ’’zhes gsal ba ma zad/ yang bkras lhun dka' chen dpal lags zhu ba des ‘‘tā ming gis hor rgyal rabs gtor skabs jing gir gyi rgyud pa dpung dang bcas pa bod du yong / hor thog mtha' bar gsum zer ba de chags tshul yod pa red ’’ces gsungs/ mtsho sngon du o rod tsho bzhi zhes pa'i nang du jing gir gyi rgyud pa yod lugs skor hor rgyal sras kyi gdung rgyud du grags pa g.yungs drung rgyal bas ‘‘yon rgyal rabs 'thor rjes mtsho sngon nas bod du 'ong mkhan o rod tha'i ji zer ba de yin yang lo khams gsal po med/ khong gi 'og tu thor pa skya bdun zhes pa'i tsho gcig 'khrid rgyu yod/ thor pa skya bdun ni dpa' rtsal ldan pa sha 10

stag yin pa dang / khyung po ser tsha la khyung po 'bum rje grags pa zer ba yod pa de ni khyung ser gyi mi grags can zhig yin zhing / o rod thal jir sog na ra khug zer ba de'i sa ming sprad nas dpon du bskos pa red/ na ra khug zer ba der da lta sog gru khug zer bar o rod tha'i ji bya ba 'khrid nas rgyud 'dzin byas shing / de'i bu che ba hor dkar po stod du bskyod nas hor bar rta jing gir bya ba de dang de'i rgyud pa 'phel rgyas byung ba red ’’ces gsungs/de dag gi rgyud ma chad par 'dzin mur twa la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas bod sa gnas kyi chos srid bdag dbang bzhes te ‘‘dga' ldan pho brang ’’zhes su grags pa'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gsar du tshugs nas bod sa gnas kyi sde dpon che chung tshang ma chab 'og 'jug skabs hor bar rta jing gir dpon yang lha sar khri gsol rten 'brel du yong nas lha sar khang pa gsar pa zhig brtsigs pa der hor khang zhes ming thogs/ thab rten du sbud bde lha mthong gzhis zhes pa mi ser them dud nyi shu lhag yod pa'i sa khang mi gsum bstsal ba'i lo rgyus yod/ gang ltar lha gzhis mi ser bcas par da lta bar ‘‘hor bar pa ’’zhes ming du chags shing / deng sang ‘‘hor khang ’’zhes 'bod pa 'di yin/de nas hor bar rta jing gir dpon gyi khyim rgyud de rim bzhin lha sa dang / byang 'brog gnyis gzhis byes su gyes te lha sar sdod mi rnams la bu med par bu mor thug ste mi dbang pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal skabs pho lha ba'i gcung po no yon kho sho che rab brtan don grub ('di la yul gyi nang dza sag dmag dpon rab brtan gyi lha sgrung zhig kyang yod )dang / che chen kho sho che/ tshe dbang rdo rje bcas bu spun rgan gzhon gsum dang zla bsgril gyis spun che bas mi dbang pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis bod nang khul dutsho11

zhi 'jags su gtong bar ram 'degs byas pa'i byas rjes dang / pho lha ba'i rgyud 'dzin bu wang 'gyur med rnam rgyal la nyams nyes byung rjes pho lha ba'i rgyud 'dzin lcang lo can dang / hor khang gnyis la gtan 'khel gyis gong ma chen pos rgya bod man ju bcas kyi yi ge gsum 'khod kyi bka' shog 'thag drub ma dam sbyar stsal ba dang (de dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur skabs lha sa grong khyer rig slob cud nas bzhes song /) gong ma g.yung ṭin khri lo bcu gnyis pa'i shing stag ( 1725)lor dza sag the gun jir gyi tha'i ji'i cho lo thog mar bstsal thog gong ma'i mdzod nas dzu'e dang hrud cin sogs kyi yo chas sna chogs dang / dar gos// gser dngul spam mtho lo ltar stsal lam mchis/ phyogs mtshungs tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa dang brgyad pa'i dus so sor dbu stod mal gung rdzong 'og rgya ma khri khang la sogs pa'i gzhis ma lag gi 'dzin dbang bdag thob rnams bstsal thog dgas po lcang ra mkhar thog dgon dang gzhis ka dpal 'byor gling ma lag yas mas kyi bdag thob/nag chu rdzong khongs gsang gzhung shog drug gi ya gyal so hrug lho byang gi 'brog sde sogs rgyun 'dzin chog pa'i she bam bka' shog kyang bstsal yod/ ‘‘gung mtho ba lcang lo can pa dang de'i 'og ma hor khang dza sag yin ’’zhes yul gyi sho bshad du btang nas kha dpe bsgrags rgyu yod pa 'ig chags pa red/ gong gsal bu spun gsum gyi dza sag gi cho lo rim pa bzhin du bzung ba dang /gong ma chen pos kyang dza sag rim pa dang po'i cho lo mi mus rgyud bcas su bstsal ba'i bka' shog thob pa nas bzung mthar bu gzhon pa tshe dbang rdo rjes kyang dza sag cho lo bzung nas 'das/bu gzhon pa tshe dbang rdo rje 'das rjes tshe dbang rdo rje'i bu dbang 'dus la mu mthud dza sag gi cho lo thob/ de'i bu dza sag bsod nams bkra 12

shis la'ang rgyud 'dzin dza sag rim pa dang po'i tha'i ji'i cho lo thob ste bka' blon gyi las 'khur yang bzung thog stod mnga' ris khul la dwags kyi sa mtshams su chings mol du'ang phebs te rang gi bu tshe ring dbang phyug rdo rjer la dwags rgyal po'i bu mo don grub rgyal mo bag mar blangs/ dga' ldan pho brang pa dang la dwags bar gyi mdza' mthun gyi 'brel dam zab tu btsugs/de nas gnya' nang du gor bod dus zing skabs chings mol du phebs te tsha ba'i nad kyis 'das rjes gzhis bzhugs bu tshe ring rdo rje'i bu rgan pa don grub g.yul rgyal la yang dza sag gi go ming thob ste bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang la me skyon byung ba gsar bzhengs kyi do dam pa gtso bo'i gras su bsko gzhag gnang don bzhin bka' blon bshad sgra don grub rdo rje'i gzhogs 'degs gnang ba sogs dang rjes su khong rang nyid sku na mtho phebs kyis rgan chos gnang /dza sag don grub g.yul rgyal rgan chos gnang rjes de'i bu dbang chen dgra 'dul la dza sag gi cho lo 'pho 'gyur byas te mdun thabs su rmar khams khur mtshur dpon gyi bu mo zhig blangs pa de'i phyogs kyi spun mched rmar khams pa 'ga' zhig rgya ma khri gang du gtan sdod bya mur nang khul mi ser dang 'khrug rtsod byung nas mi gsod byung bas yul de'i mi dmangs gyen langs kyi gnas tshul tshabs che byung bar bka' bcad phog ste dza sag gi cho lo'i go gnas las phab cing rang khongs snye mo nyi 'brum gzhis lto skal du bstsal nas sa 'dzin du 'jog par mdzad/dza sag don grub g.yul rgyal gyi spun mched gzhon pa thogs med dgra 'dul la nam mkha' dngos gzhi'i bu mo zhig mdun thabs su blangs thog gzhis bzhugs kyi rnam par bzhugs pa de'i bu rang cag gi mes po dam pa 13

bsod nams stobs rgyal zhabs sdod zhus te mdun thabs su sger zur khang pa'i bu mo zhig blangs nas lha sa'i hor khang gsar gyi rang shag tu gtan bzhugs gnang / skabs der bka' mgron lo shas gnang ste mtsho sna rdzong du gnas 'phos kyis mtsho snar bzhugs mus su rang gi khu bor byas nyes byung ba'i tshab tu lha sar ched 'gugs mdzad de chu rta (1ṭ+wāṃ〈2)lor dza sag gi cho lo bdag gis bzhes/ de nas mdo smad sa khul du zhib dpyod sogs dang /rjes su sa khyi (1〈kha〈)lo'i hor zla lnga pa'i nang nyag rong spyi khyab tu phebs skabs las bya rtse drung las tshan pa gcig dang bla sman sogs ngo las chibs zhabs nyung bsdus dang bcas mdo smad du thengs gsum phebs shing /dbus mda' dpon gyi las 'gan bsko bzhag bstsal te lha sar phyir phebs las 'khur yod mus thog bka' blon bsko bzhag bstsal ba red/ nyag rong du phebs skabs sde dge khul 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang /kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos dang rig gnas kyi gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad pa ma zad/ 'ju mi pham yang dngos su mjal ba dang / lhag par 〈spyod 'jug 〉la nyams len dpyis phyin pa zhig mdzad pa ni de snga spyod 'jug gi phyag dpe zhig la gang nyid kyi phyag bstar ma'i mchan 'grel mdzad pa zhig kyang mjal myong ba sogs lo rgyus mdor bsdus tsam mo/rang nyid kyi mes po bsod nams stobs rgyal la dza sag bsko bzhag zhu ba'i bka' shag gis gong mar 'bul rgyu'i wang zhu'i nang khu bo dbang chen dgra 'dul gyi byas nyes kyi rnyog dra rnams ma bkod pa dang / mes po nyid don grub g.yul rgyal gyi spun gzhon pa thogs med dgra 'dul gyi bu yin pa'i gnas tshul rnams wang zhu'i nang yig rdzob la 'tsher nas dbang chen dgra 'dul nad 'das kyi tshab tu bu bsod nams stobs rgyal la dza sag bsko 14

bzhag yong ba zhes stabs bde sla bcos kyi wang zhu'i yi ge bzos 'dug pa las don snying mes po bsod nams stobs rgyal dza sag don grub g.yul rgyal gyi spun gzhis bzhugs thogs med dgra 'dul gyi bu yin pa las/ dza zur dbang chen dgra 'dul gyi bu min zhing / rjes su dbang chen dgra 'dul gyi bu brgyud nas dza sag rgyud 'dzin skor rnyog slong byung ba'i gnas tshul 'og tu 'god rgyu/bka' blon bshad zhol chang hor bzhis bka' shag gi las 'khur byed skabs sku bcar spyi mkhan g.yu thog pa byams pa bstan 'dzin dang gzims dpon mkhan po bar zhib pa sogs yin zhing / khong tshos snyan khra ji bzos gang ltar bka' shag gi byed phyogs 'grig min gyis gnas chung chos skyong chen por dus dbang gnas tshul lung zhu phul ba'i bka' lan la bka' shag nang dam sri yod lugs phebs par brtag zhib byas nas dbyin ji'i dmag 'khrug gi skor sogs la le thogs kyis chu yos (1190 2)lor gong gsal bka' blon bzhi nor gling gi las shag khag nang do dam mdzad de zhib dpyod byed mur mes smo dam pa bka' blon hor khang bsod nams stobs rgyal nor gling lho sgo'i 'gram gyi lha sa'i skyid chu'i chu lag mtsho 'khor kong mo chung ngu zhig yod pa de'i nang du glo bur sku gshegs shing / don rkyen 'di byung ba'i rjes su dpon rigs 'ga' zhig gis ‘‘bka' blon hor khang gis nor 'khrul la 'gyod pa skyes nas rang shi bskyon pa red ’’ces dang / gzhan dag kha shas kyis ‘‘bka' blon hor khang nam kun nas blo sbug dog po dang nus med bla 'dar ba yin pas 'dri gcod byas par 'jigs snang skyes te chu la mchongs pa red ’’ces zer srol sna tshogs byung yod la/ mang tshogs dkyus ma rnams kyis bshad srol ltar na ‘‘bka' blon gzhan dag gis ma nyes kha g.yogs dang /15

rang nyes gzhan 'gel byed pa'i ngan jus bting ste bka' blon hor khang do dam byed sa nas lkog tu chu la bskyur nas dkrongs pa red ’’ zer ba'i bshad srol yang byung yod/ bar lam bshad smra dga' ldan dpal 'byor lags kyis bris gnang ba'i 〈〈sger bshad smra ba'i khyim tshang mi rabs kyi lo rgyus rags tsam bkod pa 〉zhes pa'i nang bka' blon bzhi'i don rkyen skor la 'di 'dra zhig bris gnang 'dug pa ste ‘‘mes po dpal 'byor rdo rjes zur gsal gyi de snga rgya gar rdor gling du chings don mjug skyong du bskyod skabs phyi rol pa'i lag nas rgyu brngan zas pa dang / dbyin ji bod du gtong rgyu'i don rtsa khas len byas rigs yod med zhu ba bzhes 'dug par dngos don drangs pa'i yin sa min bskyel khung lung dag 'bud mtha' ma 'gag pa zhu gnang mdzad pas nyes 'gel bka' dpyad gnang bder ma gyur stabs bar lag nas bka' blon bzhi lkog gsod yong rgyu'i nyen kha'i mngon tshul ha cang chen po byung khar tshogs 'dus kyang dza drag chen pos 'dri zhib gnang khar 'ga' shas kyis 'dum bde sa nas thag gcod 'gab lugs zhes don du srog thog gtong rgyu'i 'char 'don byed mkhan yang byung bar gzhigs na chu la dbyug rgyu'i srog chad gtong rtsis yod lugs sbir grags ha cang chen po byung yod ri’ces gsal bar gzhigs na skabs der lkog gsod kyi jus ngan 'ding gi yod pa gsal por bstan yod/ mes po dam pa mdo smad khul snga rjes thengs gsum tsam phebs te nyag rong spyi khyab gnang myong ba dang rjes su dbus mda' mdzad yod pa/ khong ni rnam kun thugs bag yangs shing / las don thog thugs thag chod po yod tshul skor nga phod gcig po mchog la bgres rabs tshos gsungs/rgyun thugs nges zhib phra 'dug par gzhigs na chur lcebs rang shi bskyon pa e 16

yin snyam shing / skabs der bka' blon gzhan dag tshang mar rang nyid sger gyi ming thog nas gdan sa gsum sogs kyi sku srung gtan btsugs yod kyang /mes po dam pa der zhabs zhu ba phru gu lo chung zhig las med khar de yang ma bsdad pa'i gsang stabs zhig la lkog gsod btang ba min nam snyam pa'i dogs pa yod/ ngos rang gi bsam par skabs der bka' blon hor khang lkog gsod btang ba yin na'ang 'dra/ rang shi bskyon pa yin na'ang 'dra gang ltar da lta lo rgyus 'ga' zhig thog thon pa tsam dang / skabs der bka' blon spyi'i nag nyes dag sel byas pa tsam las sger gyi gnas tshul 'di la mtha' 'bras brdar sha gcod pa'am mjug sdom byed mkhan zhig byung mi 'dug snyam/mes po dam pa bka' blon bsod nams stobs rgyal gyi bu dbang chen phun tshogs rnam rgyal la sras rnam pa'i gdan thob yod mus thog shing sbrul (1kha05)ching gong ma kwang zhud khri bzhugs so gnyis pa hor zla 9 pa'i tshes 15nyin gser snyan sgron don la bod kyi srid skyong dga' ldan khri pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan la gong mas bka' yig phebs 'brel pha 'das tshab tu dza sag rim pa gnyis pa'i cho lo pha shul bu 'dzin du 'jags gnas bstsal/ khong gi mdun thabs su sger ram pa'i bu mo zhig blangs par bu zhig btsas kyang ma bu gnyis ka mgo ma thon par 'das stabs rjes su sger tsha rong nas nga rang gi ma de bag mar blangs shing / nga rang gi mes po bsod nams stobs rgyal la bu gcig dang / bu mo drug byung 'dug pa/ bu gcig pu de ni gong du smos pa ltar rang gi pha dza sag dbang chen phun tshogs rnam rgyal yin pa dang / bu mo drug gi nang nas rgan pa nyi ma lha mo ni lha rgya ri ba'i khri chen gyi btsun mor blangs/ de 'og byams pa chos sgron ni nang du las ka byas te bzhugs shing /17

khong la bu gcig btsas pa de nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med yin/ de 'og skad bzang lha mo yab gzhis bsam pho'i bag mar ster/ de 'og bu mor rgyal rtse snyan grong nas go mag gcig blangs/ de'i 'og a nan dgas po lcang rwa'i gzhis sdod bkras phun lags kyi bag mar ster/ de 'og byang chub chos sgron ma (tshe ring sgrol ma'ang zer )ni a nan gshegs rjes gong gsal bkras phun gyi mna' mar ster ba bcas de dag gi rgyud 'dzin rnams brjod na yig rdzob mang bar dogs nas bzhag ste gtso bor hor khang pa'i ming 'dzin rang rigs kyi rgyud pa rim mthud brjod rgyu ste rang nyid kyi pha dbang chen phun tshogs rnam rgyal la ngos rang gi ma sger tsha rong pa'i bu mo tshe brtan sgrol dkar mdun thabs su blangs par thog mar bu mo gcig btsas pa de 'das rjes me sbrul lor slar yang bu mo gcig btsas pa ni gcen mo tshe ring g.yu sgron yin zhing (rjes su rgyal rtse sger sne sdod pa'i mna' mar phebs/) pha dbang chen phun tshogs rnam rgyal twa la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa rgya gar du bzhugs skabs zhabs brtan legs 'bul zhu bar rdor gling du ched phebs gnang / dza sag gi go ming rang 'jags thog zhol spyi phogs khang gi do dam phyag las gnang zhing / skabs de'i phyag sbrel sne'u zur mkhan chung sha rgyags pa zhig yod pa ngos nas kyang mjal myong / rtsis dpon lung shar yang de skabs drung dkyus las byar yod pa dang / skyed byed gang de'i sku'i nye tsha yin la khong gnyis blo dkar gyi grogs po zhig tu'ang gyur/ skyed byed nyid sa rta hor zla 10pa'i nang lha sar rim nad chen po zhig byung ba'i skabs la tshad rim gyis bsnyun nas dgung grangs sum cu tham pa'i lor sku gshegs pa dang de dus ngos rang skyes ma'i sbrum nang du yod pa red/skabs der snye mo nyi sbrum gzhis su sa 'dzin du bzhugs pa'i dza zur 18

dbang chen dgra 'dul rgyud 'dzar nas ngos kyi pha dam pa de nyid gshegs rjes ‘‘hor khang gi rgyud pa chad 'dug cing / rgyud 'dzin nga tshor zur pa rang gcig pu yin gshis/ rgyud 'dzar rjes 'brel hor khang gi 'dzin dbang dang dza sag gi go ming bcas nga tshor gsol ras yod pa ’’zhes mgron chen bstan pa dar rgyas mtshan shugs che skabs khong brgyud/ twa la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum par snyan zhu phul ba red/ 'on kyang ngos rang gi pha 'das skabs skyes ma'i sbrum du nges rang skye rgyu yod pas ‘‘nga tshos sbrum du yod pa'i bu ma btsas bar kho pa tsho'i zhu ham du ma song ba ’’zhes bde sdug zhus par/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas ‘‘gnas skabs dza sag ni go ming du dza sag hor zur pa zhes ming btags nas zhabs sdod ma zhus par skra lcang lo brgyab thog bu btsas mtshams bar hor khang nas lo re 'bru khal 250dang /dngul srang brgyad brgya lnga bcu re sprod dgos ’’zhes pa'i dpyad thung 'dra gnyis rtse'i 'gag tham 'byar ma so sor bstsal ba red/gnyis po/ phran hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar rang nyid kyi gnas tshul mdo tsam/ngos rang skyes ma'i sbrum du yod skabs nga rang gi nang mi rnams sems khral chen po byung ba ste gal te bu mo zhig skyes na kho pa tshos (hor zur )rigs rgyud skor rtsod pa slong nges snyam nas ngo g.yog tshang ma blo bde zhig ma byung bas lung brtag rim pa zhus te zhabs rim rgya che sgrub pa dang / skabs der sde dge ka thog si ru rin po che zhu ba zhig bod du gnas gzigs su phebs 19

yod pa de rgya ma khri khang du ched du gdan zhus kyis nga ma skyes gong khog ming yang zhus pa red/ si ru rin po ches ma la spyan 'bur tshugs su nam/ tan gyis gzigs nas ‘‘bsod nams dpal 'bar ’’zhes ming btags gnang bas ngo 'khor rnams dwangs ba'i spu long ches cher g.yo ba'i ngang sems gso lta bus sems ngal cung zad zhi thub pa byung ba red/de nas rim bzhin zla dgu ngo bcu'i rim pa rdzogs te rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa lug ( 1919)lo ngos rang skyes skabs glo bur thal rlung drag po zhig kyang ldang nas rgya ma khri khang (ha lam thog brtsegs bzhi yod pa )gi lho ngos mdun gyi lcags ri phyi'i rgyang thag kung khri lnga bcu drug cu tsam gyi sar ‘6'bo sdong lcang dkyil ri’zhes 'aribod pa'i shing sbyar sdong chen po zhig yod pa rgya ma khri khang gi yang steng nas sbyar sdong de dbar da ra ldi btang yod pa de yang chad nas lcags ri'i nang shar ngos mchod khang gong gi mdun 'cham gzigs mdzad sa'i khang gsar steng zhes pa zhig yod pa de'i nang dar ldi de ka bar dam du 'khril bsdad yod pas/ ska/bas der lul mi rnams kyis de nyid rtags mtshan bzang por brtsis te ‘‘da shor ma song ’’zhe grags skad 'duga.a ṇi byams pa lags kyis nga rang bsam yas su 'khrid gnang ba/me stag lo rang nyid rang lo brgyad du son skabs a ṇi byams pa lags dang lhan du rgya ri'i a ṇi nyi ma lags mjal bar bsam yas mdo sde mchod pa'i skabs dang bstun nas bsam yas su 'khrid pa gnang zhing / rgya ma'i phu nas g.yag la bzhon re la brgyab nas bsam yas e ma 'u/nga gi ma/dor e ma 20

lung ri khrod a ṇi'i dgon pa mjal nas bsam yas su phyin pa sogs da lta'ang dran yul du gsal thag chod 'dug cing / de skabs rgya ri a ṇi nyi ma lags dang khong gi bu mo pad+ma dbyangs can bsam yas su sa 'dzin du btang ste bzhugs pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis lo rgyus le'u zhig zhu rgyu yod kyang yi ge mangs su dogs nas ma bris/ bsam yas ming gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang der a ṇi byams pa lags dang lhan du zla gcig tsam a ṇi nyi ma lags kyi bzhugs nas bsam yas lcags ri'i nang gi mi ser dkyus ma dud chung zhig gi khyim nang bsdad pa yin/ lo de'i mdo sde'i mchod pa mjal ba dang /de skabs pad+ma dbyangs can lags bsam yas mkhan chos kyi chung ma lta bur nyar yod pas/ zhor du nga tsho la'ang gzisas pa mi chung ba gnang byung /yig rtsis slob 'go chugs pa/rab byung bcu drug pa'i (1927) me yos lor rang lo dgur son skabs skyespu mas grong khyer lha sa'i skyid ras dar po gling slob grwa'i rgan bdag o rgyan lags kyi (so nams las khungs kyi drung yig )drung du slob grwar skyel ba gnang zhing / slob grwa der slob phrug lnga bcu drug cu skor 'dug pa sku drag dang tshong rigs sogs rigs sna tshogs kyi bu phrug yod pa red/ hor khang la bu nga gsar du skyes par brten de'i sa khang mi gsum gyi 'dzin dbang rang gnas byung ba lta bus nang mi spun mched rgan gzhon g.yog 'khor tshang mas nga la gtsigs chen byed kyi yod la/ lhag par du skyes mas nga lang shor du nyin gcig kyang mi gtong bar g.yog po ched gtsugs kyis de la mngags cha nan po gnang ba dang / skyes mas nga rang la yig rtsis yon tan slob rgyur do 21

snang shin tu chen po mdzad pa de dag ni bka' drin chen po yin par shes tshor zab mo yong gi 'dug shing byi ( 1kha2 4)lo tsam nas bzung ngos kyi skyes ma de tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul gyi zur grogs su las dbang gis 'brel nas thog mar bu mo gcig btsas pa nas 'go tshugs te bu mo drug da nga bu gcig bcas khyon ngos rang gi 'og ma bu phrug bdun tsam byung yod/ngos rang shing byi nas chu bya ( 192 4nas 1kha2 2) bar lo grangs bcu'i ring bod yig slob sbyong byas shing / skabs der yig gzugs gtso bzung gis sbyong ba las nang don gyi slob deb sogs da lta'i slob grwa lta bu'i cha rkyen med pas lo lnga drug tsam phyin yang rang nyid ni shes bya'i byang tshad ha cang zhan zhing / 'on kyang rang nyid sku drag gi phru gu yin stabs lha sa grong khyer nang sger gyi slob grwar 'gro thub pa sogs mthun rkyen gang sa nas mi dman pa yod pa red/ skabs de'i yas mas su hor khang gi choms chen dkon gnyer mal gung ka mtshal dgon pa nas yin pa'i zhang rgyal mtshan lags zhu ba zhig yod pa khong gi mdun du nga rang rtag tu 'gro gi yod/ khong ni rgyun du tshoms chen nang gad phyis gnang sgo legs shing / zhal bar rdog phyis brgyab nas ha lam sa/dong mthong mi yong ngam snyam pa'i gtsang ma 'od dang ldan pa'i thog nyin re mchod ting brgya tshar gcig tsam la yon chab phul nas 〈yan lag bdun pa'i 〉zhal ton chag med mdzad de bzhugs kyi yod/ nga rang yang dgongs mo slob grwa grol nas kha lag bzas rjes khong gi sar phyin nas bka' 'gyur nang gi mdzod kyi 'jig rten chags rim sogs rtag tu gsungs pa rnams nyan gyi yod pas nga rang la bag chags bzang po zhig chags thub pa byung / khong de dus dgung lo lnga bcu'i yas mas tsam yin zhing / rjes su khong mal gung bslab ston sgang du phebs nas dgung lo dgu bcu ma zin tsam 22

bzhugs pa red/ nga rang slob grwar 'gro ba'i skabs der twa la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku bcar spyan bsal thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis 'gan bzhes nas nor gling spyan bsal pho brang dang / rtse pho brang shar rgyud nyams gso gsar bzhengs sogs rim par gnang ba dang / lha sa'i grong khyer nang chu spre lor kun bzang pho brang legs grub byung ba'i zhal bsro'i mjal khar snyan seng zhus par nyin gcig glo bur du da lam mjal khar bcar dgos zhes bka' brda 'byor bas/ nga rang skyid ras slob grwar yod mus su 'bod mi btang byung zhing / skabs der rtsis khang du ma zhugs pa'i gong yin stabs zhwa mo tshe ring skying khab dang gos phyu chen/ lham shol tse bcas gyon te mjal khar de 'phral bcar bar rgyal ba rin po ches nga la ‘‘dgung lo ga tshod yin nam// slob grwa ga par phebs kyi yod dam/ mtshan la ga re zhu gi yod ’’ces zhe sa kho nas bka' dri gnang gi 'dug pas/ nga rang ya mtshan nas rgyal ba rin po che la mi kun gyis zhed snang chen po de 'dra byed kyi 'dug kyang / rang nyid phru gu lo chung zhig la zhe sa kho na gnang gi 'dug snyam nas ha las pa'i tshor snang zhig skyes byung /rtsis khang du zhugs pa/chu bya (1922)lo'i zla 2pa'i nang rtsis khang du zhugs shing / de dus rtsis dpon lung shar ba dang / khro dga' bo/ cha lu ba bcas yin pa dang / rtsis pa sgo /yang pa sogs yin pas nga rang gi rdel rgyugs dang yig tshang tshad bzhes mkhan ni rtsis pa sgo yangs pa yin/ yig rtsis nang sbyong gi dge rgan ni bkras lhun rim bzhin bde rab rdo rje g.yul rgyal yin zhing /23

khong ni nga rang gi sru mo g.yu sgron lags (a ma'i spun rgan pa )kyi sku zla yin pas nye babs kyis 'dris che ba dang / khong lha sar phebs skabs tsha rong gi khyim du bzhugs pa'i sar nyin ltar bcar gyi yod/ khong gis ‘‘khyed kyi khu bo yin ’’zhes gsungs (khong gi gcen po tsha sprul ngag dbang blo bzang yin/)dge rgan bde rab rim bzhi 'dis nga la rdel rtsis yig gzugs kyi slob khrid zab mo gnang bas bka' drin mtshungs zla bral ba zhig yin/ yig tshad dang / rdel khra sogs rtsis pa sgo yang pa brgyud nang du nang sbyong gra sgrig byas chog pa byung ba dang / rtsis khang du zhugs nyin rdel rgyugs dang / yi ge yig phreng gcig tsam rtsis dpon rnam pa'i sku mdun du bris pa de dag sngon du nang nas bris te phul ba de yig bsdur gyis yig rtsis kyis rgyugs rnams bzhes pa brgyud rtsis phrug sras rnam pa'i go sar tshud cing / yig tshad kyi tshig rtsom de tsha sprul rin po ches gnang byung / de nas lo de'i sa zla'i tshes 15nyin char can bka' shag dang / rtsis khang / shod skor drung 'khor yongs rdzogs/ rtsis phrug pa bcas rang rang go bab kyi las gos mdzod gos dang tshon man sogs dang / zhwa rma lcags mdar go bab khru tog dang bcas gzab mchor gyis (skabs de'i rtse skor bka' blon bla ma dge 'dun chos dar dang / shod skor bka' blon khri smon dang / gnang byung ba yin/) snga dro lha ldan gtsug lag khang la gnas gzigs gnang ste se ra ltag sgo brgyud snang rtse shag mdun phebs skabs de nyin btson pa nag nyes chung tsam yin pa'i mi gsum bzhi tsam glod grol gtong srol ltar pus btsugs kyis bsdad par kha btags re g.yogs nas glod grol dang de nas ra mo che gtsug lag khang du gnas gzigs gnang ba dang sbrags rkang thang mar gling skor du phebs par sngar lam sa gnas so sor zhabs skor phebs lam du sku ngal gsol ja dang /24

zhal tog mchod de yud tsam re bzhugs kyi 'dug de skabs zhabs pad dang rtsis dpon gyi phyag nas 'thor byed dngul gzhong 'khyer mkhan rtsis phrug pa gcig gtong lam bzhin lo der nga rang gtong ba gnang byung bar ra sa gtsug lag khang dang / ra mo che gtsug lag khang / nor gling / rtse pho brang bcas kyi gzim chung dang / lha khang bcas par yang gnas gzigs su phebs skabs lhan bcar zhus shing / de nyin nor gling spyan bsal pho brang du sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i mjal kha gnang bar gang 'tsham ring spyan bsal pho brang gi phyi sgo'i g.yas g.yon gyi lcang gseb dkyil du sgug sdod zhus rjes bka' brda phebs bstun twa la'i bla mas zhabs stegs kyi steng nas phyag dbang gnang ba dang / de nas po ta lar srid blon glang mdun gyi sar bcar/de nas mar lam rdzong rgyab klu khang du ko ba'i nang zhugs te phebs srol dang /der zhol gnyer gyis gra sgrig byas nas dkar skyong gi gsol ston bshams shing / 'ba' cha'i skyid sdug nas nang ma'i gzhas sogs rol dbyangs kyi mchod pa'i dga' ston la rol/ de nas gling bskor gyi 'phros rnams bskor zin bstun rang khyim du phyir log byas pa yin/ de nyin gling bskor du bskyod mi shod skor yongs dang / rtse skor bla phyag rtse gnyer rtsa rtsam shing gsum bcas yod pa red/ lo de'i hor zla 10pa'i tshes 20nyin tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa sku zhi bar gshegs nas rtse shod gzhung zhabs rtsis phrug phyag nang / nang gzan dang bcas pa gdung mjal mya ngan zhu bar bcar skabs nga rang yang de'i khongs su bcar te gdung mjal zhu myong / sngar srol mya ngan mtshon byed rna rgyan sog byil dang bcas dkrol dgos pa dang / lham shol rtse gyon pa sogs byed dgos pa red/ skabs der/ sku gshegs nas nyin gnyis 25

gsum las phyin med cing / spyan bsal pho brang du sku bcar kun 'phel lags nas 'gan bzhes te sku gdung phebs byang nang gdan zhus kyis phebs byang nang yod yod par mjal kha zhu ba las sku gdung ril bu ngo ma mjal thub kyi med pa red/ rjes su de yang kun 'phel lags kyi byas nyes gras shig tu gyur yod/ de nas lo gcig tsam ring ngos rang 'phreng ring sru mo rin chen sgrol ma lags kyi mdun nas dbyin ji'i skad yig dang / ang rtsis sogs slob sbyong byas/bod me byi lo'i ( 1rdzo26) lha sa smon lam chen mo tshugs skabs dge ba'i bshes gnyen shes rab rgya mtsho'i slob ma sku dang 'bral med bcar bzhugs dge bshes lha rams pa skal bzang rgya mtsho smon lam skabs grwa bskor mtshan rtags 'jog pa'i dus dang bstun dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho gsung chos rwa ba'i shar ngos sngags khang steng dgon gsar shod du spo bzhugs mdzad 'dug par tsha rong gis sne sprod (ngo sprod ) mdzad nas 'phreng ring dza sag (skabs der grong drag mda' tshab rim bzhin go gnas yod ) dang phran gnyis la 〈sum rtags 〉bka' khrid skyabs zhus ltar de nyin nas 'go btsugs te kho bo mu mthud sku bcar zhus/ 'phreng ring ni thog ma'i nyin de las phebs ma song / ngos rang lo de'i nang sum rtags legs par bka' khrid zhus zin pa byas/ de skabs nas nga rang la bar chad lta bus srog rlung gi nad gzhi ljid po zhig phog rung rim gyis seng drags byung / skabs de dus ngos rang gi a zhang tsha rong sras sprul sku skal bzang lha dbang (skya bab gnang ba ) nas nga rang gi rlung nad la phan ched sgra snyan bslab pa gnang byung /dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho me glang ( 1927)lor go min tang gis mes rgyal nang sar gdan zhus ltar phebs nyer lha sa'i byang ngos dge 'phel ri 26

bo'i 'dabs su dgon gsar shod ri khrod du bzhugs par phebs rdzongs 'bul ba dang sbrags mjal khar bcar/me glang hor zla dang po'i tshes 1nyin ngos rang lo gsar zhabs sdod ma zhus bar bod yig slob grwar bskyod cing / zhor du bde rab rim bzhi rdo rje g.yu rgya'/ lha sar phebs 'byor dang skabs 'khel te zhabs sdod kyi rdel rgyugs dang yig tshad slar yang nang sbyong byas pa dang khong gi drung du bcar nas yig tshad kyi rtsom yig nang don yang slob ston zhus pa dang sbyong brdar bcas byas/me glang lo'i rjes tsam la a ri ba sba nar zer ba lha sar 'byor ba de dang mnyam du sba bu mthar phyin rogs par yod cing / bod nas dpe cha mang po nyos pa de dag gi dkar chag sgrig pare dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos kyi grags pa gdan zhus kyis khong tsho sdod yul tsha rong khyim du phyag las gnang bzhin bzhugs pa dang / nga rang gi a ma dam pa de dang mjal te nga la dpe cha 'khrid par gdan zhu mdzad cing / khong ni 'khrungs yul sog po sbo ras thu dang / dgon pa ser byes bsam blo ba yin pa sogs zhib cha rang nyid nas khong gi rnam thar mdor bsdus shig zur bris byas yod la/ khong gis phyogs sgrig mdzad pa'i dag yig de yang 'phro skyong mdzad dgos pa'i bskul ma zhus thog shing dpar par bskrun kyang byas/ de nas zhabs sdod zhu bar nye ba'i tshe rtsis khang du zhugs pa dang 'dra ba'i zhabs sdod kyi yig tshad dang / rdel rgyugs rnams rtsis dpon rnam pa'i mdun du phul te rtsis khang nas bka' shag brgyud zhabs sdod snyan dar zhes pa dmigs bsal gyi kha btags legs pa zhig srid skyong rwa sgreng hu thog thu dang / glang mdun gnyis lhan tshogs shod gzim 'gag tu sne mgron brgyud de 'bul dgos pa ltar phul bar phyag rtags phab ste zhabs sdod dngos su zhu 27

nyin gos rgya lu chas gyon dgos pa sogs sngar lam byed sgo'i rim pa rnams brgyud cing / nga rang sras rnam pa yin stabs skra lcog steng du gser gyi ga'u g.yu khras brgyan pa spras dgos pa dang / rgyun gos rgyun chas gos chen rgya smug gyon dgos pa/ zhwa mo 'bog to/ rgya gri phor shub lham/ 'ja' chen rgya smug sosas gyon dgos/ de dus bka' shag nang bka' blon gnang byung ba dang / chang khyim pa/ bon shod/ bkras mthong ba bcas yin pa dang /rtsibashaṃ khang nang rtsis dpon cha lu ba/ shel gling pa/ ka shod pa/ rtsis tshab 'bri yu ba bcas yin/ de nas grwa bzhi glog 'phrul las khungs kyi las byar bsko gtong gnang zhing / skabs der grwa bzhi glog 'phrul do dam pa sa dbang gnang byung ba dang / dza sag tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul yin/me glang lo'i hor zla drug par shod skor gyi las tshan che ba rtswa com shing gsum (rtswa gnyer rtsam bzhes/ shing gnyer )zhis grags pa'i nang tshan rtsam len gsar pa'i bka' bsgyur bsko gzhag gnang ba naṭashaṃ bzung grwa bzhi glog 'phrul lang gi las 7/ bcam bzhag byas/ skabs re'i rtsam len rnying pa ni 'a/ mo shar gyi rtse drung chos 'dzin lags dang / shod drung mkhar sna gnyis red/gsar pa nga rang gi phyag sbrel tsha sprul phyag mdzod kyi khyim tshang gi bu rgyud rtse drung las tshan blo bzang rgyal mtshan yin zhing / rtsam len gsar rnying rtsis sprod rtsis len gyi sprod dpang bka' drung klu khang (bde mkhar ba )ba yong ste khong gis nan tan chen pos rtsis sprod rtsis len byed skabs sprod 'deb gzhir bzung sprod len byed pa'i dngos po rnams kyi chad tho sam ṭa'i steng bkod thog sam ṭa shog bu'i nang bsgril te thel snon gyis rjes su spro 'deb tu 'god rgyu yin zhes nga tshor rtsis sprod byas byung / sa stag ( 192rdo) lo'i smon tshogs skabs dge 'dun par 'char can tsha grwa 'bul gtong byed sgo'i yong 28

dmigs rtsam len 'bab deb nang gsal po yong khungs yod kyang / rtsam pas ma ldeng bar tsha grwa'i dod smon lam skabs grwa pa rer rtsam dod dngul srang sa/nga dang zho lnga re dang / tshogs mchod skabs grwa rer zho gang skar lnga re rgyag dgos byung /smon tshogs gnyis la spyir btang byas na rtsam len pas rin re tsha dod grwa rer dngul zho med skar phyed gsum re rgyag dgos pas bla phyag las khungs su sdeb sgril gyis bla phyag tu dngul rtsis brgyab ste sprod dgos/ tsha grwa 'bul yul dge 'dun 'byed skal len mkhan dang bcas pa bsdoms na skabs der grwa grangs nyis khri lhag tsam zin gyi yod/ tsha grwa ni dge 'dun ngo phebs la ma gtogs med cing / de yang zhogs pa snga po yin stabs phal cher grwa grangs khri brgal tsam ma gtogs e yod snyam yang tsha dod dngul rnams bla brang phyag mjod par grwa grangs ngo yod ltar brtsis nas rtsis rgyag dgos pa de thigs bsags rgya mtshor gyur pa'i dpe ltar bla phyag tu dngul khyon che sprod dgos pas phyin chad sdeb sgril gyis dge 'dun pa'i phyag tu dngos su phul chog pa zhes yig tshang brgyud snyan zhu phul bar don smin byung ste rtsam len lag gron chung zhing / dge 'dun so so'i phyag tu 'bul thub pa sogs gang legs byung /gong gsal sa stag lo drung 'khor rtsal rgyugs zhes gna' srol lus rtsal 'gran bsdur gzigs 'bul byed sgo 'phel zhing / de ni shod drung zhabs sdod zhus rjes gzigs 'bul thengs gcig zhu dgos pa dang / de yang sngar srol nyams med kyi thog nas rta'i sga chas dang / mi yi gyon gos/ mda'/mdung / me mda' (bod mda' )sogs rta thog nas 'ben rgyag gi 'gran bsdur ang grangs len dgos pa dang / mda' la rgyang ma zhes ring thung 29

'gran dgos pa bcas yod/ lo der rdzong rgyab tu rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dang /bka' shag bcas phebasari te dbu gur nang nas gzigs 'i/ba gnang ba'i mdun 'gran bsdur gzigs 'bul zhus shing / nga tsho rim bzhi sras rnam pa dang / drung dkyus bcas mi nyi shu lhag tsam yod/ de dus kyi sras rnam pa dang drung dkyus rnam sa kyi chas lugs bzo dbyibs ji yod 〈mi dbang rtogs brjod 〉sogs lo rgyus yig rnying khag tu gsal bas ma spros/sa yos ( 1kha2la)lor nga rang la sngar lam shod skor gyi sras rnam pa yan dang smon lam mdzad sgo 'i ya so ra khri pa zhes pa zhis/ 'khor srol bzhin lo dor ya sor bgres pa rim bzhi sding cha ba dang / gzhon pa nga rang la 'khel zhing / ma gzhi ya so ra byed skabs ba/ka' ngal che tsam yod kyang skabs der nga rang gi skyes ma bzhugs yod stabs nga rang ni gos gyon thub tsam dang phyi la thon thub tsam byung na 'grig shing / phyi nang gi gra sgrig tshang ma a ma drin can des sku las bskyon pa red/ bka' drin mtshungs zla bral ba'i skyes ma de yang rim gyis bslun nas lo der sku gshegs pas rang nyid la chag sgo mun pa thibs pa ltar byung / lcags 'brug (1940)lo rtsam len pa'i las 'khur yang lo de'i zla drug par 'phos zin te rtsam len pa gsar pa sbrum pa sra sa dang /rtse drung las tshan nga 'ig yi na snyam/ sprod dpang du bka' drung smin skyid gling pa yin zhing / de snga/ bde mkhar bas sprod khra saṃ ṭa'i thog bkod yigre rnamasatsho saṃ ṭa nas shog bu'i steng phab ste snyan seng dang bcas bde mkhar ba'i tham kha blangs pa sogs rtsam len pa'i las 'gan legs grub zin/30

khrim tshang gi 'gan 'khur phrag thog tu babs rjes/de snga ma rgan 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas kyang nga rang la 'phros mol mdzad myong la/ rang nas kyang mthong myong ba sger spel bzhi ba'i bu mo sgrol ma g.yang 'dzoms de a ma'i a ṇi gnam dpon rmo'o g.yu sgron lags zhu ba des ngo 'phrod gnang ste lcags 'brug lo smad du bag len gyi rten 'brel dang bcas ngos rang gi mdun thabs su bsus te rang nyid nas khyim tshang gi 'gan 'khure ma blangs rang blangs lta bur phrag thog tu babs/ de nas rtsam len gun mthud du (gun gsab lta bur ) lho brag do rdzong gi tog gnas dang bcas pa bsko rtsale rtsis len gyis do rdzong du ngo bskyod ma thub kyang chos lung rdzing kha ba'i go bag bsod nams stobs rgyal ngo tshab tu btang nas lo re bogs ma phran bu blangs (khong la nga tshos chos lung sku zhabs zhes 'bod cing /rjes su khong rong skyid smad kyi ming thog nas zhabs zhu byas pa red/)lcags sbrul ( 1941)lor rang gi mdun thabs sgrol ma g.yang 'dzoms la bu mo gcig btsas pa de'i ming la tshe ring chos sgron zhes btags (da lta grong khyer lha sa'i rim 'gog babs tshugs su las ka byed mus/) de nas rang khyim du tsha rong dza sag zla bzang dgra 'dul gyi zur grogs ngos rang gi skyes mar bu phrug bdun tsam byung ba de rnams kyi skor rnyog dra cung zad langs pa'i gnas tshul 'ga' zhig byung skor 'dir ma spros/ chu rta (1kha42)lo de'i dbyar kha rang gzhis rgya ma khri khang du ngal gso spro gseng lta bus gang 'tshams zhig bsdad/ chu lu ga ( 1942) lo bu mo gzhon pa zhig btsas shing /ming la byams pa sgrol dkar zhes btags (da lta las 'khyur ngal gso byas te 31

bsdad yod pa/) de nas mna' ma'i khyim gzhis gtsang pa rnam spel bzhir yong dgos zhes yab yum gnyis kyis nan cher bskul 'debs mdzad pa ltar bcar rgyu dang sbrags rang nyid kyang lo nyer lnga'i keg thog tu 'khel bas /lho gnas dang gtsang gnas mjal bar phyin na dge mtshan che lugs brjod mi byung bar brten bka' shag brgyud gzhis bskor la dgongs pa zhus te rgya ma khri khang brgyud bsam yas dang / rdo rje brag gong dkar chos sde/ bde chen chos 'khor sogs mjal rjes sna dkar rtse brgyud rgyal rtser 'byor zhing /dpal 'khor chos sde sogs mjal te gtsang pa snam spel bzhi'i gzhis su 'byor/ der nyin shas lhod bsdad kyis sa skya mjal bar bskyod/ mar lam bkra shis lhun po sogs mjal te stong mchod brgya mchod sogs gcig tu bsdoms na khri mchod tsam 'bul rgyu byung / lo der gzhi rtser sdod skabs bka' shag gi bka' rgya zhig 'byor gsal ‘‘rgyal rtse dbyin ji'i dmag sgar du me spyogs ‘ha'o dzar ’zhes pa slob sbyong byed par lha sa nas sku srung dmag lding khag gcig la dmag mi nyi shu rtsa lnga btang ba'i 'go 'doms su khyod rang dang /gzhis rtse sku srung ru dpon mkhar sna bar bkod rgya zur song bzhin dus tshod bkag nas rgyal rtser 9radzoms pa dgos rgyu ’’zhes gsal rdon ltar/ rim bzhin spel bzhir phyir 'khor te rgyal rtser thon pa dang / rgyal rtser 'byor rjes nga tsho bza' tsho bu phrug bcas rgyal rtse ni zhabs su sdod sgrig bzos te bsdad/ skabs der 'dzam gling dmag chen sa/nyis pa mjug sgril nyer 'khel yod pas/ de skabs a ri'i gnam gru khrung ching la 'gro mkhan zhig lho kha bsam yas rgyud du lhung nas mi grangs lnga rgyal rtse brgyud rang yul du slog par rgyal rtser 'byor ba dang thug byung / phyag sbrel mkhar sna mkha' khyab bde chen bkar khang steng bzhugs pa dang rjes su sbrag sbang lar spos gnang /32

'go dmag yongs rdzogs nyin re thengs gnyis re dbyin ji'i dmag sgar la me skyogs slob sbyong byed par bskyod dgos pa dang / nyin gung dang dgong dro'i kha lag gi dus tshod kyil gnas tshang du log dgos/ de ltar zla ba drug tsam slob sbyong byas te shing sprel (1944)lor dngos su tsha kha blta mtshams su rgya gar nas me stsogs la skyon yod med blta zhib byed mkhan dbyin ji'i lag rtsal pa gcig yong ba de dang mnyam du lha sar rdog thon/ me smyogs dang dmag mi bcas lha sa nor gling sku srung dmag sgar du 'byoran lha sar rgya sa/ra gzhung gi ngo tshab dbyin ji'i me ca ra shes rab bsdad yod pas kho pas me sgrogs la zhib 'jug dang / lag rtsal mi sna dbyin ji ba des me sgrogs lhu lag bshig nas phyis bdar yag po brgyab pa dang skyon med 'gan len byung mtshams sku r+sāng dmag sgar gyi lho ngos nas bya skyag dkar po 'i ri ldebs la 'ben btsugs kyis bka' blon dmag spyi dang bcas pa bltastozhib tu yong ste me skyogs tsha kha bltas/ de nas me sgrogs tshang rma sku srung dmag sgar la rtsis sprade de nga tsho so so'i khyim du re zhig ngal gso lta bur bzhag / shing bya (1945)lor bu gcig btsas pa'i ming la byams pa bstan dar zhes phur lcog byams mgon sprulo sku rin po ches ming 'dogs pa gnang ba (da lta yig bsgyur gyi las ka byed bzhin yod/) lo der gzhis bskor du dgorngas zhus kyis reng gzhis rgya mar bsdad pa dang / dbyar kha lha sar bskyod de slar yang dwags po lcang rwa gzhis su gzhis bskor rdagongs zhuso kyis rgod dkar la brgyud bsam yas su 'byor/ bsam yas mchod mjal zhus nas klu khang gru brgal te e rgyud lce nga rwa gzhis su 'byor zhingo / lcang rwa gezhis ni dbus kyi ri khrod lta bu ri steng du chags yod/ lcang rwa gzhis ka'i mi ser rnams dbul zhing nang khral yang lci tsam yin pa dang / bu lon rgya 33

chen po chags pa de dag gi phyi nang bu lon tshang ma rtsa chag yong thabs dang /sa zhing mi rtsa rnams kyang rang cag gnas thabs skor gcis nas nang khral thad sazhis sdod so sos rang gi 'dod pa bzhin byas mi chog par lo re'i khral rnams kha ba/sal gyis deb thog bkod de de lhag bskul 'ded mi chog pa bzos pa dang / gnyis nas gzhis ka rang gi bu lon dang / gzhis sdod so so'i skabs bu lon rnams gzhis sdod rnying pa so sor rtsad gcod re ba bton nas skyed med lo dus kyis sprod rgyu bzos thog gzhis ka'i bu lon rnams rtsa chag btang / gsum nas sa zhing rnams de snga'i sa tho rnying pa yongs bdel po phyag mdzod lags kyis phyir 'bul byung bar rtsa bsnan gyis sa char dngos su mig bltas son 'gro bskor nas mi ser so sor sa tho lag 'dzin khams dwangs bkod nas sprad/ bzhi nas mi rtsa rnams mi rtsis zhes pa brgyab nas mi ser them pa rer mi grangs bgo 'grems byed srol de dag med pa bzos nas rang gi bu spun g.yog bcas par bstun mkhas byams skyong dgos pa'i bslabatsho bya nan tan bcas byas pa yin/ de nas lcang rwa'i thod du lha zhi ri khrod ces par mkhan zur ngag dbang blo gros bzhugs pa'i mdun nas sbyor chos dang byang chub lam rim bsdus pa'i bka' khrid kyang zhus/lcang rwa mkhar thog dgon zhes pa ni rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtshos phyag btab pa'i dge lugs dgon pa rnying khungs shig yin zhing / sngar nas lcang rwa mkhar dgon dang lcang gzhis gnyis mchod yon zung du sbrel te lcang rwa gzhis nas dgon pa'i 'dzin bdag byed mus kyang de sngon dza sag bsod nams bkra shis skabs bu'i mdun thabs su la dwags rgyal po'i bu mo zhig blangs pa gong du smos zin pa ltar khong gi ming po zhig ri rgya bsam gtan gling gi sprul skur ngos 'dzin byas pas ri rgya sprul sku dang / ming sring gi 'brel 34

bar brten mkhar thog dgon gyi bla 'dzin ri rgya bla brang du phul te ri rgya bla brang nas bla thob 'dzin pa las gnyer tshang gi bdag thob sngar bzhin lcang rwa gzhis na4byed mu4yin/ 'on kyang nga rang gi pha'i dus skabs su lcang rwa gzhis kyi mchod rgyun sogs la hor khang dang mkhar dgon gnyis dbar kha mchu langs te rtse yig tshang la thug yod pa dang kha mchu de lo grangs sum cu skor detwar nyal bsdad pa de ngos rang der bskyod skabs nga tsho slar yang chod gan bzhag nas mthun sgrig byas pa dang / skabs der dwags po lha sding ri khrod du mkhar thog tshogs yongs la lhan du rgyal sras skal bzang bstan 'dzin gyi yang srid kyi drung nas dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid lung zhig kyang zhus/cho sku‘srung ru dpon bsko gzhagasmyoganang ba/ngos rang lcang rwa gzhis su gzhis 'khor sdod mur bka' shagadzāgis bka' rgya botang 'byor dro sku srung ru dpon sras rnam pa'ang bsko gzhag gnang srole bzhin nge dzange la ‘‘sku srung ru dpon bsko gzhag byas pa yin ’’zhes gsal don ltar lcang rwa gzhis nas lha sar bskyod 'byor rjes shing bya (1945)lo'i lo mjug tu sku spung ru dpon gyi gsar mjal zhus/ ru dpon gaspur mjal ma zhus gong la nga rang gi rig gnas dge rgan sog po dge bshes chos kyi grags palongo sprod mdzad nas mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel mjal (gang de'i rnam thar zur du bkod yod pas yang bskyar ma spros/) mkhas dbang gang des rgyal rabs 〈deb ther dkar po 〉brtsams gnang bar mthun rkyen sbyar ba dang / rjes su khong gi gsung rtsom yongs rdzogs par skrun zhus dag bcas la mthun rkyen mi dman tsam zhu thub pa'i skal ba thob/ ri skabs 35

der sku srung mda' dpon pha lha sras yin zhing / dmag sgar du ru brgya rnams res 'khor ‘‘ḍi shing ’’zhes pa nyin bdun re sdod bya 'khor rgyu yod cing /de'i ring dmag sgar du zhag sdod byas phyin mda' dpon nas ched du brda tho btang nas lhan rgyas tshogs dgos byung na las/ de min nang du sdod rgyu yod pas/ de skabs mkhas pa rnams kyi sku drung nas thos pa phran bu gsog thub pa'i go skabs shig yod kyang dus tshod mang che ba le lo g.yeng ba kho nas 'da' khar song / lo de'i zho ston la nor gling du lha mo zlos gar gyi 'khrab ston sngar lam bzhin byas te nyin gsum ring lha mo gzigs 'bul dang snga dgongs dmag sgar gyi ru sgrig gus btud rnga brdung du 'bud kyis byas shing tshang mas dbyin lugs kyi dmag chas gyon thog ru dpon tshos dbyin lugs dmag chas dang bod lugs kyi mgo la skra lcog dang (sras rnam pa yin na skra lcog tu gser gyi ga'u ) rna bar gser gyi sog byil g.yu dang mu tig gis brgyan pa btags yod pa red/ de bzhin dbyin ji'i dmag zhwa thug khog dang keb sogs kyi ldebs su gser gyi ma'o sgor rdo rje rgya gram ris su 'khod pa pha lam dang mar gad la sogs pa rin po che phra sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa gyon srol yod pa bzhin ngos rang yang de bzhin du gyon yod/ lo de'i hor zla brgyad pa'i nang tsam la dge chos rin po che do dam du tshud lugs sogs gang de'i rnam thar zur bkod ltar dang / shod skor las tshan yan la lo re drung 'khor spyi pa'i dbyar skyid gtong res 'khri srol bzhin lo der nga rang dang las tshan 'bru phog skyid sman gnyis la 'khel bas khong gis dod bsgril bod dngul srang lnga khri tham pa (bod dngul srang lnga khri tham par ṭam rdo chig stong zer )sprad nas nga rang gis 'gan blangs te drung 'khor spyi la thugs spro nyin bdun btang zhing / thus/sa spro der nyin gcig sa dbang rnam pa dang /36

spyi mkhan/ mkhan drung sogs gdan zhu byed dgos pa red/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me phag (1947)lo de'i smon lam groli nas tshogs mchod ma tshugs bar der stag brag dang / rwa sgreng gnyis kyi 'gal ba'i dus zing skabs yin zhing (de skor zhib phra'i gnas tshu'/ chab srid gros tshogs dus deb sogs la 'bri mkhan mang po byung yod pas 'dir ma spros/) lo de'i bod zla gsum pa tsam la ngos rang mdo spyi sa dbang lha klu'i las byar phogs dpon bsko gzhag byas don bzhin me khyi nas lcas/sa stag bar lo bzhi po de'i ring chab mdor phogs khang gi las ka byas te zhi drag dpon rigs las bya dmag dkyus dang bcas pa'i phogs sprod kyi lam lugs dang / chos mchog dge 'dun la chos phogs zhabs rim sogs kyi gtong sgo gtong ba'i byed sgo'i bya ba phud skabs der chab mdor dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po ser byes dge bshes byams pa mtha' yas chab mdo mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi slob dpon lta bur bzhugs mus la lo re bka' chos thengs re zung gnang skabs rang yang bcar te lam— nim che chung dang / sngags rim che mo/ gsang sngags kyi skor/ 'jigs byed sogs kyi dbang dang rjes gnang sogs rim pa thob/lcags stag (1950)hor zla 9pa'i nang krung go mi dmangs bcongs 'grol dmag chab mdor 'byor te chab mdo drag po'i bcings bkrol btang tshul lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul rgyas pa gzhung sger yig cha mang po'i nang 'khod pas 'dir zhib phra spros ma dgos kyang skabs der thad kar phrad pa'i gnas tshul 'ga' zhig mdor bsdus shig brjod na gong lo'i bod zla rdopa tsam nas bcings 'grol dmag gis bod la dpung bskyod byed skabs ri bor spyi bos brdung ba lta bus bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis pho zad mo la ma thug bar bkag 'gog bya rgyu byas don ltar thabs shes ci yod kyis bkag kyang phyogs 37

kun nas pham ste mdo spyi nga phod dpon 'khor tshang ma lha sar phyir bros gnang ba la gong rngan mdar bcings 'grol dmag 'byor ba gsan thos kyis phyir log phebs te gru gu dgon nang bzhugs par bcings 'grol dmag gis chab mdor gdan zhu gnang ba dang nga tsho khag gcig chab mdo'i nye 'khor du bsdad yod pa sogs lo rgyus mang ngo/ zhig gi yi ge mang bar dogs nas bris med cing / 'on kyang de'i bar der dge stag sprul sku rin po che'i skor dang bcings 'grol 'go dmag mjal 'phrad byung ba'i gnas tshul mdor bsdus zhus na/ spyi lo 1949lo'i zla ba 10pa'i nang krung go'i nang sa bcings 'grol btang zin lugs yongs grags chen po byung ba ma zad/ chab mdo'i byang ngos ldan khog rgyud bcings 'grol dmag 'byor yod lugs go thos kyi rkyen pas tshang ma zang zing du gyur/ skabs der dkar mdzes be re dge stag sprul sku rin po ches bod ljongs la zhi ba'i bcings 'grol yong thabs kyi bka' mol gnang bar sde dge khul la phebs 'byor yo da skad mur/ lcags stag bod zla ṭ+wāṃpa'i nang tsam la cha pa ru zur gyis sne shan gnang ste dge stag rin po che sde dge nas chab mdor phebs 'byor byung zhing / khong gis kru'u tsung si ling gi phyas byis phyag bstar ma zhig bsnams te bod zhi bas bcings 'grol yong thabs ched du mdo spyi bka' blon lha klu ba'i mdun du bka' mol gnang skabs lha sa nas mdo spyi gsar pa bka' blon nga phod mchog phebs 'byor gnang nyer chab mdor sa yom chen po zhig brgyab cing / nga rang yang skabs der mdo spyi gsar pa nga phod mchog phebs par chab mdo bka' shag nas sngar lam la gong rngan mdar bka' shag sku tshab mgron drung gcig phebs bsur bskyod dgos kyi yod rngapre dang stabs bstun nas phebs bsur bskyod rtsis byed skabs 'khel ba dang / sa g.yom chen po de brgyab rjes mi 38

mang po zhig bad rlung lta bu'i na tsha langs mkhan byung ba dang 'dra bar des rkyen dge stag rin po che mchog kyang sku khams mi bde ba byung 'dug dge stag rin po che phyag mdzod de mal gung rgya ma khul nas yin pas nga tsho yul phyogs gcig gyur gyi gnas la song / dge stag rin po che yang nang khul nye phyogs shin tu gyur cing / de'i sang nyin chab mdo bka' shag sku tshab bka' drung rin sgang dang / phran gnyis nga phod kyi phebs bsur la gong rngan mdar thon te nyin lnga drug tsam 'gor song / phyir log skabs bla mdar 'byor dus dge stag rin po che dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i gnas tshul go thos byung zhing chab mdor 'byor phral phyag mdzod dang bka' mol byung don ‘‘rin po che rnam kun bod sman gyi phyag bzhes gnang ba ma zad/ sku ltems skabs khong gi mgul du btags pa'i rin chen ril bu rnying pa zhig yod pa de bzhes nas sku khams nyin re bzhin je sdug tu phebs song ’’zhes gsung gi 'dug pa dang / mi gzhan dag gis sku phung bya gtor zhu skabs rgyu ma btsabs 'dug zer ba sogs skad cha 'dra min sna tshogs shig thos pa —tsam las zhib phra'i gnas tshul ji yin gsal po rtogs pa byung ma song / nga phod mchog chab mdor phebs 'byor gyis mdo spyi gsar rnying rnam gnyis bka' gros gnang don bzhin lha klu lha sar mgron drung dang bcas phyir log phebs pa dang / nga phod las bya dang bcas chab mdor bzhugs/ de rjes chab mdor drag po'i bcings 'grol gtong skabs nga tsho mdo spyi las bya dang bcas pa bros phyin kyang bcings 'grol dmag gis bros yul nas ched 'gugs kyis sngon 'byor bcings 'grol dpon dmag gi 'go khrid wang thon krang dang /krang kru'u ren zhu ba gnyis kyis ‘‘btsan rgyal ring lugs pas da phan yun ring rgya bod kha bral btang yang da cha mes rgyal khyim tshang gcig gi spun zla thug 39

(sprudra da byung ba tshang ma mnyam rub kyis btsan rgyal ring lugs mthar skrod btang nas mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang dro skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho ba skyel thub pa byed dgos ’’zhes dang / ‘‘chab mdo'i phogs dpon kyang khyed rang rang 'jags kyis snga/ra bzhin bya ba sgrubs dgos ri’zhes sogs gsungs / wu'u si krang la sogre/sa dbu khrid dpon dmag byings rnams rim phebs kyis dge stag sprul sku rin po che yang dug ster bar ngos 'dzin mdzad nas hud kreng ud ched mngags ngos sar phebs te/ ‘‘nga tsho dge stag rin po che'i phyogs gtogs gcig gyur la song / dge stag rin po cher dug bster ba'i gnas tshul skor mnyam du brtsad gcod byed dgos ri’zhes dang /skabs der chab mdor rlung 'phrin gtong las pa dbyin ji'i mi pho ṭo ngo 'khor gtan sdod byed mus la thugs dogs yod lugs gsung byung yang /rang gis gong du zhus pa ltar las brtsad gcod mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pa yin cing / skabs der bcings 'grol dmag 'byor nye'i skabs log spyod shog khag gis dkrog gtam mang po bzos nas gung khran tang dmar po'i 'go khrid 'og gi bcings 'grol dmag gis mi sha za ba sogs bshad kyang rang nyid nas bcings 'grol dmag gis mi sha za ba zer ba der yid ches med/'on kyang phyogs gzhan nas ri bo chen po gsum mgo rting bslog pa'i skad grags kho nas bshu gzhog gral rim pa zhig la mtshon na 'jigs snang mi skye ba ci la srid/ yin na'ang bcings 'grol dmag dngos su 'byor skabs spyod bzang gi dmag mi ‘‘sgrig khrims chen po gsum dang / do snang byed dgos pa brgyad ’’lag len dngos su bstar mkhan dza mtshar che ba zhig mthong bas 'di 'dra yod 'gro snyam pa sngon chad gtan nas ma byung /rang nyid chab mdo nas lha sar sngon tsam nas dgongs pa zhu dgos don 40

ni chab mdor sdod ring gzugs po 'phrod po ma byung bas phogs khang yang dgongs 'khrol gyis gsar pa sa gnas su 'byor ma thub par lus pa'i byung rkyen rnams chabalhamado bcings 'grol —u yon lhan khang gi dbu khrid wang chi ma'e kru'u ren sogs la dgongs zhus kyis chab mdo nas thon te lha sar srid tshab blo bzang bkra shis dang / klu khang ba (bde mkhar ba ) gnyis/bka' tshab thub bstan rab yangs dang / bshad zur can yin cing ngos rang 'byor 'phral sngar lam 'byor phyag sogs zhus/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs kyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod rjes krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab krang cing u rgya gar brgyud lha sar phebs 'byor byung ba dang chabs cig bcings 'grol 'go dmag kyang lha sar 'byor bas nga rang dang rtse mgron rgyal mtshan lags gnyis la lha sa khul gyi bcings 'grol dmag gi phogs sgrig do dam las bya ser skya kha shas dang bcas ched 'dzugs bsko bzhag gnang ste lha sa kun bzang pho brang nang las khungs tshugs pa yin/ bod zhi bas bcings 'grol theb rjes kyi 'brel yod gnas tshul/ de rjes sa gnas srid gzhung nas yolegs bcos tshogs 'thus ’’skong tshogs dang 'brel legs bcos las khungs zhes pa btsugs te sa gnas kyi lam lugs rnying pa rnams rim bzhin bsgyur bcos gye da 'char yod pa'i skabs der rang nyid ni chu 'brug (1952)lo'i bod zla 7pa'i tshes 1nyin mes rgyal nang sar gus btudartetshogs pa zhig ched gtong byas pa'i gras su 41

btang zhing / ma'o kru'u zhir gus btud tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso dza sag sne shar thub bstan thar pa dang / tha'i ji sding cha ba/ bkras lhun mkhan che spo ra ba dang bcas pa lha sa nas rgya gar brgyud rgyal sa pe cin du bskyod skabs rgyal rtse dang / gro mo/ sgang rtog brgyud ka sbug tu 'byor te der spom mda'i khang par zla phyed tsam bsdad / skabs der bkras mthong raka ra rin po che thub bstan chos ldan mchog kyang mjal ba dang / de snga dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi grogs po ur ru su rog rig gi bu 'jor 'ji rog rig zer ba khong yang ka sbug tu bsdad 'dug pa bkras mthong rin po ches lhan du gsol ja zhig tu 'bod gnang mdzad de khong yang thug 'phrad byung / de nas ka sbug nas ka li ka ta brgyud gnam gru'i thog bskyod cing / nga rang ni rgyal khab phyi sgo thon pa dang po yin pas ka li ka ta nas mtha'i rgya mtsho chen po'i mkha' dbyings su gnam gru 'phur bskyod byed skabs mig lam du mthong ba'i rgya mtsho chen po'i mtha' thams cad chu 'dzin lang long du 'phyur ba bod kyi thang ka dang / ldebs ris su bris pa ltar 'dug pa sngar rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram rgya gar nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i ri mo'i shan mngon sum du lhang lhang 'char zhing / de nas sing ka phor dang shang 7nga brgyud mes rgyal gyi rgyal sa pe cin du 'byor te rgyal khab dbu brnyes nas lo gsum 'khor ba'i dus chen gzab rgyas gnang bar zhugs pa dang / de nas nga tsho stabs gcig tu mes rgyal gyi zhing chen khag mang por lta skor slob sbyong du gtong gnang skabs sno len gzab rgyas phun sum tshogs pa mdzad cing / sngar mthong ma myong ba'i mig gi longs spyod mang po blta bas ngoms mi shes pa lta bu byung / skabs der lo mang zhal mjal ma byung ba'i rang nyid kyi dge rgan krung go'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i tshogs gtso dge ba'i bshes gnyen shes rab 42

rgya mtsho mchog kyang mtsho sngon zhing chen zing ling byu bzhugs pa dang dngos mjal byung ste dgyes tshor chen pos thugs rje'i rjes su bzung zhing / de rjes yul gru gzhan lacebalta skor du lhan phebs kyis byang shar har pin nas bka' slob kyi legs bshad 〈ngo mtshar glogagi rol rtsed 〉kyang bstsal/skabs der mes rgyal nang sar khyon zla —ba —bcu tsam 'gor ba dang / slar yang shang kang brgyud mkha' thog nas bod du phyir log byas/ skabs der legs bocos las khungs btsugs zin 'dug pas/ rang nyid kyang sras rnam pa'i tshogs 'thus khongs su bdams 'dug chu sbrul (1952)lo'i zla 6nang bod dmag khul ‘‘sa garnar+sā sposaṃ gyid slob grwa ’’zhes pa btsugs gnang mdzad paradzorang nyid la dzacings༈'grol dmag dang / sa gnas las byed par3bod kyi skad yig slob mkhan dge rgan dang / zhor skyong spyi tshogs 'dzin grwa'i kru'u ren/ dmagasmokhul las byed slob grwa'i slob gnyer khru'u'i khru'u krang bcas kyi las 'gan gnang bar zhabs 'degs zhus pa yi na/ sa khyi (195〈)lo'i zla dang po'i nang rtse gzim chung 'gag nas nga rong la sngar lam hor khang mi ngos dza sag gi go ming zhu dgos pa'i srol ltar da lta dza sag gi rjes 'brel 'khri bya mang po zhig sgrub rmus ltar dza sag go ming rtsal ba yin 7ces bka'atshobasgyur dang chabs cig kong zhi krongo rigs rang skyong ljongs dbu rbarnyespu par bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang gi sku tshab bka' tshab dza sag sne shar thub bstan thar pa dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku tshab rnga rang bcas rten 'brel zhu bar bskyod dgos phebos pa bzhin 'dam gzhung gnam gru thang nas ga nam grur zhugs te bskyod/ saphreg —(1rdzo59)lo ngo log zing 'khrug lhing 'jags rjes rnga rang 43

yang bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang gi tshan se hre'i nang du tshan se yon gyi ming 'dzin du zhugs pa dang rang skyong ljongs yig bsgyur khang du zhor skyong las don sgrub bzhin par spyi lo 1962lor ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung rtsom deb bzhi pa zhus dag byed par bod rang skyong ljongs nas ched gtong mdzad pa gzhung las thing gi kru'u ren phun tshogs bkra shis dang nga rang gnyis dang / mtsho sngon nas mkhas dbang gsung rab rgya mtsho/ shi'i khang nas mkhas chen bkra shis tshe ring bcas pe cin krung dbyang mi rigs dpe skrun khang du mnyam 'dzoms thog dpe skrun khang gi mkhas pa mi bzhi bcas khyon mi brgyad kyis zhus dag gi las ka lo gcig byas/ spyi lo 1966lor ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje ’’zhes pa 'go tshugs te mi lo bcu tsam ring rang gzhan tshang mar rang dbang med pa'i mnar gcod sna tshogs tshad med myong dgos byung ba ni shes ldan ya rab bzang po'i skye 'gro kun/ / ma rab khram pa'i rang snang gang shar 'og /yi min bden rdzun 'byed pa'i skabs med par/ /tshig tsub mtshon gyi bkol spyod drag pos gnon/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ ‘‘mi bzhi shog khag ’’thal ba'i rdul du slog thog rig gnas gsar brje brtsi med mthar phyin btang ba nas bzung krung go'i skam sa chen por slar yang bde skyid kyi 'od snang khyab thub pa byung ba ni/ rang gzhan skye bo kun gyi mngon sum myong grub tu gyur pa 'dir zhib bshad ma dgos shing / spyi lo 1991lo'i zla ba 5pa'i tsherngaske 2 2nyin bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nas lo ngo 4rkya'akhor ba'i dus chen gzab rgyas shig ma dzad skabs krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso li tha'i dbyin gyis sne khrid gnang ba'i krung dbyang 44

sku tshab tshogs pa dang / bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 'jog skabs bod kyi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med mchog nyid steng zhal lhan rgyas bcas pe cin nas lha sar ched phebs kyis mdzad sgo 'dir dngos su zhugs gnang mdzad de bkra shis bcide legs phun sum tshogs pa'i mdzad chen gzab rgyas gnang skabs rang nyid kyang mdzad chen 'dir zhugs te dga' bde'i dpal la rol ba bcas rang gi rnam thar mdor bsdus shig bris pa lags so/rtsom sgrig pa'i gsa' bshad/ gong gsal rtsom yig gi rtsom pa po hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar mchog sku 'das grongs su ma gyur gong snga rjes su bod rang skyong ljongs chab srid gros tshogs kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang /ljongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi kru'u ren gzhon pa gnang myong yod pa dang / ljongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi kru'u ren gzhon pa gnang mur spyi lo 19rdzo4lo'i zla ba 12 pa'i tshes 27nyin khong lha sar sku gshegs pa red/45

ci'i phyir srid tshab gnyis gnas dbyung btang ba red dam/khren cin po'o yis/spyi lo 1950lo'i zla ba 1rkyapar chab mdo'i g.yul 'gyed rjes/bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis gtsos drung yig chen mo thub bstan bstan dar dang / dmag spyi dza sag khe smad (bsod nams dbang 'dus )dang / bsam pho sras (bstan 'dzin don 'grub )dang / thub bstan legs smon bcas 'thus mi tshogs pa pe cin du mngags gtong byas shing / khong tsho dang krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa'i li wu'u han dang / krang cing wu'u/ krang go hwa/ sun kri yon bcas kyis pe cin du zhi ba'i gros mol gnang ste/ spyi lo 1(ba51lo'i zla ba 5pa'i tshes 2 2nyin 〈bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉la ming rtags bkod stabs bod ljongs 'di nyid zhi ba'i sgo nas bcings 'grol gtong ched rmang gzhi ha cang legs po zhig bting ba red/〈gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉la ming rtags bkod ma nyid du kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gis thugs dgyes po'i ngang nas ‘‘yag po byung / don zhig 'grub song bas de ni rgyal kha zhig red/ 'on te 'di ni gom pa dang po spos 46

pa trem yin zhing / gom pa gnyis pa ni 〈gros mthun 〉lag bstar bya dgos rgyu de red/ de dag rang res 'bad brtson byed dgos kyi red ’’ces gsungs/ bod rigs mi dmangs dang mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna bcas nas kyang spro sems rab tu 'phel bzhin pa'i sgo nas thal mo brdabs te rten 'brel zhus pa red/ yin na'ang skabs de'i srid tshab klu khang ba dang blo bzang bkra shis kyis gtsos pa'i sa gnas srid gzhung nang gi ngan rengs shog khas ngan sems rgyun 'chang thog don tshan bcu bdun gyi nus pa nyams nyes su gtong gang thub byas te khong tshos thog mar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi tshogs pa'i snyan zhu bkag nyar gyis mchan 'god ma byas pa dang /de rjes dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mis 〈gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉thog ming rtags bkod pa'i rjes su kho pa tshos slar yang bden med ham shed kyis skyon 'dzugs byas pa sogs gnad gcig tu bsdus na mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du yong rgyur 'dod mos med pa de red/kho pa tsho'i yid bzhin gyi khog rtsis ni 'di lta ste/ man ju'i dus mjug gi bod sdod an ban ltar krung dbyang dang cho med zhi lhod kyi 'brel ba tsam zhig gnas thabs sam/ yang na go min tang gi bod sdod don gcod khru'u lta bu'i ming stong pa zhig 'jog rgyu bcas red/ bod sdod dpung sde'i si ling yon blo mthun krang go hwa yis srid tshab gnyis por mjal 'phrad gnang skabs klu khang bas sngar gyi bod sdod blon chen krang ying thang la dpe blangs te/sngar mi chen krang zer ba zhig yod pa des dmag mi 'khrid med rung khos bod du bya ba bzang po zhig byas yod/ khyed kyang rus ming krang yin 'dug pas khyed kyis mi chen krang lta bu byed rgyu'i re ba yod/ ces brjod/ blo mthun krang go hwa yis kho pa tshos bcings 'grol dmag bod skyod la ngo brgol byed 47

pa'i 'chal gta/ ma la dgag pa nan po bskyon rjes/ klu khang bas 'jisas sku 'a gyi rnam pa bstan te bod kyi yu/la 'di dbul phongs yin pas dmag dpung mang po gso mi thub/ gal te dmyo/ga dpung mang drags te 'bru rigs za rgyu ma rag na de ni dmag 'khrug pham pa las bzod dka' ba yong rgyu red/ces brjod/ de'i thog nas kho pa tsho ni smyo ham chen po ji 'dra zhig yin mngon thub/ 〈gros mthun don tshan/ bcu bdun 〉gyi nang du mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du bca' sdod byas te btsan rgyal ring 'u gas pa'i ngan shugs de bod nas mthar skrod gtong rgyu zhes gtan 'bebs byas yod rung / klu khang ba dang blo bzang bkra shis sogs kyis ngan sems khog bcangs kyis 〈gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉lag bstar byed rgyur 'gog rkyen bzos pa dang / gung khran tang dang mi dam ngas bcings 'grol dmag bcas la ngo rgol byed kyi yod pa red/ 'dir nga tshos zhar byung du klu khang ba dang blo bzang bkra shis gnyis yang snying mi gang 'dra zhig yin min skor ngo sprod mdor bsdus zhus na/ klu khang ba ni de snga bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtsis dpon zhig yin/ skad grags yod pa'i klad rnying spyod rtsing pa dang /lam lugs rnying pa mkhregs bzung byed mkhan zhis/ red/ blo bzang bkra shis ni de snga go gnas yod la dbang cha med pa'i mkhan chen zhig dang rnying srung mkhan zhig kyang red/ ming grags de tsam med pa'i mi de lta bu gnyis bdams nas bka' blon gyi gong du 'jog dgos don ci yin zhe na/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'bri chu brgal te chab mdo bcings 'grol btang zin rjes/ bka' blon mang che ba tā la'i bla ma dang mnyam du gro mor bros skabs kho pa gnyis lha sar bzhag ste dus bab la ya lan byed du bcug pa tsam red/ go gnas mthon por gnas pa'i srid tshab gnyis nas rang 48

'dod ltar grub song snyam ste mngon sum 'dzems med kyis 〈gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉la ngo brgol byed ched ‘‘mi dmangs 'thus tshogs ’’rdzun ma'ang skabs de'i dus bstun gyis btsugs pa ste/ zla ba 2pa'i tshes 11nyin a lo chos mdzad dang blo bzang bkra shis gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i log spyod can tshos ‘‘mi dmangs 'thus tshogs ’’rdzus ma 'dzugs rgyu'i nang gros dang rtsa 'dzugs byas te gung khran tang dang mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la ngo rgol byas shing / srid tshab gnyis kyis lkog tu ngan bslab byas pa'i 'og ‘‘mi dmangs 'thus tshogs ’’rdzun mas ham shed shin tu chen po'i sgo nas 'thus mi mi grangs drug mngags gtong gis krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab dang bka' shag bcas la dus gcig tu ‘‘re zhu'i snyan yig ’’zhes pa bskyal ba de'i nang don ni ha cang log spyod yin pa dang / bod dmag gi dmag sgar nang du skar lnga'i rgyal dar 'dzugs su mi 'jug par mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod nas phyir 'then byed dgos zhes bshad nas 〈gros mthun 〉rtsis med btang ste mes rgyal kha bral gtong rgyu'i re ngan 'chang ba red/ bka' shag srid gzhung du ‘‘re zhu'i snyan yig ’’zhes pa 'byor rjes ha cang byed dka'i gnas su gyar zhing krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab la brgyud 'bul mi nus par srid tshab gnyis la 'dri bar bskyod skabs/ klu khang bas/ 'di ni mi dmangagakyi dung 'bod red ces brjod pa ma zad/ ‘‘re zhu'i snyan yig ’’de bzhin sku tshab krang cing wu'u dang dmag spyi krang go hwa mchog la 'bul dgos pa'i bka' yang phab/ gnas tshul de dag gi thog nas kho pa tsho ni gong 'og dbugs lam gcig yin pa gsal por mngon thub/ dus bab ha cang dza drag che zhing / srid dzab gnyis po ni 〈gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉lag bstar bya rgyur 'gag rdo 49
