lta bur gyur zin pas/ 'gag rdo de dag gtsang sel mi byed mthu med yin stabs zla 4pa'i tshes 27nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab krang cing wu'u dang krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi 'gan bzhes pa krang go hwa dang h+phan rmin bcas nas bka' blon yongs rdzogs kyi tshos/sa 'du skong tshogs gnang zhing / tshogs 'dur zhugs mkhan bka' blon gyi gras su zur ba/ nga dbang chen dge legs dang mdo mkhar ba phun tshogs rab rgyas/ lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ thub bstan rab yangs/ bshad zur bcas yod gshis/ sku tshab krang cing wu'u yis/ srid tshab gnyis pos skad cha dza dzor ha cang mang po bshad yod pa dang / mi rigs mthun sgril la gtor bshig 〈gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉la rgyab 'gal bcas byas par yang mi rigs mthun sgril gyi ched du nga tshos bzod sgom yang yang byas shing / 'on kyang da dung nga tsho g.yang sar bcur te skyur rtsis byed kyi 'dug pas da cha phar rgol mi byed dka' med la brten srid tshab gnyis po'i go gnas gnas dbyung du gtong rgyu'i nga tsho'i bsam 'char bzhin khyed bka' blon rnam pas tā la'i bla mar brgyud zhu gnang dgos zhes gsungs pas/ bka' blon tshos sku tshab krang cing wu'u yi bka' mol nyan rjes tshang ma hang sangs shing / srid tshab gnyis po'i byed stangs de rigs gtan nas 'grig med pas 〈gros mthun 〉lag bstar bya rgyur— phan thogs med pa dang bya spyod thal drags pa zhig red ces khas blangs pa ma zad/dgongs 'gal mi bzhes pa'i thog nga tsho tshang mar bsam gzhigs byed du 'jug rogs zhes bshad/ bka' blon tshos gnad don chen po chung ngur bsgyur dgos snyam ste phyi nyin bka' blon tshos slar yang drung yig chen mo lhan rgyas dang rtsis dpon sogs gdan drangs te sku tshab krang cing wu'u la dgongs 50

sel zhu khul gyis don du srid tshab gnyis rang 'jags 'jog rgyu'i re ngan bcangs rung / sku tshab krang cing wu'u yis srid tshab sanyis la bzod sgom bya thabs bral bas ‘‘kho pa gnyis kyi dbang cha ni tā la'i bla ma'i sku dbang las brgal 'dug pas khyod tshos tā la'i bla mar thad kar snyan seng zhu dgos ’’zhes gsungs/ de bzhin bka' blon tshos zur khang dang nga phod/ lha klu bcas 'thus mi mngags te twa la'i bla mar snyan seng zhus shing / twa la'i bla mas/srid tshab gnyis dang bod las don u yon lhan khang bar gyi 'brel ba ni chag grum du song ba'i ka yol ltar slar yang skyob thabs med cing / de bas srid tshab gnyis po'i dbang cha med par bzos te go gnas sngar bzhin 'jog rgyu las gzhan ma mchis/ zhes gsungs par— brten bka' blon dang srid tshab mnyam du 'tshogs te srid tshab gnyis po'i dbang cha med pa bzos zhes khyab bsgrags byas par klu khang bas ha cang mi 'dod pa'i sgo nas khyod tshos ltos dang ri mgor bcings 'grol dmag mis sgar gur phubs zin 'dug pa de yid la nges dgos zhes bshad/ de ni kho pas slar yang dug skyon zhig btang ste slad phyin rlung 'tshub bskyar log yong phyir sa bon btab pa zhig red la kho pa tsho'i log spyod kyi ngo bo de'ang dmar rjen du thon pa zhig kyang red/ —zla 5pa'i tshes 1nyin tā la'i bla mas ‘‘mi dmangs 'thus tshogs ’’rdzus ma de bzhin khrims 'gal yin pas 'phral du kha gtor dgos pa'i khyab bsgrags gnang ba bcas de ltar ‘‘mi dmangs 'thus tshogs ’’rdzus mas bzos pa'i dza drag gi gnas tshul de dag zla ba gcig lhag tsam song mthar gtor pham sdong ba de ni tang gi srid jus kyi rgyal kha zhig yin la btsan 4brgol rgyal gces 'thabasgyu phyogs gcig gyur 'dzugs pa jidang 'phel rgyas chosu gabyutong rgyur dgos nges kyi gom rim zhig kyang red/ 51

spyi khrab mkhan zun ngag dbang rnam rgyal de nyid kyi lo rgyus mthong thos dang 'brel yod rags rim/rgyal mtshan bstan 'phel gyis/sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan zur ngag dbang rnam rgyal de nyid ni/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu yos (190 2)lo 'phan po lhun grub rdzong khongs 'bras spungs ri spyi'i chos gzhis grogs mkhar gzhis 'og tshe lud pa'i pha dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / ma bsod nams bu khrid las btsas shing / lo na bcu bdun son skabs ser smad grwa tshang du grwa pa bzos/ khong gi pha dge 'dun rgya mtsho ni spyir btang gi khral pa zhig yin yang / khul de'i khral zla khral ros/sa su la dka' ngal gyi gnas tshul byung na rogs ram gang thub byed mkhan zhig yin pas tshang mas brtsi bkur chen po byed kyi yod pa dang /grogs mkhar gzhis ka'i ngo tshab tu'ang rdzong la tshogs 'dur rtag par gtong gi yod pa red/ lhun grub rdzong ni mkhan drung ngag dbang bstan skyong gi thab brten yin pa dang / de'i ngo tshab kyis kyang pha dge 'dun rgya mtshor cha 'jog dang dga' po byed kyi yod pas dge 'dun rgya mtsho lha sa jur 'gro skabs 52

mkhan drung ngag dbang bstan skyong gi gzim shag tu gnas tshang byed kyi yod pa red/ thengs gcig mkhan drung sar bcar skabs ‘‘khyod rang la rogs ram byed 'os 'dra 'dug na lab shog ’’ces bshad par dge 'dun rgya mtsho de nyid nas ‘‘nga rang la phru gu bu se dar chos zhugs byas pa zhig yod pas de dag mi dbang mchog gi zhabs zhur thugs nyar gnang thog zhor du yi ge zhig kyang sbyong du 'jug rogs gnang / rjes su gzhung zhabs shig zhu 'dun yod pas rogs mgon thugs rje ma chung ba ’’zhes zhus par mkhan drung nas khas len byas stabs de rjes phru gu de mkhan drung gzim shag gi mdun g.yog tu bskyal te chibs g.yog lo gnyis dang ma byan gyi lag g.yog lo gnyis byed ring las rka/ra hur brtson che la 'khyams myul mi byed pa dang / kha rdzun lag rku ma byas stabs gzim chung nang mdun g.yog tu nyar ba dang yi ge sbyong du bcug pa ma zad/ de bzhin grwa khungs kyi 'bras sgo mang grwa tshang du grwa tshang spos/ sa sbrul (1929)lo nor gling nang sgang yig 'bri ba yig gzugs skad grags yod pa'i mkhan drung ngag dbang bstan skyong gi tsha bo rtse drung thub bstan bshad sgrub nad mnar gyis glo bur grongs shing / nyin gcig tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas mkhan drung ngag dbang bstan skyong gzim chung du thad kar 'bod gnang thog ‘‘thub bstan bshad sgrub de nyid kyi spun mched phru gu yod dam ’’zhes gsungs par med ces zhus pa dang / ‘‘yang na de nyid nas yi ge slob myong ba'i phru gu bu 'dra yod dam ’’zhes gsungs par ‘‘zhabs sdod pa de nyid 'tsho sdod skabs shag tu yong dus nga 'i mdun g.yog phru gu zhig yod pa de'i yi ger dras rgyag tu 'jug gi yod/ phru gu bu de ni 'phan po lhun rdzong khongs khral pa zhig gi bu yin pa dang / phru gu'i pha'i re bar bu de gzhung zhabs zhu re byed kyi 'dug ’’ces snyan seng zhus pas tā la'i bla mas ‘‘yig tshad 53

cig 'bul dgos ’’zhes gsungs pas de 'phral mkhan drung nas mgyog myur yig tshad cig 'bri ru bcug ste ga/zim chung du phul bar ‘‘khyed kyis yig tshang du gros mol gyis lnga mchod 'char nyer yod pas lnga mchod kyi zhabs sdod 'os khongs su gtong dgos ’’zhes gsungs don bzhin yig tshang las khungs nas lnga mchod kyi zhabs gsar 'os khongs su bcug ste mi bab spyan zhur bcar bar zhabs gsar gras su phyag rtags gnang (de skabs lo na nyi shu rtsa bdun du slebs yod pa )skabs de'i zhabs sdod snyan dar 'bul rgyu dang / yig tshang las khungs su spyi sgrig gan 'bul gyi khag theg gnang rgyu sogs gsar mjal zhu sgo tshang ma mkhan drung gzim shag nas rogs ram gnang / gsar mjal zhu sgo zin nas zla gnyis tsam song mtshams rtse gzim chung 'gag nas mkhan mgron che ba brgyud ‘‘khyod rang nang sgang yig tshang gi yig 'bri'i zhabs zhur bcar dgos pas sang nyin rang nyal chas 'khyer te yong dgos ri’zhes bka' phab pa red/gzim chung nang sgang gi las don sgrub skor/skabs der gzim chung nang ma khang yig tshang du yig 'bri'i zhabs zhu ba rtse drung rtse gnyer las tshan 'brang stod pa dang / rtse drung thub bstan sangs rgyas/ rtse drung thub bstan nor bzang / rtse drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal rang nyid bcas dang / bka' shag yig bsgyur las tshan tshe ring dbang 'dus/ (rma' yu'i gu yi pha skabs re bcar dgos kyi yod di ) bcas yin zhing /las 'gan ni gzim chung nas thad kar gtong rgyu'i bka' yig dang / snyan 54

zhu/ thugs dam zhu 'byor gyi bka' lan zin bris bkod de snyan zhus kyis phyag thon mtshams gtsang 'bri dang / skogs rgyag dam phab sogs byed dgos/ 'tsho ba'i thad rgyun du nang sgang du sdod dgos pa las/ gzim chung gi bka' 'khrol med par rang 'tshams kyis 'gro bskyod mi chog nyal khang yang yig tshang 'gram mi gnyis rer khang chung re las med cing /mdun g.yog ni de bas kyang nyar mi chog kha lag gsol thab nas nar gtong byede kyi yod pa las/ phogs thob sogs zur du med cing / lo re rtse yig tshang las khungs kyis yong bsdu zhes rdzong gzhis khag tu khral 'bab bsdu dam bskos na ngo tshab bam/ bogs gtong sogs byas tshe lo re dngul ṭam rdo bco lnga skor 'bab kyi yod/ rgyun gtan nyal khang dang / yig tshang tshugs yul yas mas su gtsang sbra dod pos tshul mthun gyis sdod dgo sa/'on kyang phyi'i blta stangs su nang ma sgang pa zhes sku'i gam du gnas yod stabs mthong chen byed kyi yod pa red/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal nas gzim chung nang sgang yig 'bri'i las 'khur lo gnyis zhus mtshams rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu bya (192 2)lor twa la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum me dgongs pa choso dbyings su thims pa dang / lo de'i nang bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms spyi mthun gyis rwa sgreng ho thog thur rgyal tshab gsar bsko byas rjes sngar lam sne shan rtse drung gnyis dgos gshis tshogs 'du nas rtse drung ngag dbang 'byor ldan dang / rtse drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gnyis la sno shan bsko gzhag byas/ 55

rgyal tshab rwa sgreng gi sne shan dang che gling do dam pa byas skon/sne shan ni sku sger rwa sgreng bla brang phyag mdzod khang du rtag bcar gyis dza sag gi ngag bkod dang len dang / gzhung gi las khungs khag nas rgyal tshab rin po che'i gsol phogs zhu len/ rnam kun rgyal tshab rin po che gang du phebs kyang chibs zhabs su bcar dgos/ sne shan par 'bab yong sngar lam phogs dngul srang brgya skor las med pa dang / rta gnyis rgyun du nyar dgos stabs sne shan rtse drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal ni shag tshang sogs med pa'i grwa rkyang rten med cig yin gshis bun thog bun brtsegs kyis 'a 'ub 'dus min la brten rdzong gzhis zhu 'tshang rim par byas par rtse yig tshang las khungs nas 'o sa 'char kha shas khongs bcug kyang skabs su ma 'khel ba'am// yang na bla brang gi zhabs zhu'i dgos mkho sogs gang yin phyag rtags gnang med/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me glang (1927)lo sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan pos 'char 'bul byed pa'i mdzod chung khongs tshe gling gzhung chod do dam pa zhu 'tshang byas par 'char phul phyag rtags kyis bsko gzhag byung yod/tshe gling do dam pa ni rtse skor las tshan go gnas mtho dma' sna tshogs nas zhor skyong byed pa zhig yin zhing / skabs de'i do dam pa mkhan che sog po lo tsā ba dang / las 'brel rtse drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gnyis yin pa dang / de 'og drung yig gnyis dang / khang gnyer gnyis/ rgan po gnyis/ 'bo kha ba gcig gad pa gcig bcas dgos pa de dag do dam 56

pa gnyis nas bsko 'then byed srol dang / 'bab yong ni byang la thog kha'i she dpon rtse drung dang nag chu 'bri ru she dpon rtse drung gnyis kyi mar 'bab dang / kong po rgya mda' rdzong khongs nu ma ri 'bras nang dang dbu stod gri zhal gnyis bcas khul gyi she khag nas mar dang / chu shur stag dkar gzhis sos/sa gzhis khag kha shas kyi bogs 'bru/ lha sa 'ong khar do dam gnyis kyi 'a debs skyong byed pa'i bogs 'bab/ de bzhin lha sar khang pa khag kha shas yod pa'i khang gla/ mi rtsa pho mo gang 'tsham yod pa'i mi bogs bcas 'bab kyi yod/ gtong gron bya yul ni nor gling chibs g.yog dang /khang gad kyi zla re'i phogs thob 'bru mar dang / mkhan khongs lcang gcod las bya rtse drung gcig dzodang / 'ul mi bcas kyi 'bru phogs/ — nor gling nyi 'od du rgyud grwa smad stod re mos kyis zhabs sgrub dang / gzim chung nas 'phral 'phral 'bas sgrub dgos rigs kyi dgos cha spyi mkhan phyag mdzod khang gi ngo sbyor ltar sprod pa sogs byas te byung song gi rtsis khra do dam 'phos mtshams 'bul dgos/— gong gsal gtong sgo4khag la gtong cha ma ldeng ba rnams gzhung 'bru'i dkar steng nas 'don sprod chog pa'i bko' rgya zhu len bya rgyu yod/ do dam so sor lha spu 'ong khar son khal dgu bcu 'gro ba'i sa zhing la ston 'bras legs po byung na lo re bogs 'bab sogs phud 'bru khal lnga brgya skor dang / zan rte bcas 'bab/ de'i zhing g.yog byed ma/khan 'dur rgyug misor zhes mi bdunatshotsam la ja rtsam las sprod mi dgos par skul chog las khungs khye 'bab len skabs dang / gtong sgo gtong skabs kyi g.yo zol bar khyad/ mjal zhu bcas la tshod rtsis byas na phyogs rer mor khal bduno cu tsam re dang / 'bru khal bdun cu skor 'bob kyi yodaca/ rtse drung ngag dbangaskurnam rgyal la las khungs de byung bar brten —sdodaceshaspumed 57

pa'i gnas tshul thag gcod thub yod pa ste/ snyelas khungs de'i khang khongs dar rgyas lcang gseb ma khang lte ba mdo las mkhan chung blo bzang don grub kyi 'dzin pa phud/ de byings le lag gsum rtse drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi ༅ga tshang la khang 'dzin gtan 'jags yong ba'i rtse yig tshang las khungs brgyud snyan zhus la rgyal tham 'go mchan yang byung yod/ sne shan las 'khur lo lnga song rmetshams rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa stag (1kha2ṭ+wāṃ)lo gnas lnga pa'i las tshan shod mgron bsko gzhag gnang ba dang chabs cig tshe gling do dam pa yang 'phos pa red/shod mgron dang sne mgron gyi las khur byas skor/shod gzim chung 'gag ste rgyal tshab bam srid skyong gi gzim chung 'gag tu las khur byed po gtso bo sne mgron mkhan chung gcig dang / de 'og shod mgron mi bzhi tsam/ gzim 'gag mi gnyis bcas dang gzhan yang rtse gdan gnyer drung gtogs khongs nas mi gcig bang chen nang zag mi gnyis/ gad pa gcig bcas yod/ shod mgron gyis rgyun gtan sne mgron gyi ngag bkod dang len thog shod 'gag gi mdzad sgo khag gi skabs srung mdud gra sgrig dang g.yogs pa/ maṇ+ḍal rten gsum 'bul mir lag tu brgyud sprod/ mjal kha'i go rim sbrang sgrig gral bkod/ gnangs brda sogs snyan seng gi rigs zhogs ltar snyan shog 'bri rgyu/ mdzad zin dang bsngo rten gyi 'byor lan/ gzhan yang sne mgron gyi ngag bkod dang bstun nas gyod don yod na zhu ba zhu len gyis dpyad khra'i 'char 'god sogs kyi 58

yig 'bri/ rgyal tshab rin po che chibs bsgyur gang gnang la chibs zhabs su bcar dgoso pa sogs yin/ shod mgron gyi 'bab yong ni shod mgron spyi'i thab rten lo re shugs bogs phran bu dang / nyes 'bab skyed gtong gi dar dod tsam las med/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis shod mgron las khur lo gnyis byas rjes rab byung bcu drug lcagasa'abrug (1940)lo sne mgron mkhan chung blo bzang don grub mkhan drung du 'phos tshab shod mgron ngag dbang rnam rgyal la sne mgron bsko gzhag byas shing / ngag dbang rnam rgyal ni rnam kun mi gshis rling po dang / las ka sgyidasmopo yod thog de snga phyag mdzod khang gi zhabs zhu 'grub po byung ba dang blasmobrang las byed rnams dang mthun po yod la/ tsho rgyal tshab rin po che nas kyang mnyes po yod pas mi mthong che tsam yod par brten yig tshang las khungs nas sne mgron 'os khongs phul bar phyag rtags bsko gzhag gnang ba las/ dngu4 bskyal zhu tshang dang / 'go 'dren zhu brgyud sogs gtan nas byas med rored/ sne mgron gyi las don bgyid sgo ni shod gzim chung 'gag tu 'go 'doms byed sgos mtshon/ dpon rigs che phrabasko 'then skabs 'char gzhi phul 'byor la phyag rtags thon mtshams shod gzim 'gag nas bka' bsgyur gtong rgyu dang / gzhung don 'char 'phar las don khag la 'char gzhi dgos rigs bzo dgos/ gzhung sger chos bcas kyi sa mirīphyugs gsum skor ram/ gzhan yang ser skya gli dmangs nas khral rigs sogs kyi skor bkal shag dbaka yig tshang brgyud bde sdug snyan zhu 'byor rigs dang / snyod don dpyad 'char sogs snyan zhu 'byor rigs rnams 'bul brgyud dang 'brel phyag rtags thon mtshams phyir sprod bya rgyu dang / chab 59

'bangs mi ser nas 'u thug bzod bral gyis gdong zhu 'byor pa sogs kyi skor gzim 'gag tu thad kar zhib sa gnang rigs la zhu ba len rgyu dang dpyad zhib 'char 'bul thag gcod bya rgyu/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i mdzad sgo che phra'i 'char gzhi 'bul rgyu dang de'i gra sgrig 'gan 'khur/ rgyal tshab rin po che gang du bzhugs phebs su mnyam bcar thog sku phywa'i 'gan 'khur/ de bzhin skabs 'gar bka' shag dang / yig tshang sogs nas las khungs tshugs grol gang 'dra byed kyi yod med kyi lta rtogs su bskyod dgos pa sogs byed dgos/yong 'bab ni sne mgron mkhan chung la thab rten stag rtse rdzong khongs rgya ra lha khang gzhis zer ba zhig yo da kyang der ston 'bras legs min byung na byung song kha 'thab kyi med stabs slar yang tshe gling do dam mi zhu mthu med kyis sku bcar spyi mkhan ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nas 'char 'bul bzhin zhor skyong du bsko gzhag gnang ba dang / dza sag tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul dang sne mkhan ngag dbang rnam rgyal spun mched kyi 'brel bar song / nyin zhig tsha rong gis ‘‘khyed rang sne mgron gyi las 'khur yin gshis lha sar gtan sdod byed dgos pas 'khos zhan/ 'di myur sdod rgyu med par tshong 'khos thabs len zhig nges par byas na legs gnas la deng skabs sa tham du ras cha btang tshe khe slebs chen po yod gshis/ ma rtsa grwa bzhi las khungs nas snga g.yar byas na 'grig gi red ’’ces slob ston byas par sne mgron ngag dbang rnam rgyal nas thugs rje che zhus te sku bcar gzim mkhan mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin dang mnyam las kyis dza sag tsha rong bas kha theg byas te grwa bzhi las khungs nas shog dngul dngul srang lnga 'bum tham pa snga g.yar zhus nas rta drel dang ras cha rgyab brgya tham pa sa tham khul tshong 'khos su btang yang 60

'ba' khul 'byor skabs jag pas rgyab cha rta drel rang 'grigs yong rdzogs jag ded bcom 'phrog byas pa dang / de skor bka' shag tu zhu bskul byas don mdo spyi brgyud go min tang gi 'ba' sa sgor bka' mol gnang ste rku ma ngo 'phrod ngos len byas kyang rgyu dngos slog sprod skabs rta drel rgan 'khogs dang / me mda' bskul zad song ba sogs las dngos phan thogs pa gcig kyang ma spradadhestang95 zhu bskul gyi 'gro gron yang ma lon khar/ grwa bzhi las khungs su lo ltar skyed dngul srang nyis stong re sprod dgos sogs kyi dka' ngal ci che yod kyang / skabs der sne mgron mkhan chung gi ming 'khur dbang tshad de5 cwan yod stabasta g.yas lten g.yon mjal gyi nya 'ub 'dus trem byung yod pa dang / de bzhin skabs der lha sa'i rigs gsum lha khang khag gi 'gram du dmag bzlog lha khang re gsar bzhengs byed dgos stabs bka' shage nes the‘byeng rig gosum lha khang —'gram khyod chi'i khang pa rme bshig na lha khang rgyas/ yul ne+ede pas khang pa me phul na 'ogrig 7thobs med pa dang /khang tshab thad gzhung khang gang 'osadzānas zhus ne 'grig la/ yardze na sa stongs gang 'os su gsar rgyag byasana'o‘ngetrī'agrig ’’ces bshad par7kheng pa de don ltar ma 'bul thabs bral la thul chogapa dang / tshab bskyin thad nga tsho shag tshang 'khospu chung lasgrurgya che dgos gnas mi 'dug kyang / da yod sdod khang gog po sa phag khang rnying las song gsor rgyag bya 'dran yod rung 'a 'ub ma 'dus par de mur lus shimra / delin rdo shing dmangs —'ul bcas gzhung sa/nas nas rogs ram yong ba 7zhes zhus don ltar rgyu 'gro rangarkaglu gshoms kyis gsar rgyag byas pa las khang tshab sogs rgya che zhus med pa dzered/sdod khang gsarasna rgyag zin rjes khang khungs tshe gling do dam par sngar srol khang gla ma 'dzugs byas pa'i khang deb la yakhang khungs 'di rtsad gcod— bya yul 6 1

med ’ces pa'i sbug dam mchan/ 'god gnang bas khang pa ster tshong gang byed rang bdag byung yod/ de rjes stag brag rin/ po ches srid skyong gnang rjes sne mgron gyi zhu sgo 'jug po dang / las ka sgyid po/ kha tshugs zin po/brling po bcas yod pa ma zad/ nor gling nang khang yig 'bri'i zhabs zhur sdod skabs nas stag brag rin po che dang bla slob kyi 'brel ba yod pa bcas la brten/ stag brag nas mnyes po dang cha 'jog byed pa bcas kyi ngang las 'khur lo lnga byas/ mkhan drung gi las 'khur lo lnga byas skor/rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing bya (1945)lor mkhan drung twa bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen bka' blon bla mar 'phos tshab tu sne mgron ngag rnam la mkhan drung bsko gzhag bstsal bar dgongs zhu byas kyang dgongs pa ma 'khrol bas gsar mjal zhu dgos byung yod/spyi khyab yig tshang las khungs zhes pa ni ser mo yongs kyi 'go 'doms yin zhing / gzhung don che khra'i sbug dam bka' yig dang snyan zhu khag gi 'go mchan/ dgon khag gi bca' yig gsar bzo/ bla ma ho thog thu khag dang / gzhung zhabs sku ngo'i gdan thob gsar bskos kyi cho lo sprod rgyu/dgon khag tu gzhung gi 'char 'phar bsnyen bkur zhabs grub khag gi dpyad khra che chung dang / rdzong gzhis dang dgon khag gi las sne brje len byed skabs su sprod khra/ lam yig de bzhin 'char can lha sa khul dang rdzong gzhis rgya khyab tu ri klung rtsa tshig gzhung bsten bstan srung khag gi 'char 62 —

'phar lung zhu/ smon tshogs gnyis kyi mang 'gyed skal gzhung dang / mang ja'i thotshosgrig gitshogazhung khra/ ya sor gyi lagartertsa sogs 'char 'bul dang 'brel sbug dam phab 'os rigs la yig gzugalotshugs thung bris nas gzim chung du bcar te dam zhu bya rgyu dang / ga zhung zhabs ser mo ba mtho dma' yongs rdzogs go ga—nas 'os sgrig dang las tshan bsko 'then gyi 'char 'bul/'bras se dga' gsum sogs dgon khag gi las sne gzhung bkod rigs gsar bsko'i 'chur gzhi 'byor skabs zhib 'jug snyan zhus phyir thon khungs sprod rgyu/ gzhung don gal che'i skabs drung rtsisartebargyad sbrel lhan tshogasakyis bka' shag la rogayo'adegs gros bsdur dang / bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'bringabosdus gsum 'tshog skabs gtso'agan blangagate nang don gsal bshad bya rgyutshudangabasam 'char brjed tho 'bri rgyu dang 'brel snying bsdu4tshig thosnyan zhu bzo rgyu sogs kyi 'gan 'khur byed dgos/ rgyun gtan yig tsha nga las khungs su 'char ldophar las don byed dgos phud/ zhed dung mkhan drung so sor zhor skyong gi las khungs kyang yod cing / zhor skyong gilas khungs gras zhabaga'aphar las khungs su do dam 'gro res mkhan drung gcigachadang /las bya rtse dru nga gnyis/khu do dam pa sger gyi gnyer pa gcig 'bo kha ba gnyer nang gnyis/ gad pa gcig bcas yod/ mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal nas rab byung bcu drug shing bya spyi lo (1945)dang sa glang (1949) lo so sor zhabs 'phar do dam 'gro res byas shing / las khungs der 'bab yong ni pad bkod sdig stong rdzong nas lo re 'ebras khal brgya re tsam las gzha nalped/ gtong 'bru dgos rigasaljong gzhis bkar khang khag nas 'don sprod kyi bka' rgya lam yig dang sprags len pa dang /gzhan yang mar sogs nyo sgrub dgoyodangul bka' tham bka' 'dzin dang 63

'brel grwa bzhi las khungs nas len srol mchis/ gtong gron gtong yul ni gdan sa 'bras se dga' gsum dang / rgyud grwa smad stod/ lho kha smin sgrol gling / rdo brag sogs dgon khag la lha bla'i lung brtag dgongs don gyi zhabs brtan sgrub sgo khag la gtong dgos pa de dag zhib gsal zhu yas med kyang / tshod dpag byas na dngul ṭam rdo bzhi khri skor dang / 'bru ru'i khal chig khri skor tsam gtong dgos/ ngo las sger la phogs thob sogs zur du med rung / byung song kha 'thabs kyi rtsis khra 'bul skabs dang gtong sgo gtong skabs 'bo nyag tho dma'i te bag sogs kyi bar bzos phran bu 'bab pa ni lhag bsam yod med la rags las pa zhig red/mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal nas zhor skyong zhib khang do dam me khyi ( 1946) lo nas bzung lo gsum byas shing / zhib khang do dam las khungs su sku bcar mkhan che gcig dang / mkhan drung gcig mkhan chung gcig rtsis dpon gcig las bya rtse shod drung dkyus gnyis/yig skyel bang chen zhol nang (zhol pa nang zan )gcig gad pa mi gcig bcas yod/ las 'gan ni sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpal 'byor bsdu gtong las khungs khag dang / bzo las (lag shes bzo las ) 'dzugs skrun ar las/ zhabs 'phar don gcod mi sna bcas nas gzhung rtsis zhu dgos rigs kyi bsdad song rtsis khra snyan zhu bka' shag tu phul 'byor mtshams zhib mchan bkod de zhib khang las khungs su sprod pa de dag zhib khang do dam pas zhib rtsis zhu dag gis chad lhag ji byung yig thog bkod nas slar yang bka' shag tu 'bul rgyu sogs kyi las 'gan sgrub dgos/ ngo las rnams la phogs dngul phran bu zhig yod tshod kyang zhib gsal zhu rgyu med/mkhan drung so sor thab brten rdzong gzhis re yod cing / mkhan drung 64

ngag rnam gyi thab rten du mon rta dbang gnyer tshang lo gnyis (shing bya nas me khyi 1945nas 1946) lornyibar bzung zhing / de'i las 'gan ni rta dbang dgon gyi mi ser dadzobacas par khral bsdu khrims gnon bya rgyu dang /khral bsdus 'bru dngul nas dgon (rta dbang dgon ) grwar phogs thob dang dgon pa'i rgyun gtan gyi gtong sgo khag gahong rgyu bcas yin la/ gzhan yang dbyin jir sa btso nga rin zhes dbyin sgorabyudrug stong tsam zhig gzhung du 'bab kyi yod thos las/ nga tshos mtsho sna'i khongs rgya mkhar gzhis sdod blo bzang rnam rgyal zer bar lo re shugs bogs dngul ṭam rdo nyis brgya re bogs gtong byas par brten zhib gsalar+shazhu rgyu med/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me phag ( 1947) lo rta dbang dgon pa de bzhin mtha'atrī mtshams su song ngo tshab bsdad na mi 'grigs par brtsis nas rtse drung dkyus ma re btang ba dang / mkhan drung dag rnam la thab rten 'dam bla gnyer sprad pa red/'dam bla gnyer nas 'dam chos 'khor dgon dang mi ser bcas kyi chos srid gnyis ka'i 'go 'doms byed dgos/ mi ser gyi lag nas khral mar bsdus te khag gcig bkras blar 'dzul dgos pa dang / khag gcig dgon par gtong sgo gtong— dgos kyi yod pa/ sger gyi 'bab yong ni lo re mar khal brgya dang lnga bcu dzotsam dang / khrims 'bab sogs la sems can spu nag bco lnga tsam dang rartsolug brgya skor tsamatsho'abab kyi yod pa/ sgyu skabs der rgya gar khul du bal godze+eche tsam yod gshis nga tsho'i shag gis gzhan nas dngul bun g.yar te byang khul nas bal mon do chig stong lnga brgya skor nyo sgrub kyis ka sbug tu dbor 'dren tshong 'khos byas par mkhe slebs chen po byung bas de snga grwa bzhi glog 'phrul las khungs sogs nas bun len byas pa rnams gtsang sprod byed thub pa byung yod/65

gzhan yang lo ltar bod zla brgyad pa'i tshes shar du yig tshang ngo las rnams la spro chen zhes bdun gcig ring ngo las yongs rdzogs gling gar spos nas spro skyid gtong srol yod cing / de yang mkhan drung gsar 'byor nas lo de rang du gtong dgos pa dang / gsar 'byor med na mkhan drung bzhi re bskor gyis gtong dgos kyi yod pas nga tsho'i shag nas thengs gnyis gtong dgos byung zhing / thengs dang por ṭam rdo chig stong gsum brgya skor dang /thengs gnyis par nyo thang rim 'phar gyi rkyen pas ṭam rdo nyis stong skor song yod/ spro skyid gtong yul ni yig tshang ngo las tsam ma zad/ rtse skor las tshan yan dang / bka' shag 'khor bcas/ rtsis dpon bzhi/ so so'i 'brel yod sogs gzhi rgya che tsam yod pa red/shag tu 'bar rdzas 'bar gas kyi gnas tshul byung ba/rab byung bcu drug me phag ( 1kha47)lo'i nyin zhig gi zhogs pa snga po nas khams rigs 'dra ba'i mi zhig mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi thab tshang nang yong nas ‘‘sku ngo'i sku mdun bcar sa yod dam ’’zhes bshad par ma byan spo pa ske mgo mas ‘‘da lta sku bzhengs gnang rgyu red ’’ces lan btab pas ras dkar 'thum ldan gyi sgam chung zhig bcol ba dang sbrags ‘‘da lta tshong dpon phebs pa yod ’’ces bshad stabs ma byan nas sgam chung de tshur blangs te thab tshang nang 'ang pan gyi steng du bzhag cing / de nas nyin shas song yang tshong dpon zhes pa yong mkhan med stabs gnyer pa dge 'dun gyi sdod sar 'khyer te cha sgam steng bzhag pa dang de nas nyin shas song yang da dung 66

yodzomakhan megapar brten ya mtshan dgos pa byung yod/ skabagademastag brag bla brab gi rdo gcal nang yig bskyur zhig yod pa de'i narmis‘‘mdo spyi dza sagagayu thog pa nas mkhan drung ngag rnam brgyud skyabs mgonaphaskred skyong rin po cher 'bul rgyu'i gsang gnas dang / — dngos po rtsa chen zhig yod 'dug kyang de dag mkhan drung ngag rnam nas bar bzos kyis nyar te 'bul gyi med pa red ’’ces bkod yod lugs g.yog po gcig la gcig brgyud kyi go thos byung ba darīng / dzisgam chung de'i ras 'dzar thog tu'ang ‘‘gangs ljongs bstan 'gro'i srog shing skyabs mgon srid skyong rin po che mchog la 'bul lam zhu rgyu /mdo spyi dza sag g.yu thog pa nas phyag bcas phul ba'i snyan zhu ’’zhes 'khod yod stabs gnyer dge 'dun nas g.yu thog gzim shag tu 'dri skabs ‘‘chab mdo nas mi 'byor —med la dngos po —de 'dra 'bul brgyud go thos kyang ma byung ’’zhes brjod pa red/ mkhan drung ngag rnam ni rgyun gshis sgam po yod gshis gnyer pa sogs nas gnas tshul de khong la gtan nas shod nus med/de rjes nyin gtsig lha'ibacar gzim dpochu rimakhan po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin sku bcar spyi mkhan gyi bka' bsgyur mjal dar rten 'brel skabs rogs ram byed par ngo g.yog tshang ma song ste las 'brel 'jags seng du gnyer pa dge 'dun rang shag tu log yong skabs bza' zla dang phru gu nang du bsdad med pa dang / ga5dan steng bsdad rjes cha sgam steng gi sgam chung de mthong sto ‘‘ya mtshan de gang yin nam/ ban po sogs kyi ngan sngags gnod skyel byed yas 'dra min nam ’’bsams pa las/ 'arber— rdzas smren pa ni dogs pa tsam yang ma shar khar/ la thel de bkog nas kha dbye ste nang du gang yod bltas thog la thel(slar yang sbyar rgyu'i bsamo pa 'kho ra nasi the'u bkog sto rasaji'athum bshus no sa sgeyo chung kha dbye ma thag ༷zur ’’zhes pha'i sgra thon stabs lam seng 67

gdan steng du dbyug ste bros par de 'phral 'bar gas byas rkyen dngangs tshab dbang gis gdan 'gram dran med du 'gyel ba dang dran pa gsos skabs mi mang po 'gram du 'byor nas ‘‘sku zhabs gang byas song ngam ’’zhes ha las byed kyi yod pa/ yar langs dus gnyid sad pa lta bu dang / dpral ba'i thog tu skyi shud phran bu las gzhan skyon gang yang byung med na yang / khang pa'i skya ldeb dang gdung ma/ lcam shing sogs lcags tshags nang bzhin bzos yod pa/ 'bar gas bya yul gdan steng yin stabs 'bar skad shugs che byed thub med skad 'dug gang ltar gnas tshul de gsang thabs bral bar song /mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal la bshad par de mur skyur thabs bral gshis de'i phyi nyin ras 'dzar dang / sgam chung chag ro/ 'thum ras/ lcags ro bcas 'khyer te bka' shag tu gong gsal gnas tshul rnams snyan seng zhus pa las/ skabs der skyel mi su yin rtsad chod thub med na'ang / rjes su rwa sgreng bla brang jus nyes byung skabs rwa sgreng bla brang nas stag brag bkrong dmigs kyis bskyal ba ngos len zhu khongs nas ra 'phrod byung skad go thos tsam las skabs der ngos rang spo stod rdzong dpon yin pas spo bor yod stabs zhib gsal zhu rgyu med/ ser byes su dpung 'jug byed skabs kyi 'brel yod gnad don 'ga' zhig me phag (1947)lo bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / bka' blon lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje dmag 68

dpung dang bcas rgyal zur rwa sgreng rin po che rwa sgreng dgon nas lha sar gdan zhur btabab serakhyes ‘‘lto tshang rdob rdob ’’zer ba sogs nas go thos byung 'phral rwarme sgreng rin po che lhangasar gdan 'dren zhus byung na lam bar nas 'phrog rgyu yin lugs brjod par ser byes mkhan pos sog po bstan dar nas bya ba de 'dra byas tshe nyen kha'i rang bzhin yin lugs kyi slob gso byas par rdob rdob tshos nyan sem4 lta ci phamakhan phro 'dis de snga lhun grubabyurdzong tshab bsad pa'i gnas tshul byung skabs kyang bkag 'gog kho rda byas stabs mthar grwa pa mang por khrims nyes 'khur dgos byung yod pa dang / da res kyang bkeg 'gog byed bab gang la bltas kyang phyi nang dgra bo khyad par gtan nas mi 'dug na sngon la nang gi dgra bo brtul dgos ’’zhes brjod de lto tshang rgan pa'i grwa pa rnams mkhan po'i sdod shag tu shor zhing / mkhan po'i phyag mdzod nas sgo brgyab thog sgo'i ser kha'i seng nas me mda' brgyab ste grwa pa gcig bsad stabs de 'phral grwa pas 'dzems bag med par mchong ste mkhan po'i phyag mdzod bsad mas thog khar bskyod de mkhan po'ang dmar gsod btang ba dang / rgyal zugarwa sgreng rin po che se ra'i dgon gsham du phebs dzabyor mtshams grwa pa sdeb mchong gis shor yong ba grwa bzhi dmag sgar nas me mde' sbag sbag brgyab ste grwa pa bkag dgos byung ba sogs kyi don rkyen byudza khar ser byes grwa tshang nas byed gte cis 'bul zhu rtsis med pa ma zad/las sne'ang ngosabacarartemi byed pa'i ya bzung bya rtsis kho na byas stabs se ra dgon du sa gnas srid gzhung gis drag po'i dpung 'jug gis byed gte 'dzin bzung bya rgyu'i gtan 'khel te dmag don 'go 'doms bka 'a blon ka pa dang / dmag spyi dza sag skal bzang tshul khrims/ mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ rtsis dpon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ tsārtsis 69

dpon rnam sras gling dpal 'byor 'jigs med/ las bya dmag las lhun grub tshul khrims/ rtse drung byams pa bstan dar bcas grwa bzhir bca' sdod byas te dmag don las kar bkod 'doms kyis kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi dma' dpon shud khud pa 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub dang / zur khang lha dbang stobs rgyal gnyis kyi 'go dmag rnams ser shar glang chen ri zur nas bye rag shar rgyud dang / ka dang sku drung dmag sgar gyi dmag mi khag cig la ga dang ru dpon sbud sgang pa nas 'go khrid kyis bye rag gi dkyil rgyud/ ga dang dma' dpon mtsho sgo zur pa'i 'go dmag rnams nas nyang bran 'dab ngos nas se ra'i nub rgyud bcas bskor bkag byas thog da dung drag po'i bya spyod lag len bstar mi dgos pa'i thabs lam btsal 'tshol ched dga' ldan khri rin po che dang / 'bras dga' gnyis/ rgyud grwa smad stod/ gling khag bcas kyi las sne/ sbyin bdag tshong khag bcas dang / lhag par du phur lcog byams mgon rin po che nas gtong gnang mdzad pa'i phyag mdzod byams pa rgyal mtshan bcas bar mol gnang bar ched phebs kyis se byes grwa pa'i 'dod blo ltar bye rag nang thug 'phrad byed dgos zer don bzhin dus 'dzoms kyis mkhe nyen go gses ji ltar byas kyang grwa pas nyan 'jog byed kyi min lugs nyag kyang brjod par brten kha dang grwa bzhi dmag khongs nas se ra'i rgyab ri'i rgyab ngos nas 'dzegs te rtse ri len du btang ba dang /dgon nas ser byes grwa pas sngar gyi me skyogs sogs me 'phen byas yong gi yod par 'jigs bskul ched dgon gyi g.yas g.yon phyi rol du me skyogs re zung brgyab pa/ rtse ri len 'gro'i 'go dmag rnams rtse rir 'byor te grwa pa dang me mda' rgyag res yud tsam byas rjes grwa pa rnams dgon nang du bros/de rjes dmag mi dgon nang 'dzul te tshogs chen thog dmag dar btsugs pa 70

sogs byas kyang / ser byes grwa pas 'du khang nang 'dzul te sgo mnan nas bsdad/ 'on te yun ring brten thabs med stab sa byed gte re zung stag sgo brgyud bros pa las/ de byings grwa pa tshang ma gzhung sgo phye ste tshogs grol pa ltar rang 9ba/ so sor log par dmag mis me 'phen ma byas par log tu bcug de 'phral grwa bzhi nas bka' blon ngo las rnams 'byor te mi su 'dra zhig nas kyang dgon gyi dngos po rku 'khyer mi chog pa'i bkod khyab byas/de 'phralotshosobyes las sne rgan gras tshang ma dmag don ngo las mdun bcar nas mgo rgyar phyag 'tsha la dang sngar 'gyod phyis 'doms zhusnyergyu'i khas len byas thog byed gte rnams rtsis 'bul zhus te lhing 'jags byung ba dang / byed gte khag gi khang par sgo thel brgyab thog byed gte rtsis 'bul zhus pa rnams thag pas bkyigs te grwa bzhir 'khrid nas 'dri rtsad byedarnamus su byed gtso'i gras rtse nya sprul skus ser byes grwa tshang gi nang brten phur pa 'khyer bros byol song ba ser rtse sgrub khang bla brang du gsang 'byor byung bas sgrub khang bla brang phyag mdzo da nas grwa bzhir gsang bskyod kyis ‘‘rtse nya sprul sku nga tshos mgo bskor nas se rtser bsdad yod pas lam seng 'dzin bzung byed mkhan gton dgos ’’zhes zhus par grwa bzhir yod pa'i bka' blon sogs dmag don bkod 'doms pa nas phyag mdzod la legs dar kha btag a she dang /gsol ras dngul srang brgya tham pa sprad pa dang de 'phralalge nya sprul sku 'dzin bzung byed mkhan dmag mi btang ba cirnams seracertse sgrub khang bla brang du 'byor skabs dmag mis 'tshab 'tshub byas te rtse nya'i rogs zla grwa pa gcig bsad pa de'i sdigo lag dang bcas rtse nya sprul sku 'dzin bzung bsdoms ‘ bkyigs kyis grwa bzhir 'khrid 'byor gyis 'dri rtsad zhib bsher zin rjes nyin gcig byed gte mi grangs bcu skor bsdoms bkyigs thog dmag mis bskor 71

nas rngam brjid chen pos lha sar 'khrid yong ste zhol btson khang du bcugarwa sgreng gi byed gtso'i khongs nas snyung gnas bla ma gsang gcod nang rang shi brgyab/ de min rnams la zhib phra'i zhu len dang mjug sdom dpyad 'char 'god rgyu bod ljongs tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa nas byas pa ste dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan mig 'bras bton te tshe btson 'jug rgyu dang /mkhar rdo sprul sku tshe sgo tshe lcags dang bcas tshe btson gyis nor gling sku srung dmag sgar du rtsis sprod bya rgyu/ rtse nya sprul sku sogs byed gtso khag cig zhol las khungs su tshe btson 'jog rgyu/ de byings rnams tshe sgo tshe lcags yod med sna tshogs kyis bla brang khag dang / sde dpon mi drag so nam las khungs bcas la rtsis sprod bya rgyu/ rgyal zur rwa sgreng nas srid skyong byed skabs bzung ba'i rdzong gzhis dang / 'dzin dngos dpal 'byor gang na ci yod rnam/sa gzhung bzhes thog rwa sgreng bla ma sku phreng rjes phebs rnams tshogs chen sprul sku che kha'i gdan thog bzhugs rgyu las/ ho thog thu'i mtshan gnas med pa bzo rgyu bcas kyi bka' dpyad gtong rgyu'i 'char 'bul zhus par srid skyong stag brag nas ‘‘rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan gyi mig 'bras 'don rgyu'i thad deng skabs gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i sku keg la brten 'gab min ’’gyi mchan 'god dang 'brel de byings 'thus rtags bkod yod pas dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan tshe sgo tshe lcags brgyab nas nor gling sku srung dmag sgar du rtsis sprod bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi bzos thog drung rtsis dang tshogs 'thus rnams nas zhol pa las khungs su nyes can re re'i mdun dpyad khra sgrog sbyang zin 'phral thon lcag tsha nan gzhus te khungs so sor rtsis sprod byas/72

rte spyi rkyub mkhan po'i las khur byas skon/rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags stag rtso(tho195cirkya)ldor sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin 'das tshab/ — gsar pa sdakhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal bsko gzhag byas shing / skabs der mākhan drung ngug dbang rnam rgyal nasga srid skyong stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab kyi gzim chung mjal bcar gyis ‘‘nga rang skyes sbyang gnyis ka nas shes yon dman pa dang / gong sa mchog sku na phra ba sogs gang sa nas zhabs zhu rngo thogs pa yong re bral ba ’’sogs gang ci'i rgyu mtshan dang 'brel dgongs zhu thengs gnyis tsam zhus kyang srid skyong rin po ches ‘‘khyod kyis ‘gzhung sa'i zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu ni 'di phyi gnyis yod cig yin tsang lhag bsam rnam dag zhu rgyu yin lugs ’ shod myong yod mod/ da res thog tu 'khel dus dgongs zhu byed pa dedzo kha bshad lag tu 'khel ba zhig red dam ’lkuzhes dgongs 'khrug gi rnam pa lta bu bstan par brten gsar mjal ma zhu mthu med byung zhes ngag dbang rnam rgyal nas nga rang lda gsung myong / sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po ni rim pa gsum pa'i las tshan bka' blon dab gcig mtshungs yin zhing / der las tham yod pa ma zad/ rdzong gzhis rgya khyab khag la bka' rgya bka' 'dzin sogs btang chog pa'i dbang cha yod la gsham du phyag mdzod khang zhes phyag mdzod gcig dang drung yig gcig 'dzugs dgos pa dang drung yig brgyud nas las khungs khag sogs la ngos sbyor ram/ mkhan khongs mi rtsa yod rigs la mi bogs bsdu len gyi byung 'dzin/ gzhung khang khag gi khang gla bsdu len bcas —byed pa/73

gzhung gling khag la do dam bdag gces byed mi rtse drung gcig dang /gnyer pa gnyis/ lcang gcod ces lha klu skor pa mi grangs brgyad/dmangs 'ul mi grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga skor skul chog pa de dag gis rgyun du lcang ma gcod 'dzugs byed pa/ de bzhin gzhung rnam sras gan mdzod la bkar 'jug byed skabs bka' blon 'khor res dang sku bcar spyi mkhan gnyis nas sngar gyi 'bab yong kha shas bsdu len byed pa/ sku bcar spyi mkhan gyi rnam kun gtso bo'i las 'gan ni rgyun du nang ma khang du rtag bcar gyis sku bcar gsol gzim mchod gsum gyi 'go 'doms byas te tā la'i bla ma'i sku 'phya 'gan len dang / lhag par du srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes rjes gnang sgo mtha' dag la rgyus bab zhabs zhu/ bka' shag sogs nas rtse gzim chung 'gag brgyud de snyan zhu phul 'byor rigs dang / rtse yig tshang las khungs nas snyan zhu dgos rigs sku bcar spyi mkhan brgyud de 'bul dgos pa las/thad kar 'bul mi chog pas rgyun du snyan zhu'i rigs la zhib rtogs kyis 'bul brgyud byed dgos la/ spyi mkhan ni rtse yig tshang las khungs kyi 'go 'doms kyang yin stabs rtse skor las tshan che phrag bsko 'then dang / las don gal che'i rigs la mkhan drung rnams spyi mkhan gzim shag tu bcar nas snyan seng go bsdur zhu skabs snon 'phri bya rgyu sogs kyi 'gan 'khur byed dgos pa/ de bzhin bka' shag nas las don gal che'i rigs la gdan zhu byas na go bsdur 'gan 'khur bya rgyu/ rnam kun mdzod sbug dang / mdzod chung gnyis su bar seng yod tshad du bskyod de 'go 'doms 'gan 'khur gyis rtsis 'dzin sogs la sbug dam gling gsum ma zhu phab kyang byed dgos pa sogs red/sku bcar spyi mkhan gyi thab rten rgyal ston gzhis sdod lo gnyis bzung 74

zhing / der ngo tshab gcig bta nga ste yulartsodagon gyi khrims 'doms bya sgyus mtshon khraladzibosdus kyi khral mdwo nas dga' ldan rgyun mar du lha khal bcu gnyilore yod mar ltang ngo grangs nyis brgya skor dang / bla thugo las khungs su mar ltang brgya dang bdun cu skor/ sger la mar ltang nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam bcas 'bul gtong byed dgos pa dang / gzhan yang 'bru rigs sogs phran bu 'bab kyi yod kyang nges gsal zhu rgyu mi 'dug spye mkhan gyi gsol zhib ljags sgrinajizhol gnyer nas zla re khal re 'bul rba deng / rta drel spucu skor la ldedzo pi'imo'adam rtswa rtswa gnyer nas lo 'khor lor skyel dgos pa/ rta drel gyi chag chur sogs len rgyu yod 5pa red/ nga—ga dbang rnam rgyal nas sku bcar spyi mkhan gyi las 'khur byas nas lo phyed gsum song ba ste rab byung bcu drug chu 'brug (1952)—lo'i bod zla 2pa'i nang nyin zhig srid tshab gnyis nas shod gzim chung du sku bca ra spyi tsākhan ngag dbang rnam rgyal 'bod de bshad don ‘‘nged cuganyis gong sa mchog gi sku mdun du snyan zhur 'gro rim bzhin ‘spyi khyab mkhan po de da mus su las 'khur 'khyer rgyu de gang 'dra 'dug gam ’zhes bka' phebs 'dug na/ sku ngo khyed kyis dgongs par gang 'dug gam ’’zhes brjod lan du ‘‘rgyun gtan thugs la mi bab pa'i rnam pa lta bu yod kyang / sngon chad chab srid kyi go gnas dbang tsha rim par bzung ba dang / deng skabos chab srid nya—ga phra'i skabs dgongs zhu dal sdod byas na tha shal gyi byed stangs yin par bsamasanas bsdad yod/ da ris mar bka' de 'dra phechibasi pa ni dgongase zhu ༷bde po zhig byung bas layoseng dgongs zhu bya rgyu blun gyi’zhes zhus lugasang rang la gsungs myo—nga /rme— degongs zhu'i snyan zhu'i brjod don ni zol la brten nas ‘‘keg dus su slebs grabs yod pa dang / mig chab thangalpen sogs bkod 75

nas las zhabs chabs cig dgongs 'khrol yong ba dang / da phan las 'khur byed ring son khal gcig tsam 'gro ba'i sa zhing 'du 'khos bya rgyu ma byung bas da cha ma shi bar 'tsho rten gzhis khag 'os bab cig gsol ras yong ba ’’zhes bkod yod kyang / las 'khur dgongs 'khrol thog go gnas rang 'jags dang / 'tsho rten sprod dang mi sprod kyi skor lan gang yang bkod med pa red/ de skabs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe bdun yin pa/ go gnas rjes 'brel gyi chibs sgyur sogs mdzad sgo khag la ngo g.yog mang po bcar dgos la rta drel yang mang tsam dgos pa dang / chos byed sogs la 'gro bskyod mi bde ba yod stabs slar yang rab byung bcu drug chu sbrul (1952)lo las zhabs chabs shig dgongs 'khrol yong ba'i bskyar dgongs zhus par dgongs 'khrol thob pa ma zad/ ‘‘da phan khyod rang gi byas rjes thad rtse mgron rgyal mtshan bstan 'phel thog dgongs bzhes gnang rgyu yin ’’zhes phebs pa de nas bzung mkhan zur ngag rnam de nyid nas brag yer par lo phyed gnyis dang / rwa tshag tu lo gcig brag lha klu sgug tu lo gnyis bcas sku mtshams su bzhugs pa dang / me bya (1kha57)lo rgya gar khul gnas mjal du bskyod par skabs der dpal 'byor sogs gang nas phyi rgyal du sdod pa'i cha rkyen 'dzoms yod kyang rang yul du phyir log gnang /de snga lcags stag (1kha5khye)lo bcing sa 'grol dmag chab mdor phebs 'byor la dogs 'drogs kyi rkyen pas tā la'i bla mas dbus dbang sgyur dpon rigs khag gcig gro mo bar byes g.yol skabs gzim chung khag dang /mdzod che chung gi go 'doms su sku bcar gsol gzim mchod gsum nas gcig bzhag srol yod pa ltar gzan sgril brtag lung gi don bzhin spyi mkhan ngag rnam lha sar bzhugs/ gzhung lam skam thog nas krang cun krang lha sar 76

phebs 'byor thog krung dbyang gi phyag rtags dang sbrags mkhan zur de nyid ridang thog ma'i mjal 'phrad skabs krang cun krang gis gsung don ‘‘dbang 'dzin dpon rigs mtho rim tshang ma ngo tshab bzhag nas gro mor g.yol yang /khyed rang ngo ma lha— sar bzhugs par nga— chotshos dga' bsu’zhe rgyu yin ’’zhes gsungs yod/ rī sa phag (195kha)lo ngo log zing rmekhrug sngon3sa lha sa rme ru dgon du 'bras spungs bka' 'gyur bla ma'i bka' 'gyur gyi ljags lung gsan bzhes skabs rme dgon gyi drung yig sar gnas g.yar gyis bzhugs yod pas/—zing 'khrug nang dngos zhugs lta ci 'brel ba tsam yang med pa/ dper na/nga rang 'dod gcig rtse mgron rgyal mtshan bstan 'phel nor gling du sdod dgos byang ba'ang mkhyemāmed/ 'on kyang de sngon khong gis mtho rim dbang ༄'dzin gyi las ka mang po byas pas thags dogs byang ba lta bu yin nam/ra ra yang na gzhan gyis snyan khra ji zhus gang ltar ngo log zing 'khrus/ lhing 'jags gtong skabs rme ru dgon gyi grwa pa dang mnyam du ljoridzin bzung gise nor gling du btson 'jug thog btson pa khag gcig dang mnyam du kan su'u zhing chen khongs getong gnang rjes 'das grongs su gyuḍi pa bcas so/ mo tre— —— ri 77 —
ra zur ba mas rgya ma sa

stabs bar 'dum byed par 'gro 'dod byed mi dkon pa'i gnas tshul 'og nyin de'i dgong cha chu tshod brgyad dang skar ma sum cu tsamanya rim bzhi las tshab khro dga' bosartsophran ngo gtugs kyis pakod mngags byas don/ da lta sku srung dmag khag gnyis dbar 'khrug rkyen che bzo'i skor bar mol byed par khyod rang bka' shag sku tshab tu ched bskyod kyis do nub dmag khag so so rang gnas su log thabs dgos gal che zhing / skad cha shod phyogs thad 'jam rtsubro stabs bstun khyod nas blos bcad byas chog ces nan skulache bar brten mi 'gro mthu med byung zhing / lam bar bsam gzhigs skabs dmag sgar/de gnyirmes rnam kun dgra shugs yod ngomase kyi ming grags dang spyod tsub gnyis ldan yin pas da lam bstun mkhas zab nan dgos gal ma zad/ lhag par kha dang brgya dpon kho par mgo skor zhig ma btang tshe gnas lugs bshad kyang nyan shos mi yong bsam byung / go thos la kha dang brgya dpon skal bzang gi bza' zla kha dang bzhi ru las mtshan gyi bu mo yin skad dran byung bas thabs shes 'dug lham/ de nas sa gnas der bskyod cing / skabs der ca dang dmag mi rnams dmag sgar gyi phyi sgo dmartsopor mnan te rang srung zab nan byedahopa dang / kha dang dmag mi rnams drag chas spras te ca dang dmag sgar gyi mtha' bskor nas bsdad 'dug pa'i lam de'i brgyud du 'aspul thag kyang chod 'dug kha dang brgya dpon skal bzang ngo mdog༈nagyur te nga'i sar yong nas dus zing 'di 'dra'i sar ci'i phyir yong ba yin nam zhes dris byung bar ngas kho par khyod tsho sku srung dmag khagarteganyis kyi rgyu chung rkyen che'i nang 'khrug rgyag nye 'di skor bka' shaganas bar mol byed pa ra bkod mngags ltar yong dgos byung / de ni khyod tsho kha ca phyogs gnyis ko'i 'a go dmag la legs nyes 'gog dang / rgyal khrims go bskon byed dgos pa'i 79

bka' mngags yod la/ lhag par sku zhabs brgya dpon lags khyed kyis nges par shes gal che ba'i don zhig yod/ de ni bka' shag gi bka' min la nges gtan 'khel min yang mi shes/ yin na yang nang gnas bshad na khyed rang khyug tsam zur mjal zhig gnang dgos zhes bshad pa ltar slebs byung / skabs der kho par mgo bskor gtong stengs 'di lta ste/ da lam khyod tsho dmag khag gnyis thad rgyal khams mthar gtugs dgos pa'i don gnad che rigs med pa dang / lhag par kha dang grwa bzhi rgya sbyong dmag sgar rnying khungs yin pa dang byas rjes rim yod thos/ ru dpon bzhi pa las tshan skal bzang lags ni rwa sgreng phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa 'dzin bzung gang sar byas rjes ha cang yod mkhan zhig red/ khong gi byas rjes su zhi drag go smyur gyis rim bzhi'i go gnas sprad de dmag spyi khang gi las byar bsko gzhag gnang gi yod tshod/ de dang chabs cig khong gnas 'phos tshab ru dpon zhig dgos pa 'os sgrig skabs khyod rang brgya dpon skal bzang 'os khungs su 'jug gi yod tshod 'dug de'i skor gros sdur byed skabs mi re gnyis kyis ma gzhi brgya dpon skal bzang la ru dpon 'os nges yin/ 'on kyang skabs 'gar stum spyod ya yus che ba dang ngang sgug 'jam bshad mi thub pa'i skyon cha yod 'dra bas babs lhing brtan gsum yod pa zhig dgos lugs brjod pa sogs da lta bka' sdur gnang mus yin tshod 'dug pas gal te gsar 'gyur de dag bden pa yin tshe da res dmag khag gnyis kyi 'khrug 'dzing de ni khyod rang la bar chad min nam snyam pa kho bo'i rmongs 'char yin/ de ni bden pa nyag gcig yin min mi shes kyang zhib brtags bsam gzhigs gnang na legs gnas snyam zhes bshad pas brgya dpon/ skal bzang gis ngo 'dzum zhig bstan byung / go skabs de dang bstun kha dang dmag rnams do nub rang 80

gnas su log na legs zhe4bshad pa yin/ de lan kha brgya skal bzang gis mdo spyi rnying pa'i sku srung dmag gis mi mang lag mang gis nga tsho'i dmag mi kha shas netshi gson cha ma 'chis bzos pa 'di skor sdug nad theg cithabs bral lugaspu bshad byung9 bar/ ngas de'i thad sdug gyong 'khur mi dgos rbaden rgyab khrims kyis langs rgyur brten nga rang che da mngags btang gnadzo ba red/ bden pa ngar 'og tu nub mi srid/ de bas yo lang thal cha ma byung gong phyir log dgos gal che/ khyod tsho dmag sgar phyogs gnyi4kas sang nyin’lurgas mthun rgyusna rkyen zhu bar yong chog gi red/ bden don rjes 'brel khyod tsho'i dmag sgar la mtshan gsol dang / rmas ma la nad gsos sogs 'os 'tshams kyi thag gcod yong nges yin/ de bas khyod rang bzhi rtsalas tshan 'phos tshab kyi 'os 'char du yod nges bden tshe dkrog rkyen gleng ngan ma lhag pa'i sgo nas gtam don gnyis tshang yong rgyur bsam blo gtong gal che lugasartsebaṃshed pa yin/ kha brgya skal bzang gis nga la bka' phebs bzhin nga tsho brgya lding rnams gros mol gyis snyan seng zhu bar bcane chog zer/nga'i bsam dzor da ni don go chod tsam yong bzo 'duspu snyam zhing / de nas kho tsho brgya tsholding rnams yong nas do nubace bla dpon gyi bka' don 'gal med dmag mi rnams la ma go ma thos mid dzi bshad pa yin da lta phyir log 'gro grabs yod/ sa dbang chen mor (lha klu zer )zhu phyogs gang drags gnang rogs zhes bshad byung / de nas ca dang dmag sgar gyi phyi sgo 'byed du bcug ste ca dang brgya dpon kun dga'i sar phyin pa yin/ ca dang dmag mi rnams 'dzing rag chung gras khag mang po bzos nas ya lan sprad chog ang gsar byas te bsdad 'dug ca brgya kun dgas nga la rgus zhabs yod pa'i sgo nas gdano thog tu bzhag rjes ngas ca brgya kun dgar nga ni bka' shag gi 81

sku tshab tu btang gnang byung / da nyin dgung dro kha ca dmag khag gnyis mdo spyi gsar rnying gnyis kyi zhal 'og tu 'khrug 'dzing de ltar byed babs shin tu thabs rdug byung 'dug mi khri rkyen ngan gyi 'byung rtsa dmag mi re zung yin srid kyang / dmag sgar phyogs gnyis ka'i brgya lding 'go byed mi snas khrims sa tshod longs 'di dbang du ma song bar dmag khag gnyis ka rang gnas su zhi 'jam ngang gnas sdod dgos pa dang / sang nyin mdo spyi gsar rnying lhan 'dzoms thog rtsa zhib gnang rgyu yin lugs zhes bka' phebs 'dug cing / da lta kha dang brgya dpon skal bzang dang lding bcu dmag la'ang de don bshad zin pa ltar kho pa tshor gyong gun chags lugs yud brdar mang bshad mthar don snying phyir log byayosong / khyod tsho ca dang dmag sgar la mtshon na drag shugs ngo mnong mi dgos pa'i dmag sgar rnying gras shig yin la/ sku zhabs brgya dpon gang nyid kyang zhi drag gnyis thad nas 'jon thang che zhing dmag byings la 'chun 'doms 'tsho skyong byed sgo gang sar 'phyugs pa med pa gong 'og tshang mas cha 'jog bya yul zhig nas da lam 'khrug rtsod kyi gnas tshul 'di bzhin rgyu chung rkyen cher ma song ba'i bsam gzhigs mdzad dgos bshad par ca brgya kun dgas lding bcu bskong nas rang re kha ca dmag khag gnyis khongs dmag mi don ma go 'ga' shas kyis chang 'thung rgyag tshod ma zin par ra bzi 'dzing rtsod kyis phan tshun gnyis kar rmas skyon gang tsam byung 'dug pa de skor nga tshos shes ma thag tu nga tsho'i dmag mi rnams 'dzoms brda btang ste gcig kyang ma lus pa dmag sgar nang bcug pa yin/ yin na yang kha dang brgya lding dmag bcas tshang mas bhi reng ghan dang / kring gan/ de min me mda' ring thung sna tshogs 'khyer te nga tsho'i dmag sgar du kha gtad yong bas de 'phral nga tsho'i dmag sgar gyi phyi 82

sgo brgyab pa dang / srog mgo thon thabs 'og grabs mi byed mthu med byung /da cha kha dang brgya lding dmag bcas nas rgyal khrims la brtsi 'khur zhus tshe mong tshos kyang rgyal khrims la brtsi bkur dang len zhus chog pa zhes bshad byung /ngas gnad don 'di skor sang nyin zhib rtsad gnang nges red/ do nub rang gnas su log ste sang zhogs nam langs 'phral 'dzing rags kyi sa rdo med pa bzo dgos zhes bshad/ de nas ca brgya kun dgarakoraphrosa'abal byas te chu tshod skar⑫ma bcu tsam bsdad rjes phran ngo g.yogagasum phyir log gis rim bzhi khro dga'i sar phyigate gong gsal gnas tshul zhib phra bshad pa dang /lhag par kha brgya skal bzang kho pa'i rang gshis la dpag pa'i thabs shes shod phyogs mi byed thabs med skor gsalabashad ma byas tshe slad gnas tshul ji yong cha ma mchisahosnyam nas kha brgya skal bzang gobashad pa'i skor bskyar bshad byas/ khro dga' 'os bag chags bzhag 'dug thugs brje che/nga rangartetsho'i sku srung brgya dpon smyon pa kho la— (kha brgya skal bzang la zer )khye da kyi a gar so lnga de 'dra zhig (rlung nad selaba'i sman— ) ma bster na dngos 'brel gnas lugs bshad kyang go shes med mkhan4zhig red/ thugs dran rkyen po byung / skad cha des do nub phan thogs yod pa ma zad/sang nyin yang kho'i bsam blor phan thogagayong nges yin pas yag po byung 'dug 7kha ca dmag khag gnyis nang 'khrug byed pa desro'akha4'dren mtshan bshadagang minalong nges de dag zhi thabasagang legs byung 'dug ces brjod de spro dga'i rnam 'gyur ci rigs dang 'brel sne len gang gezab byas byung / de nas phran rang khyim du log pa yin/ skab sa der nga'i drel pa mi 'gyur zhes rta drel rtswa gsor btang sa nas phyir log 'dug pa dadze+edus mtshungame shing / mi 'gyur gyis nga la 'u thug bzod med kyis bshad don/83

sku ngo khyed rang spyang mjo/ga rgod mdog gi lkug rtags la/ kho rim bzhi khyi skyag 'go 'khyer gyis (khro dga' ba'i skra lcog gi bzo lta mi legs par zer )bka' la brtsis te dmag ngan de tsho'i bar du 'gro mkhan yong ngam/ grwa bzhi dmag mi zer ba ni (kha dang dmag la zer )ha go don rtogs red/ rwa sgreng la 'gro skabs de tshos dmag spyi dza sag skal tshul lags zer bar me mda' 'phen rtsis kyis gsod la khad byas ma song ngam/ nga tsho chab mdor yong skabs mar lam mal gung sha ba 'phrang du khams pa grwa rgyun la zur g.yol byed phyogs phra mor bsnyad de sa dbang gi mig gi mthong sar me mda' brgyab ste bsad ma song ngam/ gzhan yang brgya dpon skal bzang gis don med mi kha shas bsad pa go myong yod/ da res lhas skyabs te chags sgo ma bslangs tsam byung 'dug bka' shag sku tshab tu 'gro mkhan mkhan rim dang /bka' mgron so gas khyed las go sa mtho ba mang po yod/ de tsho ma btang bar sku ngo khyed la 'gro dgos zer don gang yin/ kha brgya skal bzang ni srid skyong stag sbrag gi spun nye yin na yang 'dra gang ltar de'i ltag shed byas te mi bsad rta khyer ga re byas na yang brtsad gcod gtong nus mkhan 'dug gam/ dper na lha klu chab mdor 'byor nyin der mdo spyi gsar rnying gnyis yod sar brgya dpon skal bzang gi phyu pa tshal phyu dang / kha sbyar gyon thogazhwa mo wa lan gyon te ske rag la rgya gri phor shubs btags pa de tsho nas (skabs de'i gzhung srol cha lugs min pa )kho pa ya med yin pa mngon gsal red/de dgong thob rgyu ni rim bzhis lto chas bster ba dang thugs rje che bshad pa de red/ gal te shor rgyu ni che bar ngo g.yog gi srog yin pa dang / chung sar nyes rdung sha phye rus phye bzo rgyu de red/ 'on kyang da res rlung rtas rgyugs pa red/ da phyin las ka de 'dra gnang tshe nga ni sku ngos dza sag chen mo'i (nga'i 84

pha la zer )sar zhu bar log 'gro thag chod yin zhes ngu 'bod byed bzhin du kha rdung tsha—nan zhig btang byung / mi 'gyur gyi bshad pa rnams sha tsha bhol med dang bden pa yin stabs tsi shod 'di shod ma byung / drel pa ni yul dus gang la nga rang med sar rta drel gsotshags dang / kha dngos rgyu nor kho par rtsis sprod dgos pa dang / dgra jag chom rkun la gdong len yang bhed dgos pa ma zad/ la klung sa 'gag bshag pa'i khe nyen bsam dus drel pa mi 'gyur la sngar—las mi mthong cha 'jogs che ru song ste kho par chung tsag go sdur byed pa dang de nyin ngas mi 'gyu ra la dmag sgar gnyis kyi don gnad de gzhi rkang gnad don de tsam ma che yang rgyu chuborkyen che'i nyen tshabs la bltas na chung chung yang min/ dper na khams la mdo gyi ni rgyal po dang 'dra zhing /mkhan rim ni jinang blon dang khyad med/ ngang tsam zhiṣ+ka nagremi 'gyuraci la khyod nyid chung dus lo bcu gnyis tsam nas nga'i g.yogangapor yodzob dang /sha tsha zhing blos bkal chog pa zhig yin pas nga tsho ngo g.yog rnames kyi rgyu dngos dang / rta drel khyed rang drel pa'i lag tu bzhag pa yin/ — dber narmo lung pa zhig shu rgyu nor bcom mkhan zhig yong na nga'i bsayopar khyod kyis rang srogablos gtong byed kyi red bsams kyi yod/ da’ lamatsād mibasam 'cha ra yadze+eng rang la sha tsha'i semaga'akhur byas pa zhig rang red/ — 'on kyang dza drag gal che 'gag 'phrang la thug dus rogs phan gang thubs byasatshe mi tshos rang la yid ches cha 'jog byed stangs phran bu'i khyad par yong thub/ khro dga' bo ni gzhung tshozhabs bgres gras yin pa dngaka las go 'pher poyod pa/ gong 'og tshang mas gdeng 'jog chen po byed pa ma zad/ mdo spyi'i (lha klu'i )dbu 'ogodapung pa lta bu yin pa ma zad mi brtan po yod skad kyang go myong yod/ khro dga' bo'i kha la nyan pas dmag khag gnyis dbar don 85

go tshang tsam byung / 'di skor dka' nyen phran bu 'phrad kyang / phyis 'byung gang ci'i bya bar legs slob zhu sa'i gnad cig mthong dgos bshad par mi 'gyur blo mos byung song / de rjes dmag khag gnyis kyi don rkyen rang yal la 'gro thabs mdo spyi gsar rnying gnyis kas nang slob gnang bas 'thus pa dang khro dga' nged gnyis 'brel ba zab tu gyur stabs phan tshun 'gro 'ong byed 'go tshugs/ nyin zhig nga rang khro dga'i nang du bos nas mdo las rnams sho dam mi 'gro'i thad zhu 'tshang yod pa dang / legs gras rnams thab rten (mdo spyi dang mkhan chung rim bzhi bka' drung bka' mgron sogs mthong chen bye sar bdam lam )la 'gro ba sogs khyed kyis mkhyen shag red/ 'di lo'i dus tshod lo phyed tsam song zin pa dang / phyi lo phebs khungs gang 'os shig tu 'os 'bul zhus chog sa chen (lha klur zer )khyed la gzigs rkyang chung ba ni e yod snyam par 'dug ces bshad byung / ngas khro dgar sa che'i thugs rjes mi 'dor yang / rgyal bka' blon po'i bsgyur phyogs yong rgyur brten skyabs khongs nas mi 'dor ba'i re bcol zhus/nyin shas mtshams nga rang la 'ba' snyug gru khul gyi sho khral bsdu dam bskos byung / de ni sa thag ring ba dang 'ba' mtshams yin stabs nyen khar 'dzems nas bogs gtong byed rtsis byas kyang / khro dga' bos nga la ma gzhi khral bsdu'i sa khongs chung gras yin pas 'gro rin med pa ltar yin rung khyod rang ngo phebs gnang na legs lugs zhes bshad byung / 'gan babs ni sho khral bsdu len dang khul de'i gnas tshul ji yod chab mdor snyan 'bul zhu dgos shing / me phag bod zla bdun pa'i nang chab mdo nas 'ba' la thon par lam 'gor nyin nyi shu tsam song rjes sho bsdu'i sdod gnas 'ba' spyi rdzong sgang zhes 'dri chus bcad pa'i sa gnas der 'byor/ me phag zla dgu 86

pa'i tshes shar du 'ba' la bskyod de gnas tshang khang ltag legs tshang zer bar bsdad/ nyin der 'ba' chos sde dgon pa'i las sno dang / la ga bla zeng /ri mda' ra mkhon zur bla brang— / 'jun bla brang zer ba sogs kyi las sne gnyer phyag rnams ja chang bskyel bar 'byor/ khong tshos ja chang skyel don ni/ snyug shod gru kha/ gru kha rong / bcu dpon shis gru kha/ gsang ba khe smardod ko sa/ 'bum stod smad bar gsum bcas (khulader rgya sde gsar mchod zero ) sa gnas de rnams brgyud kho tsho'i tshong 'grul 'gro 'ong byed dgo4pas red/ phyi nyin hu'u thon krang gis li zhan san tshozer ba'i —skye ju khungagader mdo yin pa zhig btang 'byor gdong phag sha/ bya sgong / sngo tshal sna tshogs bcas bskur 'dug hu'u thon krang la mjal lan sprode par nga ra nga gi ngo tsharba g.yog por btang ba'i gdong tha mag lam dzer kran shog sgam gcig sbasalig gi stod thung bzo ldengagacig thaskur/ de rjes hu'u thon krang gis nga rang mgron 'bod byas te thug 'phrad skabs rgyabyu bod sa mtshamayosngar yode skor dang 'brel zab 'cham mthun yag po yong ched ar 'thung smorne tshig tsam las zhu don gzhan dag med/ ru — — mdo spyi lha klu cheb mdor phebayolam mal gro gung dkar she ba 'ophrang du khems pa grwa rgyun mi grangs bzhi lnga tsam zhig tsha phog rgya—ga sdod skabros lha klu sa gnas de rgyud phebs pa dang dus mnyam shing/ mdo spyi'i sku srung kha dang brgya dpone skal bzang ni rang gshis smyon rtsa 6sa ltar gtum —spyod che kha ne/skabs der mdo lju'ilha klu sgug ra byed mkhan se re'i grwalho me phyin lugis glernga phyoges kyi dogs pa'i rkyen dbang yin na'ang 'dra/ kha brgya skal bzang dnge ge rgyun de tsho'i dbar dbus khams skad lugs mi 'dra bas go brda ma 'phrorda pa ji yin gang ltar sku srung kha dang brgya dpon skal bzang gis sa gnas de 87

rang du me mda' brgyab ste khams grwa mi gnyis bsad pa dang / de min mi gsum 'dzin bzung byas te khrid nas kong po rgya mda' rdzong sdod shod drung rgyal grong nang so bar rtsis sprod byas pa red/ grwa rgyun de tsho 'ba' chos sde dgon gyi grwa pa yin pa dang / pha yul 'ba' gling dkar shis (grong tsho de ni rkun jag gi lte gnas ming can )nas yin pas/ gong gsal grwa rgyun de tsho'i khyim bdag dang gnyen mtshan nye ltos rnams nas nga rang 'ba' la 'byor ba'i go skabs dang bstun te mi bsad la stong dang rgyu shor la 'jal zhes pa da res spyi rdzong sga khral (snyug gru sho bsdu'i ming )nas len dgos/ gal srid ma sprad tshe khams srol sha lan len dgos zer ba sogs (srog lan srog 'jal gyi )'og grab byed lugs 'jigs bskul gtam len lhag 'dug pa ma zad 'ba' la ga bla brang gi phyag mdzod dang phran 'brel ba phran bu yod pa mda' ra mkhan zur bla brang gi tshong mdzod gcig 'thus chos chung ye shes zer ba gnyis nas phran la brda 'byor byung zhing / 'ba' chos sde dgon pa'i nang du khong gnyis su rung gi bla brang nang du sdod dgos zhes bshad byung / yang nga rang gi gnas tshang yin pa'i khang ltag legs bshad kyi nga la bshad don/ nga tsho'i yul gyi srol lugs la 'grul pa drag zhan che chung khyad med gnas tshang g.yar rjes bza' 'thung sne len gang yag byed dgos shing / gal srid 'grul pa re gnyis kyis dang po gnas tshang 'di ru sdod pa dang / nyin shas mtshams gzhan la gnas spos byas tshe grong mi tshos gnas tshang de la 'phya smod ngan pa byed nges yin/ khyed rnams nga'i nang bzhugs tshe nga rang yang dga' tshor chen po 'dug yin na yang skad cha snyan po mi 'dug gling dkar shis pa tsho gcig gis sha lan len dgos zer ba sogs shod lugs ngan pa yod nges red/ gan sa skabs khyod rnams chos sde dgon nang du gnas spo 88

mdzad tshe r+ṣadaga' bsam bzhin yod ces bshad byung / ngas gnas spo dgos donomed kyang sems 'jags byed kyi yin zhes bshad/ kho tsho phyin rjesrong tsho ngo g.yog mi lnga sems 'tshab ngang gnas kyang phyi tshul du nyams snang med khul byas/ skabs der nga tsho ngo g.yog rnams bsam kros bsdur skabs la las chos sde dgon par spos na legs zer/ la las hu'umathon krang sar spos na legs zer/ la las sku ngo do nub khams chas rtsag rul gyon te phyir log byas na zer ba sogayol drel pa mi 'gyur gyis de 'dra byed dgos don med gtam don gang sar bsam blo gtong dgos/ snyug spu rgyud du sa srung ta dang dmag mi brgya khag gcig yod/ nga rang do nub drel gcigaphyir log byas tshul kha g.yar gyis sa srung ta dang brgya depon kun dgor gnas lugs bshad de dmag mi gang latshamagoshig phebs bsur gtong rogs zhes brjod na snyam/ de'i bar khyod tsho gnyer gzim tshos thon gra sgrigs te dmag mi 'dir 'byor 'phral bza' btung 'tshims nges shig sprad rjes da lta chagre mdo nas rbaka' brgya gal che zhig 'byor tshulatshi la kha g.yar te layoseng phyir log byagane leg sa zhes bshad byung / skabs der gnas tshul nyen kha che tsam yod/ nga rang gi bsam tshul la'ang3g.yog po'i bsam gros na—nga nas mi 'gyur gyis bshad par mos pa byung ba de yang 'phral phan phugs gnod yong rgyu ste/ gnas tshul de dag brgya dpon gyis ru dpon la bshad/rme ru dpon gyis mda' dpon la bshad/ mda' dpon gyis chab mdor bshad pa'i brgyud rim de dganganang khor yug mi sna'i sgro 'dogs kyis nga rang la ming bshad yong rgyu smos ci mdo spyir yang mtshan bshad byung tshe gzigs pa mi lesas pa yong nye na che snyam nas bsam blo mang tsam btang mthar/ gdornga thug dragapos dgra bo 'dul dka' bas/ sna tshogs thabs kyi 'du na mas 89

rlabs kyis dpyod zer ba ltar zla gras tshor rang rang blo nus la gzhigs pa'i bsam gros bsdur ba gang legs kyang nga'i bsam tshul la sang nyin chos sde dgon pa'i las sne dang bla brang khag gi gnyer phyag hrag bsdus shig 'bod 'gug gis sngon la kho tshor gnas lugs yong rkyen zhib phra bshad de kho tsho brgyud 'ba' gling dkar shis pa tshor go brda 'phrod nges shig byed du 'jug dgos/ der yang khong tshos ma nyan tshe sa srung ta dang dmag mi'i brgya dpon la lab na 'tshams shing / gal srid 'dzing res thug tshe des rkyen rgya bod dbar 'khrug rkyen yong shas che/ 'di skor 'os shing 'tshams shos ni tshe nag blo bzang dang / spom mda' rgya 'gag phyag mdzod ji ling a song gnyis sar bang mi zhig btang na nyung mthar rta pa brgya skor gcig gtong rgyu ni blos 'gel chog pas/ gal te 'khrug gzhi che tsam byung yang rgya sde nang khul yin pas rgya bod dbar 'khrog rkyen zer ba'i gleng lhag yong don med/de min don phan yong rgyu med par ngo gso byas yud kyi rgyu las med ces bshad par/ tshang mas de rang legs zhes gros thag bcad/ de nub dogs zon byed bzhin gnas/ phyi nyin 'ba' chos sde dgon pa'i las sne dang / bla brang khag gi gnyer phyag hrag bsdus shig 'phral du yong dgos 'bod mi btang ba ltar 'byor byung / kho tshor sne len gang legs zin rjes da lam 'ba' gling dkar shis pa'i khungs med gleng lhag 'di skor don rtsa che rigs min yang / nga tsho'i khor yug tu gnas pa'i mi snas do snang byed dgos pa zhig chags 'dug nga tshos bsam gzhigs byed dgos pa zhig ni mdo spyi lha klu me phag zla 4pa'i tshes 2 2nyin lha sa nas chab mdor phebs pa'i lam 'khel mal gro gung dkar sha ba 'phrang nang 'ba' nas yin pa'i grwa rgyun mi lnga tsha phogs brgyab ste sdod bzhin yod pa de tshor skad brda ma 'phrod pa yin nam sku srung 90

brgya dpon gyi hod thal shor ba ji yin gang ltar sa gnas de rang du mi gnyis la sku srung brgya dpon ngo mas me mda' brgyab ste rkyen lamo btang ba dngabyu 'phros mi gsum kong po rgya mda' rdzong bar khrid de rtsis sprod byas pa'i don rkyenasgyubyung ba dngos don yang / rang nyid skabs der mdo spyi lha klu'i phebs sgrig do dam pa yin gshis lhan bcar ma dgos pa nyin gcig gam gnyis kyi sngon tsam la thon te rangapa'akhri'i 'gan 'bab las ka byed dgos pas gnad don de dang 'brel ba rtsa ba nas med/ 'on kyang khungs med 'chal gtam gyi gleng phyogs 'di thad khyed tsho brgyud gling dkar — shis pa tshor ma go ma thos med pa'i ga ses grol thengs gcig byed dgos 'dug pa de yang gling dkar shis pa tshos blang dor ma 'dzol ba'i bsam gzhigs dgos gal che lugs gsungs rogs gnang / gal srid mi gsod gyod gzhi'i skor rtsod gleng nges par dgos’na mdo spyi sa dbang lha klur bde sdug snyan seng zhus tshe bden pa bden thog tu 'khyol khes la ngas kyang zhu sna byed 'os dam don byas chogade min kho bo rang nyid kyi thog nas sha lan len rgyu'i 'dun pa nyag gcig tu bcangs tshe tshe nag blo bzang ( 'di ni skabs de'i jag pa g.yer chen rgya sder gzhis chags shig )dang ji ling a song ('di rmar khams rdzong khongs rgya sgag gzhis sdod grags can mi sna zhig )gnyis sbran te bar dpang byed bcug thog gling dkar shis pa dang 'phros mol bya rgyu ma zad/ slad 'ba' chos sde dgon so/gas gling dkar shis pa dang 'brel yod rnams bod phyogs tshong 'grul la ma gnasargyamajal 'gro mi dag kyang dogs zon byed dgos pa'i don rkyen yong nges sogs zhib lhong bshad de phan tshun rtsod rnyog mi byung ba'i go brda sprod dgos pa'i gsal bshad byas pa ltar de 'phral gling dkar shis pa'i sar bang mi ched btang zhib mol byas shing / de'i phyi nyin 'ba' chos sde 91

dgon pa'i las mdzod gnyer bcas nga'i sar yong ste mda' ra mkhan bla brang gi chos chung ye shes zhes pa dang / 'jun bla brang gi mdzod rnying dbang rgyal lhun grub ces pa gnyis gling dkar shis su btang bas da nas bzung gnad don de skor khyed la thugs dogs nam yang dgos sa med/ nga tsho 'dir yod rnams nas 'gan len byas chog ces bshad de de'i skor le 'khon med tsam byung / rmar rdzong khongs rgya sgag gzhis sdod ji ling a song dang tshe nag blo bzang phran dang 'brel ba yod pa kho nas le 'grig byung ba ma gtogs skabs der 'ba' snyug shod gru khar sa srung dmag mi bcu shog re rgyun sdod lam srol yod kyang 'ba' khul rkun jag mang bas lag mda' gcig kyang khyer mi nus pa'i nyen kha che tsam yod pa sogs khrims lugs brtsi med kyi gnas tshul tshabs che yod/de'i dus 'ba' khul bca' sdod a ri'i bud med gnyis yod pa ste rgan pa'i ming la sa'u si jab zer ba dang / gzhon pa'i ming la sa'i si keb ṭan zer 'dug bud med de gnyis kyi skad sgyur bod rigs brtson 'grus zer ba de brgyud khong gnyis nas tha mag ko lo phe kren shog sgam gcig dang / ku shu sogs shing 'bras sna tshogs do gcig tshal rigs sna tshogs phran tsam bcas skur nas nga'i sar 'tsham 'dri byed par btang ste nga rang nyin gcig kho tsho'i sar spro 'cham du yong dgos zhes bshad byung ba ltar ngas bar seng zhig la yong rgyu'i khas len byas/ de nas nyin shas song mtshams slar yang skad sgyur brtson 'grus nga'i sar btang 'byor byung bas de nyin nga rang ngo g.yog mi lnga brtson 'grus mnyam du khong tsho'i sdod gnas su bskyod/ kho tsho'i khang khyim sgo'i nang g.yas g.yon dang / rgya khyon gang 'tshams yod pa'i khor yug tu me tog dang 'bras ldan ljon shing sna tshogs kyi dri zhim 'thul bzhin 92

'dug de nas kho mo gnyis kyis lam sna khrid de mgron khang du 'byor zhing /ngas kho mo gnyisaphro 'tshams rtags wa lpags mgo yug sbyar ma gnyis sprad pa dang khoḥmocho gnyis dang spyir btang gleng molasmophran bu byas/ de rjes thengs gnyis pa 'bod 'byor skabs nga rang phyin par sngar bas cung zad yag pa'i sne len byas te nga'i g.yog po rnams kyang mgron khang du sdod du bcug nga rang sa'i si keb ṭan zhes pa'i bud med gzhon nu de'i nang du kho mo gnyis dang skad sgyur bcas mnyam sdod byed skabs rol rtsed la dbyings bzhin par god bro'i gtam gleng 'dri bshad phran tsam byas pa brgyud/ bud med rgan pa sa'u si jab ces pas nga la kho mo gnyis deng skabs 'ba' la sdod pa ni/ kho tsho'i rgyal khab nang gi chos lugs las don sbyin gtong dge sgrubasmobyed mkhan zhig yin/ der brten 'ba' khul du khyim 'dzin gzhis chagasasmobyas te 'ba' dang nye 'khor gyi mi su rung la sman rin mi len par sman bcosu byed pa dang / pha ma med pa'i dwa phrug rnams gso skyong byed pa/ gza' 'khor re'i nang la kho tsho'i chos lugs ye shu'i chos bshad thengs gnyis byed pa/chos bshad nyan mkhan la chos yon du dngul phran bu sprod pa sogs kyi byed tshul bshad byung ba dang / 'ba' khul mi ser tshos kyang yang rin (a mi ri ka )lam lugs kyi chos de yag po 'dug ces kho tshor dga' po byed lugs bshad byung / ngas khyod gnyis nas dge sgrub sbyin gtong gi bya ba de ltar byed pa'i gron dngul a ri'i gzhung phyogs nas gtong ba yin nam zhes dris lan du sa'i si— jab zer bas nga la gzhung phyogs rang gi dmigs bkar btong ba ma yin kyang / gzhung phyogs mi sna che gras yin pa'i chos lugs pa tshos gtong gi yod ces bshad byung / yang5kho mos khong gnyis da din 'ba' khul du chos bshad dang / sman bcos/ dwa phrug gso nyar byas te 93

bsdad pa ltar chab mdor bsdad chog pa zhig zhu rtsis yod pas de don zhu phyogs thad su brgyud zhus pa legs dang bya thabs gang dgos sogs rogs ram dang nang slob byed dgos bshad byung / skabs der nga'i bsam par a ri'i chos 'chad mkhan kho mo gnyis kyis 'ba' khul mi ser la sman bcos dang / chos bshad/ sbyin gtong / dwa phrug gso skyong byed pa bcas ni bslu brid dang mi sems 'gugs thabs byas pa'i ngos 'dzin dang / lhag par chab mdor yang 'ba' dang 'dra ba de ltar byed pa'i 'char bkod yod pa de'i dmigs sems gang yod zur tsam shes thabs byed da gos snyam zhing /ngas kho gnyis la tshod bgam gyis bshad don khyed gnyis da phan 'ba' khul mi ser la dge 'grub sbyin gtong byed sgo de ni bod kyi chos lugs dang yang mthun shas chen po 'dug kyang rgya sde dang bod sde'i bar la mthun rkyen dang 'gal rkyen gang thad nas mi 'dra zhing / 'on kyang skye bo su zhig yin rung phan bder mi dga' ba med/ khyed gnyis chab mdor 'gro sdod chog pa mdo spyi lha klur zhu phyogs thad/ rmar khams sa srung ta dang mda' dpon sde dge sras brgyud zhus tshe bod kyi gzhung srol 'gro lugs dang mthun te yag po yong lugs bshad pa yin/ der kho gnyis kyis nga la khyod rang brgyud de zhus na mi chog gam zhes dris byung / ngas kho gnyis la dmigs bsal mi chog zer ba med kyang / khyed gnyis kyi don de bsgrub par byed pa'i zhu phyogs dang thabs shes nga las ta mda' yag gi red ces bshad/ nyin de'i phyi 'char sa'i si keb ṭan zer bas nga la 'dra min gyi rnam 'gyur mtshon par byed pa'i gtam brjod dang bcas lag 'dogs chu tshod o lo man/ dba' ṭi mi krigawa ṭar phub zer ba gcig dang / rgyang shel gcig ka'o ya ko gcigaskad par gcig bcas rin pa mi dgos par mtshams rtags yin zhes u 94

tshugs kyi sprad byung / dngos po de rnams a ri'i khul du yago gras gong chen ma red/ thugs 'dzems gnang mi dgos zhes skad bsgyur brgyud bskyel bar btarnga ba bzhin blangs pa yin/ de rjes nga rang 'ba' nas bod sar skyar log byede rgyu'i snga nyin sa'u si jab dang / sa'i si keb ṭan gnyis kas kha lag btang ba dang / nan mngags byas don/ khong gnyis chab mdor yong sdod chog pa 'i zhu phyogs dngartsethabs sheso gang yong byed dgos/ de ltar yong bzo 'dug tshwa khornga gnyis sar bang mi do rgatan zhigo yi ge bskyel bar gtong dgos/ 'gro song gtong yis gser ṭam tog tsamartsobaskur rtses yod/gal srid don de dus thung nang yoji bzo mi 'dug na yi ge kha gsal gtong dgos pa las da res dga' po byasronas sprad pa'itshodangos pornade dag phyir bskur mi byed rogs/ de min khyod nas nga tshor rogs ram byed rgyu gzhen dag yod ces bshad byung don ngas kyang khas len byas dorna ltar de rjes nga rang chab mdor 'byor skabs ngas ris bzhi khro dga'— bor 'ba' la gnas tshul lhag stangs dang / a ri'itshobud med gnyis kyis chab mdor bsdad chog pa'i zhu phyogs rogs ram byed dgos zer ba'i gnas lugs zhib phra bshad lan dukhro dga' bos nga la de 'dra byung tshe phyi rgyal gyi dus babs 'pho 'gyur gyi gnas lugs shes thabs phan cha phran bu yong srid kyang dgon pa dang grwa pas rnyog dra bzo srid pa dang khyed kyang tsho smad tsha sho mkhan chung bsam mkhar ba'i mirtse'agro'i las 'brel rdu bsko gzhag gnang zin song bas sa gonas su thon dgos stabs a ri'i bud med gnyis kyi gnas lugs rob bsdus shig sa cher (lha klu zer )zhus te bka' gsal thon babs la lta dgos bshad byung / de nas nga rwang slar yang 'ba' slug grur las mjug bsdu bar 'gro skabs 'ba' la yod pa'i ari 'i bud med de gnyis glo bur du bod sa tsha kha lho brgyud shang 95

kang du phyir log zin 'dugade nas sa glang bod zla brgyad pa'i nang mdo spyi lha klu'i bka' bkod ltar phran la 'dan ma tsha sho'i ming 'khur thog skye mdor yod pa'i gung khran tang gi dmag dpung mi grangs dang drag chas ji yod sogs phyi nang bzo cho rtog zhib dang / gzhan yang skye mdo'i khor yug gi sa babs gnas stangs dang / 'dan ma nas skye mdo'i bar lam thag nye ring sogs rtogs zhib byed sgo'i las 'gan 'khur ba dang / skabs der phran la gsang 'phrin gtong deb gcig kyang rtsis sprod byas byung / phran ngo g.yog sde dge mdzo mdar ga mda' dkar byung ba dang / skam thog tsha sho lha klu'i mdzod pa bkra shis rab brtan gnyis sar sa mtshams yas mas kyi gnas tshul gtong len skor 'brel mol rjes ldan ma 'dam thog dpon tshang du gnas sdod skabs chab mdo nas ang bsgyur drung tog blo bzang tshul khrims dang / rlung 'phrin gtong mkhan 'bras ljongs pa bsod nams rdo rje dang / rgya gar ba ra na bha tu zung rlung 'phrin yo byad chabs sbrags thog go 'jo nas snyan 'bul rta shad tha dang dmag gnyis dang bcas mnyam 'byor byung / phran la gnas tshul rtog zhib byed sgo'i las 'gan sprad pa tsam las/ gron dngul gtong dmigs cha rkyen gang yang sprad ma byung yang / khul de'i dgon pa'i grwa pa dang / mi ser tshong rigs bcas kyi khongs su skye mdor yod pa'i rgya rigs gsar rnying dang / phan tshun 'gro 'ong dang 'grim 'grul 'brel gtugs ji 'gab brtsad zhib byas par 'dam thog tu sdod pa'i lha skyabs zhes pa dang /khang gsar 'chi med tshe ring gnyis zhing pa mi ser yin pa dang / khong kanyis skye mdo dang / ldan ma yul khag gnyis po'i yul mi dbul phyug rnams la che bstun chung 'dris dang / lhag par skye mdo'i rgya rigs gsar 96

rnying dang / gung khran tang gi khrod du'ang ngo shes 'brel ba yod mkhan zhig yin pa go thos byung / der brten khong gnyis la 'brel ba 'dzugs slad so so'i 'dod blo dang mtshams pa'i tshong dngos rtsag rtsig nyo tshong byas pa dang /ko gru'i 'grul lam chung sa'i sho btso'i ngo tshab ming 'khur sprad de tshong 'grul la zhib bsher byed bcug pa/ lha skyabs zhes pa'i bu mo dang / 'bras ljongs bsod rdor gnyis gnyen sgrig gi bar mol byas pa brgyud skye cha/do'i gsar 'gyur 'tshol bsdu'i mngags gdams byas shing / kho pa gnyis nas gsang don gzhan gyar mi 'byung ba'i khas len dgos lugs dang / skye mdor sdod pa'i kho pa gnyis kyi gnyen nye —rgya bod re zung yod pa de dag gis bod sar gnas skabs ring gser bsngog 'don chog pa dang / khyod —la gser dgos mkho mchis tshe yul thang las drag tsamatshobyas te btsong chog brjod pa ltar khas len byas pa ma zad/ gsang don phyir gyar mi yong ba'i khams srol mna' shag bsgrigs shing / de nas nyin shas mtshams lha skyabs kyis brjod don/ 'dam thog nas skyetshomado'i bar sa dbyibs lam thag gi shog lho zhig sprad de/ skye mdo'i gung khran tang gi 'go gtso li'u da'e sis yon zhes pa dang / de 'og mi gnyis/ de min mi grangs nyi shu rtsa gsum dang dus rgyun 'gro 'ong gtan 'khel med pa'i mi bzhi yod khongs mirtsoganyis bod rigs yin pa/ me skyogs che ba skyon can gcig dang chung ba gsum/ thung mda' hre lan gsum/ ring mda' bco brgyad/ tar gtong yo byad cha tshang bcas yod nges yin pa dang / dus rgyun du tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa dang /de min tshal zhing gsar sbol sogs ngal rtsol kho na byed pa/ lto gos la yag gnas med pa/ gung khran tang ni dmangs gtso gsar pa'i ring lugs kyi 'go khrid pa yin zhes rang lugs la bstod bsngags dang / lugs rnying la 97

ngan dmas byed pa/ btsan rgyal dang / dpon ngan/ bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin bcas rtsa med bzo dgos zer ba/ dgon pa'i las sne bla sprul dang / yul gyi 'go dpon la mthun lam byed khul tsam las/ gnya' gnon bshu gzhog gtong mkhan zhes 'khon 'dzin yod pa zhig yin tshul bshad byung / de rjes 'chi med tshe ring skye mdo nas phyir 'khor skabs shod phyogs 'dra min tsam las gong mtshungs yin pa dang / go lag kha grangs 'dra po med na'ang / skye mdo'i yul mi'i nang du gleng phyogs khag gnyis yod pa ste/ gcig ni rgya gsar gung khran gyi lam lugs ha cang sdug po yod pa dper na/ rgan 'khogs tshang ma lo na gzhon du gtong ched sa sbas gtong dgos zer ba dang / dge sdig blangs dor mi shes par pha mas phru gu gsod pa sogs/ phru gus pha ma gsod pa sogs kyi lugs ngan dar spel byed mkhan red ces zer ba dang / gcig shos ni gung khran lam lugs 'og gnya' gnon bshu gzhog dang bran g.yog lam lugs med cing 'dra mnyam rang kha rang gso yin la da yod rgyu dngos bgo bsha' rgyag gi yod tshod ces dbul po rnams ni 'di yag tu gang 'gro las sdug tu mi 'gro gtan 'khel red zer ba sogs gsar thos byung ba'i gnas tshul rnams chab mdor btang lan da dung gang ci'i gnas tshul nyul zhib mu mthud byas te snyan zhu dus thog tu 'bul dgos gsal ba dang / rim bzhi las tshab khro dga' bos (mdo spyi'i 'og rgyun las gtso 'gan 'khur mi gnyis yod pa nas gcig yin pa )phran la nang yig btang 'byor nang rang gnyis nye sngon ngos mjal skabs zur tsam zhus don ltar sa che'i (lha klu )dgongs gzhir gnas skabs rgya phyogs la dpung snon ma 'byor gong skye mdor dpung 'jug byas te skye mdo khul de tshur len thub 'char yod na'ang gong rim nas phyir phebs ji yong 98

nges med stabs gnas skabs der bstun snyan 'bul mdzad phyogs dgos gal zhes gsal khar yi ge me ltar ram (mer sregs gtong ba'i don )zhes 'byor byungari/ de rjes chab mdonas btang rta shad gdong bka' rgya 'byor don du mkhyen pa nam mkha' ltar yangs pa'i skye mdo'i sa 'go rnyingahopa zi ling rma kromāyon mchog la zhes bris pa'i yige dmasbyar zhig 'a dug pa de ni gal gnas shin tu che bas rma kron yon ngo ma'i lagatu 'phrod thabs byas te yig lan— de 'phral chab mdor rta shad ched gtong byed dgos gas la don ltar 'chi med tshehoring bskyel bar btang nas phyir 'khor skabs brjod don/ ma kron yon ni phyi tshul rgya gsar gung khran tang dang mnyam za mnyam sdod lta bu snang yang / nang donasbyin lto skul las byed pa dang / bzang btson min tsam gyi gnas su gyar 'dug der brten kho par yege sprod stangs mi shes par nyin gnyis 'gor song / kho par yi ge sprad par bltas rjes lam seng dbrel9 te yig lan ni med zer ba dang khyed tshos gra sgrig yag po byed dgos zer ba las lab lan gzhan dag slog ma byung yang / gung khran tang nang la kho pa'i ngo shos shig yod pa des bshad don la gzhigs chu da lta lho nub dmag srid uyon lhan khang gi bka' med pa dang / dmag dpung yang 'byor med stabs dugotshod shod thag mi chod kyang lo 'di'i nang la yong bzo med pa dang / phyi lor bod mi dmangs bcings 'grol gtong rgyu ni nyo lam gtan 'khel lugs tshig thag bcad chog gi red ces dang / nga tsho yang tshes cha gtan 'khel ma song yang ldan sgrol ma lha khang du 'gro dgos 'dra ba4lam phyogs thad bod sa'i dmar sprin ko sa'i 'khyags zam brgyud dgos yod pa las de min 'gro lam med tshul dang / de ni rjes su 'byor rgyu'i dmag dpung la zan shing dang bza' chas spus tshong gra sgrig gi dril bsgrags tshogs 99
