'du bskong tshogs byed dgos par brten gnas skabs dgos gnas gnang dgos mi 'dug ces bshad byung ba rnams lha klur snyan seng zhus par lan btang 'byor ma byung dbar zla bcu gcig nang gi nyin gcig zhogs par 'dam thog dpon rgan gyis brjod don da lta gung khran tang gi dpon dmag rta pa mi grangs nyi shu skor zhig go mtshon me skyogs sogs 'dra min 'khyer te 'dam thog gi thad ka'i 'bri chu pha ri'i grong tshor 'byor zin 'dug pa dang /khong tshos 'dam thog dpon dang / dgon pa'i las sne 'go 'dzin gyi 'thus mi kho tsho'i sar yong dgos zhes lan brda btang 'byor byung bas ji ltar byed dam zhes bshad byung / de lan lam seng dgon sde'i 'thus mi'i ming 'khyer mi chog cing / khyod tsho mi gnyis gsum tsam phyin kyang chog ngas 'di gar kho tshor nyin gung tsha phogs stabs bde zhig gra sgrig byas yong / 'dam thog tu nga'i sar khong rmams khyug tsam zhig phebs dgos zhes lan/ bskur yang /phyir 'khor gdong lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi rtsa tshigs red ces rgya yig bris pa'i yig chen tham sbyar kha shas shig bskur 'dug de dag 'dam thog dgon sde'i sgo sge rgyang gsum la sbyar dgos zer ba dang da res yong khom med ces bshad 'dug rtsa tshigs kyi snying don ni tang gi 'go khrid 'og bod mi dmangs rnams mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang phyir log dgos/ de ltar ma byas tshe mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis ñtsa gas kyi khu tshur gzhus te mgo bkas klad 'gems bzo rgyu yin zhes 'khod yod tshod las skabs der rgya yig shes mkhan med/ gong gsal yig cha dang / sgrol ma lha khang du gtam bshad zin tho/ chos 'khor dgon du ldan mdzod rtse drung gi khang pa'i sgo sge rtsig ldeb bcas la sbyar ba'i gnas tshul gang yod chab mdor btang ba yin/ lhag par nga tsho yang da mus 'di khul sdod dgos tshe 'byung 'gyur 100

gnas— tshul ji yong cha mi 'tshal bas sa srurdzudamag sgarazhig gtongatshoganang ngam sa mtshams su bka' mol sne 'phrod mdzad 'os sogs gang ltar zhu bde'i bka' gsal 'phral stsol yong ba zhesaganas tshul zhib lhongs btang ba dang /rim bzhi khro dga' bor gus rang nas 'di lo'i ring bstan srid snying bcad gzhung bsam rnam dag gi 'tsho gnas mdzes zol med pa snyan phul zhus par bka' gsal tregang yang bstsal 'byor ma byung zhing / phyi lo 'di khul gyi las 'khur dgongaga'akhrol yong thabs nang yig btang ba yin/ de rjes lcags stag zla ba dang po'i nang 'chi med tshe ring la kho pa'i ngo shes rgya rigs shig yod parī des ba shad par nye dus gong gi bka' la (gung khran tang )si khron dang /zi ling brgyud dmag dpung phon che yong gi yod pa nges can yin lugs dang dmag dpung 'byor 'phral sa mtshams khag la las don gtong 'then gyi 'gan dbang gtso bo dmag mi'i 'go khrid kyis byed rgyu yin tsang kho tsho 'i las 'gan yabodu 'gro gedang / sa mtshams yas mas khag tu dmag mi btang na las ka mang du 'gro lugs bshad byung bas 'dam thog tu khyod rnams mi bcu skomazhig sngar mus nam yang bzhugs phod mi gda' zhespobashad byung /gnas tshularda dag chab mdor btang lan du khyod rang layo 'khur 'pho sa tshab shod drung nor rgyas par gsar bsko song bas ngo ma ring min yong rgyur ngomitshab 'di par las khur rtsis sprod bya dgos zhes pa'i bka' rgya 'byor don bzhinapirtsis spradarīthog gus rang chab mdor 'gro gtan 'khel zin yang / de rjes bka' rgya 'byor don nor rgyas pa ring min 'byor rgyur ngo 'byor ma byung bar khyod rang rgyus 'bab kyis nyin shas sdod dgos zhes pa'i bka' rgya 'byor te zla phyed lhag tsam song ba'i skabs der nyen kha'i gnas tshul nyin bzhin je cher song ba'i don dngos chab mdor gnas snyan thengs mang btang ste lan 101

gsal ma byung bar kho tsho tshang 'dzoms sar da lta'i rgya dmar gung khran zhes pa de ni sngar gyi rgya mi dang nam yang mi 'dra/ dper na go min tang dang / si ling ma kru'u zhi zer ba de tshos kyang 'gran nus bral te gzhan yul gyar dgos byung ba red/ nga'i rmongs bsam byas na nga tsho nyin gnyis kyi sa lam/srib mda' tsam la phyir 'then byed dgos pa las/ bka' lan ma thon sngon du rgya mi'i lag tu tshud nyen yod lugs bshad pa yin/ 'on kyang nor rgyas pa'i ngo tshab kyis bshad don khyed nyid las 'khur rtsis sprod zin pas phebs na'ang 'grig pa las/ nga tshor mdo spyi'i bka' gas/la med pa dang / nor rgyas ngo 'byor ma grub khar gung khran mig gis ma mthong bar phyir 'then byed blos bzod min zhes dang de'i rjes drung gtogs blo tshul dang kho tsho sdod rgyur blo thag bcad don rnams slar yang chab mdor da phan bka' gsal ma thon stabs gus rang da lta de phyogs rdog thon zhu dgos byung zhes btang ba dang /phran ngo g.yog rnams sde ge srib mdar 'byor skabs nor rgyas ngo ma der 'byor dus mtshungs red/ nga gnyis gnas tshul shod gleng byed bzhin mur rta shad khams pa gcig 'byor don gus pa 'dam thog nas thon pa'i rjes su nyin phyed tsam la gung khran rta pa brgya skor tsam 'byor te 'dam thog tu yod pa'i rlung 'phrin dang / rlung 'phrin gtong mkhan rgya gar ba gnyis 'dzin bzung byas te skye mdor khrid song ba dang / drung gtogs blo bzang tshul khrims dang / nor rgyas kyi ngo tshab/ ldan mdzod rtse drung bcas gsang gcod dang lud skyong nang du yib ste thar tsam byung tshul chab mdor snyan 'bul 'gro dgos bshad byung /de nas lam thag nyin drug thog zla bzhi pa'i tshes shar du phran chab mdor 'byor 'phral rim bzhi khro dga' bo'i sar bcar skabs snga phyi'i gnas 102

tshul zhib zhus mtha' don lha klus gnas skabs khyed rang do dam gnang bzo 'dug ces bshad byung bar de'i lan du gang gnang ci mdzad de rang sdug 'khur zhuwā las gzhan gyi thabs 'tshol byed rtsis med/ chab mdo dang ldan ma'i bar da phan gnas tshul gtong len byas pa'i snyan zin bka' rgya sogs yig cha mdor bsdus shig lha sar bta4 zin pas 'di skor sku mchog mdzad dka' yong gzhi'i dgongs bzhes na ma yang ma dgos/ tsā gnas tshul de skor zhib cha rjes su mkhyen rtogs yong nges zhes bshad de phyir log de'i phyi nyin lha klu'i sar phyin kyang ngo thug ma gnang stabs chab mdo'i gzhung las khang du sngar lam 'byor phyag zhes pa zhu 'gro'i skabs mkhan che zla ba zhes pas bka' bsgyur don mdo smad zhi drag yongs kyi spyi 'doms mi dbang sa skyong chen po'i bka' dgongs/ khyod rang mi rgyu 'khor bcas nyams med 'di 'byor thub yod kyang / ldan mar yod pa'i gzhung gi rlung 'phrin dang / rlung 'phrin gtong mkhan rgya gar ba mi gnyis rgya dmar gung khran tang gis 'dzin bzung byas 'dug pa ma zad/ de 'phros rnams srog ma shor tsam nas bros thar thub 'dug pa 'di skor khyod nas gzhung sa'i mtshan lar ma ltos pa'i byed babs gzhigs pa'i khyod nas phyi nang lag 'brel ji byas zhu 'bul dgos pa dang / drung gtogs blo tshul dang / ldan mdzod rtse drung / shod drung nor rgyas pa'i ngo tshab bcas 'byor mtshams khong tsho'i zhu babs dang bstun nas brtsad zhib byed rgyu yin pas/ gnas skabs khyod rang kha dang sku srung dmag sgar la do dam rtsis sprod gnang ba yin zhes sku srung brgya dpon dang / go 'khyer btson srung dmag mi grangs bcu'i bar du khrid de dmag sgar yang steng gur chung zhig nang do dam byas te srung cha dmag mi grangs bcus mtha' skor bkag srung 'og tu sdod mus su nyin shas song mtshams zhu ba thengs gsum 103

blang mthar skabs de'i mdo phogs hor khang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang /bka' drung rin sgang pa bsod nams dpal 'byor gnyis nas g.yas song g.yon byol med pa'i 'gan len zhus song zhes gus pa'i sdod gnas chab mdo'i gnas tshang du bsad 'thas las don snying do dam bkag rgya'i 'og tu da ra gnas/ de nas mdo gsar nga phod chab mdor phebs nye'i mtshams/thag gcod la/ gus par nyes don gtso gnad la cha bzhag nyes pa gser srang bco lnga dang rlung phrin rin 'bab gsum gnyis sgrub dgos pa dang /nor rgyas dang ldan mdzod rtse drung so sor nyes pa gser srang bcu re dang rlung phrin rin 'bab gsum gcig sgrub dgos pa'i gan len byas/ te mjug bsdus pa bcas so 104
sa lam

bsam mkhar ba ched 'bod byas pa bzhin yab gzhis phun khang du bskyod pa phun khang gi bar 'khyams su 'byor 'phral tsha rong gi a phrug kha shas thon te bla phyag bsam mkhar bar lam seng gri rub rgyab ste bsad pa red/ de'i yong rkyen ni bod sdod am ban dang / lu'u cun dmag dpung la bla phyag las khungs nas 'bras ltang brgya tham pa sprad pa'i gnad don la thug pa de ni/sa gnas srid gzhung gis am ban la 'char can mkho sprod byed dgos pa'i gtong sgo'i 'bras yin pa las dmigs bsal am ban la sprel lad 'khrab ste sprad pa zhig ma yin kyang / brum pa chos mdzad nas tsha rong la shog snub rlung 'tshang gis dkrug shing rgyab ste bla phyag bsam mkhar ba rgya mi'i phyogs gtogs tshul bshad pa red/ bla phyag bsam mkhar ba gri rub kyis bsad dus zhabs phyi dkon mchog lam seng phyir bros te nang du 'byor nas gnas tshul rnams nga'i pha la brjod 'dug 'on kyang tsha rong nas bla phyag bsam mkhar ba bsad pa'i skor skabs shig ring gsang ba byas te nyin ltar nga tsho'i nang nas zhal lag sags len gyi yod pa red/ de lta bu'i gsang rgya byed dgos don ni bla phyag bsam mkhar ba'i rgyab tu 'bras blo gling grwa tshang gi gra dmangs yod stabs nang khul dkrog rkyen mi yong ba'i don du yin bzo 'dugatā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa rgya gar nas phyir log phebs te yar 'brog bsam sding dgon du bzhugs ring tsha rong lha sa nas bsam sding du ngo bskyod byas pa red/ de mtshams bsam sding dgon nas twa la'i bla ma'i bka' bzhin a drung lha sar ched gtong gnang mdun ‘‘smon grong skal bzang 'phral du bsam sding dgon du yong dgos ’’pa'i bka' rgya 'byor 'phral nga'i pha skal bzang bsam sding su phebs pa dang / de gar 'byor ba'i snyan seng zhus 'phral mgron gnyer chen mo lkog pan tse nas bka' bsgyur don du ‘‘smon 106

krong skal bzang giso tsha rong/zla bzang dgra 'dul la yi ge slob dgos ’’zhes gsungs ladug pasi de nas bzung pha skal bzang lags kyi las 'gan ni nyin ltarotsha rong la yi ge slob rgyu de re da/ — ci twa la'i bla ma lha sar phebasace'abyor zin mtshams dmag spyi— khang gsar 'dzugs kyis pha skal bozang la dmag drung bosko gzhag stsal ba red/(skabs de'i dus tshod ni spyi lo 1rdzo12tsam red/) lha sa ya mon du dmag spyi khang gi las khungs byas pa red/ dmag spyi khang thog mar gsar 'dzugs skabs spyi mda' tsha rong dang / de 'og dmag dpon bzhi/ dmag drung gnyis/ zhal ngo gcig bcas yod pa dang / de gong bod darma ga sum stong las med kyang de rjes rim bzhin dmag dpung rgya bskyedaḥbyas pa dang / pha skal bzang lags kyis dmag drung lo brgyad gnang ba red/ de rjes pha skal bzang lags kyis sngar smon grong gyi 'dzin khongs mnyes thang ra stod ri khrod nyams gso dang 'brel 'dzin dbang yongs rdzogs pha bong kha4bla brang la phul ba red/ gnad don des rkyen pas bsam mkhar zhabs sdod pas snyan zhu zhus 'brel zhib sa yig tshang las khungs nas gyod gzhi 'khrun thag ma chod par pha skal bzang shar chen lcog tu btson 'jug dang / a ma zhol btson khang du btson 'jug byas/ skabs der nga rang rtse slob gra ba yin pas pha ma gnyis kyi sar lta bar 'gro gi yod/mthar yig tshang gis 'char phul bka' dpyad du rtse drung gi shag tshang mi skyas do dam byas pa'i gnas tshul 'os min la brnyad de ‘‘pha ma gnyis 'on bsam mkhar khongs khral 'dzin du 'gro rgyu dang / nga rang rtse slob grwa nas phyir 'then byed dgos ’’pa'i bka' dpyad btang don bzhin nga tsho pha ma bu gsum 'on bsam mkhar khongs khral 'dzin du btang ba red/ pha ma gnyis 107

'on khul sa zhing 'debs las kyis khral rgyugs te lo shas bzhugs pa'i rjes tā la'i bcu gsum pas bskongs 'gugs gnang bas pha skal bzang lags nor gling du bcar skabs mgron gnyer chen mo a sob (bstan pa dar rgyas )kyis bka' bsgyu ra don ‘‘khyod kyis de sngon dmag spyi khang gsar 'dzugs las ka'i nang gzengs su thon pa'i zhabs 'degs zhus par slar yang khyod rang dmag spyi khang gi las ka byed dgos pas dmag drung gsar mjal zhu dgos ’’pa'i bka' bsgyur gnang ba red/ pha dam pa des rkyang phyag dang 'brel zhus don ‘‘de sngon dmag drung byed skabs zhabs 'degs yag po ma sgrub par da cha de bas zhabs 'degs zhu nus bral song ’’zhes u tshugs mthar skyel gyi dgongs pa zhus 'khrol thog sngar gyi byas rjes su 'on bsam mkhar du khral rgyugs ma dgos par lha sar bsdad 'thus dang / phru gu de mdzad sgo stabs bstun ma dgos par dmigs bsal gyis zhabs sdod zhus 'thus zhes bka' bzhes sbug dam 'byar mar gnang rung pha dam pa des ‘‘phas zhabs 'degs ma sgrub par phru gus zhabs 'degs sgrub kyi ma red ’’ces gsungs te skabs der nga rang zhabs sdod zhu ru ma bcug kyang de rjes pha skal bzang sku ma gshegs gong shing khyi lo ( 1924) rwa sgreng srid skyong gnang 'phral nga rang gzhi nas zhabs sdod kyi gsar mjal zhus pa yin/ 108
ba mas

ri zur/ stag rtse brang khang bcas sprul sku gsum yod/bar skabs shig la zhwa lu dgon gyi las sne khag 'dod pas ngo tsha sgrib ste spyi rgyu bar bzos dang / nang khul shis min gyi rkyen pas lab gleng rim byung la tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa 'tsho gzhes skabs gzhis rtse bkras lhun dza bla dang spyi rdzong zung sbrel zhib dpyod du bsko gzhag gis rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu sprel (1kha22)lor btang ba'i dpyad khra de dag zhwa lu'i 'dzin skyong byed phyogs skor gyi rtsa 'dzin du byed pa de lta na yang / bar lam no yon las thog ri zur pa'i shag tshang dam chos zer bas btsan shed brgya kha gcig gcod byas rkyen tshogs chen gyi rgyun ja sogs je zhan je sdug tu song bas dge 'dun tshogs yongs la phebs mkhan yang je nyung du kharigro ba'i gnas tshul ma bzod par shing sprel (1kha54)lo ri sbug dbu mdzad chen mo mkha' khyab kyis chu sprel khra ma'i dgongs don bzhin gtong sgo'i thad no yon dang / spyi sa/ dbu chos bcas pa zung sbrel thog lag bstar byed dgos pa'i skor no yon las thog pa dam chos la 'phrol mol ḍa phyi thengs mang byas par no yon bya thabs rbad bral gyis spyi sa/ dbu chos sogs dang zung sbrel mi bya mthu med byung nas de ltar lag bstar byas par zla ba gnyis tsam gyi nang kha lhag 'phrod 'khyil ja mar sogs mi nyung ba zhig byung ba de dag zla ba yar ngo dang / mar ngo'i gso sbyong sogs la zab ja gtong rgyur gtan 'bebs byas pa des no yon gyis bar lam spyi rgyu lkog zas byas pa a ru sder thon byung bar brten no yon phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa ngo tsha kha skyengs tshad med byung ba red/yang gnas tshul gzhan zhig la no yon re'i las rgyun gtan 'bebs lo drug re yin stabs no yon dam chos lo lngar nye bas no yon gsar pa'i 'os 'du byed nyer slebs shing / de sngon dam chos no yon la gsar bsko byed skabs 110

'os dang po dam chos dang / 'os gnyis par dbu mdzad mkhe' khya ba yod pyom zad/ grwa tshadzore natsās 'du mi re dgos par rab rgyas grwa tshang khong 'oṣ+pemi dbu mdzad mkha' khyab nyag cig la gtan 'khel yod pa'i dbang gis no yon las thog dam chos kyi khe dbang la g.yo 'gul thebs nges pa'i 'gal ba'ang je snyed lhag pa bcas don rkyen 'gal ba gnyis po med par bzo ched no yon las thog pa dam chos la jus 'don yongs rdzogs byed mkhan no zur dpal 'byor yin pas kho gnyis ngan gros kyis dgamadzad mkha' khyab rtsa med gtong rgyu'i thabs ngan yod rgu rtsal dkrug byed kyi yod pa'i gsang don dbu mdzad mkha'akhyab la nye phyogs khag nas brda 'byor byung bar brten 'gal ba de bas rno ngar dang / rnyogs 'dzing ji cher 'gro mus tho ga spyi lo 1954lor shing rta chu 'khyer zhes nying re'i phu nas chu chen yur ma shoms thon nas rgyal rtse dang / pa snam/ gzhis rtse sogs myang chu'i ngogs kyi sa cha mang por ston 'bras len rgyu ma byung stabs zhwa lu dgon pa'i dge 'dun rnams la lo de'i dgun hūṃgs 'bru khal gsumazhware chad lusposu gyur gede dag sprod rogs zhes grwa dmangs nas brjod par dbu mdzad mkha' khyab kyi — ‘‘phogs chad ma sprad par 'grig gi ma red ngas kyang yong chog ’’ brjod deskabs der no yon ri sbug tu bsdad yod pas dbu mdzad dang / 'thus mi bcas ri sbug tu no yon sar bskyod skabs no yon zhwa lur phyir 'o tiyong ba dang tag tag thug ste dbu mdzad mkha' khyab kyis ‘‘galo chu skyon gyis rkyen pas ston 'bras lag son ma byung rung grwa par phogs ma sprad par 'grigaskethabs med pas bkar 'jug gi 'bru khongs nas phogs chad sprod rogs 7lab par no yon gyisayobakar 'jug phyag deb nang 'khod yod pas 'grig gi ma red ’dzinas khas yoblang pa dang / de rjes slar yang no yon gyishag tu phyimā111

nas grwa par phogs chad sprod dgos lugs lab par sngar bzhin ngan shed kho nas deb gsal bkar 'jug snyel lag pa 'chang na 'grig gi ma red ces lab par de lan dbu mdzad mkhas grub kyis sgo nga dang / sha sogs skyabs rten 'bul mkhan yod na bkar 'bru bu lon btang chog pa dang / grwa par phogs chad dus sprad na mi 'grig pa gang yin nam zhes rtsub po'i tshig gis bshad par brten no yon sngar bas kyang tshig za je cher gyur ba red/ bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing lug (1kha55)bod zla gnyis pa tsam zhig gi nyin zhig dgon pa'i 'du khang gi steng du no yon las zur gnyis dang grwa pa dge slong tshul khrims zer ba bcas 'dzoms thog de min grwa pa dang / mi skya bcas mi nyung ba zhig tshogs te dge slong tshul khrims kyis gan rgya gcig la thel tse len gyi yod pa'i sar dbu mdzad mkha' khyab slebs nas blta skabs gan rgya de'i nang ‘‘da lam las don 'di'i thog nga tsho tshang ma rdog rtsa gcig sgril bya rgyu yin ’’zer ba'i sbug tshig las don dngos gsal bkod med pa de mthong bas don med kyi gan rgya 'di len dgos don gang yin nam zhes dge slong gi lag nas 'phrog ste phyir log 'gro skabs 'du khang gi 'gro lam du slebs skabs khu dpon brtson 'grus zer bas dbu mdzad kyis dpung par 'tham 'ju byas par dbu mdzad kyis kyang sngon dpags kyis gra sgrig ltar gri gor ban zhig am phrag nang bcug yod pa de khu dpon la gzhus pas lag pa rmas nas shor ma thag dbu mdzad myur bros kyis rang shag tu 'dzul te sgo brgyab nas bsdad cing / skabs der ser skya mi grangs mang po zhig gis nyin zhag lnga'i ring dbu mdzad mkha' khyab kyi sdod shag mtha' skor nas rub brgyab ste gsod thub na dang / de min dbu mdzad mkha' khyab dang /gcen po rab rgyas grwa tshang slob dpon mkhas btsun gnyis chu bkag btang 112

nas gsod rtsis byed pa ha cang dza drag gi gnas su gyar ba red/ skabs der se ra skya mi mang gis de ltar byed pa'i rgyu rkyen ni no yon las zur gnyis ngan grosasgrokyirnathoganas —no zur da: sgal 'byor dang shan gcig pa lta bu'i de sngon ri sbug spyi sa rnying pa dge bskos ‘ za ba zer ba dang / kho pa'i g.yog grwa dkon mchog zer ba gnyis btang naḥg dgon nang gi grwa par phogs rgyag shi red zer ba dang / miser nang de ring 'bru bun gtong gi yin tshul (dkrogs gtam 'ur slong byas par brte rna )mi mang po bsdu bskongs kyis tshang ma 'dzoms mtshams phogs ri'irgyag mkhan dbu mdzad mkha' khyab yin pas kho pa rtsa med gtong rgyu'i skor la nga tsho dzu tsang ma rdog rtsa gcig sgril bya rgyu yin pa'i gan rgya rgyag rgyu'i gros ngan bshams te mi mang por mgo skor btang ba las byung ba red/ skabs de ga/nas tshul ‘ ta cang dza drag je cher gyur stabs no yonatsho phyogs nas gzhis rtse rdzong la (sta/bas de'i gzhis rtse rdzong dpon rtse drungaglus tshan thub bstan nyi ma dang / shod drung las tshan chab tshom gnyis red/)dbu mdzad mkha' khyab kyis khu ཿdpon brtson 'grus la khrims 'gal gri rmas btang tshul snyan seng zhus par ba/zhis rtse rdzong nas de skor tho rgyag par sbrags drung blo gros rgyal mtshan btang / zhwa lur 'byor ma thag no yon gyi las shag tu khrid nas khu dpon brtson 'grus kyi lag pa rmas skyon la bskor tho rgyag rgyu kho na las dbu mdzad mkha' khyab kyi las shag ser skya mang pos bskor ba sogs kyi zing cha'i gnas tshul sbas gabasdong byas te mgo bskor gtong rtsigabyas kyang skabs der zhwa lu dgon pa'i sprul sku'i gtso bo bu ston rin po ches gnas tshul de gsan thos byung 'phral ri sbug nas zhwa lu thil du ched phebs skabs skya ser mngarupos dbu mdzad kyi shag mtha' skor nas gsod rdung gi skad cor rgyag pa de gzigs pas ‘‘'o rtsis 'di 'dra'i las ka gang byed kyi yod mi bsad na ga 113

la 'grig gi red/ rdzong gi sku tshab no yon gyi shag tu yod pa mgyogs po skad gtong shog ’’gsungs pa ma zad/ ‘‘chu bkag btang na mi shi gi red/mgyogs po chu len du shog ri’ces gsungs nas chu len du btang ste sge'u khung nang thag pa btang ste chu skyel du bcug pa dang / sbrags drung de yang 'phral yong nas khyod tsho khrims med 'di 'dra byed chog gi ma red zhes lab kyang a lan bya mi ma byung stabs lam seng gzhis rtser phyir log gis rdzong la snyan seng zhus pa red/de'i sang nyin rdzong gi phyag mdzod gnyis ched mngags zhwa lur yong ste dbu mdzad kyi shag mtha' skor bya mi ser skya rnams phyir logre/ byed du bcug pa dang / dbu mdzad mkha' khyab dang / gcen po rab rgyas grwa tshang gi slob dpon mkhas btsun gnyis lo de'i zla gsum pa'i tshes shar la gzhis rtser mnyam khrid kyis rdzong du 'byor mtshams zhu len sogs ma byas par gnas skabs gad par rtsis sprod zer ba'i do dam byas shing / de bzhin dbu mdzad shag la yang gnas skabs ring rdzong gi phyag mdzod gnyis nas sgo thel brgyab pa dang / don rkyen chen po 'di lta bzo mkhan byed gte gtso bo no yon dpal 'byor dang / no yon las thog pa dam chos gnyis lha sar phyin nas kho pa tshor le khag med tshul gyi mig 'khrul zhig ston rtsis byas pa dang /rdzong la zhu gtugs byed mkhan grwa mang spyi 'thus yin zer ba'i grwa pa kha shas dang / mi ser gyi 'thus mi yin zer ba kha shas bcas btang ba red/'on kyang gzhis rtse rdzong lhan khang du dbu mdzad mkha' khyab dang / gcen po mkhas brtsun gnyis nas rim bzhin snga phyi'i 'byung rkyen ngag thog dang yig thog gi zhu shog kha gsal phul ba ma zad grwa pa dang / mi ser gyi 'thus mi yin zer mkhan tsho'i zhu khongs nas zing 'khrug rkyen 'di'i 'byung rtsa no yon 114

las zur gnyis la thug pa'i skor thog par brten gzhis rdzong nas da lam zhwa lu dgon gyi 'khrug rkyen zang zing chen po ched bzo byed gte no yon las zur gnyis phag pa tshil mnongs kyis lha sar gsang bskyod byas 'dug par 'di skor da lta gzhis rtse rdzong du zhib dpyod byed mus yin gshis do bdag no yon las zur gnyis gzhis rtser bkod brdzong yong ba'i snyane zhu bka' shag la phul don ltar zla ba drug pa'i nang ched mngags skyes sgrol a drung dang sbrags no yon las zur gnyis gzhis rtser 'byor nas rdzong lhan sar 'byor tshes zhus te zhwa lu ba'i khongs gzhis rtse grong rdal khongs sha ra bum pa zer bar bsdad pa red/ dhe no yona'is tshur gzhisartser 'byor rjes gzhis rtse rdzong gis gyod ya phan tshun nas zhu ba zhu len thengs gnyis re tsam byas thog no yon las zur gyis jus bkod ltar ser skya mang po skad btang ste zing cha chen po bzo mkhan dge zur zla ba dang / kho pa'i g.yog gras grwa dkon cog gnyis rdzong gi gad par rtsis sprod do dam byas yod pa de gnyis la tsha 'dri rta lcag bcu phrag re btang stabs dkon cog gis snga phyi'i 'byung rkyen tshang ma re re bzhin ngos len dang /dag 'bud bcas byas pa red/ de'i skabs no yon gnyis kyiso rdzong gi gad pa'i khongs lhan rgyas gad pa dbang rgyal la dngul dang / dngos po mi nyung ba sprad de kho tsho'i gyod don skor la gnas tshul ji yod nyan 'jog bya rgyu'i las 'gan sprad yod stabs/ de'i nub lam seng lhan rgyas gad pa dbang rgyal sha ra bum par no yon las zur sar ched bskyod kyis grwa dkon cog la tsha 'dri btangartestabs skad cha tshang ma ba shad tshar song zer ba'i lan bskyal bar de 'phratshwano yon gnyis 'tshab sha ha cang chen po langs te de'i nub mtshan mo rang la zhwa lur bar rkang thang dang / de nas rta drel dang bcas pa cir lung 115

brgyud lha sar bros byol du phyin pa red/ de nas nyin shas kyi rjes grwa dkon cog kyang gzhis rtse rdzong gi pe har lcog gi nub ngos nas g.yang la mchongs te rang shi brgyab pa red/no yon las zur gnyis lha sar slebs rjes gzhis rtse rdzong nas khrims drang po byed kyi med pas kho tsho'i gyod don skor lha sa rang du zhib dpyod yong ba'i thabs shes yod rgu rtsal krug gis bka' shag la snyan zhu phul bar dus skabs der bka' shag gis gyod don kho nar zhib dpyod byed mkhan gyod zhib las khungs zer ba zhig ched 'dzugs byas yod pa der zhwa lu'i gyod don de'i zhib sa yang gyod zhib las khungs su thon pa red (gyod zhib las khungs kyi gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur mkhan dza sag g.yu thog bkra shis don grub dang /rim bzhi ra sa rgya rgan/ rtse drung rtse mgron tsha thor ba bcas kyis gtso bo byed pa'i ser skya mi grangs bcu drug tsam yod pa red/) no yon las zur gyis zhib sar snyan seng zhus pa ltar gzhis rtse rdzong la bka' shag nas bka' rgya dang sbrags a drung ched 'gug tu btang ste gyod ya dbu mdzad mkha' khyab dang /gcen po rab rgyas grwa tshang slob dpon mkhas btsun/ ka 'og grwa tshang gi dbu mdzad rdo rje/ khang rnying grwa tshang gi slob dpon thub bstan bstan 'dzin bcas lha sar 'gro dgos zhes gzhis rtse rdzong nas bkod khyab byas par dbu mdzad mkha' khyab nas ‘‘nga tsho bka' don ltar lha sar phyin chog pa dang /lag pa ya gcig gis thal mo yong shes min la brten no yon las zur dang 'phar spyang lag sbrel gyi gyod gzhi bzo mkhan dug rtsa bung nag dge zur zla ba dang / dge slong tshul khrims/ khu dpon brtson 'grus bcas gyod ya mi gsum yang nga tsho dang chabs cig rdzong brda yong ba ’’zhes snyan seng zhus par phan tshun mi bdun shing lug zla 11 (spyi lo 1955)nang lha sar mngags 116

skyel byas pa red/ skabs der no yon gnyis kyis zhu khongs su tshud pa'i zhwa lu'i mi ser gyi 'thus mi gnyis dang grwa spyi'i 'thus mi gsum bcas —mi lnga lha sar gtong dgos pa de ltar yang / mi ser gyi spyi 'thus dang grwa pa'i spyi 'thus red zer ba de tshos nga tsho ni no yon las zur gyi ji zer kho na byas pa tsam laso rtsa ba'i gyod gzhi'i thad the jus byas rigs rtsa ba nas med nges gan 'bul zhu 'aṣ+per yin zhes gan rgya 'ba' can phul te lha sar 'gro ma dgos pa'i dgongs pa zhus pa red/ dbu mdzad mkha' khyab can mi bzhi lha sar 'byor rjes gyod gzhi do dam pa g.yu thog gis skyabs rten mi len pa'i mna' bskyel byuzlasarored zer ba go thos byung stabs kha btags shig 'khyer— nas nang bcar zhus prer 4khyod tshos rgyu rkyen gang yod tshang ma drang 'brel kho na las rdzun zhu byas na oṃb nas 'grigacegi ma red ’’zhesazuzerawā dang / de rjes ra sa rgya rgan dang / tsha dor ba'i rtse mgron so sor skyabasmo rten du bod dngul srang brgya tham pa re da—nga / kha btags a 'dra re bcas 'khyer nas phyin par rgyu rkyen gangazuyodakha gsal zhu dgos pa red/ 'di dag dgos kyi ma red zer nas dngul dang / kha btags blangs mi 'dug 'on kyang tsha dor ba dang / no yon zur pa dpal ldan gnyis kyi 'brel ba ni zhwa lu khul sger se ma spag ra zer r+pā'i sa khang rnams tsha dor ba'i kho'adzin du zhus par skabs de'i no yon las thog dpal 'byor song ltabs tsha dor bar rogs ram mtha' 'khyol byas te som spag ra'i sa khang tsha dor bar kha 'dzin du sprad rkyen kho tsho nang ma snod gecig yin pa dang / ra sa rgya rgan ni rgyu dngos rjes 'brang gi drangalhugs mi zin par skad grags yod mkhan zhig yin la no yon gyi shag tshang ni dpal 'byor phyug po yin khar/ zhwa lu dgon pa'i dpal 'byor yongs rdzogs no yon gyi lag tu stabs ra sar 'bul rten rgyu dngos mang 117

po sprad pa ma zad/ tsha dor bas mgo 'dren bya sa pa bcas la rten khong gnyis ni no yon las zur gnyis kyi phyogs su rkang langs byed mkhan zhig tu gyur pa red/dbu mdzad mkha' khyab can gyod zhib las khungs su 'byor tshes zhus pa dang chabs cig don gnad skor rgyu mtshan hrag bsdus shig zhus te zhib cha snyan seng yin thog nas zhu shog phul chog pa zhes zhus par ra sa rgya rgan gyis khyod tshos gzhis rtse rdzong du phul ba'i zhu shog tshang ma 'di ga las khungs su 'byor yod pas da cha bka' dpyad zhu rgyu kho na las bskyar du zhu shog phul dgos don mi 'dug brjod par dbu mdzad nas nga tsho gzhis rtser zhu thag chod pa gang yang byung ma song na rim bzhin zhu lam 'gag med zhus chog zhus te de nyin phyir log byas pa dang / de rjes yig thog tu gyod gzhi rtsa ba'i 'byung rkyen sogs zhib bkod kyis phul ba'i nang don rtsa ba gzhis rtse rdzong du khu shog phul ba ltar gyi khar no yon dam chos kyis kho pa'i shag tshang dpal ldan chos 'byor ngo tshab tu btang ste 'du khang steng 'bru khang nas 'bru 'bor chen bton pa dang / dgon pa spyi'i lcang gcod kyis ka gdung mang po btsong pa'i rin dngul dang / gzhis chen zhes pa'i gzan rtswa 'bor chen gzhan btsong byas pa sogs kyi 'bru dngul 'bor chen lkog bzos byas pa sogs kyi skor zhu shog cig phul bar ra sa rgya rgan gyis ‘‘khyod tshos zhu ba mang po phul na bka' nyes mang po yong yas las yod pa ma red ’’ces zhu ba bka' 'gog bya rtsis kho na byas rung dbu btsugs kyis phul thog de rjes nyin ltar de no yon las zur gyis zhu lan yang bzhes rgyu'i zhabs bskul rim zhus la mthar nyin gcig dza sag g.yu thog slebs 'dug par g.yu thog gis kho tsho'i zhu ba'i lan ga 'dra 'dug gam gyod yar sgrogs sbyang byed dgos kyi red bshad par brten 118

ra sa bya thabs zad nas no yon las zur gyis phul ba'i zhu lan de dag sgrogs sbyang byas par de'i nang kho tshos 'bru bre phul gyi cha shas tsam bton med pa ma zad/ gzan pa dgon pa'i sims can la ster ba lasagazhan tshong byas med/lcang ma tshong sgyur sogs kyi gnas tshul med nges yin 'khod 'dug par brten de 'phrad dbu mdzad mkhal khyab can nas 'dir skor kho pa tshos ham zhu kho na las drang bden tshig gcig kyang mi 'dug na nga tsho gdong bzhi ra sprags yong ba zhes tsotshugs mtha' nan zhus par g.yu thog gis gad par —4no yon las zur gnyis skad— gtong shog kho tsho gdong thug byas narte'agrig gi rid ’’gsungs par de 'phral no yon las zur gnyis lha sar 'byor te phan tshun gdong thug gis re re bzhin ra sprod byed skabs/ ra sa rgya rgan gyis khyod tshos no yon gyis 'bru btorna song zer bshad pa min namo no yon gyis 'bru bton mi 'dugagam zer ba dang no yonatshonas kyang ngas 'bru rtsa ba nas bton med zhus pas/ de lan dbu mdzad nas ‘‘no yon gyi ngo tshabo dpal ldan chosi 'byor btang nas bton song7’zhes zhu shog sngon mar yang de rang zhus yod ces zhus par g.yu thog gis ‘‘de rang red no yon gyi rgyab la 'bru 'khur nas ga par bton gyicired/ ngo tshab btang nas bton pa de ni no yon gyis bton’pa red ’’ces bshad pas ra sa rgya rgan gdong dmar rkyang chags pa ma zad/de'i nang yod pa'i drung rigs ser skya gzhan dag tshos ra sar zur blta dgos pa zhig tu gyurartsepa ma zad/ ngo tshab kha skyeng gis skad shugs chen pos no yon la ‘‘da ga 'aspris byed kyi yin nam/ khyed rang gis byung mi snyedug ’’ces bka' bsgyur btang khul byas 'dug par dbu mdzad can nas don gnad re re bzhin ra sprags byas par brten ngos len mi bya mthu med byung ste mthar no yon gyis bka' nyes gsung chad bka' bzhin zhus chog pa/ zhis 119

khas len byas 'dug skabs der g.yu thog khang pa sbug ma'i nang bskyod 'dug par de 'phral ra sa rgya rgan gyis nyes pa can la nyes pa zer ba red bka' nyes zhus na da ga ma red pas da khyod tsho tshang ma mar phebs shig zer nas zhu mtshams bcad de gyod ya phan tshun gnyis ka phyir log byas 'dugayang gnad don gzhan gcig la no yon las zur nas gyod gzhi 'di'i rtsa ba'i yong rkyen zhwa lu'i skya ser tshang ma mgrin gcig yin lugs zhus par de lan dbu mdzad can nas bgyod gzhi bzo mkhan no yon las zur phyogs gtogs bcas pa las ser skya gzhan dag la le khag med ’’ zhus par ra sa rgya rgan gyis khyod tshos zhu ba phyogs 'gal ha cang chen po 'dug na gyod ya so so'i mkhar dbang 'ben btsug gi gan rgya bzhag ste de mtshams sa gnas su zhib 'jug bya mi gtong gi yin brjod 'dug par dbu mdzad can nas de don rang zhu gi yin zhes mkhar dbang 'ben btsug gi gan rgya 'bul rgyur thag bcad par no yon nas kyang de ltar khas len gyis zhib sar phyogs gnyis ka'i mkhar dbang 'ben btsug gis gan rgya bzhag rjes zhwa lur zhib 'jug byed mi a drung ched btang gis 'dri zhib byas par ser skye khongs nas mgrin gcig yin zer mkhan dang / nga tsho jus gtogs med zer mkhan phyed 'khyer du phyin stabs do bdag so so'i ming 'khod gan rgya len 'khyer gyis a drung phyir 'khor rjes rtsa ba'i zhu thag chod par cha bzhag nas dpyad mtshams btang ba'i snying por no yon las zur gnyis kyis dgon spyi'i 'bru bton nas bed spyod byas pa dang / gling kha'i shing cha ka gdung btsong rin/ gzhis chen gyi rtswa spus gtsong byas pa/ de bzhin rgyun ja'i kha lhag ja mar lkog bzas byas pa rnams chad lus med par spyi sar phyir slog bya rgyu dang /dgon pa'i spyi'i rgyu dngos rang mtshams bed spyod byas par nyes pa/ zhwa lu 120

dgon yas mas kyi mchod rten dang / sku bsnyan nyam chag yod rigs la gzhigs gso'i zhal gser bcas 'bul rgyu/ zhwa lu'i dge 'dun tshogs yongs la mang ja zab rgyas gcig gtong rgyu bcas dang / dge zur zla ba zhes pa bud med dang mthun sdebs bya gapa da lamartsezhe kho ngaspu nas ra 'phrod byung bar brten zhwa lu dgon gyi sgrig khongus nas phyir 'bud bya rgyu/ dbu mdzad mkha' khyab kyis zhu dpon brtson 'grus la gri brgyab ste brtson 'grus la rmas skyon byung bar nang gsos sman rin dngul srang nyis brgya lnga bcu zhu dpon brtson 'grus lasprod rgyu dang / dbu mdzad kyi ming 'khur zhig gis gri brgyab pa 'os min la brten grwa sa nas phyir 'then dang / slad zhwa lu dgon du 'gro mi chog pa bcas dang / yang do bdage phan tshun gyi zhu don da lam gyi gyod gzhi 'di zhwa lu ser skya spyi nas byas pa zhig red zer ba dang /no yon phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa kho na las ser skya byings min lugs zhu skor zhwa lur a drung ched btang gis zhib dpyod byas par gnyis ka'i zhu khongs ltar min pa ser skya spyi nas yin zer ba dang / nga tsho gtogs med zer ba phyogs gnyis su gyur 'dug par brten 'di skor gan don brda 'ded ma dgos par bal rdab rdo gnon du bzhag pa yin/ rab rgyas slob dpon mkhas btsun dang / khang rnying slob dpon bstan 'dzin gnyis da lam gyod don 'di skor the gtogs byed 'os min la nyes pa zhwa lu dgon tshogs yongs la mang ja gcig gtong rgyu bcas 'khod pa'i dpyad mtshams shig btang nas thag gcod byas pa red/ 121

lho kha zangs ri rdzong dang / de khul gyi lo rgyus mthong thos phyogs sgrig rags tsam/lho kha sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus rgyu cha 'tshol bsdu tshogs chung gis/lho kha zangs ri rdzong ni yar klung gtsang po'i byang rgyud du chags shing /zangs ri rdzong gnas yul rgyud du brag ri zangs kyi mdog lta bu yod pa der zangs kyi gter kha yod zer srol yod pas yul gyi ming la yang zangs ri zhes 'bod par grags/ brag ri zangs mdog can de'i mtshams su brag de las kha mdog cung zad nag tsam zhig yod pas zangs ri zangs kyi ri la lcagasatshokyi ka ba btsugs yod ces bshad srol yod cing / khul der gnam gshis dro grang snyom la zhing 'brog kyi cha rkyen legs pa dang / phu la rtswa thang legs shing rgya che ba phug thag ring ba mal gro gung dkar gyi sa mtshams su thug pa/ nub 'on rdzong dang sa 'dres (sne gdong rdzong 'on chus/) shar 'ol kha rdzong dang sa 'dres (zangs ri rdzong 'ol kha chus )yin zhing / khul de'i 'phyings zhes pa'i sa khul na pho ba'i nad gso ba la phan par grags pa rdo cung si'i khrod na/sa byung ba tshwa chu'i 'phrod bsten bya rgyu yod pa/ skye shing nags tshal gyis yongs su phyug pa la lar gnam mkha' yang mthong dka' ba'i gseb na ri dwags sha 122

ba'i khyu dang / d+ngha gla ba/ rgya/ gcan gzan dredamong dang / 'phar spyang /g.yi la sogs pa yod rung / phyis me mda' dang 'bar rdzas kyi sgras mthong rgyu dkon tsam yin/ khul de'i sa cha khag cig la lcags bzhun bskol byas pa'i bzhun ro mthong rgyu yod la/ sa ming la lcags kha gzhung zer zhing / mda' la zhing sa gshin la skam gsher snyom pa nas dkar nag dang / gro/rgya gro/ kong gro/ gro dmar/ sran ril/ rgya sran/ pad kha/ sho sa/sran chung / nyung dkar sogs 'bru rigs sna tshogs skye smin thub cing /yul de'irtechu rtswa shin tu brtan pas char chu dkon pa 'i skabs su yang chu chad myong med/ chu log dang dpyid dus gangs chu mdar slebs skabs nyin zhag re gnyisarnatsam las dus rgyun chu rnyog rtsa ba nas med pa dwangs shing bsil la yid khar 'ong ba yod/ zangs ri rdzong 'di bzhin rgyal ba sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho'i yum tshe dbang lha mo mchog gi yab gzhis 'khyongs thebs lte bar gyur pa red/ sgos gzhis klu sding pho brang rdo brtsigs brtsegs ldan spen bad dang bad phur kha brgyan skar mas mdzes par byas pa ja khra lung gnyis ma'i dbyibs dang mtshungs pa/ dbu tog tu gser zangs las grub pa'i gañdzira'i gser 'od chem chem rab tu 'phro zhing nyi 'od 'phro shugs che skabs de'i mdangs kyis nye 'khor lcang shing gi lo ma tshig snyam byed pa/ klu sding pho brang de'i dkyil spu/ nga tshom chen nang rten gtso rgyal dbang bdun pa chen po'i 'dra sku dang gsung rten rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che 'i gleg bam la gos gsum brtsegs kyi gdong 'dzar gleg shing gleg thag 76) ldan kun dga' ra ba'i nong bzhugs su gsol yod/ der bkar khang zhig yod pa de bsam pho'i sku ngo phebs dus skabs ma gtogs sgo dbye mi chog pa'i dam 'byar byas yod/ spyi lo 195ralo khams jag gis 'phung dkrug klong 123

skabs gtor skyon btang dogs kyi rdzong gtso thun mong thog rten sgam rnams yang steng nas btsan sar sbas bcol byed dus shing skas 'dzegs bab skabs 'khur mi'i sgal steng nas sgam gnyis sa steng du lhungs te thing sgam chag grum gshor rkyen nang rten dngos mjal byung ba rgyal ba sku phreng bdun pa chen po sku na phra ba'i skabs kyi na bza' dri ma can cha tshang dang byin rten/ rin chen ril bu sna tshogs ma dzod gos ser po'i khug ma'i nang bsgril 'thum mang po byas nas yod pa sgam gcig rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i bris sku spus legs/gnod sbyin/ btsi dmar dang / dgra lha'i sku brnyan gos 'tshem drub las bskrun bzhengs bris sku dang gnyis su med pa yod sgam gcig de min shing sgam bu la ser po'i 'thum dang / rag ser tshag ldan gyi zur bshan byas pa sgam nyi shu sko ra 'dug pa'i nang nas gong gsal sgam gnyis ched du kha dbye ba lta bus der yod tshang mas byin rten/ dang / rin chen ril bu byin rlabs zhu rgyu byung song / klu sdeng pho bra de'i nye 'dabs su ku shu'i ra ba stod sma da gnyis yod pa smad kyi dbus su dbyar dus spro skyid gnang yul bsil khang dang /gzim chung khag sasol thab/ gnyer tshang bcas babo/da pas mdzes pa mtshon mdangs rnam par bkra ba/ ku shu'i ra ba stod kyi dbus su bsam 'grub pho brang gi rje bo tshe dbang rigs 'dzin ('u si ling )gyi yab tha'i ji phyag rdor dbang phyug gi sku rjes su bzhes pa ma ṇi dung phyur brgya yod/'khor lo chen po bzhugs yul du ldebs bris la zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang sgo'i g.yas g.yon du rgyal chen rigs bzhi bcas mjal nyams dod la gser dang mtshon/ mdangs kyi 'od rnam par bkra ba/ gos tshos sna'i rgyal mtshan dang /ka phan ma ṇi 'khor chen dbu thod du gos chen gser po'i gdugs phub pa bcas kyi mdzes pa la ni bskor mi'i nus pa la ltos ma dgos pa chu yi 'khor ba 124

ma ṇi zhabs bskor 'khor bskyod snyom sgrig byed par chu yur gyi rka sgor rdo khungs yod pa nas dal lhod gtan 'khel byed pa/ ma ṇi 'khor chen gyi lha khang de'i mtha' 'khor du ro mngar ba'i ku shu'i sdong po dang / spang ljongs ne tso'i gshog pa rkyangs pa ltar yod pa gtsang zhing yid dbang 'phrog pa/ku shu'i sdong po'i ra ba yas mas lcagasaris bskor ba'i nang nas 'jol mo sogs kyi skad snyan par sgrogs pa/ ma ṇi'i 'khor lo nyin mtshan med par 'khor bskyod gnang bas dril bu thabs shes zung gi gsungs snyan par grags pa mtshan gnyid kyi seng la'ang lhang nger thos thub kyi yod/ ma ṇi lha khang der sri zhu bdag skyong zhu mkhan sku gnyer gcig yod pa'i bzhugs khang lcang gang ma'i sgo'i mdun du me tog sna tshogs kyi ra bas bskor yod pas bzhugs nyams spro ba/ khong la tshal zhing son khal gcig tsam 'gro ba yod thogaglu zangs ri rdzong nas lo re phogs 'bru gad gtsang khal lnga dang / bud shing bar 'bul zhu dgos/ ma ṇi khang der mar me rgyun bskangs mar khal gcig si/ mar khu 'gro ba'i mchod kong gcig yod pa mchod ma ra dmigs thobs su 'bri drug yod pa skyes med 'chi med kyi bsam pho'i 'brog par rtsis 'khrir sprad yod/ 'bri re nas lo re mar khal gnyis re 'bul dgos/ cim ṇi lha khang sku gnyer nas zla re bzhin mchod kong gtsang ma bzos nas sdong rkang btsugs te ras sam shog bus thal rdul mi 'gro ched khebs brgyab nas 'brog pa'i khyim tshang la bskyel gyi yod pa 'byor 'phral mar khal gcig btsag bcad de mchod kong 'gengs 'bul zhu gi yod/ zangs ri rdzong dpon yab gzhis bsam grub pho brang gi zhabs khongs nas 'os babs kyis bsko gzhag byed kyi yod/ rdzong dpon ngo g.yog la lo re phogs 'asbi khal brgya tham pa re yod/rdzong gi khongs mi khang gnyer gcig gad pa gnyis/ spyi lo 1955lo 125

gsar bskos gtso drag bzhi bcas yod/ kho tshor zangs ri rdzong nas phogs sogs gang yang sprod ma dgos/ lcags yos zhib mchan nang gsal lo sgro skyid gshong gzhis bsgril zangs ri 'don byed bzhi bcu zhe gcig dang gsum cha gcig 'ol dga' nas log pa 'don bdun zhes gsal ba dang / sa mtshams skor yul de'i phu byang ngos lcags kha la zhes pa'i la rtse rdi'u tshur bsgril dang / phar ngos mal gro gong dkar gyi sa khongs/ shar brag la shug pas khengs pa de 'ol dga' rdzong dang sa mtshams mtshon rtags/ nub sne gdong rdzong khongs (ljang zangs ri rdzong / ljang shang )dang sa ma tshams mtshon rtags chu mig ljang khu/ lho rgyud yar klung gtsang pos bcad pa bcas yin/ zangs ri rdzong gi mnga' 'og tu shar nub zhol pa/ gad ral/bud/ lu sgang / phu/ log bcas rgan phag brgyad yod/ dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyurari skabs mi grangs 1500skor dang / sa zhing son khal 2〈0 0tsam yod/ zangs ri rdzong khang chags yul ri bo nub bltas zla gam gzugs 'dra'i ldebs su yod/ lho byang gnyis su rang byung brag ri'i btsan 'gas yod pa byang gi brag ri'i mtshams nas chu len du gsang ba'i thog nas 'gro yul chu yur chen po lta bur thog phub rdo skas btsugs nas yod/ rdzong ge rgyab ri mthon po ri zhes pa'i rtse mor phyogs bzhir so blta bya yul khang pa rdo brtsigs thog brtsegs gsum yod/ rdzong khang la lcags ri mtho tshad ku khre bzhi tsam gyis yongs su bskor nas yod 'dug pa zhigs 'phro ltag bsdad 'dug rgyal 'gas/ zhes rgya la sgo chen po brgyud nas ma gtogs rdzong khang la 'gro lam med pa/ de nas rdo bstegs rim pa 'dzegs nas rdzong khang du 'gro lam yod/ zangs ri rdzong khang rgya che zhing spen bad bad phur kha brgyan skar mas mdzes par byas pa/ de'i dkyil khang bla ma lha khang 126

zhes 'du khang ka ba sum cu so drug yod pa'i nang rten gtso rgyal ba shākya thub pa gnas brtan brag ris bskor ba rgyal dbang sku phreng bdumon pa'i sku mched bka' blon gung kun dga' bstan 'dzin nas bzhengs gnang mdzad pa'i gser dngul spel mas thing shog bris pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur cha tshang yod/rdzong khang gi byang phyogs su gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'i dgon khang yod/tsi'u dmar sku brnyan rngam 'jig can ye shes dngos zhugs lta bu skye bo so sor zhal mdangasami 'dra ba mjal gyi yod skad/ mgon khang de'i rgyab ngos brag rtser lo ltar spre'u zhig yong ste brag ri de'i mtshams dzo nang zer bar lha rten zhig yod pa der kham star 'bul gyi yod pa grags/ spyi lo 19ṭ+wāṃ7bod me yos lo'i spyi dus su spre'u chen po zhig brag rtse der slebs nas dzo nang zhes lha rten sngon ma yod gnas su mar bab yong ba sa khul de'i skye bo tshang mas mthong 'dug phru gu mang pos sa der rnam kun mthong thos med pa'i spre'u slebs par ya mtshan byed pa dang / gson bzung thub res mtha' bskor ri bskor byas 'dug kyang brag ri mtho la g.yang gzar che bas bzung rgyu lta zhog de las ldog ste de nas nyin gnyis gsum nang gar song cha med du gyur 'dugamagon khang de'i mgon gsol ba 'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen kho na nas dge 'dun gnyis phebs srol yod/ rdzong khang gi dbus su dpal gur mgon phyag bzhi'i mgon khang dang / sngags srung e ka dza ri'i mgon khang yod pa mgon gsol ba gdan sa mthil nas dge 'dun gcig phebs srol/ khong rnam pa rer zangs ri rdzongs nas lo re phogs 'bru khal nyi shu rtsa lnga re 'bul dgos/ zangs ri rdzong 'og la gong gsal rgan khag brgyad yod khongs nas zhol rgan 'og gis zangs ri rdzong gi rnam kun las ka rtsag rtsig gang yod dang /thab g.yog mi gcig gtan 'dzugs byed dgos pa dang / rdzong gis bzhes 127

thug tshod ma yin zhes sngar sro la dpyid dus za po/ de nas pad lo/ de nas la phug bcas dus bstun sprod dgos kyi yod pa red/ gtan yang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / lho kha spyi khyab nas zangs ri rdzong la bkod yig 'byor 'phral 'brel yod la dgongs don brda sprod byed par nyin mtshan skabs gang 'khel lam seng 'gro dgos/ de min rgan khag bdun nas so so'i sa thog tu yod pa'i gzhis kyi dus gzhi'i zhing g.yog dang / zangs ri rdzong la dus rgyun rta g.yog mi gcig rgan khag res 'khor rgyugs dgos la/smon lam dmag rta'i rta g.yog gcig dmag rta'i gzan rtswa phu rgan 'og tu grong stod na ra dang / phyag rdor na ra zer ba rtswa rwa rgya che khag gnyis yod pas lo re rtswa brngas 'dren bya dgos khar/ mda' pa rgan khag bzhi nas gzan khral rkang res 'degs khal 12re 'jal sgrub byed dgos/ lu sgang rgan 'og nas lu sgang gzhis kyi dus bzhi'i zhing g.yog dang / bsam pho dang / zangs ri rdzong bcas kyi ster 'kho snum btsir rgyu ji yod kho tshos bya dgos/ zangs ri rdzong nas snum rgyu sprod skabs pad khal drug re la snum zangs 'bo gang dang / 'ba' cha khal gsum sprod dgos/ lhud rgan 'og mi ser nas nas 'bras gzhis kyi dus bzhi'i zhing g.yog dang / ra dzi gcig gtan 'dzugs dgos pa dang / gzhis stod nas lo re'i gzhis 'bab steng nas bsam pho'i gsol zhib ljags smin rgyu 'bru khal nyis brgya re sgrub sprod byed dgos/ khul de nas thon pa'i nas dkar mo de gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i spus legs shing bro ba yag po yod/ lo re'i gzhis 'bab gong gsal zangs ri rdzong nas bsdu len gyis gzhis de rang la bsdu 'jug byed pa dang / zla re'i gsol zhib 'char 'phar nges med rgyu 'bru zangs ri rdzong nas 'don sprod byas thog brngod 'thag las kyi do dam zangs ri rdzong gi ngo 128

tshab gcig gtong gi yod/ gsol zhib rgyu 'bru brngod mkhan lag rtsal mkhas can zur 'dzugs byed dgos/ brngod zin mtshams shing gzhong chen po zhig yod pa de'i nang 'brus lham zhes ko lham ched bzos byas yodarnapa gyon nas brus thengs gsum rgyag dgos/ de nas yos gad legs par brgyab zin pa dang chu 'thag kyang gzhis de rang la yod pa 'thag las zinari rjes zangs ri rdzong la rtsis 'bul zhu dgos/ shar/ nub/ log ga da ral bcas rgan khag bzhis res 'khor gyis zla re bzhin bsam pho'i nyer mkho gsol zhib ljags smin dang / rgya gro gro zhib ang dang ang gnyis 'thag las byed dgos pa dang / gzhan yang bsam pho'i nyer tshang dmigs bsal nyer mkho bsangs dang / sug pa/ mdor na dar lcogs mtshems skud sogagakhal rgyab brgyad skor zangagari rdzong nas gra sgrig gisa'abul bar 'gro dgos/ 'bras spung zho ston dang / chab zhugs skabs zangs ri rdzong nas bdag skyong byed pa ku shu'i ra ba stod smad du yod pa'i nang nas ka ra —ku shu zhes pa'i ku sdong gnyis yod pa de'i 'bras bu ser skya mdog ro mngar bcud dang ldan zhing mig gi mthong ba dang dri tshor ba tsam gyi za 'dod kyi 'gram chu ldang dgos pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i ku shu zhig yod pa de dag zangs ri rdzong nas lo ltar bsam phor 'bul dgos/ bsam pho nas mor gling gzim chung gis gtsos bka' blon/ de min thugs snang dge yul khag la 'bul gyi yod/ ku shu'i ra ba srung mkhan mi gcig ched btsugs yod/gong gsal ku sdong de gnyigal bdag srung nan po bya rgyu'i 'gan chen po yod/kyashu smin mtshams rang bzhin sa la lhungs pa rnams ku shu'i ra ba srung mkhan nas bed bcad chog bsam pho ma yin pa'i zangs ri khul la ku sdong gnyis gsum yod pa kha shas yod cing / bshad sbol la ku sdong de tsho sing pa zer 129

ba'i mi rigs shig gis btabs pa red ces zer/ de tsho'i rgyud pa kun gling rta tshag sku gong ma'i yab blo bzang rgya ma/tsho sogs kyi rgyud 'dzar da lta'ang ngos 'dzin rgyu yod/ gong gsal zangs ri rdzong nas bdag skyong byed pa'i ku shu'i ra ba stod smad gnyis nas ku shu spus 'bor gnyis ldan yod pa zangs ri rdzong ma/sa mi ser la ku shu mkhar rgya'i 'degs khal rer rin bod dngul srang gsum re tsam byas te tshong rgyur sprod/ mi ser nas lha rgya ri khul dang 'ol dga' khul du yul so so'i thon dngos dang brje tshong byas te mi ser la'ang bar mkhe cung zad yod cing / spyi lo 1rdzo64lo tsam la ku sdo nga gsar pa mang po btsugs yod rung da phan ku shu'i 'bras bu 'dogs thub pa byung med/zangs ri rdzong nas bdag skyong byed pa gla ba'i nags tshal rgya che yod pa lo ltar yal gcod rgyag pa dang / lo gnangs chags su gla gling stod smad re mos kyis gcod skabs lcam shing dang / 7 gdung dwags bo/nga nas thon pa'i som shing ltar ring la phra sbom snyoms pa cha stoms byas nas lo re stong phrag bzhi lnga re zangs ri rdzong la 'bab kyi yod/ gla tshal de dag deng skabs ha lam rtsa med lta bur gyur yod/ zangs ri rdzong 'og mda' pa rgan khag shar/ nub/gang ral/ log bcas bzhi nas mda' gzhis kyi dus bzhi'i zhing g.yog bya dgos pa de yang mi ser so so'i khral rten rgya khyon la gzhigs te zhing kha bgo 'grems byas yod pas zhing rmo'i yo chas gra sgrig bya dgos pa ma zad 'debs log 'khrol gsum zhes lo re smo thengs gsum re byed skabs mthong mkhan la lto chang dang / dus tshod ji tsam song ring nyin re gla 'bru bre do re sprod dgos/gzhis stod nas rmon phyugs dang / myo/thong lcags/ son/ lud bcas 'don sprod bya dgos/ mi ser nas rkang 'gro de ltar bsgrub dgos pa ma zad/ lag 'don sgog lab 'o rin dang lnga bed bogs ma zer ba sogs 130

ming 'dra min gyi 'bru rigs sna tshogs kyi khral 'bab bsdoms khal 5'a0rkyaskor dang rgya sos shing dngul zer ba bod dngul srang 200tsam/snam bu rgyugasaldems 5rkyaskor bcas zangs ri rdzong nas lo ltar bsdu len byed cing / lo sgro skyid gshongs gzhis (mtsho sna rdzong khongs )nas mon rmag sgo/mthing bu/ lu gu thang / gla rkam —(1kha4rdoskor nas hin rdus btsan bzung byas )bcas nas bsdu len byas pa mar gtso bor gyur pa'i lho zog 'dra min sna tshogs khal rgyab 150dang dos rgyagaganyis la rta’'ul re/ za nya la 'gel khal re/— sdod sgrig bcas mon rmag sgo bsam grub gling rdzong nas zangs ri rdzong bar sa tshig thog rta khal bskul 'ded chog pa'i sbug dam ga tan lam yod tshopa'i dgongs don ltar lo re'i khral 'bab rnams zangs ri rdzong la rtsis 'bul zhu dgos/ zangs ri rdzong nas lho kha khul dgon khag gdan sa mthil/ sle lung / mkhar dmar steng / 'phyi nga ri khrod sogs la sngar layomachod yun gtong sgrub byed dgos pa ma zad/ lhag par bsam yas gtsug lag khang du dkar me'i mar bzhu'i dus tshod bsam yas mdo sde mchod pa/ sa zla'i mchod sprin/ cho sprul dus chen bcasakādus chen rer mar khar rgya'isnye'adegs khal drug cu skor re btsag bcad zangs 'bor 'jal nas bsam yas dkon gnyer dpon dang / bsam yas rdzong rtse gathim 'gag che da phebs bcas sar gshor 'bul zhu dgos/ mnga' dwags rgyal gsum ('on mngasaris grwa tshang / dwags phro bshad sgrub4gling / chos 'khor rgyal )lo ltar chos 'khor rgyal du dbyar gnas zhal bzhe4dusi 'dzoms gnang gi yod pa 'on mangs ris grwa tshang 'dus tshogs rnams yar lam zangs ri rdzong du lo ltar bod zla rdopa'i tshes 5nyin 'char can phebs nas bdun phrag gsum bzhugs ring rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che gsung 131

sgrog gnang ring bsnyin bkur zangs ri rdzong nas zhu zhing / khul de'i dad can khag nas kyang bsnyen bkur zhu mkhan mang tsam yod/ zangs ri rdzong nas nyin re gsol ja dus thengs bcu gcig dang bzhes tsha dus gnyis/gsol ja dus rer sngar srol bzhes phor re yin/ gsol ja'i rdor dmigs zangs ri rdzong 'og mda' rgan khag bzhi nas dbyar dus ba 'jo ma zhing kha'i mu seng la rtswa bzar 'khrid pa re nas rtswa mar bzhes mar lha nyag re 'bul dgos/ gtan 'khel med pa'i kha bsnon dgos rigs zangs ri rdzong nas 'bul dgos/ skabs de'i gsol ja bsam pho rang nas gtong srol/bzhes tsam gyi rgyu 'bru mi ser la rtsis 'khrir sprad yod pa'i skyed 'bru khal lnga nas bzhes tsam khal dgu re mi ser nas 'thag las kyis rdzong la 'bul dgos pa der (lnga dgu ma zer )zangs ri rdzong nas dge bdun rer bzhes tsam khal gnyis re byas pa thengs gnyis dang / snum btsos phul lag (gro zhib phul re yod )bzhes zas dge bdun res grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga re bcas 'bul dgos/ zangs ri rdzong 'og la zangs ri 'khar dmar steng dgon pa'i chos gzhis gnyer tshang dang / gdan sa mthil dgon pa'i bogs zhing re gnyis yod pa phud de min bsam grub pho brang gi khe gatreng las gzhung sger chos bcas kyi sa zhing med la/ mi ser them dud gcig kyang med/ bsam grub pho brang rang nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung la bod dmag gi phogs dmigs zhib 'phar zhes 'bru rigs khyon che 'bul dgos stabs/ nang khul mi ser la'ang zhor 'khyog 'khel te mi ser nas sa lhag mu lhag gsar sbol byas par bogs ma 'bul dgos pa ma zad/ skal bzang lugs bzang skabs kyi 'bru'i rin gong ltar khral dngul phul 'thus rnams kyang 'bru rigs ngo ma 'bul dgos pa dang / rkang 'gro phyi khral bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 132

lam yig dgongs don sgo drung sa tshig phyed len tsam las 'khri srol med brgyud/ nang khral bsayopho/ zangs ri rdzong / sa gnas so sor yod pa'i gzhis khag gi dus gzhi'i zhing g.yog bcas bsgrub rgyugs dgos par brten miser rnams dka' ngal me+e tsam yin/ 'tsho thabs gtso bo zhing las dang / 'byor ldan khagagi zhing g.yog sogs 'gro khungs mang tsam yod par song na de nyin lto chang nar gtong thog nyin re gla rtsam pa'am gro zhib bre do re sprod (bre do gla bre zhes bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dam 'byar mkhar bre zhes pa las che ba phul brgyad re 'gro ) khyim nang skyes pa las go 'pher ba yod na thi gu dang rwa co zhes pa'i rnyi btsugs nas gla ba bsad de gla rtsi dang sha pags gsang thab sa kyis tshong ba dang / bsang / sug pa/ phyag ma /sgog skya/ bso nam lag chas kyi so bsgar byed 'tsher pa shing / bsholagug snam bu tshos rgyag skabs dgos pa skyur khu rlon bud skam po/ dmar rtsi sogs rihoskyes dngos po 'khyer nas yar klung khul 'bru rtsam dang brje tshong bya bar rtag par 'gro gi yod/ dgon pa'i gnyer tshang dang / 'byor ldan khag gi sgo drung du song nas re 'bod byas 'phral tshong shag slebs byung zer nas chang dam bi gang dang / rtsam pa 'gel khal bong glang la bster gzan bcos lam seng bster gyi yod/ khyim tshang der bsang / sugapagang 'os lag rtags su sprod srol darnga / der sdod ring 'gel khal la gzan rtswa bster rkyang dang / 'gro khar 'bru rtsayogang rung bster gyi yod/ brje tshong bya stangs 'phyag ma drug la 'bru bre do/ rlon bud skam po khal gnyis la 'bru khalagacig 'tsher pa shing rkang bcu la 'bru bre re/ bshol gug gcig la rin 'bru khal gcig gam/ khal gcig lhag tsag ri sgog dang /dmar rtsi/ bsang / sug pa sogs la 'os mtshams kyi 'bru rtsam dang brje 133

tshong bya gi yod/ de bzhin sngo khaṇ+ḍa yod pa de bod gso ba rig pa'i gsung rgyun la khaṇ+ḍa kun la yod de zangs ri bzang zhes gsung la/ sman rgyur yang 'gro khyab che tsam yod 'dug zangs ri khul cham nad phog na khaṇ+ḍa btung na phan po 'dug ces 'thung gi yod/ lhag par ya ma'i nad kyi mgo/ so/rna/ sna 'gag pa sogs kyi nad la phan che la gzhon nu ma tshos gdong la rtag par byug gi yod pa sman nus kyis gdong mdog dkar po chags kyi yod skad dang / nyi ma'i tsha zer 'gog thub pa'i rkyen gyis red zer/ ston dus lo ma ser por gyur te sa la ma lhung tsam la brngas nas lcags khog gam rdza khog snum tshi med pa gtsang ma'i nang tshig skyon med pa yun ring btsos pa'i khu ba de slar yang snod gong bzhin nang la tshig pa yun ring bskol ba'i ldi khu der lug gi pags pa'i khug ma'i nang blugs nas yar klung dang / lha sa khul du 'tshong gi yod pa der zangs ri'i khaṇ+ḍa red ces mthong chen byed kyi yod/khul de'i lo tog la ser skyon mi 'byung ched ser srung sngags 'chang yod pa nas zangs ri rdzong nye 'khor gyi zhing kha re nas skye dngos gang yin rung ser ba srung yon du phom/ chags gsum re bsdu gi yod/ thag ring rgan khag bzhi nas ser yon 'bru rkyang bsdu len byed/ gser srung sngags pu'i pha shul bu 'dzin rus rgyud nor bu dgra 'dul deng lho kha sa gnas srid gros u yon yin/khong gi khyim ming la rje bzhugs zer/ rje rin po che der zhabs sor 'khod de bzhugs myong bas rje bzhugs zhes 'bod grags/ khong gi pha mes tshe ring bkra shis zhu ba'i mchan rdo g.yam thog brkos nas khyim bde'i phyi sgo'i thod du yod la khong gi phyag g.ya sa pa'ang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur bar khyim der yod/ ser ba babs nye'i skabs phyag de mkha' la 'phyar na ser ba bab yul kha phyogs bsgyur thub kyi yod lugs shod srol yod/ zangs ri rdzong nas 1/34

lo ltar dbyar khrims gan rgya dang / ri rgya klung sdom zhes gan rgya len srol yod pa dar+bhar khrims gan rgya'i nang don latshudabyar’dus 'ong seb la bud megapang gdan med pa dang / zhwa mo med pa 'gro mi chog pa dang / sha dmar rdza dmar 'khyer nas 'gro mi chog pa/ brnga sa dus la ma slobs gong 'ong seb la zor ba 'khyer nas gang byung rtswa brngas mi chog pa dang / btsas ma brnga skabs lam 'khel zhing dang mtha' zhing nas 'go btsugs brnga 'dren bya rgyu las— gang byung brnga 'dren mi chog ces dang / btsas ma brnga chog pa rdzong la snyan seng zhu dgos/ rdzong nas khyon yongs la zhib 'jug gis— brnga dus gtan 'khel byed cing / btsas ma brngas zin pa'i shul du ba glang rtswa ba—zar btang chog pa zhes rdzong la snyan seng dang sbrel sems can re nas sgong nga re 'bul dbo/sa la rta drel rtod pa rgyag dgos/ rdzong gi ngo tshab ched btang nas btsas ma brnga rgyu bsdad par ba glang nas gnod skyon —gtong gi yod med skor g.yeng bya srol yod/ ri rgya klung sdom gan rgya'i nang don la phar spyang phud de min ri klung skam gsher la gnas pa'i bdag med srog rkachags che khrar mi 'jig srog gi skyabs sbyin stsal bas gnod 'tshe byed mi chogade las 'gal na nyes tshab la gzhigs pa'i thag gcod bya rgyu sogs 'khod yod/ dus chen gtong srol bod kyi lo gsar nyin bdun dang / grol ston nyin gcig bcas zangs ri khul yongs la de ltar yin/ bod lo gsar tshes gcig zhogs pa chu phud dang po rag thabs la brtson len gyi nam ma langs gong nas pho mo khyad med pha ma gnyis 'dzoms ming bkra legs pa zhig gis gzab mchor spra si/ kha zas sder kha dang / phye mar chang phud/ bsang bcas 'khyer nas chu phud len du 'gro/ chu khar sder kha sgrig bsang 135

btang / lha rgyal 'then chu phud blangs nas khyim tshang gi rten drung du yon chab phul/ de nas phye mar/ chang phud 'khyer nas khyim bdag nas 'go btsugs lo gsar pa'i bkra shis bde legs zhus/ de nyin khyim bdag gi bla gza' srog gza' 'khel yod na dar tshes dang bstun khyim khang gi zur lcog tu dar tshon sna lnga btsugs/ bsang btang / lha rgyal 'then nas lha gsol byed/ de min tshes gsum lha tshes zhes de nyin dar lcog btsugs/ de nas skyes lha yul lha gsol bar dar lcog dang / phye mar chang phud/ kha zas sder kha bcas 'khyer nas 'gro de min rang rang 'khos 'byor la gzhigs pa'i lo gsar gang skyid gtong srol yod/ tshes gnyis nyin zangs ri rdzong gi nye 'khor du yod pa'i mi drag rnams nas gzab mchor gang legs spras te rdzong dpon la lo gsar sku skal zhes rten 'brel zhu bar kha zas sder kha mtho la sder rdzas sne 'dzoms gang rgyas/ gsol ja/ mchod chang / mjal dar dkar gtsang gcig bcas 'khyer nas 'gro rdzong dpon sdod khang du bskyod nas kha zas sder kha bsgrigs 'bul dang sbrel gsol ja/ mchod chang btegs zin pa dang / mjal dar phul nas smra ba'i dang po bkra shis bde legs zhus/ rdzong dpon nas phun sum tshogs zhes lan rgyag de nas gral la 'khod rdzong dpon nas gsol ston gzab rgyas btang zin pa dang /gsol rgyab zhes mchod chang 'khrung phor re nan gyis blugs pa 'thung nas tog tsam bsdad/ de nas rang gnas su log yong skabs kha zas sder kha rang la lo gsar skal ba'i tshul du phyir bslog thog skye dar re g.yogs srol yod/tshes gsum nyin lha sa smon lam gtor rgyab rta par bskyod mkhan rnams la rdzong nas tshes gsum rta rgyug tu yong dgos pa'i sngon brda btang / de nyin rta pa rnams nas zhwa mo sog zhwa/ sog byur/ rgya gre phor shubs/ lham spu 136

shol/ snam rgya tshos kyiṭīgyon’pa sogs gzab gyon gyi rta bzhom nas rdzong sar bcar/ shrī nga rta go 'pher med na rdzong nas lha sa smon lam chen mo'i ‘gtor phargyab rta pa'i da mag rta zhes rta bzhi gra sgrig byed srol de'i khongs nalibazhon na 'grig rtswapa rnams nos rdzong gisnyechibs zhabs su mnya ma bskyod rta gral bsgrigs te rta rgyugs thang du bskyod/ der rdzo nga gi sdod gdanad+ngha dang / rta pa rnams la gdan lcogs/ phye mar gyi 'bo dang / mchod chang rngam ban bcas gra sgrig byed dgos/ rta pa rnams lo na rgan gzhon go rim ma 'dzol par gral la 'khod pa dang gsol ja mchod chang btegs te cung zad lhod tsam byed/ de nas rta pa rnams rang rang gi me mdar rdzas brdzong rgyag si dang / bud thi'i me kyung kha'i mchu to lta bu bzo ba sogs gra sgrig zin pa dang / rgyugs thengs dang por stong rgyugs/ gnyis par 'ben dang por me mda' dang 'ben gnyis par mda' rgyag rgyugs thengs gsum par stong rgyugs bcas zin pa dang / rta pa rnams rdzong dpon gyi mdun du gral 'grig po bsgrigs nas pus mo g.yas pa 'dzugs tsam byas nas gus btud zhus/ gom pa gsumu phyi 'gros brgyab zin pa dang / g.yas g.yon gral la 'khod/ mchod chang btegs cung zad lhod tsam byed/ de nas rta pa noms tshordzotre dpon gyi chibs zhabs su rta gral bsgrigs nas rdzong khang du 'gro/de nyin rdzong dpon nas lug sha dang lab sgor mnyam btsos byas pa dang /sha rjen/ si paṇa dmar 'dur/ sha skam mthud sogs kyi gsol ston gzab rgyas gtong srol/ myi rta pa rnams sho sbag sogs rtsed 'jor rol nas sdod/ dgong dro'i gsol tshig zin pa dang rta pa gcig gi 'khrungs phor btegs nas rdzong dpon gyi 'gram du langs nas bsdad pa'i brgyab tu rta pa gzhan rnams nas bkris pa'i nang don ldan pa'i gzhas chen btang zin pa 137

dang / rdzong dpon chang 'thung gi med na phud stor byed/ rdzong nas ske dar re g.yogs nas log yong skabs rdzong khang gi bde yangs mthil zhes par bsangs dang / phye mar/ chang gra sgrig byas yod pas bsangs btang phye mar dang / chang phud gtor/ rta pa rnams kyi rgya sgri'i rtser phye mar blangs nas skad sbom po skad gdangs ring pos 'jags rkyang zhes pa nang don la bla ma zhig zhu na/ tham/sa cad mkhyen pa la zhu ang / byin rlabs gzhan la re dgos pa'i sha pho zhig ma yin/ dpon po zhig zhu na/ bsam pho rgya lu la zhu ang / 'go 'dren gzhan la re dgos pa'i sha pho zhig ma yin/ bstan srung zhig zhu na tsi'u dmar po la zhu ang / 'phrin las gzhan la re dgos pa'i sha pho zhig ma yin/ dga' ba la/ skyid pa la/ kyai/ so so/ lha rgyal mo— zhes lha rgyal 'then pa dang chabs cig rgya khri'i rtser yod phye mar nam mkhar stor nas dga' bzhin spro bzhin par rang gnas su log 'gro/ bod zla 1tshes 15dang / zla 4pa'i tshes 15/ zla 6pa'i tshes 4sogs la zangs ri mkhar steng dgon pa'i nye 'khor la yod pa'i drag gzhan tshang ma gzab mchor gang legs spras te mkhar dmar dgon du yong nas snga dro rten gtso ma gcig lab sgron gyi spyan sngar mchod sprin bstar 'bul zhus/ nyin dgung tsam nas cung zad thag ring tsam yin pa'i yul sde yas mas kyi skye bo pho mo khyon che 'dzoms nas dgon pa'i rdo bcal nang gzhon nu smos ci/ a skra dkar por gyur ba'i rgan khog dang bcas pas lag gdang sbrel nas yul zhen chen pos gzhas sgor 'gran bzhin par ja chang dang / pag gzan/ ra lug gi sha btsos pa sogs bza' btung la rol nas sdod/ dgong dro log 'gro skabs phal cher ra bzi nas nye du rnams kyi g.yas skyor g.yon skyor ngang skyug pa skyugs bzhin du da dung chang btung nas gzhas dang / rnam thar 138

gang yin ma shes pa gtong bzhin dga' zhing spro ba'i ngang nas log 'gro/ bod zla 1rkyaba'i tshes 25nyin zangs ri rdzong gi nye 'khor du yod pa'i lha sa smon layogator rgyab rta par phebs bsu dang / mi rgyugs rnams nas nang spyong byedartasrol yod/ nor bu gling kha (rgyal ba rin po che chos 'khor rgyal sogs lho khul gnas gzigs phebs skabs phebs sgrig zhu yul yin )zhes pa'i rgyab tu rta rgyugs thang la yod der zang4ri rdzodzogi khang gnyer nas 'gan 'khur gdan lcog gra sgrig byas yod/ rta pa rnams so so'i khyiyonas rdzong dpon gdan zhur bskyod nas rdzong dpon dang bcas rta gral sgrig nas rta rgyugs thang du bskyod/ mi rgyugs rnams rim pasa'abyor/ dbus su rdzong dpon gyiri gdan yod pa'i g.yas g.yon du rta pa rnaspas lo rgan gzhon go rim ma 'dzol bar gral la 'khod/ mi rgyugs dang bcas par rdzong gi khang gnyer dang chang masasamachod chang btegs zin pa dang / mi rgyugs rnams sgo gsumathang dkyil zhes par bskyod/ de nas rdzong4 dpon sdod yusde bar rgyugs 'gran 'byor da nga gnyis rdzong dpon nas tho bkod byed/ rta pa rnams thoso'i bzhon rta'i rta sga srab rme dang me mda' sogs la zhige'ajug ste rta rgyugs godze+ebazhin thengs gsum rgyugs zin pa dang / rta pa rnams rdzong dpon gyi mdun du gral sgrig pos bskyodanas pus btsugs chang 'thung sogs gong bzhin byas rjes rta pa rnams kyi rdzong dpon gyi chibs zhabs su bskyod nas rta gral sgrig rgyal 'gag zhes rta babs yod sa bar rdzong dpon phebs bskyel zhus nas rang gnas su log 'a gro/ lha sa smon lam skabs bsam 'grub pho brang gi mi rgyugs rnams sger pa dang / sde dpon khag gi mi rgyugs dang spyi mtshungs rgyugs 'gran zin pa dang / bsam pho'i tshoms chen nyi 'od du gdan lcogs gra sgrig byas yod pas/ so so'i ang gnas ltar gral lashā139

'khod/ bsam pho gnyer tshang nas ja chang dang / rtsam phor sha sder bcas ster/ bya dga' mi rgyugs ang dang po lon mkhan la 'bru khal nyi shu tham pa/ang gnyis par 'bru khal bzhi/ ang gsum par 'bru khal gnyis bcas zangs ri rdzong gi yong steng nas sprod dgos pa'i ngo sprod yig 'dzin la bsam 'grub pho brang zhes gsal ba'i rtags dam phab ste ka kor med pa sprod srol yod la lha sar sdod ring za nyal 'gel khal gcig 'khri khungs nas gtong dgos pa'i zangs rdzong nas bkod khyab byed kyi yod/ zangs ri khang dmar steng dgon ni sngar btsun ma'i dgon yin skad dang myo/nga' ris sprul sku grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btabs pa'i gar pa grwa tshang zer ba de de khul yod zer zhing / brtsigs rmang gi shul dang / de khul zhing kha'i ming la rgyal sgo byang sgo zer ba'ang yod la/ mkhar steng dgon pa'i spyi tham kha ris la sgar pa grwa tshang zhes 'bod pa dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur bar yod/ dgon pa de yar klung gtsang po dang nye bas chus 'jigs pas dge 'dun rnams da yod mkhar steng dgon du spos pa dang / btsun pa rnams rim pas dgon pa'i gnyer tshang gi bran g.yog lta bur gyur ba red ces bshad srol yod la khong tshor bla brang las btsun zhes 'bod pa dang bza' zla bu phrug kyang yod la/dgon par bsnyen bkur nam yod kho tshor skal ba yod/ las btsun 'khri khungs khral 'jags lta bu yin 'dug pas 'khri khungs so so nas las btsun rer lto skal zhes zhing kha son bre bcu skor 'gro ba re sprad yod/ gal te las btsun tshe 'das shul 'dzin med na 'khri khungs nas tshab 'jug bya dgos kyi yod pa red/ mkhar steng dgon pa'i rten gtso ma cig lab sgron de rmar gdung yin lugs zer/ chos lugs ri bo dge lugs dang / dmigs bsal ma cig lab sgron gyi dgongs rgyan mo gcod kyi gdam pa thun mong ma 140

yin pa yod/ spyi lo 195khalor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu lhag tsam dang / 'go 'dzin du dbu mdzad gcig dang dge bskos gcig dad ldan khag nas sbyor 'bul zhus pa ma rtsa 'bru bun gtong len byed mkhan la lhan rgyas zhes dge 'dun gsum/ dge nadun rer lore gsol phogs mkhar steng gnyer tshang nas 'bru khal gsum dang ma 'bru bun btang gi skye 'bab nasace'abrurtekhal gnyis bcas yod/ spyi lo 1941lo bod saganas srid gzhung gi ngo tshab mkhan che bkra shis gling pa mkhyen rab dbang phyug lho kha khul gnas mjal dang sbrags dgon sde khag gi 'dul khrims sogs la zhib brtsad byas shing / mkharadamar steng da gomādu gzhi gsum gyi phyagartebazhes ji bzhin tshang ba med pas dze+ego 'dzin du 'on mnga' ris grwa tshabagi mkhan zur re phebs dgos pa'i bka' ltar mkhan zur rgyal mtshan shākya (1945)bod me khyi lor zangs ri mkhar dmar steng dgon gyi mkhan po gsar du phebs mkhan rin po cher lo re gsol phogs 'bru khal bco lnga re mkhar steng gnyer tshang dang / grwa tshang lhan rgyas thun mong nas 'bul dgos/ khong rko rna(195rdo)bod sa khyi lor dgongs zhu mdzad de dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur rjes khra 'brug gtsug lag khang du chos dad rang mos khongs sabazhugs chog pa byung nas mi ring bar sku 'a das/ mkhan po gsar pa tshe ring don grub lha sa brgyud stod gaphebs nas brgyud pa'i dge bskos gnang / de nas mnga' ris grwa tshang gi mkhan po gnang nas mi ring dgongs zhu gnang nas 'on bkra shis du kha ri khrod dungabazhugs mus thog mnga' ris grwarketshangar+shagi mkhan po las thog gi lho kha spyi khyab la zangs ri kha dmar dgon gyi mkhan por phebs dgos pa'i 'os 'char phul don ltar bka' ngo ma ldog par (1959)bod sa phag lo'i zla dang po'i nang mkhan thog tu phebs nas mtshan 'don gnang ba tsam 141

las mdzad pa skyong rgyu gang yang ma byung bar de lo'i bod zla bzhi pa'i nang do dam du 'tshud nas spyi lo 1kha61lo gong dkar rdzong khongs rgya phrug na ra gsar sbol skabs sku 'das/zangs ri rdzong 'og 'a/ rgan khag brgyad yod pa rba/na khag re re nas 'ong bskor dbyar skyid sa/tong ba dang / gzhung rkyang chos bskor zhes zangs ri rdzong nas 'gan len gyis 'ong bskor gtong srol yod pas dpe mtshon lta bu/shar kha rgan 'og 'ong bskor skabs ser srung sngags 'chang (lag rin po che yang zer ) nas 'ong bskor tshang ma'i tshes cha gtan 'khel byed srol ltar gtan 'khel zin 'phral bskor res rgan po dang / spyi mis 'gan 'khur nas chang rgyu mchod tsam sogs kyi dmigs sgo khral rkang re nas 'bru bre bzhi re bsdu zhing / 'byor ldan khag nas 'ong bskyid dbyar skyid zhal 'debs rang mos kyi sprod srol yod/ 'ong bskor dngos gzhi nyin mkhar steng dgon nas 'dzom brda dung chen btang ba dang / mkhar steng dgon du chos 'khur ba dang / rta pa sogs tshang ma 'dzoms bstun dung dkar dang / rnga sbub sil snyan/ rgyal mtshan lha dar sogs mchod pa'i yo chas thogs pas sngun bsus pa'i rjes su dpa' bo dpa' mo zhes rigs rgyud bzang zhing / dbang po skyon med/ pha ma gnyis 'dzoms kyi gzhon nu pho mo gnyis yod pa dpa' mos gos bzang po'i thog steng brtsegs dang / g.yu byur spel ba'i spa phrugagaser gyi ga'u dang a sgor sogs rgyan chas cha tshang bas mdzes par byas/lag tu dar tshon sna lnga ldan pa'i mda' dar la me longs dang g.yu byur mu tig sogs kyi 'phyang 'phrum can mda' yi stong kha mar gyi bskangs rno dbal can gyi mda' lcags bcas cha tshang ldan pa bzung nas phya g.yang 'gug pa'i tshul gyi g.yab mo byed pa dang / dpa' bos gos snam rgya tshos sam go snam/142

lham spu bshol/ rgya gri phor shub/ gse ra gyi sog byil/ zhwa mo 'bogasato bcas kyis brgyan te lag tu gong bzhin mda' dar bzung ba/ de'i rjes0su chos 'khur ba pho mo gang rung them re mi ri gtong srol yod pas bud med rnams nas gos bzang po dang / g.yu byur gyi rgyan ldan mo chas cha tshang bas mdzes par byas/ skyes patshodag gis kyang zab mchor dang bcas rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi po ti 'khur nas gral 'grigs pos ngang pa'i— gom pa ltar dal bus 'gro/ de'i rjes su rta pa rnams yod pa'i dang po ser srung sngags 'chang nas gyon pa rnams rgya tshos thog gzan gos kyi tshul du 'bu ras lim nang gyon la/ g.yu khras brgyagapa'i gser gyi rna rgyan chung chung chatshodang /zhwa ser po bcas gyon nas rta thog thon/ de rjes mkhar da mar steng dgon pa'i nang rten gras sgrol ma gsung byon yin zhu ba bzhugs su gsol ba'i dngul gyi ga'u 'bral pang gdan 'dren pa mkhar steng dgon pa'i dge 'dun de'i rjes gon 'og de'i khongs su yod pa'i 'byor ldan khag nagartartopa re dang rgan po'i rta pyobacas rta pa bdun brgyad skor yod pas zhwa mo sog zhwa dang /sog byur gos snam spu phrug gam 'go snam gang rung / rgya gri phor shub sogs kyi gzab mchor dang ldan pa/ rta'i mgo dang mjug mar gru'u tse tshon sna'i rgyan 'dzar ba dang / g.yer dril gyi sgra dbyangs 'khrol bzhin dal bus bus 'ong bskor du 'ogro zhing / skyid tshal gling zhe sa pa'i gaganas su bsu chang yod pa gral dbus su ser srung sngag 'chang dang / sgrol ma gdan 'dren pa mkhar steng dgon pa'i dge 'dun gyi gdan lcog g.yas g.yon du rta pa rnams kyi gdan lcog ja chang bcas rgan po dang spyi mi/ chang ma bcas nas gra sgrig byas yod pa'i ja chang gang mnyes btegs nas lhod tsam sdod/ de nas ser srung sngags 'chang nas sde brgyad la ser skyems kyi mchod pas brngan par byas 143

zin pa dang / chos 'khur pho mo rnams lag gdang sbrel te glu len pa dang zhabs bro rgyag de nas chos 'khur ba rnams gong bzhin sngon du 'gro/ser srung sngags 'chang dang sgrol ma gdan 'dren pa dge 'dun nas bab chags po'i rnam pa bzung nas rta rgyug mi gtong yang rta pa gzhadzhan rnams kyis rta thog nas zhwa la drud pa dang / rta thog tu nyal nas rgyugs pa sogs rang rang khyad rtsal ston nas rta rtsal 'gran/ lta mo ba rnams nas lo tog sna tshogs kyi 'chun po lag tu bzung nas g.yang khug shog ces skad bzang mthon pos 'bod pa dang chabs cig lag tu bzung ba'i lo tog gi 'chun pos g.yab mo drag tu byas nas rta pa tsho phyir yong nas rta rtsal skyar du 'gran nas chos bskor 'khor ba dang mkhan steng dgon pa'i gnyer tshang gi rdo bcal nang 'dzoms nas rgan po sogs chos bskor 'gan 'khur bas ja chang btegs/chos 'khor ba tshos mkhar steng dgon nas gdan drangs rgyal ba'i gsung rab po ti rnams dgon par rtsis phul nas rang gnas su log nyin gnyis par ser srung sngags 'chang nas mkhar steng dgon pa'i gnyer tshang du bsdad de yul lha gzhi bdag dang / sde brgyad la mchod gtor gser skyem gyi brngan par byas nas lo tog la sad ser sogs kyi gnod skyon mi 'byung ba'i 'phrin bcol byed/ rgan gog de'i khong khyim nang gi skye bo rgan gzhon phal cher dang nye 'khor gyi yul mi bcas mang po rang rang 'khos 'byor la gzhigs pa'i bza' btung g.yos sbyor 'khyer te mkhar steng dgon pa'i gnyer tshang rdo bcal nang 'dzoms nas snga dro bod rigs kyis dga' po byed pa'i lha mo 'gro ba bzang mo'i rnam thar hrob bsdus kyi 'khrab ston byed pa de yang lha mo ba dang /'ong bskor dbyar skyid gtong mkhan 'du 'dzoms byas pa'i nang nas rang mos 'khrab ston byas pa las zur du sgrig btsugs yod pa sogs gang yang 144

med/ dgong dro tshang ma lag gdang sbrel nas yul lugs gzhas sgor rgyag gi yod dzitshang mar chang nar gtong bya srol/ rgam rub tsam la gzhas sgor dkyil —du bsangs btarnga bkra shiso lha rgyal 'then gzha sasgor grol nas rang gnas su dga' spro'i ngang log 'gro nyin gsum par 'ong bskor 'gan 'khur ba mkhar steng gnyer tshang du 'dzoms nas lo gcig dus gcig gi 'ong bskor skobs kyi byung song zhib rtsis byas pa'i lhag 'phro yod na mkhar steng dgon pa'i 'dus spyir bsnyen bkur zhus nas rtsis dag byed/ sgrol ma gdan 'dren po —mkhar steng dgon pa'i dge 'dun gyi bzhon rta dang / 'ong bskor dpa' bo dpa' mo'i rgyan gos sogs 'ong— bskodzor 'gan 'khur bas re bskul byas pa tsam las mjal rten dang gle cha sogs sprod ma dgos pa'i khyim tshang su yodatsho nas ka kor med pa gtong rkyang las mkhregasi bzung byed mkhan med / — yar klung gtsang po'i lho rgyud nas zangs rir 'gro skabs klu khang gru zhes pa (rnam kun gru sa skede'i 'gram na lha rgya ri'i spro khang ku shu'i— sdong po kha shas bcasartseyod pa'ing khul der klu khang zhes 'bod pas spu'i ming la'ang klu khang gru zhes 'bod rbar —grags )shing gru chen po gru stod du shing las bzos pa'i rta mgo la kha btags dang / dar mtshon gyi 'chun po 'chang ba/ gru smad du shing las bzos/pa'i skya ba chen po gnyis yod pas gtsang po'i rlabs gshags nas sgrol 'don byed3kyi yod/ gtsang chu rgyas sgangs la nyin gci ga la gru thengs gcig gam/ gnyisi tsam las gtong mi thub/ deng dus tshan rig shes bya las bskun pa'i spu mthong skabs sngon gyi gru de'i nang gtsang chu rgyas skabs 'gro 'ong byed pa ha cang glen rtags tsha po zhig red snyam/ yin na'ang mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe byung ba'i lo rgyus brjod rgyu med/ gru sa de'i ri 145

lho ngos lha rgya ri dang / byang ngos bsam grub pho brang yin/ rtsa ba'i grutshobadag rtsed thang dga' ldan chos 'khor gling dgon gyi yin 'dug pa lha rgya ri'i khongs rong 'chad dkar rdzong nas lo re gru bogs 'bru khal nyi shu rtsa lnga re rtsed thang dga' ldan chos 'khor gling gnyer tshang la 'bul dgos kyi yod pa red/ gru 'di gtong mkhan mnyan dpon gcig skya ba rgyag mkhan mi gsum bcas yod pa khral 'dzin gtan 'jags pha shul bu 'dzin yin/ kho tshor yong 'bab che la de'i nang nas mnyan dpon la gsum skal yod pas 'bab che/ lhag par lo ltar hor tshong zhes lho byang yul zog brje res kyi tshong 'dus tshugs te hor pa rong dgon pa/ 'bum dgon pa/ chig 'bum ta ring / nag shod/ sog sde sogs nas mar bal khyon che dang /de bzhin bsha' rgyu g.yag lug dang sha sogs 'khyer nas 'bru rigs bsgrub par yong skabs mnyan pa tshor de bas 'bab yong che/ 'ol dga' rdzong brgyud (zangs ri rdzong 'ol dga' chus )zangs rir yong ba'i hor zog dang /khal g.yag gi sga chas rnams lha rgya ri'i khongs (rong zangs ri rdzong rong chus )la dbor nas lho byang yul zog brje tshong byed cing / khal g.yag khyon che yod pa phal cher zangs rir sdod/ hor pa nas zangs ri rdzong la ngo sprod mjal rten du sbang sha zhes dud khag gcig gi tshogs pa re nas lug sha deb gcig phul phyin rtswa rin sogs gang yang sprod ma dgos par khal g.yag rtswa bza' gar gtong rang dbang yin/ tshong 'dus skabs der lho kha sne gdong phu mda' bar gsum gyi dgon pa'i gnyer tshang dang / 'byor ldan khag gis gtsos yul zog brje tshong bya mkhan dang /‘ de bzhin grwa nang / gong dkar rdzong khul bcas nas 'bru rigs bkal ba'i khal ma khyu bsgrigs nas ro tshong la yong gi yod la/ rtsed thang gi tshong pa dang lha sa khul nas mar bal 146

bsgrub mkhan tshong pa'ang yong gi yod/ skabs der zangs ri khul nas thab shing dang / sngo rtswa skam po 'khyer nas mar bal dang brje tshong byed pa dang /ho—ra pa ngo shes tsho'i rtsam pa thag rgyu dang / tshos rgyag rgyu sogs kyi zhor las bya gi yod/ hor zogabyugatsang po sgrol 'dogaskabs gru thengs re btang zin pa dang mnyan pa rnams hor pa'i sdod gur nang 'gro mnyan pa gur nang slebs 'phral ja srub ma dang / sha/ gro ma'i mthud/ phyur mthud sogs 'di bzheso 'di bzhes zer nas kho tshos ma zas pa'i sems khral lta bu bya gi yod/ skabs re sha thug bzhes sha rkyang pa'i thug pa bster ba dang /mnya—na pasa'agro khar pag skal zhes mar dang / mthud/ sha gang 'tshams re sprod dgos pa dngasmo/ mnyan pa tshos sha mthud blugs snod lto phad re yang mnyam 'khyer byed kyi yod/ hor pas de ltar ma byas na mnyan pas dngos po phyed sgrol phyed bzhag gis hor pa gzhan pa'i dngogopo sgrol 'don gyi skyag ngan bya gi yod pas red/ mnyan pa tshos de ltar byas rkyen thengs shig hor pa sog sde khag gcig gis brje tshong zin pa dang 'bru rigs 'a ge la khal g.yag rnamasaji'aded mi dang bcas nyin gnyis gsum gyi sngon la btang /bzhon rta yod pas kha shas shig rjes la bsdad de gru sgrol zin ma nyid la mnyan dpon byams pa zer ba gtso bor bzung nas kho tsho'i 'dod pa tshim par nyes brdungs tshod med btang mjug rta bzhon rang yusde du log mnyan dpon nyes brdung btang bo rma kha nas khrag thon pa gru'i nang mkhyil bsdad yod pa red/ mnyan dpon gong gsal sgo glegs sreng 'khyer nas nang la bskyal dgos pa sogs kyi gnas tshul byung myong yod/ skya ba rgyag mkhan rnams ri la bros thar ba'i jis su hor pas me mda' re gnyis brgyab 'dug rung nyes skyon ma byung / zangs ri rdzong mnga' 'og nas gru bogs zhes khral rkang re 147

nas 'bru bre do re rong 'chad dkar rdzong (lha rgya ri'i khongs ) nas bsdu mi 'byor 'phral sprod dgos pa las gru gla sprod ma dgos rung ston dus mnyan dpon gtso bor byas nas mi re ngo res bsod snyom bster rogs zer ba tsam las don du kho tsho rang gis mnyam 'khyer byas pa'i bre chen po re sprod dgos pa ma zad/ da dung khyim tshang 'byor ldan la mnyan dpon dang skya ba rgyag mkhan bcas nas ja sbag chung gnyis dang ja ril re gnyis/ 'khyer 'khos 'bring la ja sbag chung gcig dang ja ril/ 'khos dman la mu zi sgam chung lnga tsam dang / snyom chung gru nang de tsam 'gro ma dgos pa la'ang mu zi sgam chung re tsam bcas 'dod nyo 'dod tshong med par 'bam tshong spus bsgyur ga/tong ge yod/ rin thang ja sbag chung rer rin 'bru bre bcu/ ja ril rer rin 'bru bre lnga/ mu zi sgam chung rer 'bru bre re bcas len gyi yod/spyi lo 195〈lo'i skabs kyi 'bru'i rin thang la cha bzhag na mu zi sgam chung gcig la bod dngul srang lnga drug tsam gnas/ mnyan pa tshos da dung zangs ri rdzong 'og ri thag nye ba'i rgan/ khag gsum nas shing slong zhes thabs shing bster rogs zer nas rnam kun 'grul bzhud che chung la gzhigs pas shing brgyab gnyis gsum nas ma chags pa sprod dgos la gru kha bar skyel 'dren yang byed dgos/bsam grub pho brang gi khongs rdzong gzhis khag gi lo re'i yong 'bab bsdu 'jub/ byed par bsam pho'i phyag mdzod yong srol ltar phyag mdzod gra nang don grub rab brtan zangs ri rdzong gi yong 'bab bsdu bzhes su yong skabs kho pa'i lag g.yog khongs skal bzang 'phrin las zer ba zangs ri rdzong gi khang gnyer las thog 'gar tshang nga 'i bu mo bde skyid g.yang 'dzoms dang 'dod mthun byung nas de'i go mag tu slebs rjes rim pas skal bzang 'phrin las 148

bsam pho'i phyag mdzod ngo mar gyur/ kho pa'i bsam blor bsam pho'i rje bo'i blo 'dod dang mthun na rang don lhun gyis 'grub rgyu red/ de byings la bsam zhib ma byas kyang 'grig pa'i ngos 'dzin byed pa ltar byung nas bsam grub pho brang gi rje bo'i mig nang la 'dzul na'ang zug mi ga tong ba lta bu'i mthong chen byed kyi yod/ gong gsal bsam pho'i phyag mdzod skal bzang 'phrin las kyi zhabs rten pha gzhis ma khang nyams gso byed thengs gnyis kyi skabs rdo brtsigs thog brtsegs gsum ldan rgya che gsar rgyag byas pa'i dkyil khang tshoms chen rnam dag sgo gsum yod pa'i nang gser zangs las grub pa'i mkhan slob chos gsum sku tshad kung khre gang tsam yod pa na bza' khra rgyan rin thangarnabral ba'i rgyan spros byas pa dang / gsung rten 'brug shog spus legs yin pa'i bka' 'gyur rin po che gos tshos sna'i gdong 'dzar can kun dga' ra ba'i nang bzhugs su gsol ba'i dra mig la thal rdul mi 'gro ba'i ched shel sgo bsgar ba/ ldebs bris la bde chen zhing bkod dang / ri bo tā la'i zhing bkod/ sgrol ma 'i zhing bkod bcas yod pa'i spyan sngar yon chab brgya rting gi dkyil du dngul gyi mchod kong gser tshag ldan pa mtho tshad khre tse do tsam yod pa'i mar me rgyun bskangs/ de bzhin gos tshon khra'i rgyal mtshan dang / ka phan/ phyed phur/ gdung khebs/ gsham bu gru'u rtse tshal lngang dang / gong ldan bcas la gzhung zhabs ser skya dkyus mas 'gran mi thub pa mnga' bdag las lhag pa/ dgon pa che khag zhig gi 'du khang dang gnyis su med pa dang / 'og khang tshang ma 'bru rigs kyi mdzod khang yin pa 'bru khal khri skor yod pa zangs ri/ rong / 'ol dga' ñdzang sogayol 'bru bun gtong ba/ dpyid ka son dang / dbyar dus rtsam rgyu lta bur 'bru khal lnga g.yar po blangs na lnga drug 'gro zhes ston dus 'bru khal drug sprod 149
