dgos la 'bru bun zhu skabs khyon 'bo ra la gzhigs pas mjal rten 'bul dgos/ de min gser g.yu mu tig rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan cha pho chas mo chas cha tshang kha shas dang / bod dngul rmos ci/ nā yang stong sgam mang po yod/ 'bri g.yag 50khyoskor yod pa'i sbra khag gcig rta drel bong bu ra lug sogs ni khyon che yod pa rmos ci/ mi thog gcig rang la 'bar ba'i 'byor pa dang ldan zhing dbang shugs/ che ba'i grags can mi sna zhig tu gyur/yin na'ang khong rnam kun rgyas spros co ba nas mi byed par sto rgo sa gnyis la gyong btang nas sdod kyi yod/ de rjes bsam pho'i phyag mdzod yin bzhin thog zangs ri rdzong dpon las 'gan gcig lcogs byed skabs gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar mgon gsol bar zangs ri rdzong nas lo re gsol phogs 'bul dgos pas 'bul phyogs skor mgon gsol ba dang 'cham mthun ma byung bas khong gi tsi'u dmar mgon gsol ba 'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen dgon kho na nas gdan zhu byas nas sngar lam yong srol yod pa'i mgon po ba rnams 'phyongs rgyas ri bder phyir bslog byas tshab la zangs ri mkhar dmar steng dgon nas dgon po ba phebs dgos pa'i bsgyur bcos byas te lo rgyus kyi srol rgyun dang ma mthun par gyur/ dpal 'byor dang / dbang shugs gnyis gong mthor song ba'i bsam pho'i phyag mdzod 'gar tshang zhes grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i mi sna de skad cha shod skabs tshig 'bru mi gsal bar lkug skad rgyag pa dang / sdod khang gsar pa spro skyid ldan pa/ khyim 'dzin ma dang rigs myug mang pos yongs su bskor nas bkur bste byed kyi yod kyang rang sems rang la ma dbang ba lta bur nyin mtshan med pa khyi smyon ltar ri klung sa cha mtho dma' gang (zi/ ma ltos par mchong rgyugs kho na byed pa ma zad/sngon kho rang gi blo dang ma mthun pa'i mi drag gzhan su yin rung mig gis 150

mthong 'phral nyes brdung gtong rkyang byas stabs nyin mtshan med pa srung bya 'bral med dgos pa zhig tu gyur pa red/ khong spyi lo 1955lo tshe 'das/de sngon khong gzugs po thang po yod pas lo na drug cu re gcig la phebs skabs kyang rgyab 'khur 'khur nas tsa rir gnas bskor la bskyod pa ma zad/zangs ri rdzong la— ston dus nyin gcig la thengs bzhi lnga bskyod dgos pa khong gi sdod khang nas zangs ri rdzong bar lam thag spyi le ga cig tsam las med rung zangs ri rdzong ri ldebs su yod pa gyen la rdo skas mang po 'dzeges nas bskyod dgos rkyang lus ngal yod pa'i rnam pa tsam yang med/ der brten mi tshos khong yong gi yod pa mthong na i si pag slebs byung zer/ de'i go don ni de snga phyi rgyal nas thon pa'i lcags i si pag ces pa nang bzhin gzugs po sra thang 'dug zer ba red/ bshad srol la bsam yas gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs skabs gto bcos su dgos pa bsam yas nas rtsis pa'i thar phyogs su brag la shug pas khengs pa/ ri la dar dkar yol ba btang 'dra/mtsho la a ma long 'dra yod khul du bu ma sangs zer ba gdong rme gsum ldan lo brgyad son pa de dgos pa lung bstan ltar rgyal po'i blon po khag cig gis rta bzhon nas 'tshol du yong pas gong du lung bstan pa ltar brnyed brag la shugs pas khengs pa 'ol dga' rdzong dang zangs ri rdzong gnyis sa mtshams mtshon rtags yin dzi da lta bsdad yod/ ri la dar dkar yol ba btang 'dra 6/sa khul de'i ri khag cig la bye mas yol ba btang 'dra yod/ mtsho la a ma long 'dra zhes pa phyugs kyi rgyu ma a ma long zer ba de dang 'dra ba'i mtsho yod pa bcas brnyed kyang bu ma sangs zer ba ma brnyed par 'tshol mi rnams phyir log yong bas lam 'gram du brag ri zhig yod pa der slebs skabs nub rlung gis 'tshol mi rnams rta kha phyir phyogs dgos pa byung bas lung bstan pa 151

ltar ri de'i rgyab ngos ri bsul zhig na khang pa chung ngu zhig yod pa mthong bas der yod dam snyam nas khang khyim/ der song bas ma sangs zer ba brnyed/khul de'i sa ming la log zer/ bu ma sangs rta thog bzhag nas yar klung gtsang 'gram 'gro lam brgyud nas yong bas bu ma sangs kyi pha ma gnyis kyis bu gtong bar ma phod par rjes bsnyegs nas yong ba 'tshol mi tshos mthong bas bu ma sangs kyi gos kyi dkyil du rdo bsgril nas gtsang chur dbyugs pas gos chu khar g.yeng ba pha mas mthong bas bu ma sangs chu la phangs pa red snyam nas pha ma gnyis ka gtsang por lcebs pas gdon 'drer skye ba red zer ba'i sa khul de rang gi gtsang po'i phan tshun thad kar lha rten gnyis yodaci bu ma sangs kyi khyim shul gyang ro da lta bsdad yod pas khul de'i mi rnams kyis ma sangs gyang khog ces deng sang yang de ltar 'bod kyi yod/bsam grub pho brang gi 'brog pa nas lo re rtsis zhu byed stangs skor zangs ri rdzong khongs su 'brog pa sbra khag lnga yod pa khyon bsdoms 'bri g.yag mgo grangs chig stong lnga brgya skor yod/ sbra khag rer zangs ri rdzong nas lo re phosas 'bru khal sum cu tham pa re sprod dgos thog khral rkang gcig gi rkang 'gro'i khral 'bab sgrub rgyug ma dgos/ 'brog pa'i khyim tshang nas rkang 'gro'i khral sgrub ma dgos stabs sa rkang gzhan la bogs mar btang na rkang 'gro'i bogs ma lo re 'bru khal sum cu tham pa re 'brog par len rgyu yod/'brog pas lo re rtsis zhu byed stangs phyugs tho nang gsal 'bri so gnyis yan la ma lnga bu gnyis rtsis thog nas bi'u'i bsdoms 'bor gyi bzhi zur gcig phrug brlags zhes bi'u shi ba'am bor bar rtsis te skyes 'phel rtsis zhu ma dgos rung / dkar 'bab 'bri bel ma dang 'dra mtshungs bsgrub dgos/gong gsal ma lnga bu gnyis re rtsis pa'i 'phros rnams yar ma zhes bi'u rtsis zhu 152

ma dgos/ dkar 'bab 'bri bel ma re nas mar khal 2 1rkyabar dang 'bri yar ma re nas mar khal 2 10re dang / mar khal re nas phyur ba mkhar bre drug re rtsis pa'i 'bab rtsis zhu bya dgos/ sog phyur zhes bar hrob phul na do skor ba dang / phyur zhib phul na gsum skor rtsis nas len srol/ zhol pho zhol mo gnyis (lha g.yag pho mo )dang / 'gel khal lnga la khul rtsid mi 'khri ba phud pho so gnyis yan re nas khul rtsid nyag brgyad re dang /pho da byar gnyis dbyar gsum dang / mo dbyar gsum yan bcas re nas khul rtsid mkhar nyag drug re bcas brtsis 'bor nas sbra rgyu 'dam spu mkhar 'degs kyi khal 2 10 bar bcags 'phros ngo 'asgel ma dgos pa khal rer bod dngul ṭam re len srol (khal ṭam zer/) 'dam spu zhes pa she rdzi ngo yod kyi lo re'i lham rgyur khul rtsid g.yag shos kyi g.yag gcig 'dams kyi yod/rnga ma phyugs 'bor ji yod mgo grangs gnyis re nas rnga 'phyang krad sgor ma zhes krad sgor rang khengs tshad long re bcas 'bul dgos/ mar ltang 'bri g.yag ko ba yin na ltang re nas ljid grib nyag 12 12 re 'bud kyi yod pa dang / ra lug gi pags pa yin na grib mi 'bud/ ngan shi spya nga bsad la sems can na grangs so so nas bcu zur re 'then dzha(bcu kha ma long med )'phros rnams phyugs tho gzhung khra gsar 'god bya dgos yod pa dang / khe gyong rang 'khur yin/ zangs ri rdzong thog bsam pho'i phyag mdzod ngo bskyod kyis 'brog khral rtsis rgyag bsdu len byed nyin 'brog pa dang bcas par zangs ri rdzong nas gsol ston gzab gtong byed dgos shing / dkar 'bab 'phros chad bsdad pha rnams zangs ri rdzorde nas rjes su bsdu len bya rgyu'i chad gan len gyi yodatshopa bcas so/ 153

lho brag lha khang rdzong gi khral bsdu khrims gnon byed phyogs dang 'brel yod 'khar chu dgron pa'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/lho kha sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus rgyu cha 'tshol bsdu tshogs chung gis/yar klung gtsang po'i lho rgyud bod 'brug sa mtshams su gnas pa'i da lta'i rdzong khag bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan lho brag (deng skabs lo gro rdzongatsho/) lha khang dar ma/ seng ge do rdzong bcas rdzong gzhis khag bzhir bod skad kyi sgra ngo mar lho brag rdzong zhes pa de'i lo rgyus rgyu cha 'tshol bsdu bya yul rdzong sa gnas kyi chab gros u yon gtan bzhugs rnams la bod 'brug sa mtshams kyi khyab khongs dang / lho brag 'khar chu dgon du lha khang myang mchod zhes dus chen tshugs srol/ de bzhin sprel lo nam shar gyi tshes bcu/ lo ltar sprel zla'i tshes bcu sogs chos lugs kyi byed sgo rgyas bsdus sna tshogs tshugs srol yod pa/ de'i skabs bod 'brug yul zog brje tshong byed stangs dang /'khar chu dgon gyi yu la ljongs chags dbyibs/ gnas yig 'thor bu/rdzong de'i las 'dzin thob thang dang / de'i khyab khongs su khral bsdu khrims 154

gnon byed stangs sogs kyi skor 'di ga lo rgyus 'tshol bsdu tshogs chung gis phyogs sgrigs zhus pa/lho brag lha khang gzhis ka dang gzhis khongs kyi gnas tshul sko ro/lho brag lha khang gzhis sdod ces par de snga pre gnas srid gzhung gi rtse drung tog gnas drug pa zhig gtong sros dang / bod 'brug sa mtshams la brten tshong las thabs shes bya yul legs pa dang / mi ser thog nas yong 'bab che bas mnga' bdag che btsan gyis kha 'dzin hab thob byed kyi yod /kha rgyun du cha snyom nyin re rta co pa re'i rin gong gi yong 'bab yod ces bshad srol dang / lha khang gzhis la las drung gcig dang gtso drag gnyis/ rgan khag bcu gnyis/ — mi ser them dud 142/ mi grangs 400skor/ khral rkang 22 61bar/ stong rkang 9phyed 6/ tha khogs dngul bsgyur gyis dngul sprod dgos pa'i son khal 440skor yod pa/ lha khang gzhis la lo re mi ser nas khral bogs 'bru ru'i khal 100rkyaskor/ dngul bsgyur gyi bod dngul ṭam rdo ṭ+wāṃ0skor 'jal sgrub byed dgos pa dang / sa gnas srid gzhung la shing cha 'bras pangs ring tshad spyi khre gang tsam yod pa ngo grangs 15rkya0dang / a zhang pang leb mtho dgu ma zhes pa grangs 500skor/sa gnas srid gzhung 'dzugs skrun dgos mkho'i pang leb nam dgos mtshams cha gses kyis sprod dgos pa dang / gzhan yang rgya shing brngod gsum/ 'dam rtswa rnga gla/ gzim chung dmag rkang bzhi dang / rgya sbyong 155

dmag gcig sku srung dmag phyed bcas kyi dmag gla sogs khral dngul mang tsam 'jal sgrub byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ lha khang gzhis sdod sger la lo re sha khral zhes rkang re nas chung khog re dang / ba glang ko ba re ('bri g.yag gi ko ba sprad na ldab rtsis byed/) ko khral 'gro dmigs ni dbus 'bul 'bras ltang dang / rtsod ltang rgyag byed yin 'dug de min rkang re nas snod phad re bsdus te rgya 'bras dbus 'bul gyi snod phad yin/ yang mar 'degs khal 12 0skor dang / rdzong gi 'bud shing nar gtong / rdzong zhol mi ser dang / stong shar grong tsho'i mi ser nas rnam kun rdzong gi rta g.yog dang / dgun dus rdzong gi bzhon rta'i gzan pa gtub rgyu sogs byed dgos/ de min lag shes bzo khral 'phar bskul byed pa dper na/ shing sgam dang / 'o zo sogs shing byad sna tshogs bzo mkhan/ sgam bshan rgyag mkhan/ rum 'thag mkhan// 'tshems bsdo la sogs par lag khral bskul te gla cha sne sel tsam las mi sprod/ bde chen sa sngags dgon khongs bye ri gzhis kyis kha 'dzin byed pa lha khang gzhis kyi sa cha dang / mi ser them dud bdun/ mi granganu/ sum cu skor bcas yod pa nas lha khang gzhis la lo re bogs 'bru ru'i khal 150sprod dgos kyi 'dugalha lung dgon pa'i chos gzhis gter brgyud gzhis kar lha khang gzhis kyi mi ser them dud gsum yod/ lha khang gzhis sdod gnas yul der 'tsho khag bzhi yod pa de yang zholatsho pa/ gling stod/ klu sding / dbus khang bcas yin/ g.yul khang (dbul khang ) zer ba chu zhig gi pha rir yod/der sprang po khe gtsang sdod pa las sprang po rnams gong gsal grong tsho gsum po'i nang bsdad mi chog lha khang gzhis 'og gi ser nas sgrub dgos pa'i nang khral smos ci / phyi khral sa gnas srid gzhung la rgyugs dgos kyi yod/156

rtsa ba'i khral rten sa zhing gzhi rgya chung la/ 'brog las ni de bas zhan po yin par brten rnam kun ri nas khang pa'i shing cha gcod bregs dang / smyugs ma'i snod chas zar bu dang / shing gi gzhong pa/ rta sga/ khal sga/ zhing las yo chas sna tshogs sogs bzos te gtam shun dang / yar 'brog khul tshong bskyod kyis rin par 'bru rigs gtso bo dang / de min spu bal/ sha mar/ sogs brje tshong byed kyi yod/ dgun dus la lam kha bas 'gag kyang 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal sel ched mi ser 'jon nus yod pa khag cig 'brug yul du 'gro skyod chog pa'i lha khang gzhisal skyabs rten bod dngul srang 2 5skor spradade don min byung mtshams 'brug yul nas dus thog tu phyir log yong rgyu'i khag theg dang 'brel ba'i gan 'jog byed dgos/— 'brug yul nas tshong zog si pan kho na nyos te mi 'khur rerakhal 100skor 'khur nas phyir 'khor mtshams lho brag zhing khul la btsongs nas 'bru rigs dang brje tshong gi 'tsho thabs bya rgyu de ni thabs shes yag shos lacebartsi gi yod/'on kyang 'ga' res 'brug yul sa bab mi 'phrod pa'i rkyen gyis 'chi rkyen byung ba'angayong gi yod/ lha khang sa khul du lo gcig la nas dang / bra bo btab ste lo tog thengs gnyis bsdu gi yod/ der mi ser them grangs 1rkya0lhag tsam nang nas 'byor ldan gnas khag drug dang / zhol pa rgan 'og skyid rab phud/ de byings them dud 92tsam yod pa dbul phongs yin/'brug zog a shom dang / 'ba' chi/ kong rtsam/ kham bu/ rnam kun bra bo las bzos pa'i khur ba dang / bra bo'i pag4btsos mi'astob spyod kyi yod pa red/ de min gro dang / sran/ rtsamaglus nas rtsam bza' rgyu ha lam mthong rgyu med/ mi ser so so'i khral rten sa zhing gi mtha' skor du kham sdong mang po yod pas kham bu dang / bdag med ri kham thogs 'thu byas 157

nas gtam shun khul 'bru dang brje tshong byed kyi yod/ kham bu ha cang 'bel po yod stabs rta bong / ba glang / phag pa sogs kham bus gso chags byed cing / dgong mo ster ba'i kham tsig zhogs pa sems can so so'i kha 'og nas phung gsog thebs pa 'bor chen 'phyag rgyu yod pas kham tsig gis nang tsis snum 'don pa'i srol rgyun yod/lha khang gzhis sdod lcog stengs skabs mi ser thog khral rigs 'phar brdab che tsam byung rkyen ngo brgol byas pa dper na/ mthings zhes pa'i lung pa zhig yod pa der bod tshon mthings srus dag thon khungs yod stabs sngogs 'don gyi lo ltar khral bskyel dgos pa'i sa khungs de dag mi ser kha mthun gyis sa khungs bkag ste lha khang gzhis sdod nas zhib brtsad skabs chu rud kyis 'khyer song zhus pa de nas bzung tshon mthings kyi khral 'jal mi dgos par gyur/ gter kha de dag da lta bed med rang sor gnas shing / de bzhin shu gu steng zer bar shog bu'i rgyu cha nags tshal yod par bod shog spus legs khral bskyel dgos pa de yang mi ser nas me brgyab ste ri la me shor song zhus nas shog shing med par bzos stabs shog khral yang rang shugs su bskyel mi dgos pa'i khral chag gi phan pa byung yod/lha khang gzhis sdod tshe smon gling tsha rdi byang ser byes rtse drung blo bzang bstan 'dzin skabs lha khang gzhis 'og bye chung rgyag rdo zer ba dang / pad lha khang gsar zhang po/ bra'o lung ye shes stobs rgyal/ bde skyid khang gsar bcas kyis dug gtong ba'i bya ba spel gyi yod pa zhib brtsad bya rgyu nar 'gyangs lus mur gong gsal bzhi pos lha khang gzhis 'og dkyil rabs pa'i mkhar sdod gzhis su brku rgyag byas pa ra 'phrod 'dzin bzung byas te 'dri zhib byed skabs dug bster ba'ang ngos len byas pa dper na/ bye chung rgya 158

rdos/ rang gi gcen por dug bster nas bsad pa dngos don ra sprod byung bar brten kho tsho'i mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes kyi rta lcag tshad med btang nas lha sa zhol las khungs su rtsis 'bul zhus rjes kho tsho gtsang sogs sa khul la rgyang phud btang / kho tshos dug rdzas de dag4'brug pa'i lagamanas nyos 'dug pa lha khang rdzong 'gram sgrol ma lha khang gi mchod rten rgyab tu sbas pa dngos su thon nas ra 'phrod/ 'brug pa re zung gis dug tshong rgyu yod na ‘‘dgra 'a du la ’’mi nyo'am zhes gsang skad thog nas 'tshong thabs byed kyi yod/der brten de khul skabs der rang gi ngo shes sam/ dga' nyer ja chang 'bras sogs sprod skabs sngon la rang gi dug sel byed srol yong4 khyab tu yod/ lha khang gi rnam snang—lha khang du rnam snang chodakar thog zhesawod sa 5pa'i nang khul de'i mang tshogs 'du 'dzo mas kyi mchod lus rgya chernazhu zhing /zhol pa dang / lha gdong grong tsho gnyis nas mchod 'ab sha/ zhu mi rnams la sne len gzab rgyas byed srol mchis/ lha khang de'i 'khris su nang rten la tshong dpon nor bu bzang po'i phyag mdzub zhugs par grags pa'i mchod rten zhig dang / mdun dngos su 'brug pa kun mkhyero pad ma dkar po'i dmar gdung bzhugs par grags pa'i tsha khang zur brgyad gcig yod/ lo gsum rer mkhar chu dgon par bod zla 5pa'i tshes 10nyin tshes bcu rgyas pa zhes mkhar chur cham nyin bzhi yod/ skabs der khul de'i mang tshogs dang /de min nye 'khor do rdzong / seng rdzong / dar ma/ gtam shun khul bcas kyi mang tshogs dang / 'brug pa/ mon pa/ kha che/ bal po/ lha sa'i tshong rigs khag bcas 'du 'dzoms che tsam yod/ yang lo 'khor bcu gnyis nang sprel lo nam shar thog sprel zla tshes bcu rgyun gtan las lhag pa'i dus chen nyin bcu tsam yod pa dang / nyin gsuyoring 'cham rgyag gdadzo /159

de nas tshogs mchod byed srol/ dgon der dge 'dun grwa grangs drug cu skor yod cing / de'i skabs gnas bskor ba dang / 'brug pa tshong rigs/mon pa/ la dwags/ khu nu/ stod pa ba/ khams rigs/ kha che/bal po sog/sa phon chen 'dzoms thog lho brag khul dang / yar 'brog lho khul bcas nas gnas bskor ba dang / yul zog brje tshong du 'byor ba'i mi 'bor chig 'bum skor yod pa'i nang brgya cha bzhi bcu tsam 'brug pa yin/de'i skabs mkhar chu dgon pa'i mtha' 'khor shing nags kyi gseb tu gnas bskor ba'i gur nam mkha'i skar tshogs sa la 'phos pa ltar yod pas mtshan mo me 'od la brten nas la las dgon par skor ba rgyag pa dang / mi rigs rang nyid kyi gzhas dang zhabs bro rgyag pa/ rnal 'byor ba tshos so so'i grub mtha' la brten nas tshogs mchod 'bul ba'i ḍa dril gyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs shing / nyin mo dad ldan bskor mi mang pos g.yas g.yon sgrub phug mjal bar tshang kha shig shig gis 'gro ba/ dus chen de'i ring mi mang pos gnas dang bla mar dad gus kyi gsol ba smon 'debs byed pa dang / bod 'brug brje tshong rang mos ltar byed kyi yod/ skabs der lha khang gzhis sdod dang seng rdzong gzhis sdod gnyis ngo bskyod byed kyi yod/ dgon pa'i chos gzhis zog tshong gzhis kyis dus chen ring gnas bskor ba dang / tshong rigs bcas par chang tshul 'dren dgos pa'i srol rgyun yod pas nye 'khor grong mi khag nas tshogs chang rgyu 'bru slong bskyod chog pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas stsal ba'i slong yig yod gshis/ chang rgyu 'bru khal drug brgya skor yong gi yod cing / dgon pa'i chang khang nas dgon pa'i bskor lam bar thog brtsegs gsum tsam yod par shing gi dbo pa'i nang nas chang drangs te zangs chen btsugs pa'i nang dal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin babs pa dgon par bskor 160

bar 'gro mis rang 'dod ltar 'thung chog dus chen dang bstun nas khrom rar 'brug zog rgya zog yul zog brje tshong gra rgyaspu yod/ skabs der mkhar chu dgon pa'i shar ngos su ri'i ldebs srin mo gan rkyal zer ba snying gar sdig nas lha khang gzhis 'og rgan khag bcu gcig dang / seng rdzong rgan khag bco brgyad yod pa rgan po re nas mda' re rgyag cing / mda' tsha kha ang dang po thob mir seng rdzong nas rta sga rgyag gcig dang / lha khang gzhis nas rta sga rgyag spus legs re legs gsor ster srol yod/ spyi lo 1922bod chu sprel lor mda' gyang ring thung skorazurdzong gzhis gnyis kyi rgan po phan tshun rtsod gleng chen po byung stabs sa gnas srid gzhung la mda' dang gnyis dbye ba med pa sngar srol gyang ma brgyab 'thus zhus nas phyis dang gnyis 'gran bsdur mi byed pa byung 'dugalho brag mkhar chu'i nub phyogs su seng ge ri zhes par nam mkha'i snying po'i ri khrod yod pa der dge 'dun zhal grangs drug tsam bzhugs/ gnas de'i khyad chos ni sa stemongatshothang shing gi yongs su khengagoterkenyi 'od sgribs pa dang /de min ja shing sogs shing snas yongs su bskor yod/ ricader ya mtshan can gyi bya rkang pa gcig las med pa skad la ‘‘ngag dbang / ngag dbang ’’zhes mi skad dang gnyis med rgyag pa zhig mthong thos kyi yul du gyur yod/de min bya rigs sna tshogs skad snyan sgrogs shing / ri dwags sna tshogs 'du ba sogs yul ljongs kyi rnam pa rang byung lta na sdug ba yod/ skabs der gnas ri de'i g.yasagayon du mtshams khang mang po yod pa gtso bo 'brug pa'i mtshams pa ba mang tsam yod pa las bod pa'i mtshams pa nyung shas las med/ 161

lha khang gzhis ka dang 'drug pa gnyis bar gyi sa mtshams dang / 'grem 'grul/nyo tshong byed chul gyi skor/lha khang gzhis dang / 'brug pa gnyis kyi sa mtshams dang phan tshun gnyis nas sa mtshams bar lam bzo byed srol skor/ seng ge ri rgyud de snga 'brug yul du 'gro lam sngo dong zam pa zer ba brgyud dgos pas de sngo dong zam pa bar lam bzo 'phrang skas sogs lha khang gzhis 'og thing pa/ seng ge ri/ shas mong bcas gsum gyis nyin lam lnga'i sa mtshams bar bzo dgos kyi yod/ bzo yul rong sa cha 'phrang ha cang dogs rkyen gzhung chu gcig pu de rang la zam pa bzhi bcu skor dang / sngo dong zhes pa'i zam pa de bod 'brug sa mtshams dang zam pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi brag ri'i sa dbyibs ni g.yang zar mtho tshad la shing skas gdang bu brgyad bcu tsam yod par thad kar 'dzegs babs byas nas 'gro dgos pas ha cang nyen kha che bas myong goms med na gang byung 'gro mi thub/ 'brug pa rgyal po'i mi ser gyis 'bras khal gnyis yod pa'i ltang gnyis re sgal par 'khur nas yong gi yod/bod phyogs nas lam zam sngon la bzos zin na bal tshon sna lnga'i dar lcogs 'dzugs srol/ phyi phyogs nas 'brug pas sngo dong zam pa bar bzo gi yod pas 'brug lhun rtse rdzong dpon dang / 'brug ku ru sde bzhi'i mnga' 'og mi ser nas bzo dgos kyi yod 'dug 'brug pas sngon la bzos zin na dar lcogs dkar po 'dzugs srol yod/ brag ri de'i ldebs la tshong dpon nor 162

bu bzang pos tshong las spel ba'i dus kyi tshong bre zhes pa gru bzhi dang /tshugs bre zhes sgor sgor yin pa gnyis kyi rang byon deng sang mjale rgyu yod/bshad srol ltar na sngar bod 'brug gnyis kyi brje tshong bya rgyu sa cha de rang du yin skad/ rjes su dbyar tshong dang / dgun tshong lha khang rang du tshugs srol gyi gong 'phel song zhing lam zam bya rgyu'i dus tshod gtan 'khel med par 'brug pas lam bzo bya 'go tshugs mtshams ri la me brgyab ste du sprin gyis brda sprod byed pa dang / bod phyogs nas lam bzo byed kyi yod pa'i brda mtshon du shing gzhogs chu bskyur byed par 'brug pas brtag dpyad byed srol yod/ sngo dong zer ba brag ri de'i phan tshun gang rung zam pa med na bod 'brug gnyis ka 'grul bzhud bya thabs bral/ bod 'brug sa mtshams thad lha khang gzhis nas byang thing brgyud tshe lam dpal rir/ shas mong /g.yag rgyugs la/ sbas yul khan pa ljongs/ de nas gdung zam zer ba'i zam pa yod/ sngar bod 'brug sa mtshams yin/ deng skabs gdung zam nas g.yag rgyugs la'i bar spyi sa thang du bsdad yod/lha kha nas shar la phrang brgyud 'brug yul du 'gro skabs bod la'i zhes pa bod kyi sa khongs dang / la'i de'i rtser 'dzing rag gi shul yod/ de nas sman chung ma zhe sa pa'i gzhung chu zhig yod/ de nas gang la'i rgyab tu mon kha na ring zhes pa der mtsho rgyal phur bsgrub brag phug ces pa yod/ de nas mon kha seng rdzong zhes dgon chung zhig yod pa de'i dkon gnyer de sngon lho brag lha lung dgon nas dge 'dun bzhi phebs srol yod pas rang khongs yin tshod 'dug kyang / bar skabs shig la phyogs gnyis ka nas sdod mkhan med/ phyis 'brug pas bdag bzung byas pa ma zad/ sman chu ma zhes pa'i chu'i pha ri bar 'brug 9pas bdag bzung byas/ bod zla lnga pa'i zla mjug tu 163

dbyar tshong zhes tshong dus tshugs srol yod pa der 'brug pa la so khag kha ba'i nyen kha mod stabs leng khrang dang / sib la zhes la khag gnyis po brgyud lha khang la yong skabs 'bras dang / a shom gsos pa/ so sngon sogs tshong zog sne mang 'khyer yong gi yod/ dus der 'brug pa phon che med la yul zog brje tshong byed skabs do dam 'khur ma dgos pa rang mos yin/dgun tshong zhes pa lo ltar bod zla 12pa'i tshes 15nyin bdag cag gi ston pa sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus chen khyad 'phags yin pas lha khang myang mchod zhes chos lugs kyi byed sgo gzab rgyas byed srol yod pa dang bstun tshong dus zla gcig tsam tshugs kyi yod/ myang mchod kyi mchod 'bul sogs chos lugs byed sgo gnang bar mkhar chu dgon nas dge 'dun rnams phebs/ bod zla 12pa'i tshes 12nyin dbu 'dzugs/ tshes 14nyin mchod pa gzhengs/ tshes 15nyin myang mchod cham/ ser sbrengs kyi gos sku 'grems/ tshes 16nyin rdzong nas rta pa gcig dang / rgan khag ban pa khang chung se rag mas rabs rgan/ rgyas sman/ bar lhag thing man/gdags smad/ gdags stod/ dur pa/ shas mong / zhol pa/ stong sel/ seng ri bcas rgan khag bcu gnyis kyis rgan po re nas rta pa re bcas 'dzoms te rta rgyugs 'gran sar 'ben gong 'og gnyis btsugs yod par mda' dang / me mda' brgyab/ rta rtsal 'gran tshogs der bod 'brug tshang mas dga' po byed kyi yod/ rta rgyugs 'gran rtsal zin 'phral lha khang gzhis sdod nas khrom mi dmangs kyi dkyil du ang dang gnyis kyi tsha tho klog nas legs gso'i kha btags dang / gnang sbyin bstar sprod byed pa dang / rta pa rnams la zas ston gzab rgyas bshams kyi yod/ dgong dro gtor rgyag zor 'phen byed/ tshes 17nyin rta pa rnams la rdzong nas gro ma 164

'bras sil tshal skyog re dang / kha zas lnga sder re/ pag dang sha sder bcas kyi lto dus gcig ster nas grol/ bod kyi gnam lo gsar du bzhad pa'i tshes gcig nyin gtso drag dang / rgan po/ gnas khag bcas nas changasmodam bi gang dang / kha btags re 'khyer nas rdzong la rten 'brel zhu bar 'gro ba dang / rten 'brel zhu mi rnams la rdzong nas nyin gcig ring gsol ston bshams kyi yod/ tshong 'dus skabs 'brugapa dang / mi dragargan po/ gnas khagacibacas nas yul srol rdo skor rgyag mkhan phyogs phyogs mi grangs gcig mtshungs bzos nas dkar gong ngam/ rwa co'i 'ben btsugs te rdo skor rgyag dgos/ rdo skor pha ma pa nas chang dang / gsolatshig spus legs thengs gcig gtong srol yod/ skabs der bod 'brug tshong pa dang / gnas bskor ba/ kha che dang / bal bo'i tshong pa/ stod pa/ gtsang pa/ lha sa/ dbus khul/ nye 'khor zhing 'brog mang tso tshogs bcas mi tshogs chen po 'dzoms kyi yod/ de'i skabs lha khang gnas khag drug ces pa pad lha khang gsar/ glang mda' 'og gling stod/gling smad gnyis/ gzim 'og khams gsum rdo ra bca sa gnas khag drug khongs nas gnas khag che shos sar 'brug ku ru sde bzhi'i spyi khyab lhun rtse rdzong dpon sdodakyi yod/ tshong dus ring 'brug tshong dpon gyis gnas chen la nyin ltar lto skal nar gtong byed srol dang / de byings 'brug tshong pa rnams gnas tshang gnas khag gzhan dag sar rang mos kyis bsdad chog/ pa las ngo shes brgyud nas gzhan la gnas sdod byayomi chog 'brug pa'i tshong zog gtsobo sman 'bras legs pa zher/ a su/ chu 'brus/6 'bum sde gling pa zhes 'brug dpon gyi za 'bras dmigs bsal can/ dkyus 'bras legs zher/ 'khras brngod/ 'bras leb/ a shom bo kha/ si pan 165

dmar sngon/ so lo sngon po/ rgya tshos/ dmar btsod/ tsha lu ma/ li skam rlon/ mog ro spus legs/ bur shing / rgun 'brum dkar naga'abu ras dkar po yug chen dang / gsum brtsegs/ 'bu ras a li dkar po/ 'bu ras shad pa khra bo/ 'bu ras 'ja' sgrig 'bu ras kha dkris/ 'ga' ras me tog ris sna tshogs yod pa/ 'ga'i pang btags/sbrang rtsi/ sman rigs a bar bskyur gsum/ sga skya/ sga smug dza ti pha la/ tir dkar nag rtswa ku sha/ me tog tsam pa ka sogs dang / stag gzigs gi pags pa/ sram lpags/ rgya ra'i pags pa/ ra rgod pags pa/ kha lpags/ sbrul lpags/ dom lpags/ dom sha/ dom mkhris/phag sha/ 'bras kyi a rag kong 'bru'i a rag sba slo tshon khra sgor mo dang gru bzhi/ rdzab ya'i phor pa/ ko la'i phor pa dang / sgog phor che chung sna tshogs/ smyug ma'i mar bkag che chung sna tshogs/ sked rag dang /lham sgrogs spus legs/ khra lpangs/ 'brug gri spus legs ring thung sna tshogs/ de min rgya zog sna tshogs sogs thon gyi yod pa tshong zog tshang ma rgal par 'khur nas gong gsal sngo dngos brag ri'i skas ring brgyud nas dbor 'dren byed kyi yod pa red/bod zog spyir btang tshong pas rnam thig ma legs zher sna tshogs dang /pang gdan/ snam dkar legs 'bring 'dom bcu gnyis long nges kyi gyon 'deng / rgya snam zhes snam spus legs 'dom bcu gnyis long nges/ lug lpags/ tshi lu/ shi sha skam po dang / nya sha skam po/ phyur rul/ bod dngul ṭam dkar/ dbyin sgor/ nā yang / rkyang sha/ ri dwags sha/g.yu byur/ po shel sogs tshong gnyer byed/ gzhung chung rgyas te lam zam la gnod skyon 'byung dogs kyi tshong 'dus gro' 'phral log 'gro rgyu las dus 166

'gyangs ka kor byed khoms med/ dbyar dgunaganyis su lha khang du 'brug pa dang brje ཿnga byed par yong mkhan dar ma dang / seng rdzong / do rdzong /gri gugazhis sogs kyi zhing 'brog mang tshogs tshos sa gnas lha khang phud de min sna rtse rdzong dang / sger mkhe smad pa'i khongs gling gzhis sdod gnyis la dbyig 'gog dmag lam 'khel ba'i gun mthud mtshon byed du tshong zog ji yod khong gnyis la ma gtogs gzhan tshong mi chog pa'i bka' gtan dmigs bsal yod/ gal te gzhan tshong byas pa thos tshe sna gling gnyis nas gzhung bzhes gtong rkyang dang / sna gling dang bcas pa'i sa khul khag gi zhing 'brog mang tshogs nas zog phud bcu zur dang / 'brug zog rgyab 'khur re nas dpya khral bod dngul ṭam dkar re lha khang gzhis sdod nas bsdu len byed cing / bcu kha ma long na spros mi dgos/ zog phud bsdu len byas pa rnams gnas khag la sprad de gnas khag nas lha khang gzhis sdod la nyer mkho gang dgos sgrub sprod byed dgos/ 'brug tshong rnams nas lha khang rdzong gi gtan tshigs dgongs don ltar tshong 'dus ring rdzong la 'brug pa dpon khag bzhis 'bras 'brug bre bcu drug la tshwa bre nyi shu re byas pa'i 'bras khal 200skor dang / de byings tshwa 'bras 'go thug byas nas nyos pa 'bras mkhar ru'i khal 900yas mas zin gyi yod/yar 'brog yul zog rdzong gi mkho sgrub ma zin bar gtan tshong mi chog pa'i bkag bsdoms byed pa dang / mi dmangs nas gang byung du tshwa 'bras nyos mi chog pas gnas khag them dud bdun nas tshwa 'bras sus kyang nyo tshong byas mi chog pa'i gan rgya blangs te de las 'gal rigs la 'ba' nyes lo re bla phyag las khungs la lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i tshogs bzhugs dge 'dun gyi bzhes tsha'i rgyur 'bras ru'i khal 496'bul dgos pa de dag 'gan len byed 167

dgos pa'i tshig brjod bkod yod/ ban pa'i phur gad mo rgod la zhes pa'i chu dang / dga' spro la'i chu/ stod ri nyi shar gyi chu/ mtsho smad rdzong khul gyi chu/ klung 'gro'i chu sogs gangs chu bzhi dang / mtsho chu gcig bcas kyi 'bab chu lha khang gzhis kyi mdun ngogs 'brug yul brgyud rgya gar du rgyug gi yod cing / chu der lha khang zam sbi zer ba'i zam pa zhig yod pa der lha khang gzhis stod phud/ de byings mi khas 'gro dgos byung tshe lha khang gzhis la zam gla bod dngul srang gang re phul te byung 'dzin blangs nas 'gro dgos/byung 'dzin med na zam srung ched btsugs yod pas gtong gi med/ dngul dkon pa'i khams rigs gnas bskor ba re zung gis chu brgal nas phyin pa chus 'khyer ba'i gnas tshul yang thon myong yod/ bod zla gsum pa'i nang lho brag lha khang gzhis sdod nas dbus 'bul sna tshogs mar ltang dang / btsod ltang / rtse mo zer ba kha zas sgrig gzeb/ can pang / snag tsha/ sgron thal bcas 'bul gtong dgos par gtan lam dgongs don khal rgyab grangs 20skor gyi khal ma dang / dos rgyab pa gcig gi rta 'ul bcas bskul gtong byas te 'brog rtsa yul nas gong dkar/ bye la brgyud skyel 'dren byed kyi yod/bod zla 12nang bod kyi lo gsar gyi nyer mkho sgrub par lha khang gzhis sdod nas 'brug yul du tshong pa ngo g.yog dang / dos khyer mi hreng sum cu bcas 'gro dgos shing / tshong pa ngo g.yog gnyis 'brug yul sdod ring 'brug gzhung lhun rtse rdzong nas lto chas nar gtong byed pa ma zad/ khong gnyis kyi sger tshong brgyab pa'i tshong zog rnams 'brug pas lha khang bar skyel sgrol byed cing / dbus 'bul tsha lu ma (tsha lu ma mi 'khur rer tshwa bre gang sprod dgos/) a ru/ ba ru/ skyur ru/ sga skya/ bur shing / am 168

'bras/ li bcas khal rgyab sum cu skor bla phyag las khungs su bod zlaske 12nang nges par 'byor ba 'bul 'gro'i skabs gtan chag lam yig dgongs don khal ma 20dang / dos rgyab pa gcig la rta 'ul gnyis dang /za nyal 'gel khal gnyis bcas nyin mtshan ltos med kyis dus 'bul thub pa byed kyi yod/ de khongs nas bla phyag las khungs rang la khal rgyab bcu skor las/ de min bla phyag ngo las so so'i sger gyi lo gsar nyer mkho dang 'brel yod gzim shag khag lasger gyi lo gsar nyer mkhor 'bul sprod byed dgos kyi yod 'dug yang lo ltar bla phyag las khungs su rgya 'bras dbus 'bul zhes dkyus 'bras rgya 'bo'i khal 496la 'bun spar rtsis mkhar ru'i khal 72khadang (rgya 'bo'i dbyibs slel po kha sbrub 'dra ba zhig yod/) a shang pang leb zhes pa grangs 1000skor la/ dos khal 2ni0skor 'bul dgos par gtan lam dgongs don ltar dos rgyab pa gnyis la rta 'ul gnyis dang /za nyal 'gel khal gnyis bcas dgos shing / 'gro lam 'phyongs rgyas/sne gdong / rgod la brgyud skyel 'dren skabs lam bar ka kor kho nas lo 'khor 'gor 'gyangs yong gi yod/ rgya 'bras dang rgya 'bo zhes pa dang thog bod sdod am ban gyi nyer mkho'i dmigs sgo yin pa rjes su lam ngan mu 'byams kyi dpya khral la gyur pa'i bshad srol 'dug mang tshogs kyi za 'bras lha khang gzhis sdod nas 'os 'tshams shig tshong gi yod/ 'brug gzhung ma gtogs de byings kyis 'bras ltang brgyab mi chog pa'i khrims srol ltar 'brug gzhung dang / a she dbang mo'i tshong pas 'bras ltang 'khyer yong gi yod pa 'bras ltang tshong par bkag bsdoms med khar gnas khag drug nas sdod khang dang gdan rtswa 'bud shing bcas gra sgrig bya dgos/ lhag par 'bud shing ldeng nges gra sgrig byas na kho tsho dga' po byed kyi yod/ 'brug pa 169

tshong dpon thog mar yong skabs lha khang gnas khag gi thos mtshams shig nas sngon brda mtshon byed me mda' rgyag gi yod pa me mda'i skad sgra thos 'phral gnas khag rnams nas bsu chang la 'gro dgos kyi yod/ tshong 'dus ring 'brug pa yar mar 'grul bzhud rtag tu byed cing / bod 'brug brje tshong skabs gnas pos nyo tshong gnyis kar phyogs ris med par bar gnas kyis 'phrol mol byas par nyan na smos med dang / gal te ma nyan tshe tshong zog gzhan tshong mi chog par dngos por thel tse brgyab thog lha khang gzhis sdod la spus tshong zhu dgos zer gyi yod/ de ltar lha khang gzhis sdod la spus tshong byas na gyong gun yong rgyu las med stabs gnas pos 'dum btang bar nyan 'jog mi byed mthu med yong gi yod/ yul zog brje tshong gnas khag la ma bstun par lkog tshong byas na gnas khag giga'aphrog chog pa'i dbang cha yod pa ma zad/ 'jal byed tshong rigs bcu zur dang / de min dngos zog rin bsgyur byas nas bcu zur len srol yod/ de'i ming la (ta li )zer ba dang / 'dra drang yin min la ma ltos pa'i gnas khag gi dmigs bsal dbang cha der srung brtsi byed dgos kyi yod/ tshong 'dus ma tshugs gong lha khang gzhis sdod nas gnas khag dang / de min gnas tshang g.yar po gtong mkhan bcas nas 'brug 'bras sil ma brje tshong byas mi chog pa'i gan len byas te gal srid 'bras lkog tshong byas rigs byung na lha khang gzhis sdod nas gnas por rta lcag sum brgya tham pa ka kor med par gtong rkyang byed kyi yod/tshong 'dus ring 'brug pa sdod yul gnas khag la 'bras zas chog pa las/de min gyi 'bras zas mi chog gal te zas na khang pa'i sbug sogs mngon chung byas nas bza' dgos kyi yod pa ma zad/ sgo 'gag dang / sge'u khung sogs nas phyi mi yong gi yod med so blta bzhag dgos kyi yod pa sogs 170

rdzong gi za sgosdo dmigs bsal gyi srol rgyun ngan pa de lta bu yod/ lho brag 'khar chu dgon pa'i chags dbyibs dang gnas yig thor bu sogs kyi lo rgyus skor/o rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub gnas chen po lnga'i ya gyal lho brag 'khar chu zhes pa ni lho kha sa gnas khongs lho brag lha khang gzhis kyi shar lho'i mtshams su ri bo dung dkar gyi rang byon lta bu'i sa dpyad phun sum tshogs pa'i sa gnas der yod/ phu'i gangs ri shel gyi mchod rten lta bu yod pa nas yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu rgyun g.yas g.yon so sor rgyug cing lho ngos kyi chu 'bab yul der bde mchog gi rang byon yod/ chu de lha mo mkhar chen gyi ri rgyud du 'bab cing der 'khar bas na 'khar chu zhes pa'i ming chags zer/ ri de'i khor yug gang sar pho shing stag pa dang / mo shing glang ma/ bu shing 'om bus mtshon rtsi shing sna tshogs kyi tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/thang shing dang / shug pa la sogs nags tshal gyis gnas ri de'i kho ra khor yug kun tu mdzes shing bklubs pa ltar yod la der rigs mi 'dra ba'i 'dab bya dang / ri dwags sna tshogs kyi khyu rang rang gi 'tsho ba la rol zhing rtsed 'jo 'gran pa/ de'i nang nas mdangs bya zer ba gzugs shin tu mdzes pa rma byar 'a gran pa lta bu spu sdug yid du 'ong mgrin sgra snyan zhing sgrogs pa rnams de —ga'i dgon gnas dang / ri khrod kyi khor yug tu dal bus rgyu zhing gsung snyan sgrogs shing gshog rlabs sgyur ba/ g.yas g.yon gyi ri brag tshang mar rin po che'i gter kha sna tshogs yod la/ ri brag spang ljongs tshang 171

mar sman rtswa snyi ba/ dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu sogs sna tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yal ge lo ma/ me tog 'bras bu sa phyug cing gangs lha me tog kyang gang sa gang du bcal du bkrams pa ltar mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba yod/ sprel zla'i dus chen skabs sogs la stod khul nas bod rigs sman pas sman rtswa thogs 'thur phebs kyi yod/ lhag par du rtswa rtag ngu zhes pa ngo mtshar che ba'i rtswa der tshon mdog gi cha nas kyang rigs dkar ser sngo bcas yod pa/nam zla dus bzhir dwangs zil mi nyams par sdo da pa'i ngo mtshar ldan pa'i khyad chos dmigs bsal can yod pa de ni bdag cag gi ston pa nyams med shākya'i rgyal po sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i me tog yin zer/ de bzhin gu ru'i thugs kyi dben gnas sa 'dzim mthon po ni nam mkha' 'bigs pa da mtshungs par rang 'byung lhun gyis grub pa'i ngo mtshar gyi gnas der o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas rabs kyis bcags shing sa 'dul rab gnas dang bcas gnas sgo phye ste sgrub pa mdzad cing / 'gro rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod de ma 'ong dad ldan 'gro ba yongs kyi tshogs bsag sgrib sbyong gi ched du gnas mchog de nyid byin gyis brlabs te da bar lo ngo chig stong brgya lhag tsam gyi lo rgyus ldan thog de rjes 'brug pa kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos 'khar chu dgon pa de gsar bzhengs mdzad de sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa spel nas lo 459tsam song / gnas der rten khyad par can mang po yod pa las/gter bdag dang gnas srung ni/ dur smyon seng gsum yin/ shar du 'od gsal chos rdzong gi gnas lhun gyi mtho la brjid chags pa/ rgyab ri rdo rje phag mo'i rang byon 'gyings stabs su gnas/ bar khyung gshog nam mkha' lding gi rdzong chen ri rgyal dung dkar g.yas 'khyil lta bu'i steng spyan ras gzigs 'gro 'dul snying rje yi rang byon/ 'khar chu dgon pa'i gtsang 172

khang gi rten gtso sku rgyu gser zangs las grub pa'i o rgyan za hor gyi cha byad gzi byin 'bar ba sku tshad spyi khre 7 5byeyod/ de'i thugs gzungs gu ru'i sku tshon gang pa khri phrag bcu gnyis tsam dang / gzhan yang sku rgyu gser zangs dang / li ma las grub pa'i sangs rgyaso byang sems kyi —sku brnyen/rgyal ba'i bka' 'argyur bstan 'gyur gyis gtsos gsung rten du ma dang /g.yas su sangs rgyas 'od dpag me/da mgon dang mkhan chen zhi ba motsho/g.yon du thugs chen yang snying 'dus pa dang / chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku brnyan bcas sku tshad thog tshad gang tsam byas pa khyad 'phags byin can/ dbu steng gsang ba'i 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshom bu/ ldebs bris la thod phreng sde lnga/ bla brgyud/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha tshogs/ ging chen sde bzhi/ gter ston rgyal po lnga/ sku rgyu gser zangs las grub pa'i bcom ldan mi 'khrug mgon po sku tshad spyi khre 2 50/nam mkha' snying po sku phreng drug pa'i gdung rten gser zangs las grub pa'i sku tshad mtho dgu la gzungs rten khyad du 'phags shing rin po che sna tshogs kyis khra tshom brgyan pa/ gzhan yang byur rgyu'i sdong po dang / dung dkar g.yas 'khyil/ bse ru'i rwa la sogs pa rin thang gzhal dka' ba'i rigs dngos khyad can 'gran zla dang bral ba/ phu yi ri bo sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rang byon gtam yig gi rnam pa mngon sum gral bstar sgrig pa bzhin bzhugs pa/ g.yu yi rdo bcal gting 'dra'i g.yu sgrol ma'i bla mtsho/ rtso dngul gyi ga zho nga pa ja thang gis bkang pa 'dra ba'i zhing skyong gi bla mtsho 'jigs rung mtsho nag rba klong ngom zil can/ gter bdag dge bsnyen smyos kha'i bla mtsho la sogs pa'i mtshogimatshe'u rnams kyi sgrol ma'i mdun du yon chab gsham 'dra yod/ mduspo gyi ri bor rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rang byon sosor ma 'dres pa 173

lhun po brjid chags su gnas pa/ don yod grub pa'i ri rked du rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i sgrub phug mdun ngos g.yang gzar can lta bas mi bzod pa'i brag ri'i bar na dkyil 'khor phug ces par bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha bris mkhas pas dngos su bris 'dra'i rang byon ngo mtshar can/ de'i steng rdo yi mchod rten rang byon 'khrungs g.yas phyogs brag ri'i bkod pa rgyal mtshan gyi rang byon/ de 'og ston pa'i dbu yi rang byon gyi brag ri/ de yi 'dab na zab gter mdzod kyi gang ba'i rnam rgyal brag ces bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi chos sgo gter chen gu ru chos dbang nas spyan drangs pa'i gter khungs mngon gsum de nas babs pas mkha' 'gro'i bro rang la slebs dus ngo mtshar can mkha' 'gro'i zhabs rjes grangs mang zhig yod la mi dang khyi sogs thar sa med pa'i brag ri'i ldeb rdzun 'khrul gyi mkha' 'gro'i gnas ngo mtshar can/ de nas cung zad babs pas na 'gro mgon rgya ras pas zhabs kyis bcag pa'i re snyom drug gi chos rnams gter gyi skal bar bzhes shing gnas der lo bzhi dang zla ba drug bzhugs pa'i sgrub phug re snyoms phug ces pa der rten gtso o rgyan gu rgyu bhi ma mi ṭa dang /kun mkhyen mar mi dwags gsum gyi 'dra sku/ de'i mdun gyi brag a ma gcig lab sgron gyi zhabs rjes dang / nam mkha'i snying pos yang dag sgrub pa bsnyes nas sgrub rtags nyi ma'i zer la chibs dus rabs rting gnyis kyi brag la bzhag pa'i zhabs rjes/ de nas shicha/ tu tsub pa'i g.yang rong gi lam khar gu ru'i phyag 'khar gyis brag brtol ba'i rang byon 'dab la bug pa phug nas bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ brag dung dkar g.yas 'khyil 'dra ba'i gshog pa'i nang sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan dus gsum kun mkhyen pa lo bdun sgrub pa mdzad bzhugs byin chen gyi sgrub phug der gu ru nam snying 174

thugs brtses dgyes bzhin bzhugs pa'i brag la slob dpon nyid kyi sku rjes dang dbu zhwa'irtsorjeso sogs ngo mtshar can/ gter chen gu ru chos dbang gis gnam lcags kyi phur pa che chung khro gang gi tshad cig brag de nas gter du brozhes shul/ lcags phur zhes bya ba'i lha khang der lhag par gu ru'i lung bzhin sras gu ru chos dbang gi phyag bzo sgo mang bkra shis mchod rten bzhengs 'phral gu ru dngos byon nas rab gnas mdzad skabs sa yos 'brug ldir sogs la bltas khyad par can byung ba'i byin rlabs ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa'i rten gtso gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje thog rtsegs gnyis tsam/ gu ru mtshan brgyad phreng sde lnga la sogs pa/ gnas bdag klu bdud mgo dgu'i ldebs bris/ de nas sngar lam mkha' 'gro bro rar slebs nas 'jigs rung g.yas gzar nas mar babs nas g.yon phyogs brag ri mtho po'i steng pa 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi sku lusajikyi bkod pa phyag g.yas kyi nang nas ya mtshan dang / gsil gyi bdud rtsis sdig sgrib nad gdon 'joms pa 'i ngo mtshar can/ rdo dang shing gi skas dang zam ring brgyud rong chu 'gro ba 'dren pa'i myong grol de brgal nas gnas chen bde wam ko ṭi nye 'gram du slebs dus rtsa ri'i rlung sgo zhes pa'i rlung bsil dang 'ur sgra brag seng nas mgo bo rgyus nas nyan sa la slebs shing / gnas mchogatshortsa ri gnyis pa lha mo yi mkhar chen brag mkhar bde mchog rang byon nam mkha' la snyegs 'dra/ dbu steng lha khang du gtsugs to ra —pha wang lo re bzhin je che ru 'gro tha'i byin rlabs can/ pha ri brag gi ldebs su mtshal gyi bris pa 'dra ba'i gu ju'i phyag dam/ dbang phyug gyen lang rang khyon thog rtsegs gsum tsam zhig de la rgod tshang dgon pa'i rdo rje'i rabs rjes dang /de'i rgyab tu ngo mtshar brag las pho chu dang / mo chu so sor yang mtshan babs 175

pa'i chu yod/ brag ri tshang ma sngon byon rgyal bas byin gyis rlabs pa'i sgrub phug brgya dang brgyad/ shing sna brgya phrag ldan pa'i sa 'dir mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang dang / khyung gshog gnam rdzong / ngo mtshar bya khyung rang byon bar snang nas lding zhing dkar rtsis khris 'dra'i byang chub mchod rten gyi rang byon/ de nas rdo skas rtsub mo zhig thabs nas pad+ma'i thugs sras mchog gyur nam mkha' yi rnying por gu rus lung bstan dpal ldan yang dag gi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dpal chen gyi phug ring zhes byin can/ gter ston raṇ+ḍa gling pas tshe sgrub la sogs zab chos khrom gter du bzhes pa'i gter khung dngo sa dang nyi zla yi rang byon/ rje 'bangs nyer lngar bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas smin grol gyi dbang bskur gnang ba'i gu ru'i sgrub phug byin can gyi tshogs khang dang / ye shes mtsho rgyal gsang ba'i phug pa gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso sku rgyu rgya gar shar li las grub pa'i thub dbang sku brnyan des nga yi 'dul bya 'khar chu phug ring du yod ces gsung byon gdan drangs pa mda' tshad tsam gyi ston pa/ gnas bdag rgyal chen song rab rten mkhar/ de nas g.yas phyogs mkha' 'gro'i gsang phug de brgyud nas 'jigs rung rngam zil ldan pa'i dur khrod kyi lha mo khang der grub thob me ling rdo rje'i gdan sa zhig mdzad nas phung po 'od skur gshegs pa'i 'og min gyi gnas mchog gter bton rgyal po mnga' bdag nyang ral gyi phyag bzo zhing skyong dur khrod lha mo'i sku brnyan sku mdog dmar smug zhal mdang sna tshogs su bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i rten ngo mtshar can brjod kyis mi langs pa yod pa bcas so/176
bzang pha sa sa

'gan legs sgrub zin rjes mthun rkyen mtshon byed gzhung tshong phyag nang mi 'gror dpal di gzhis sdod lo gsum dang / gser dpon phyag nang mi 'gror dwags po lha gsol gzhis sdod lo gsum re bsko gzhag byed srol yod/me khyi phan gzhung nas lo re bskor gsum mi ser la spus da 'grems tshong gi grangs 'bor kha gsal med stabs phyag nang mi 'gro so sos sger ja 'bor chen 'khyer nas gzhung ja dang mnyam bsres kyis mi ser la cha gses 'bam tshong spus bsgyur byas pas khul de'i mi ser la brdab gsig chen po byung bas bskor gsum rdzong gzhis brgyud sa gnas srid gzhung la bde sdug snyan zhu phul zhing / me khyi lor rtse phyag nang skal bzang mtha' yas la gzhung tshong dang /phran gyi pha blo bzang rgyal mtshan la gser dpon bsko gzhag gis me khyi srid skyong bka' brgya'i dgongs 'don du ‘‘'di lo nas bzung gser gzhung gnyis la gzhung ja lo re ja 'bru dang bcu gnyis sgam lnga brgya tham pa re stsal rgyur mnga' ris sgar dpon rdzong gzhis drug sbrel thog gser gzhung mi 'gro gnyis bcas thun mong nas bskor gsum mi ser khral rkang dang / leb che chung la gzhigs te spus ja cha gses gtan 'bebs kyis gzhung ja'i rin 'bab ji byas/ snyan zhu 'god 'bul zhu dgos ’’'khod don ltar gzhung tshong las 'dzin la lho brgyud bskor gsum mi ser la 'grems tshong bya rgyu'i ja 'bru dang rigs 'dzin rdo rje bcu gnyis sgam nyis brgya brgyad cu dang /khal ma brgya dang brgyad cu/ g.yog 'phar ma bcu drug 'khrid dgos par rta 'ul bcu drug gi lam yig gcig (rkun jag mang bas gzhung dngos 'phrog bcom byas pa'i gnas tshul thon pa nas bzung g.yog 'phar 'khrid chog pa'i lam yig sprad pa red )mnga' ris sgar nas la dwags bar phar tshur gnyis kar gzhung mkho dngos zog 'gel byed khal ma brgya dang nyi shu dang / rta 178

'ul brgyad kyi lam yig gcig la dwags rgyal por gaganas srid gzhung yig tshang las khungs nas rten bcas gos ras bsgril rtags tham sbyar ma dang sprags gzhung tshong 'di par la dwags khul nas gzhung gi thugs mkho shing 'bras sna tshogs dang / kha che sha skam ma sogs sman rigs sna tshogs mkho sgrub thad sngar srol ltar rgyab skyor rogs ram yong ba'i yig tshang gi yig chung gcig bcas dang / — gser dpon la byang brgyud bskor gsum mi ser la 'thung ja 'bru dang rig 'dzin rdo rje bcu gnyis sgam nyis brgya nyi shu tham pa dang / khal ma brgya dang lnga bcu/ gong mtshungasagayog 'phar bcu drug 'khrid chog pa'i bzhon rta rta 'ul bcu drug gi lamayeg 'go zho gser khral bsdu deb rtags tham sbyar ma gcig 'brong pa spyi khyab khongs sbra g.yer tshwa kha'i tshwa sho'i gtan 'bebs ltar lo re ṭam dkar srang brgya dang lnga bcu tham pa re 'bul dgos pa'i bsdu deb gcig gser khrog gar yod la sku tshab kyi sdod sgrig sogs tsho ba so sos bya dgos pa'i bka' rtsa bcas 'khyer te spyir btang bod zla gsum pa'i nang lha sa nas thon te stodalūng bde chen brgyud sa tshigs lnga/ yangs pa can sa tshigs gsum/ thod dkar rgyab sa tshigs gcig shing tshong sa tshigs drug shan tsha rdzong nas nag tshang bar sa tshigs bcu gsum/ phyogs bcu stod smad sa tshigs brgyad/ sha pho'i nyag tsa sa tshigs bzhi/ sil li sbug pa sa tshigs bzhi/ gzhung pa ma tshan sa tshigs gsum/ byang pa 'tsho bzhi sa tshigs drug bcas brgyud— de mnga' ris sgar dbyar sar 'byor kyi yod/ de sngon yar lam sa tshigs so sor spus ja 'grems tshong byed cing / rin 'bab mar lam bsdu rgyu'i gan len byed kyang lo der srid skyong ba ka' rtsa'i dgongs don ltar spus ja bgos 'grems sgar dpon rdzong gzhis dang gser gzhung gnyis zung sbrel thog cha gses bya dgos 179

par brten gzhung sprad spus ja rnams sa gnas so sor 'ol tshod kyis bzhag nas gser gzhung mi 'gro gnyis dang / bskor gsum mi spyi'i 'go gtso bcas mnga' ris sgar dbyar sar ngo bskyod kyis skabs de'i sgar dpon gong sbrum pa sras dang / sgar dpon 'og rngun mo lung yin zhing / spu hreng rdzong ka shod pa'i ngo tshab/ mda' pa rdzong / rtsa mda' rdzong / ru thog rdzong bcas sgar rdzong drug sbrel dang / bskor gsum mi spyi'i 'go pa spyi khyab bcas nas tsho pa so so'i leb che chung dang / rkang 'don che chung rgyus mnga'i babs kyi spus ja cha gses kyis gzhung khra gtan 'bebs byas pa dang /rin 'bab thad skabs der mnga' ris khul du ja 'bru dang sbag rer rgya gar sgor mo nyi shu re yul thang byed mus la sgar rdzong nas gzhung jar rin 'bab lo re'i yul thang bzhin bya dgos pa'i gros 'go bton par gser gzhung mi 'gro gnyis la dbang cha gang yang med par sgar dpon rdzong gzhi tshos thag gcod byas par 'dod min byung ste gser gzhung gnyis nas ‘‘gzhung ja spus 'grems cha gses kyi rin 'bab lo re'i tshong ra'i yul thang 'di byas dang 'di lo 'di phul zhes sgar dpon dang / rdzong gzhis/ bskor gsum mi spyi'i 'go gtso thun mong nas thag gcod kyis snyan zhu phul gnang na lo re'i gzhung ja ja sgam lnga brgya tham pa bskyel 'dren phyag nang mi 'gro gnyis yong dgos don mi 'dug pas a drung dos bskyel mdun sgar rdzong thun mong la lo re'i spus ja rnams rtsis 'bul zhus nas spus 'grems gnang na chog cing /de snga phan bskor gsum mi ser la gser gzhung gnyis kyis 'bom tshong byas par brten mi ser la brdab gsig che bas rdzong gzhis khag nas bla dpon gong mar snyan phul don son gyis 'di lo nas bzung gzhung ja kha gsal stsal bas mi ser gyi bde rtsar phan pa byung yod kyang / da dung mnga' ris khul gyi 180

bskor gsum mi ser la thog mtha' bar gsum du sgar dpon gnyis dang rdzong dpon gzhis khag gis ming 'dogs sna yi sgo nas thab gsar spus tshong zhes pa dang / dbyar tshong / dgunanetshong zhes ja dang / snam rigs/ de min dngo sa thog sna tshogs 'bam tshong byed kyi yod med dang / rin 'bab thad kyang lo re'i tshong ra'ingayul thang ltar yin min skor sgar dpon gnyis dang / rdzong gzhis khag lhag par bskor gsum mi spyi'i 'go gtso spyi khyab bcas pas kha gsal gyi zhu tho re sprad na gser gzhung mi 'gro phyag nang gnyis 'phral du phyir log bya rgyu yin ’’zhes tshogs sar bshad par sgar dpon rdzong gzhis rnams dogs 'drogs byung zhing rgyu mtshan ni sgar dpon gnyis dang /rdzong gzhis khag gsar 'byor skabs thab gsar 'bam tshong spus bsgyur dang /dbyar tshong / dgun tshong zhes pa lo ltar 'char can gyi je sogs dngos zog sna tshogs 'bam tshong gyis rin 'bab thad yul thang laru/ brgal ba'i mtho po len gyi yod pas/ mi ser la brdab gsig chen po yod lugs bskor gsum mi ser khag gcig gis gser gzhung mi 'gro gnyis la bde sdug zhu tho bskyal ba sgar rdzong gisashes rtogs byung ba red/ der brten sgar dpon gyi phyag mdzod dang / rdzong gzhis spyi 'thus bcas kyis gser gzhung mi 'gro gnyis la spus ja cha gses bya rgyu'i thad sgar rdzong mi spyi bcas kyis rgyus mnga'i babs kyi cha gse sa byasarnapa las —phyogs lhung gi bsayopa med pa dang /bskor gsumangami spyi'i 'dod blo khengs pa dang / rin 'bab thad gzhung ja dkon mchog gong phud zhu rgyur bskor gsum mi spyi dang / gser gzhung mi 'gro gnyis gros bsdur gyis thag gcod gnang na 'grig pa'i bsam gros dang /sgar rdzong gi tshong 'khos thabs len phranatshobu byas pa'i skor da migayobasal zhu tho lus ma dgo saya gser gzhung gnyis nas dgongs bzhes gnang rogs 181

zhes nang bcar thengs kha shas byas thar rin 'bab thad lo re'i ja spus legs zhan la gzhigs pa'i rin 'bab yul thang thog gzhung ja dkon mchog gong phud kyi ja sbag rer sgor lnga re 'phar 'bul zhu rgyu dang / rin 'bab 'gyangs 'jog la ja sbag rer sgor lnga re 'phar sprod bya rgyu ni tshong pa spyi mtshungs kyi lo ltar gser gzhung mi 'gro gnyis nas thag gcod bya rgyu gtan 'khel gyis lo der ja sbag rer spus thang rgya gar sgor mo nyi shu re byed mus la gzhung jar sgor nyi shu rtsa lnga re bya rgyur bskor gsum spyi khyab sgar dpon gnyis dang / rdzong khag tsho pa'i 'go gtso bcas dang / gser gzhung mi 'gro gnyis bcas mnyam gros mos mthun gyis me khyi lo nas bzung phran gyi pha gser dpon la lo re'i gzhung ja 'bru dang rig 'dzin rdo rje bcu gnyis sgam nyi brgya nyis shu re yod thog na cha gses byed stangs mnga' ris byang brgyud mi ser phyogs bcu stod smad tsho par spus ja sgam sum cu tham pa/ seng 'khor tsho par ja sgam bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ gzhung pa ma mtshan tsho par ja sgam bzhi cu tham pa/ si li sbug pa dgon gyi mi ser la ja sgam brgyad/ mar me dgon gyi mi ser la ja sgam gnyis dang sbag drug byang pa tsho bzhir ja sgam bzhi cu tham pa/ sger rtse dpon tsho par ja sgam sum cu tham pa/ 'brong pa spyi khyab khongs sbra g.yer tshwa kha'i khongs ja sgam bcu bzhi/ ru thog zhus gzhung rgyugs mi spyir ja sgam bcu dang sbag drug bcas tsho pa so sor cha gses 'grems tshong byas te rin 'bab spus ja sbag rer lag thog rgya gar sgor nyi shu rtsa lnga re dang /'gyangs 'jog la sbag rer sgor sum cu re byas te lo so sor lag yod dngul dang / lag med phyi lo sprod rgyu'i gan len bca' gtan 'khel gyis khyon lo gsum song rjes bka' shag nas rtse phyag zhol khang ched bkug gis gser gzhung gnyis kyi lo gsum tshong rtsis ji zhus rtsis khra gong 'bul zhu dgos pa'i 182

bka' ltar gser dpon las 'dzin gyi rtsis zhus rtsis khra'i nang lo gsum ring gi spus ja 'bru dang bcu gnyis sgam drug brgya drug cu tham par lo so sor lag dngul ji byung dang 'gyangs 'jog ji byas bya sputshosnon gyi dngul ji byung lo re'i gdong bsu a drung mdun rgya gar sgor mo chig khri lnga stong 'bul skur dang /mi 'gro ngo ma lha 'byor rtsis zhu'i skabs rgya gar sgor mo nyis stong re yod ko ril do bcu— bzhi la sgor nyis khri brgyad stong bcas khyon lo rer sgor bzhi khri sum stong re rtsis/ lo gsum la khyon sgor chig 'bum nyis khri dgu stong phul 'phrospu gan thog lus pa sgor brgyad khri chig stong chad pa'i las mjug bsdu rgyu'i tsiso khra rtse phyag brgyud bka' shag la bskyal ba dang / las mjug lo gnyis bsdu bskyod thad pha tshe las 'das pas nga rang gis bsdus nas dngul dngos byung ba sgorartsosum khri nyis stong phul 'phros sgor bzhi khri dgu stong gan thog lus pa dang / mi ser 'ga' zhig dbul bas bsdu dmigs med pa ma zad/ las mngonagartsobasdu rgyu'i lam yig lo gnyis las sprod lam medastobs gan rgya rnams rtse phyag mdzod las khungs su phyir sprod byas pā yin/ 'go zho gser khral lo re bsdu rgyu ni seng 'khor tsho gnas gser zho nyis brgya lnga bcu nga gnyis dang skar lnga/ gzhung pa mi tshan tsho pa nas gser zho brgya dang dgu bcu go gnyis dang skar lnga/ byang pa tsho bzhi nas gser zho nyis brgya gnyis dang skar lnga/ mar me dgon nas gser zho do skar lnga bcas bsdoms lo re gser zho drug brgya lnga bcu tham pa byung ba rnams bsdu gzhung dang sbrags rtse phyag las khungs su rtsis sprod byas shing / 'brong pa spyi khyab khongs sbra g.yer tshwa khar sku tshab sdod ma dgos par lo re'i spus ja gong gsal ja sgam bcu bzhi spradajinasarin 'bab bsdu rgyu dang / sbra g.yer tshwasmokha'i tshwa sho dod 'buli lo sgyure ṭam dkar srang brgya dang lnga bcu tham pa re sprad/ lam 'thus 183

mdzod sbug bka' gtan 'bru don ltar lo re'i gzhung rtsis zhus pa bcas gser dpon gzhung 'dzin bum pa sib blugs kyi byed sgo de ltar dang gzhung tshong gi zhor du phyag nang mi 'gro sger gyi tshong las byed kyi yod cing / phran gyi pha ngo ma dang / tshong pa zur bkod mi bzhi/ nga rang bcas tshong khag drug la sger gyi tshong rtsa ja 'bru dang legs zhan bcu gnyis sgam nyis brgya tham pa dang / snam spu phrug rgya tshos dang / rgya khra/ rgya log thig ris sna tshogs/snam dkar spu phrug dang / dpang gdan brgyad dpang / gre lham 'ba' lham/ rta chas rum sogs phom do nyi shu skor/ rta drel/ me mda' mde'u bcas tshong zog tshong pa so sor ma rtsa bskur nas lo ltar tshong rtsis pha mar rgyag dgos pa dang / byang pa tsho bzhi'i sa khongs su gser 'khrog kha shas yod pa'i khul gyi mi ser dbul phongs tha zhan rnams sngar gyi sa rnying yang skor bskyar skor gyis chu bsing rgyab nas gser dmar ru 'go nag kha shas byung ba des 'tsho thabs su nyin re gser ji byung gser 'khrog sku tshab la sprad nas rang mkho'i 'bru rigs dang / ja snam sogs blangs ste lo 'khor mtshams rtsis rgyag byed srol yod/ pha ngo ma de nyid dang / tshong pa so sos tsho pa'i 'go par lag rtags phran bu re sprad nas mkhas snyan gyis ngo tshong rgyag rogs zhes re 'dun bton te ja snam sogs tshong bsgyur dang / rin 'bab skabs der sger chos tshong pa spyi mtshungs yul thang ltar byed kyi yod la/ byang pa tsho bzhir bod zla bdun pa'i nang byang pa dbyar tshong dus chen nyin gsum gtong srol la rta rgyugs dang / me mda' dang mda' tsha kha blta ba dang / zhabs rim lha bsangs gtong ba sogs kyi dus chen la gser dpon dang / tsho pa so sos kha btags dang / gnang cha ja dang / dar mtshon gyi dpa' dar sprod srol ltar byas te slar byang pa tsho bzhir gser 'khrog sku tshab bzhag nas 184

gser dpon rang nyid mnga' ris sgar dbyar sar thon pa dang / bod zla bdun pa'i2nang rgya nyi ma zhes pa'i tshong ra zhig 'tshogs pa der nga rang lo gsum bskyod nas sger gyi tshong 'khos thabs len byas pa yin/ rgya nyi ma zhes pa rtsa mda' rdzong gi sa khongs la brten tshong ra'i khrims 'dzin rtsa mda' rdzong gis do dam byed pa dang / tshong ra'i rdus yun nyin bcu yin rung dgongs zhus kyis nyin bco lnga tsam tshugs pa dang / rgya gar ba'i tshong pa gur khag brgya skor gyi tshong zog ras bying tshos tshogs dang / 'go snam tshos tshogs/ ther ma legs zhan tshos tshogs/ dar lcog tshos tshogs/ shel ka ra dang bu ram sogs mngar cha'i rigs sman rgyu sna tshogs/ rgun 'brum dkar po/ bye ma dkar ra mngar khams sogs dang / bskor gsum 'brog pas tshwa dang / tshwa la/ ra lug bal/ pags rigs/ stod gser bcas dang / bod nas gzhung tshong gser gzhung gnyis dang / se 'bras kyi tshong pa/ sa 'du'i tshong pa/ rdzong gzhis dang / gzhung gi tshwa sho khag bcas kyi tshong zog ja 'bru dang legs zhan dang / rusdatshogyi kha gdan/rta sga'i rmā kran rmāpashol/ ko ba'i mthurari 'go srab rmed snam storgya tshos spu phrugargya log rgya khra/ thig ris sna tshogs/ tre lham dang 'ba' lham/ lham gshol/ lhag par rgya gar bar dgos pa snam spu phrug dkar po/ dpang gdan brgyad dpang bubs khams drel gzugs chung / 'brog par dgos pa me mda' pā ma li/ sbo rag ring mda' dang / mde'u sna tshogs bcas phan tshun tshodzo'akhos thabs len byed pa dang / de nas tshong ra grol rjes sa cha de nas sa tshigs gcig sar spos nas chags ra 'am/ mkhar khog zhes pa'i sa khul du yang bskyar tshong ra zhig 'tshogs par nyin lnga yin kyang dgongs zhus kyi3na bdun ring 'tshogs pa dang / tshong ra de'i sa khongs 185

bar kha rta zam nas byed pa dang / rta zam de rtse gzim dpon mkhan po'i thab rten la song sku tshab gnyis yong nas khrims 'dzin do dam byed pa dang /tshong ra 'dir tshong 'khos thabs len ni gtso bo rgya gar ba sha khog rong pa zhes pa grong gseb pa gur khag drug cu skor yong nas tshong zog bu ram ma lo sha stag las tshong zog gzhan med pa ni bod rigs tshong pa mang che bas nyo sgrub byas zin pa dang / bu ram ma lo rer rin de snga ṭam dkar gcig re byed mus kyang phyis lo ltar gong tshad 'phar chag skor tshong sho bar kha rta zam 'go khrid dang / rgya gar ba phan tshun bu ram thon khungs mang nyung la gzhigs pa 'i rin 'bab thang gzhi gcod pa dang / rjes su bu ram ma lo rtsa sgor rer rin ṭam dkar gnyis gsum tsam yang byas song bas/ skabs der ṭam dkar rer bod dngul rdza srang do re byed pa dang / rgya gar bar bu ram ji yod tho len gyis bar kha rta zam gyi dgos mkho nyo sgrub zin rjes tshong pa gzhan rnams nas nyo dgos par so so'i tshong shag yod pa'i bu ram thon che ba yod na/tshong shag so sos mang tsam nyo dgos pa dang / thon khungs nyung tsam yod dus rta zam nas nyos 'phros tshong shag so sor bgos tshong bya dgos pa/tshong ra 'di grol rjes gzhung sger chos bcas kyi tshong pa rnams dang / rgya gar ba tshong mjug bsdad pa rnams bod zla brgyad pa'i nang sgar dbyar sar tshong ra zhig tshugs pa der bskyod pa dang / sgar dbyar sa'i tshong dus la mnga' ris sgar dpon nas rdzong gzhis dang / gser gzhung mi 'gror nyin gnyis ring ston chen gtong srol dang / sgar khul gyi nye 'khor 'brog pa sger chos tshong pa tshong mjug yod pa'i rgya gar ba tshong pa gur khag drug cu skor/la dwags tshong pa bong bu 'ded nas yong ste byang khul la 'brog par mnga' ris kham bu tshong bsgyur dang / 'brog pa'i sa nas bal 'bor che nyo ba dang /186

la dwags kha che khag cig sgar dbyar sa'i tshong rdus la yong nas gra ga zamābazo byed ra'i khu lus 'thag pa'i 'dur ma dang / 'go snam/ ther ma/ shing rum sa gdan/ dzul dang / g.yang ḍi'i dkar yol sogs pa tshong bsgyur byed pa/ rgya gar gyi tshong pa'i 'go 'doms sgar sha dpon dang / las byed sman pa/ dmag mi bcas pa mi grangs brgyad tsam 'byor nas sgar dpon dang rdzong gzhis/ gser gzhung / tshwa sho khag la mthun lam gyis phan tshun lag rtags sprod res dang / nyin bdun nas bcu'i bar tshong mjug thabs len byed kyi yod pa red/ de nas tshong ra grol mtshams gser dpon dang / sger chos tshong rigs rnams lha sar thon pa dang / gzhung tshong la dwags khul la gzhung mkho sgrub par thon pa bcas gong gsal tshong ra khag gsum la 'brog pas mtha' mtshams khag la tshwa dang / tshwa la/ bal/ra lug tshong bsgyur gyis nyer mkho'i 'bru rigs dang / rgya zog sgrub pa phud gtso bo phyi rgyal gyi dngul lor yong thabs byas nas gzhung sger chos bcas kyi tshong pa'i sa nas ja snam sogs nyos rin sprod dmigs dang / de bzhin bod tshong gis kyang gtso bo phyi rgyal gyi dngul lor yong thabs byed pa dang /zhor du rgya zog sna tshogs nyo sgrub kyis mnga' ris nas lha sa bar gzhung sger tshong pa rnams la lam yig rta khal mang nyung la ma bltos pa yod pas de'i zhor du mi ser la brdas gla sne sel las sprod mi dgos par brten tshong zog la ma gnad chung ba dang / lhag par bod zla 10di dang 11pa'i nang lha sa sogs nas rgya gar la tshong pa mang po 'gro gi yod pas rgya gar gyi dngul lor dgos gal che ba'i dbang gis rdza thang 'phar chag chen po byung bar brten khe bzang che bas bod tshong rnams bod zla 10pa dang 11pa'i nang lha sar 'byor thub pa byed dgos/ lhag par stod mnga' ris khul la bod dngul ṭam 187
dmar dang bul man cho
ma la bas sa

pa zhig yin 'dug khrims khang nang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i 'dra sku zhig kyang yod pa red/rnam kun mi dpon gnyis kyi 'gan dbang thad lha sa sa khul gyi khrims gcod las 'gan 'khur zhing de yang rdzong dang rim pa 'dra ba'i 'gan dbang yod pa red/de 'og las bya khang gnyer dang / drung yig sogs yod pa de tshos mi dpon gyi ngag bkod dang len byed dgos pa dang / drung yig ni lha sa tsho pa zhes pas 'dzugs dgos pas nga rang yang lha sa tsho pa brgyud nas las 'gan de 'khur du blangs pa yin/ snang shag las khungs nas drung yig la smyug gla zhes nyin rer dngul skar phyed brgyad re rtsis lo gcig la bod dngul srang nyi shu rtsa bdun dang / las shag gi sdod khang gla lo re dngul srang gsum nas bzhi bar yod/ khang gnyer ni zhol pa'i nang gzan khongs nas yong dgos pa red/ gnyer pa gnyis yod pa ni mi dpon sger so sos 'khrid yong pa yin zhing khrims gcod byed sgo'i nang drung yig dang mnyam las bya dgos/mi dpon gyi 'gan dbang khyab khongs su da dung lha sa khul khang yod khang chung zhes pa'i gzhung sger tsho gnyis yod pa dang / bskor bya pa mi grangs nyi shu rtsa gsum tsam yod pa de dag gzhung sger tsho gnyis khongs nas 'dzugs srol ltar so nams las khungs dang / sger bshad sgra/ lha klu/ bzhi sde grwa tshang /kun bde gling sogs dang / ju gzhung gnyis khongs nas 'dzugs dgos la lto phogs kyang rang khungs so sos rgyag dgos pa las las khungs nas sprod lam med/ bskor bya pa rnams kyis mi dpon gyi ngag bkod dang le byed dgos pa smos med khar sa khul khag bgos kyis lta srung bya rgyu'i 'gan dbang yod/ gad pa mi gcig yod pa de sde drug bla brang nas gtong dgos pa'i 190

phogs thob rang khongs nas sprod dgos/ btson srung mi gnyis lhas tsho pas phogs thob sprad de gtong dgos/ rags rgyab pa zhes pa ni lo rgyus thog rags kha tsha tshul zer ba'i gzhung rgyugs mi ser yin tshod 'dug (shod rgyun gzhan zhig la rags stobs zhes snga dus rags rgyab dur khrod la ro las byed pa'i stobs ldan red zer srol yang 'dug) de nas rim bzhin khungs stong giyorjes su snang shag las khungs brgyud khrims sa gong 'og nas btson pa nag nyes che ba rags kha tsha tshul gyi khral khongs su rgyag pa dang / rtsa ba'izukhral khongs rags stobs pa re zung ma gtogs yod tshod mi 'dug rags ske stobs pa'i las 'gan ni dar chen gzim bzhengs dang / lha khul bdag po med pa'i mi ro bskyel rgyu/ mi sogs kyisasdo bsad pa'i ro thon tshe bad ga nyar gyis zhabs rim bsgrubs skabs ka li dang mi khrag mi bsad pa'i gri rīdang /rdo/ yug za ma'i skra sogs rdzas cha khag kho tshos gtong dgos/ rags stobs pa'i khongs pi gdong zer ba khag cig yogab de tshos btsonako'i btsog gcin gsho ba'i 'gan 'khur gyi yod/ rags stobs 'goya zer ba bskor bya pa'i khongaso nas bslab gral gon pa des rags stobs pa rnams la bkod bsdoms byed kyi yod pa red/ kha ches khroms 'gal byas rigs lardzosnang shag las khungs nas khaḥkorago pa rang nyid la khrims gcod bya rgyu'i dbang cha sprod kyi 'dug de'i yong rkyen ni kha che rnams khrims srung sems chung la brten twa la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas kho pa tshor dmigs bsal blta skyong gnang ba red/ gal te kha ches khrims 'gal gyi bya ba byas par nyes pa btang rung rang khongs su phyir logajibyed grol yod/ gor khongs mi rtsas khrims 'gal byung na gor zhib las khungs nas thag gcod byed kyi yod pas las khungs der mi dpon gcig 'gro 191

srol 'dugalha sa snang rtse shag gi 'gan dbang spyod pa'i sa khyon thad shar/ lho byang bcas gling skor dang / nub g.yu thog zam pas thad drangs lho byang dbye mtshams kyi nang khongs 'gan dbang spyod kyi yod/bsher khang las khungs dang / snang shag las khungs kyis do dam byed pa'i khrims 'gal btson par 'go 'doms snang shag khang gnyer nas byed dgos pa ma zad/ rtsam bzhes las khungs nas btson lto blangs te brgyud sprod byed dgos/ lha khul 'byor ldan khag gi dge rtsa sgrub skabs btson par sbyin gtong lto chas ster tshe khang gnyer dang / btson srung brgyud ster dgos /chos lugs kyi dus chen skabs btson pa rnams btson srung dang sbrags bar skor dang / gling skor brgyud slong bar gtong srol yod/ sa ga zla bar bka' blon rnams gling skor la bskyod skabs las khungs sgo 'gram du bka' blon res btson pa mi re btson 'grol gtong srol 'dugatā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa ma gshegs gong tsam la lha sa'i sa srung da dang dmag sgar btsugs thog de'i 'go 'doms lha sa mi dpon la sprad de dmag sgar dang / snang shag las khungs zla bsgril byas te de nas bzung khrims 'doms gcig sdud byas stabs mi dpon gyi dbang cha bed spyod byed bder gyur zhing / lha khul mi bsad rku rgyag sogs kyi gyod gzhi che rigs mi dpon nas bka' shag la snyan zhu dang 'brel thag gcod byed srol yod pa red/dga' ldan dar chen dang / sha ba skya ring gnyis kyis gtsos rtse pho brang gi g.yas g.yon gyi dar chen/ nor gling rgyal sgo'i g.yas g.yon gyi dar chen sogs snyol slong byed sgo rnams mi dpon gyi 'gan 'khri'i khyab khongs yin 19 2

pa dang / dar chen snyol slong lam lhong yong ched gnas chung dang /dga' gdongaloganyis lolha gsol dang / mgon khang khag la bka' shag dam sbyar zhabos sgrub dpya khra yang zhu srol 'dug dar jus pa zhes rags stobs a pha rgan gzhon su 'os thugs dam zhu dgos/ bod zla 1tshes 2nyin rtse shod bka' shag bcas kyi ngo tshab dang 'brel dga' ldan dar chen slong srol thog dar chen nyams bzo byed sgo snang shag khang gnyer nas 'gan len byed dgos/ dar chen slong skabs gtso bo rags stobs pa dang / de bzhin lha sa'i sger tsho bsam pho/ rdo ring / thon pa/ gzhung tsho bcu khag gi bcu dpon bcas nas 'gan 'khur thog 'ol mi rnams sger gzhung tsho khongs nas gtongatsholamaho'adug dar chen bslangs zin mtshams rtse 'gag tu mi dpon nas snyan seng zhu srol/ lo ltar lha sa smon lam chen mo ma tshugs gong bod zla 12tshes 20nang tshun bka' shag nas yig chung zhus thog snang shag btson pa rnams zhol las khungs su rtsis sprod byed skabs khang gnyer nas do dam byed dgos/ zla 1tshes 2la 'bras spungs tshogs chen zhal ngos lha sa'i smon lam ring khrims 'doms rtsis len byed skabs snang shag mdun du tshogar+sāgatam gtong skabs de snga mi dpon ngos las 'gro srol yod 'dug kyang phyis dgong4zhu zhus te bskor bya pa ma gtogs 'gro srol mi 'dug smon lam ring snang shag las khungs lhan rgyas tshogs srol med kyang bco lnga mchod pa'i 'khri khungs gzhung dang / srid blon/ bka' shag spyi khyab mkhan po/ yig tshang /mkhan sde che chung / rtse mgron gzim/ yab gzhis gsar rnying / sde dpon/ gdan sa'i mkhan po/ bod kyi sprul sku rnam gsum/ rgyud grwa stod smad/ snye rnam rgyal grwa tshang / gnas chung grwa tshang / gling khag sogs 193

mchod pa 'khri khungs la rtse yig tshang las khungs nas rtsa 'dzin mchod gzhung thon mtshams bkod rgya brda yig sogs mchod par brten pa'i byed sgo'i yig cha drung yig nas 'gan len bzo bkod thog mi dpon gnyis nas bka' shag la dam zhu snyan seng zhu dgos/ smon lam gtor rgyag nyin gzhungo rten srung ma dmar nag gi rten thug dang / gtor rgyab gzim pa bar skor la yong skabs sha gsar zur nas mi dpon ngo las dang / lha sa'i khang yod khang chung gi mi bcas nas spos sne zhu dgos/ 'khyams ra'i sgo mchor 'og tu 'byor skabs tshogs chen zhal ngos bskor bya pa'i khrims lcags rnams rdo bcal steng g.yugs pa dang de nas khrims 'go rtsis sprod byed lugs shod srol 'dug gtor rgyag dngos thon rjes mi dpon ngo las khag bgos kyis dga' ldam/ khri rin po che dang / gnas chung chos skyong gtor rgyab ru phebs par spos sner 'gro srol yod/ bco lnga mchod pa'i ang rim dang lha spyi'i zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu'i dus tshes 'char gzhi snang shag las khungs nas phul thog tshes cha gtan 'khel nyin twa la'i bla mar lha spyi'i zhabs ba rtan bstar 'bul skabs snang shag mi dpon ngo las dang / khang yod khang chung gi rta pa/yun rigs lha khang gi bla ma/ snyung gnas pa'i sgrig pa/ kha bal 'go pa/lha sa'i ser srung lag stod pa sogs mjal khar 'gro sol yod/ lha sa tshogs mchod skabs snang shag las khungs mi tshus/sa pa dang / btson pa rnams kyang smon lam gyi skabs su zhol btson khang du 'jog pa/ tshogs mchod ser sbrengs bar skor brgyud zhol nas khang steng dang / rtse po ta lar bskor bskyod skabs snang shag mi dpon ngo las snga dro g.yu thog zam pa bar dang / dgong dro ra mo che brgyud spos sner 'gro dgos/skar shar chos skyong gi zla re'i lha tshes sogs kyi zhabs zhu sku mdun pa 194

zhes bskor bya pa'i khongs nas bskyod dgos par brten snang shagargyadang skan shar lha mi lha bdag gi 'brel ba yod pas lo ltar 'dzam gling spyi bsang skab sa mi dpon ngo las skar shar gling khar chos skyong sku gsol zhu skabs 'gro srolta yod/ de bzhin bod zla bdun pa'i zho ston skabs skar shar chos skyong 'khor bcas kyis gtsug lagasgyukhang dang / nor gling / — se ra sogs la 'cham gzigs 'bul dgos/ de'i gong bskor bya pa dang / 'cham rgyag rag sa stobs bcas kyis snang sbyong byed skabs snang shag gnyer drung nagado dam byed dgos pa dang / nang sbyong dngos gzhi'i nyin rgyugs len mtshon byed du mi dpon ngo las skar shar lcog tu 'gro srol 'dug se ra zho ston zhes par skar shar chos skyong phebs skabs las byed bskor bya pa dang / 'cham rgyag rags stobs pa sogs 'gro dgos/ bod zla 6pa'i tshes 4nyin bka' shag ngo tshab dang / lha sa gnyer tshang pa ngo las/ mi dpon ngo las/ lha gnyer nas 'go 'dzin byed pa'i dpal gsol ma bcas nas lha ldan jo bo rin po ches gtsos brten khag la dkar me snyan shal dang / bar khang chos rgyal sbyan snga'i 'khrungs ban brje 'bul dang 'brel dpal gsol mas gsung gzhas 'bul ba bcas byed cing / de nas sngar chos rgyal gyi yochod chang bzhes snod rdza'i ṭam ban dngul shan ma de dag gdan zhus kyis rtse'i chos rgyal spyan sngar yu ring brje 'bul dang 'brel dpal gsol mas gsung gzhas 'bul ba/ de rjes drung ja'i thog ṭamawān gdan zhus kyis rtse shod gnyis la phud stor zhus rjes gnyer mi dpon ngo las dang /dpal gsol ma bcas mjal khar 'gro dgos/ dkar me dang /'khrungs ban chang rgyu sogs bsdu khungs khag nas lha sa gnyer tshang khang gnyer dang / snang shag khang gnyer thun mong nas do dam bsdu len byed/ zla 195

6pa'i tshes 5nyin bka' shag lhan rgyas la chang phud btegs pa dang /dpal gsol mas gsung gzhas 'bul skabs gnyer mi dpon ngo las bskyod zhugs byed dgos/ de rjes srid blon dang / bka' blon/ yab gzhis sde dpon bsam pho ba dang / rdo ring sogs la ṭam ban gdan zhu phud stor la gnyer tshang khang drung dang / snang shag khang drung bcas nas 'go khrid de dpal gsol ma dang sbrags 'gro dgos/twa la'i bla ma lo re dgun dus nor gling nas rtse po ta lar phebs skabs lha sa khang yod khang chung dang / kha bal 'go pa/ ju gzhung 'go pa/ re/ bzhi slob dpon las sne bcas phebs bsu skyel du bskyod dgos par snang shag las khungs nas sngon tshud brda tho gtong ba dang / de nyin drung yig nas 'go 'dzin gyi rtse po ta la'i rta so 'gram nas mjal dar 'bul srol 'dugatā la'i bla ma smon lam chen mor tshogs phebs la dad sbyin khag nas gdan 'dren zhu skabs lha sa'i khongs bro pa gzhas ma sngon tshud nang sbyong gis rtse nas lha sar phebs skabs lam gyi g.yas g.yon bro gzhas 'bul dgos/ gzhas ma dang bro pa bcas lha sa khang yod khang chung nas sngar gyi 'khri lam bzhin yong dgos/ chotwa la'i bla ma'i yang srid gdan zhu dang / khri phebs skabs kyang gzhung gi phebs bsu'i sar lam g.yas g.yon du bstar sgrig gis bro gzhas 'bul dgos pa dang / rtse po ta lar khri phebs mdzad sgo'i skabs rtse bde yangs shar du bro gzhas 'bul dgos shing / de skabs bro gzhas pa mi grangs nyi shu lhag tsam gyis rnam kun dang mi 'dra bar rgyas spros che tsam dgos pa de yang 'khri khungs rnams nas sngar lam gtong dgos pa de dang chabs cig khang yod khang chung gi rta pa rnams kyang yong dgos/ bro gzhas sngon tshud nang sbyong 196

byed skabs snang shag gnyer drung nas 'go khrid kyi nang sbyong byed pa dang /dngos gzhi'i rgyugagelen nyin sngar srol gyi gyon chas dang bro gzhas sogs la mi dpon ngo lasadakar shag lcog tu bskyod nas zhib gsherasnyedadagos/ pabod zla 2parasgrolha sa'i skyigachu yorgyas gong snang shag mi dpon ngo las sgang stod lcags zam nas lha zhol bar gyi sa mtshams phyag mdzod gling kha'i 'khris kyi steng mkhar dmar po bar chu rags rnams la zhib bsher gyis skyon cha yod med bskor tho bkod de bka' shag la snyan seng dang / dbyar chu ma rgyus gong rags 'khri sgang stod khul glang ru gzhiyosogasacikyi khongs dang /lha sa'i tsho sger4gzhung tshobacu 'i khungs so—sor mi dpomānas nyams gso le thogs med pastadagos rgyu 'i bkod khyab byed srol 'dug nyams gso'i rags rdo lha khul rags 'khri lha sa khang yodakhang chung nas sngar lam rdo'i tshad gzhi nang bzhin sgor gzhung tsho bcus bsdu len do dayonyams gso lo gcig dang / lo gcig gzhung nas mi dpon dang / rtse'i sku tshab rtse mgron gcig nas byed srol thog rags rgyag 'ul mi lha khul du ba gnam gtong bskul srol yang bar skabs tā la'itwa ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i skabs lo bcu song mtshams gzhung nas rags gso byed rgyu dang / de'i ring lo gnangs chags rags 'khri khungs so sos nyams gso byed rgyur 'gyur ba ma zad/ lo bcu song mtshams gzhung nas do dam mgron mi bsko gzhag da nga 'brel ragasarterdo/ rags shing / gzhan yang rdo shing bzo pa'i dgos dngul sogs btagreste ragaso rgyag las don zin mtshams bka' shag rags skor la ngo paskyod byed dgos pa'i lam yang byung songaka— de skabs lha zhol rags bzo mnyam 'khel gyi jus 'god dza sag tsha rong gis byas te ragos bzo gzhi rgya che tsam byas shing / 'ul7mi lha sa'i du ba gnam gtong sngar 197

bzhin bskul bar gla cha yang sprad/ dbyar chu che tsam rgyas dus sku 'bum lha lding gzhis ka'i 'khris kyi rags khug tu rdo 'phred nyagozhig yod pa der snang shag khang gnyer nas chu tshad dang gnyis lta zhib kyis chu kha mtho sar slebs mtshams snang shag las khungs brgyud bka' shag la snyan seng zhus te chu nyen che sar skabs 'phral rags 'khri so sor nyams gso dgos rgyu'i bkod khyab byed dgos/bod zla 11pa'i nang snang shag las khungayokyi sgrig 'bul re'u mig bka' shag nas gtan 'khel nyin khrims shugs btson chas dngos rigs gzhung khra bkod de sgrig 'bul nyin lha ldan bla steng khams gsum du bka' shag gdan zhus dang 'brel mi dpon nas dngos gzhung bstar 'bul thog bka' shag nas blta zhib zin rjes bla phyag la gzhung khra nang gsal dngos rin phab rgyur sprod pa dang / de rjes bka' shag grol rjes bla phyag ngo las nas dngos gzhung la zhib gsher rin gong phab srol dang de nyin bka' shag gsol thab la gsol ja bzhes 'bras kyi dod kyang mi dpon gnyis nas bka' shag ma chen la sprod kyi 'dug sgrig 'bul ang rim gral bstar sgrig nyin ang dang po thob nas sngar lam gzhung gi gnang char gyon pa cha tshang re sprod srol yod tshod/ sgrig 'bul dngos rin ma long tshe bla phyag las khungs nas chad pa 'gel srol 'dugabod zla 〈pa'i nang lha gnyer las khungs nas brda tho 'byor mtshams lha sa 'ong bsko ra du lha gnyer ngo las dang / mi dpon ngo las/ ser srung lag stod pa/ jo khang dkon gnyer dpon/ rtse 'phags pa lha khang dkon gnyer bcas nas nang rten khag gdan zhu dang 'brel lha sa'i khang yod khang chung gi rta pa sogs lha gnyer las khungs nas 'go 'dzin gyis snga dro 'khyams 198

ra'i sgo mchor 'og nas rta pa gral bstar bsgrigs —te rtse po ta lar skor ba dang 'brel gra bzhi brgyud glang rur bka' shag gdan gnyer nas gur gdan sgrig chatshisar tshang’'a dzoms mtshams gnyer mi dpon/ dkon gnyer/ rta pa bcas pa bzhugs gralaglethengs gsum tshogs dgos pa de nyin rdzon mo'i dgos cha lha gnyer las khungs na4do dam byed srol 'dug cing /rī rta pa rnams nas rta rgyugs zhar 'phen zin rjesatshudagongachi dro grong gsor khul brgyune b.rarwaskor nas phyir log byede dgos/ — — — — lha gokhusde gyi sa rdzong rta khalo mi gsum khral rigs che phra sger tshobasam pho dang / rdo ring / bla brang rnying pa bcas kyi tsho dpon gsum dang /gzhung tsho bcu dpon khag ju gzhung 'go spyi bcas la sa sbrul rgya deb nang gsal lha sa'i khang yod khang chung ang dang gnyis dang / dud grangs bcas kyi khral rigs rgyugs phyogs gong gsal tsho bcu dang bcas par bka' shag tham sbyar lag 'dzin re yod tshod de'i nang gsal ltar khungs so sos 'gan 'khur sgrub rgyugs byed srol 'dug pa bcas snang shag las khungs kyi sgrigs srol skor rang gi gang dran gong zhus ltar yin zhing / da dung cha ma tshang ba yong srid pas rgyus can rgan rabs gzhan la bka' rtsad kha skong dang /rang gi brjod tshig ma ldeng ba'i skyon cha yod rigs bskyar du dogs 'dri gnang 'os mchis tshe dran gsos zhu rgyu yod na skabs sbyar zhus chog pa zhu rgyu dang rang nyid las drung byed ring sngar lam las 'gan thog bde srung pu li si snang shag las khungs su zla bsgril gnang bar rten dmag sgar gyi nyin re'i las tho dmag spyi khang la 'bul rgyu'i yig 'bri sogs dang / gzhan yang bka' shag dang / yig tshang sogs las khungs gzhan gyis rgya khyab rdzong gzhis la gtong rgyu'i bka' rgya bcas 'phar ma'i las 'gan mang tsam byung 199

bar brten mi dpon gnyis nas bka' shag la snyan zhus kyis rang nyid nas las drung nam 'pher ring phogs 'phar lo re dngul srang nyis brgya lnga bcu re sprad pa dang / de rjes srid skyong rwa sgrong skabs rang gis las 'gan dgongs pa zhus par slar yang rang 'jags byed dgos pa'i thog lo re phogs dngul srang sum brgya lnga bcu re dang / drung gtogs kyi go ming gnang byung /de rjes spyi lo 1941bod lcags sbrul lo'i zla 1pa'i nang dga' ldan dar chen slong skabs chag skyon byung rkyen srid skyong stag brag gis mi dpon ngo las gnas dbyung btang bar brten rang nyid ci bya ltos bral gyi mi zhig tu gyur pa bcas so 200
thang sma ba 'a la rang

med pa mthong ba tsam gyis 'jigs snang skyes 'os pa zhig 'dug la/ lus po yongs rdzogs dregs pas khengs shing / gyon pa skyi dkar pags pa tsab ral re dang / byang 'brog gi snam khra'i yu 'byar g.yag ko'i rdog pa can gyi lham sayas g.yon gnyis ka ral rdol che bas rkang pa'i mdzub mo yang phyir thon zhig la 'phral sel skyob thabs bal skud dkar pos 'ab sgrog brgyab pa re gyon 'dug pa dang / mnyam 'khyer 'khur po dza dzor yod pa re dang /'thung snod ha yang gi mog mthil rdol re/ de min ha yang gi 'thur ma re ma gtogs gzhan gang yang mi 'dug go thos la ltad mo lta mkhan gyi khongs nas mi la las 'di gnyis la bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu gang yang mi 'dug ces snying rje byas nas ja dang rtsam pa ster mkhan mi nyung tsam byung song bar ja rtsam mthong ba tsam gyis bod skad du thugs rje che/ thugs rje che zhes brjod de de 'phral skyo ma mi rnams hang sang dgos pa re bldags nas ltogs rngam sel thub pa byung song zer/ phran kho gnyis sar 'byor skabs khang bdag bud med gnyis nas mi 'di gnyis la khyed gnyis 'dir ma sdod gzhan du 'gro rogs/ 'dir bsdad tshe mi dpon gnyis nas nga tshos phyi rgyal mi rigs la rang mtshams gnas g.yar byas pa 'os min zhes nyes chad gtong gi red zer nas zhe bsun che tsam bzo gi 'dug phran nas thog mar khong gnyis la hin rdu'i skad thog nas khyod gnyis gang nas yong ba yin nam/ mi rigs ji yin dang ming la ji zer 'dri zhib byas par kha 'tsher tsam ma gtogs skad brda ma 'phrod pas lan rgyab ma byung / de rjes dbyin skad thog nas 'dri ba byas par kho gnyis mi rigs 'jar man yin pa dang / rgan pa'i ming la ab sha na thar dang / gzhon pa'i ming la ha rar zer gyi yod/ de ring stod lung bde chen rdzong nas yong ba yin zhes zer ba dang chabs cig bod 202
