lugs mthe bong ker nas do nub nga gnyis la gnas tshang zhig g.yar rogs zhes nan gyis skul 'dug par/ skabs der phran gyi bsam par gang ltar mi de —gnyisaphrong khyer nang slebs rjes tshang mas phyir 'bud byas kyang de tsam dgos pa mi 'dug de bas kho gnyis 〉bod du yong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / phyi rgyal ba'i khrod du tshan rig lagartsortsal sogs kyi shes yon can mang po yod par brten dmigs bsal shes yon ji yod sogs shes rtogs thub tshe phugs yul glog khang 'dzugs skrun gyi bya gzhag sogs la phan thogs 'dra mi yong ngam snyayonas da lta ngas lha sa —mi dpon gnyis la snyan seng zhus nas chog mchan thob tshe khyod gnyis 'bod par btang yong zhes bshad par kho pa gnyis 'jigs snang yang phran bu skyes nas dbyin skad thog thugs rje che zhes zer 'dug de nas phran phyir log gis snang shag las drung bsod nams lags sdod yul phran dang skya 'brel yin pas las drung sar bskyod nas de ring phyi rgyal gyi mi gnyis slebs skor dang / gnas tshang med pa'i gnas tshul dang sbrags khyed nas mi dpon gnyis la kho gnyis la gnas g.yar gyis nyar chog min dgongs bskor snyan seng zhu gnang dang 'brel mi de gnyis kyis mnyam 'khyer 'khur po'i nang ca lag khyad mtshar jikāyod cha ma rtogs pas sngog bshe ra yab gnang 'gab ces brjod par bsod nams lags nas ngas da lta go thos su lha sar 'jar man mang po slebs 'dug ces brjod 'dug— pa de ltar bden nam zer bar ngas de lan du mi gnyis po de lhag mi 'dug de min khrom gzhung gi dkrog gtam red ces bshad pa yin/ de nas chu tshod gnyis tsam song rjes bsod nams lags nas mi dpon gnyis kyis gnas tshang g.yar 'thusatshachogatshepa dang / bros byol du mi 'gro ba'i do dam byed dgos zhes gsungs 'dug lugs lan sprad byung / de 'phralartephran nas 203

g.yog po gcig 'jar man de gnyis 'bod par btang nas sgo rwa'i nang ca lag 'jug yul zhig yod pa de'i nang pang leb kyi gdan khri gnyis dang /sgrog rtse gcig bcas brgyab nas gnas g.yar byas te ngal gso rgyag tu bcug khar/ de nub 'bras kyi lto chas rgyags tshad cig ster ba yin/ de'i sang nyin snga dro ‘‘phyi rgyal las khungs ’’zer ba'i do dam zur zur dza sag dbang chen tshe bstan nas bang chen pa zhig btang ste phran phyi las su yong dgos lugs lan 'byor byung don de 'phral phyi las su bskyod par khong nas skad cha dris don/ kha sa lha sar 'jar man ba yul gyar gnyis slebs yod tshod la khyed nas mthong byung ngam zer bar ngas mthong byung ba ma zad/ kho gnyis kyis gnas tshang g.yar rogs zhes dbu nan byed 'dug stabs/ kho gnyis bod du yong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / lhag par phyi rgyal ba rnams tshan rig lag rtsal sogs kyi shes yon can mang po yod par brten phugs yul glog khang 'dzugs skrun sogs la phan thogs mi yong ngam snyam ste gnas g.yar chog min mi dpon gnyis la dgongs bskor zhus par nyar 'thus chog mchan thob par brten da lta kho pa gnyis la ngas gnas tshang g.yar nas nyar yod zhus par dza sag nas de ltar yin na da dung khyed rang nas nyin shas gso nyar rogs ram byed dgos pa ma zad bros byol du mi 'gro ba'i do dam yang bya dgos pa dang /de bzhin khyed rang de ring 'dir yong dgos zer don ni khyed nas dbyin skad shes par brten kho pa gnyis bod du yong don dang / yong lugs yong stangs/ gzhan yang bod la phan thogs yod pa'i dmigs bsal shes yon ji yod sogs zhib brtsad kyis gnas tshul mdor bsdus 'khod pa'i shog lho zhig 'bul dgos zer don ltar de nyin dgong dro kho pa gnyis phran gyi sdod gnas su ched 'bod kyis 'jam mkhas kyi thog nas zhib cha'i gnas tshul 'dri 204

brtsad byas par rdzoganyis kyis brjod gsal/ tsharadzam glingapadamag chen gnyis pa'i skabs kho gnyis rgya gar du yod pa dnge / spyi lo 1944lor 'jar man na dzir gyi da—mag pham nyes byung bar brten skabs der rgya gar khul du yod pa'i 'jar man mi nigs yongs rdzogs dbyin ji'i bkod 'doms 'og rgya gar gzhung nas 'dzin bzung4gis rgya gar byang phyogs mnga' sde'i khongs sbre ra grun zhes pa'i btson khang du bcug pa bzhin kho pa gnyis kyang mnyam du btson 'jug byas byung ba'i sa nas kho gnyis the bas mi bzhi mnyam du bro4thar byung ba'i khongs nas mi gnyis bal yul du bskyod song ba datho / nga gnyis bod kyi lho phyogs skyid grong sa mtshams 'dzul te byang thang kho na brgyud lha sar yong ba yin zhes dang / shes yon thad 'jar man rgan pa ab sha na thar 'jar man slob grwa che ba'i spa se thon nas chu bed 'dzugs skrun gyi las ka yang mang tsam byas pa'i nyams myong yod pa dang / ha rar kho pa ri 'dzegs tshogs pa'i khongs mi zhig yin pa las/ de min dmigs bsal shesmo yon med ces zer don rnams tshigajorabakod nas sgophyiglus 7su bskyal ba yin/tsho de skabs dza sag nas zer don/ bod gling dbyin ji'i sku tshab nas kho gnyi sa rtsis sprod gnang rogs zhu 'dug pa 'di skor khyed rang gi bsam 'charoji yod zer 'dug par/ phran nas rtsa ba zhu mos ltar rtsis sprod mdzad dang mi mdzang/ gzhung sa'i phyag rtsa red/ — 'on kyang bka' don rang nyid kyi bsam 'char ni kho pa gnyis rang re'i bod kyi sa thog tu skyabs bcol lta buracislebs stabs lam 'phral rtsis 'phrod mdzad tshe mtshan lar gnod gzhir brten re zhig bkag nyar mdzad nas tshorim pas ji dge dngos dze bzhes mdzad na legs snyam pa dang / de 'brel kho pa gnyis skyabs bcol bar brten gzhung gnas nas skyobs gso'i rogs ram phran bu gnang gal che 205

ba 'dug ces zhus pa yin/ kho gnyis slebs pa'i snga dro snang shag las drung nas 'khur po bsngog bsher byas song / yang 'jar man yig thog bris pa'i nyin deb re las de min rngo thog pa'i dngos po gang yang thon ma song de nas nyin shas song rjes tsha rong sras dang / de min sku drag che mkhan 'ga' zhig nas kho gnyis la ltad mo blta ba dang chabs cig yong nas gyon chas rnying song mang po ster gnang song yang / kho gnyis gzugs stobs ha cang che bas gyon chas mang che ba lus por ran pa byung ma song yang / gang ltar cha bsdu ya bsdu byas nas gyon pa cha tshang re gyon nas mthar skyi dkar pags pa'i tshar tshag tsab ral gnyis po rdzab dong che mo'i nang bskyur thub tsam byung song /de nas nyin gcig kho gnyis kyis zer don/ nga gnyis kyi skra dang / sma ra ma bzhar tshe mi tshang mas lta rub phya smod byed 'dug pas skra bzhar mkhan gcig skad gtong rogs zer 'dug don ltar skra bzhar ba gcig skad btang nas skra dang sma ra gtsang ma bzhar du bcug pas gzhi nas yu rob ab se'i ngo gdong gsal por don song ba kho pa gnyis kyi shel sgo'i nang nas mthong bar brten ha cang dga' po byung song / de nas nyin nyi shu skor song mtshams ‘‘phyi las ’’nas kho gnyis la skyobs gso rogs ram du dmigs bsal tshad len byas pa'i gyon pa lpags tshag ther rdzus rgya rmug gi rgyab ldan re dang / ko ba'i shul rtse yun ring cha re/ zhwa mo lpags zhwa re / za chas rtsam pa gro zhib/ ja mar/ lug sha bcas sprad song bar brten kho gnyis la bsam yul las 'das pa'i za gyon phon che thob ste 'khyag ltogs kyi gnas las grol thub pas dga' tshor dpag med byung song / de nas nyin 'ga' song mtshams phran rang ‘‘phyi las ’’su bskyod de da cha 'jar man gnyis kyi sdod gnas 'phral du thugs gtan 'khel thub pa gnang rogs zhus par/ dza 206

sag nas 'di skor tsha rong dza sag dang bka' mol byung don/ — nyin sha sa ngang 'then gnang rogs/ tsha rong gzim khang rigi shag khor nas sdod khang zhig sprod rgyu yin zhes dang / ring zin tsha rlong nas dze+es len 'khong rgyu'i lan 'byor 'phral khyed la brda lan sprad chogo zer 'dug ༷de nas nyin zhas song— mtshams ‘‘phyi pos ’’nasachi brda lan 'byor gsal khyed nas tsha rong la 'brel ba byas te mi gnyis po de tsha rong la rtsis sprod byas na 'grigs lugs zerakrudon de don tsha rong la bshad par/ tsha rong dza sag nas kho gnyis kyi sdod khang gra sgrig byas zin pas 'phral du spos na 'grig pa yod zer ba bzhin de'i sang nyin khoganyisaci 'khrid —nas tsha rong la rtsicasasprod byas rjes rang snyad dang gang ci'i 'byel ba gtsang mar bcad〉pa yin/ sna— kho5gnyis phran saratar yun ring bod kyi spyi tshogs gnas stangs —dang / chos lugs/— —sku drag gi gogananas/ ches mtho'i las khungs bka' shag dang de 'og gi 4sa khung sa khag byu bud’med kyi dbang cha dang go gnas/ chas gos/ 5 skusmodrag khag mjal skabs gus pyizhabs zhu n+tangs skor —sog4'dri brtsad byas4byungasgyubar skabs de'i dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang lam lugs skor sogs bshad pa yin/ de nas lo gcig tsam song rjes 'jar man rgan pa ab sha na be+er la rtse yig tshangak+ṣ-ilas khungs nas zla re dngul phogs sbrad de 'dod dgu thang gi shar ngogagram stong dang / lcags po ri'i nye 'dabs lho ngos sa stong du smon tshogs gnyis kyi tshogs shing gi ched du sbyar lcang gi shing 'dzugs bya yul gling kha khag gnyis 'debs bzo bya rgyu gtan 'khel bar brten 'jar mnachi rgan par lcang chu 'dren ched chu yur ga sar bzo'i thig tshad len rgyu'i las 'gan sprad par rten khomos gtsang ral gyi sngar yodapam yusanas yur bu gsar pa khag gnyis zur 'khrid kyis gong gsal sa stong gnyis la 'char gzhi ldanapha pa'i 207

sgo nas lcang yur drus te sbyar lcang rtsa rkang stong phrag mang po gsar 'dzugs thub par brten de sngon nye skor chu lho byang gi rdzong gzhis khag nas lo ltar tshogs shing 'phon che sgrub 'jal byed dgos pa slad nas de ltar ma dgos par mi ser gyi bde rtsar sman pa'i dge mtshan shin tu chen po byung song / de nas spyi lo 1947tsam la grwa bzhi las khungs nas 'char phul phyag rtags dgongs don/ zhang 'dabs ri zur du brtag dpyad gtan 'bebs kyis glog khang 'os mtshams shig rgyag rgyur thag gcod zin don sna chen ri zur gyi gsham 'og gtsang 'gram nas (deng skabs rnga chen ri zur zer )rka gsar pa zhig bzos te zhang 'dabs glog khang 'dzugs skrun bya yul bar ma yur gting tshad dang kha zheng sogs cung che tsam zhig gi thig tshad len rgyu dang / chu yur gsar bzo ma zin bar gyi jus 'don 'argo 'khrid 'jar man rgan pa ab sha na thar la 'gan dkri sprad thog tsha rong gis yur po'i chu 'bab thad sngar yod gtsang ral ma yur gyi chu 'bab las ldab 'phar yong thabs kyis lha sa'i gling kha khag dang / nor gling pho brang yas mas kyi mkho chu dbyar dgun chad med yong ba dgos rgyu'i mngags cha yang byas song / chu yur 'dzugs skrun gyi 'gro gron yongs rdzogs grwa bzhi las khungs nas 'gan len dang / las mi mi grangs sum brgya skor dgos pa 'dzugs skrun ma zin bar grwa bzhi dmag sgar nas gtong dgos/ bka' shag nas bkod khyab byas pa bcas lo gnyis min tsam la chu yur 'dzugs skrun gyi las ka legs bsgrubs zin te chu 'dren tshod lta'i nyin der rka 'go nas glog khang ma yur gsar pa'i nang chu 'dren skabs dal 'gro'i rba rlabs lang long du g.yo bzhin par yud tsam song rjes yur po'i stod smad bar gsum du chu rang khengs dal brel cha snyoms kyis rgyugs pa las/ kong 'bur kha lud rgyag pa dang / 'gyings pa sogs kyi 208

skyon cha ma lhags pas 'do byed tshang ma blo kha khengs pa byung song / de rjes glog khang gsar rgyag bya rgyu'i 'phrul chas 'don 'dren gyis mtshon gnad don gang cir phyi nang gnyis nas 'gal rkyen sna tshogs thug par brten lam lhongs ma byung ba'i skor sngon du ra4nyid nas gang shes gab dran gyi lo rgyus shig bris te zur 'bul zhusad+ngha zin pas 'dir bskyar bzlos byed kyi min/ —྅jar man gzhon pa ha rar zhes pa de spyang gyeng 'dzoms khar lha sar sdod yu na ring sku drag che khag rme dbu bskor zhu mkhogopas tshang mkhro —spyan bsal lta bur gyur pa dung / lhag don blo bzang bsam —gtanajilags brgyud tā la'i bla ma'i gam du'ang yang yang bskyod chog pa'i gnang ba thob par brten kho pa'i khengs dregs ches cher 'phel nas skabs re phran rang nyid dang khrom lam du gdong thug skabs de snga ngo shes pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam yang ma bstan par mig sher nag po'i 'og ma mthong ba'i tshul gyi g.yol 'gro ba sogs ni kho pa'i gshis rgyud tha shal zhig yin par snyam/spyi lo 1949lo 'jar man rgan gzhon gnyis ka lha sa nas rgya gar brgyud rang yul du log dgos byung —songu /— ha rar kho pa rang yul du log rjes ‘‘bod du lo bdun ’’tsho zhes pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus bkod pa'i deb gcig dang / yang de rjes spyi lo 19ṭ+wāṃ 2lo kho pa lha sar nyin bdun gyi lta skor byas skor gyi deb gcig bcas bton 'dug de snga rang nyid dog bde glog khang gi las 'gan 'khur bar brten gong gsal rnams rang nyid dang 'brel ba ji byung gi thog nas gang shes gang dran sgro bkur med par bris pa yin/ da cha lo na mtho ba—sa dran pa gsal min gyis rkyen pas tshigahosbyor 'brel chags min gyis mkhyen ldan gzigs pa po rnams gsan mi bde ba sogs kyi skyon cha yong rgyur dgongs khrel med pa zhu/209

nga tsho se grong g.yul smad pa'i khyimatshangagi 'byung khungs dang / gcen po skal bzang shes rab la dran gso dang chabs cig rang nyid kyi lo rgyus la phyi mig rags tsam lta ba/se grong dbang rgyal gyis/se grong g.yul smad pa'i khyim tshang gi 'byung khungs mdor bsdus/rab byung 14pa'i lcags stag ( 1ṭ+wāṃ 20)lor bod sa ṅgenas srid gzhung gis bod sdod am ban brgyud ching gong ma ta'o kong la gser snyan sgron par chog mchan thob ste bod ljongs su lcags stag zhib gzhung gsar 'god byas pa red/ de'i skabs nga tsho'i khyim tshang der bang pa gzhung rgyugs tshe ring lha mo khral rkang gnyis zhes lto gos 'dzoms pa'i khral khyim zhig byung 'dug cing / de'i dus khul de'i gzhung rgyugs khral pa mang che ba khyim 210

gzhis stong ste srid gzhung gi khral rigs chad las dang / bsdad rkang khral par khral skyogs che tsam 'phog par brten gzhung rgyugs stong po de tsho'i sa zhing dang / khral mi lhag 'phro kha thor rnams rub sdud kyis bsdad rkang khral pa drag gras la zla sgril btang nas de snga'i zhib gzhung rnying pa nang gsal gyi rkang grangs dang / son 'gror 'gyur ba ma btang bar nga tsho'i khyim tshang der sngar yod bsdad rkang gnyis kyi khar/ stong rkang 11dang gsum cha gcig gi sa zhing dang / mi rtsa pho mo/ ri klung rtswa chu shing gsum gyi bdag thob rnams rtsis sprod dang / de'i rjes 'brel gyi sa gnas srid gzhung —la sgrub rgyu gas byed dgos pa'i khral rigs rnams 'gel dkri byas pa red/srid gzhung gi khral cirigs zhi drag rkang 'gro lag 'don la zha chag ma byung phyin khral rten sa khang mi gsum mi mus rgyud bcas la ji srid bar 'jags gnas su sprad de rang gi lag tu nyar rgyu'i bka' gtan zur — samidagoyopar zhib gzhung nang gsal bkod byas shing / der sa gnas rdzong gi rgyab gnyer dgosatshopatshodang rdzong sdod gsar rnying 'pho lemāskabs sgo khra them bsher zer ba sa mi zhibartsobasher rtsis sprod len byed rgyu'i gtan 'bebs bzos pa re da/ nga tsho'i khyim tshang chags yul bang zer ba ni lung pa shar nas nub tu kha gtad pa chen bo rang med pa zhig yod cing / nga tsho'i shar ngos su grong tsho chung chung kha shas yod pa ste/ chos gzhi rgya stod dang / nang pa gzhis/dol po ba bcas yod/ rgya stod kyi nub tu nga tsho'i sa mtshams yur bu man gyi bang mdo zer ba deng sang gzhung lam gyi shar ngos ring tshad le dbar gcig yas mas dang3/ phu chu rgyugs yul lho byang zheng tshad de las chung trem gyi sa cha gru bzhi nad mo zhig gi ri klung tshang ma rtsa ba'i cha nas nga tsho'i sa khongs yin pa dang / chos gzhis dol po ba zer ba'i grong tsho chung ngu de'i shar rngas bang 211

phu'i ri klung lhas ra 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi she ru nga/nga kher rkyang sogs them grangs drug dang 'phan po'i 'brog bdag khyim tshang gcig gi phyugs rigs dkar nag ri shing / rnga rtswa'i rtswa ra/ gzhan yang zhing kha 'arge' shas yod pa de khongs chos gzhis nyung shas phud mang che ba nga tsho'i sa khongs red/ bang phu nas shar phyogs su kha gtad de la brgyab na 'phan po lhun grub rdzong gi sa khongs yin zhing de'i bar rkang thang du bskyod na nyin phyed tsam las 'gor gyi med cing / phug thag thung ba'i dbang gis chu rtswa zhan stabs dpyid dus kyi zhing chu 'bel po med pas nga tsho'i sa zhing 'ong gling yan chad kyi zhing pa tsho'i chu thob nyin mo yin pa dang / nga tsho'i chu thob mtshan chu yin par brten gling 'go'i lho byang gnyis su mtshan chu gsog dkyil byed sa'i chu rdzing gnyis yod pa bcas 'ong gling de bzhin se grong gi gtso bo'i pha gzhis yin pa dang / de min pha gzhis le lag gsum yod/spyir btang bde chen rdzong gi nye 'dabs yas mas tshang ma sa bab mtho bas lo tog thon 'bab dma' tsam dang sad nyen yang cung che tsam yod kyang /nga tshor sa zhing rgya che ba dang khral mi yang mang tsam yod par brten rim bzhin stong po'i zhing kha mang po tha rtsi khungs slog byas pa dang / so nam 'debs las tshags chud byung nas skyid sdug 'khos kha yar rgyas kyis byang ngos ri 'dabs su chags pa'i khang pa de yang rim bzhin rgya bskyed byas te bzo bkod yag po med kyang rgya khyon che la thog brtsegs gsum yod pa zhig chags shing / khral mi de tsho'i gras nas rim pas gsar 'dzugs byas pa mo bran them dud bcu grangs yod pa de tshor gla dod son khal 12kyi sa dang / de'i khar bogs zhing son khal 12re'am de las mang tsam yang sprad de rgyun gtan mo bran rkang re nas zhing g.yog las mi gcig re dang / ston dpyid mi 212

gnyis re yong dgos pa dang / las mi nam yong la lto chas skam rlon ster dgos/ de min nang bzan yin pa mi grangs 15nas 20bar la lo re bza' 'bru ru'i khal 1rdore dang / g.yog gos snam bu dkyus ma dkar nag gang rung gi phyu pa re/ lo gnangs chags su gos thung stod thung / — lham/bud med tshor pang gdan sogs sprod kyi yod pa bcas la brten zhing g.yog dang / phyugs zog 'tsho skyong byed mi 'dang nges yod pa red/ de 'brel phu la rtswa kha yag po yod stabs sems can spu nag nyis brgya lhag gi— ru ba yod pa dang chu skor gnyis dang snum tshags sogs 'khos labyor 'dzoms po chags 'dug pa de'i byung rtsa gtso bo srid gzhung la rgyugs dgos pa'i khral rigs thad khyim tshang gcig la khral rkang mang po de 'dra yod pa rdzong 'og der nga tsho ma gtogs med kyang lcags stag zhib 'god skabs stong po'i sa mir 'khri ba'i khral rigs rnams lag 'don las rkang 'gro rgyugs mi’dgos shing / lag 'don gtso bo rgya gsos/ shing dngul/ smon rngod zer ba'i thog de min rnam grangs ha cang mang po yod pa khag gcig dngos mdog sgrub dgos pa phud lo ltar srid gzhung gi las khungs khag sogs la 'bru ru khal stong la nye ba 'jal dgos kyang skabs der dngul thang ha cang che bsapakhal rer dngul zho do dang / mtho bar zho gsum tsam yin 'dug pa dngul sgyur gyi 'bab 'bul dgos pa'i bka' 'bebs byas4pa dngaka rjes su dngul thang rim chag kyang spar cha chen po rang ma byas stabs rkang ci'agro'i khral rigs dang rī dmag khral sogs ñdzi po yod pa las r+shalag 'don gyi khral lji po rang med par brten khyiyotshang de rim bzhin yar rgyas byung nas khul de'i yul mi rnams kyi khrod du phu yi se grong g.yul smad dang / mda' yi skyar po a yar zhes stod lung phu mda'i khral pa khyim tshang 'byor pa che shos gnyis la brtsi ba yang byung 213

'dug rjes su nga tsho'i mes po'i dus su mi ngo mang bas gcig dbar gnyis shor gyi zhing las tshags tshud ma byung dang / lo phyugs lam du ma lhongs pa sogs kyi rkyen pas de khul srid gzhung gi 'bru skyed phogs khang dang / de min bla grwa khag nas blangs pa'i 'bru bun ru khal stong phrag kha shas dus thog tu 'jal sprod ma thub pa dang / khyim tshang nang kha ma gshin pas ma zur tha dad byas 'dug se grong zur pa'i skal thob la pha gzhis le lag dkar po sa dang nor rgyas khang gsar zer ba gnyis kyi sa khang mi gsum dang thon skyed yo chas cha tshang gi rjes 'brel stong po'i khral rkang bzhi sprad de zur thon byas nga/ dang / se grong ma tshang la pha gzhis ma lag gnyis kyi sa khang mi gsum rjes 'brel stong rkang bdun dang gsum cha gcig bsdad rkang gnyis kyi khral rigs dang / phyi bun 'bru dngul tshang ma 'jal sprod byed dgos byung ba dang / nga tsho'i pha de nyid kyang sku tshe ring po ma byung ba bcas kyis nyams gud che ba'i dus skabs shig kyang byung 'dug rjes su nga'i gcen po skal bzang shes rab kyis a ma de nyid dang mnyam du khyim tshang gi gtso 'gan 'khur nas rim bzhin phyi bun 'jal sprod thub nga dang / so nam zhing las tshags tshud byung ba sogs kyis khyim tshang de slar gso byung ba red/stod lung tshal bde rdzong 'og de'i khyon yongs kyi sa bab ni mtshur phu dang de min lung tshan re gnyis phud grong gseb yul mi mang che ba gnas yul byang na/sa lho phyogs su 'bab pa'i gzhung chu'i rgyud du gnas yod cing /de'i ring tshad spyi le lnga bcu skor yod pa der gzhigs te stod bar smad gsum dbye yod pa dang (deng sang yang chus gsum red )tsho rer mi ser gyi 'go gtso byed mkhan rgya tsho rgan po gsum yod pa'i nang nas nga tsho'i khyim tshang la rgan rten rkang gcig gi sa zhing yod pa dang stod tsho'i rgya tsho rgan po gtan 'jags 21‘1

thog gtso drag kyang 'gel dkri byas 'dug sa gnas rdzong dang / getso— drag — rgya tsho mi ser bcas kyi 'brel ba'i sko ra / gtso sdog gi lus 'gan ni srid gzhung gi gtan 'beb yig cha'i 'bru don ltar na rdzong 'og der khral rigs dang de myin gyod don kha shas rdzong gtso 'khur mnyam len thog zhib dpyod dang 'brel thag gcod byed dgos zhes gsal yod kyang / tredon dngos thog lo ltar 'char can— 'bru skyed phogs dpon dang zhib 'phar bsdu dam gyi ngo tshab bkar khang so sor 'byor skabs rdzong— tshab dang mnyam du gtso drag rnams rgyags rang 'khur gyis 'gro dgos pa dang / —der ngo tshab de tsho'i bkod 'doms ltar 'bru spusnga legs nyes blta rgyu dang 'bru bun gtong len gyi 'bo kha rgyag rgyu/ gzhung bun dus sprod mi byed mkhan gyi sgo rtsar bun 'ded la 'gro rgyu/ bun rnying do khag gnyis stong 'ded yul med pa chags na gtso drag gis 'gan 'khur cinas brtsad— gcod byed dgos pa sogs las rdzong dang 'dra mnyamaci gyi khe dbang gang yang med/rgya tsho'i las 'gan ni khral 'ul skul 'ded byed mi'i lag tu 'khyer ba'i sbug dam dang /— srid dam/ bka' dam bcas 'khod pa'i gtan 'jags lag rtsa dang / phar phyir thengs gcig gilam yig rigs gnyis yod pa'i nang gsal rta khal mi gsum grangs dpyad bzhin skyel mtshams rdzongaske skyel/ gzhis skyel/ sa tshigs bcas yod cing / de dag sa gnas r+sāso sor 'byor skabs rgya ritshos zhib bsher byas te he bag med pa bya rgyus/215

mtshon srid gzhung gi bka' dang mi 'gal ba dang / mi ser la 'phar brdab med pa sogs spang blangs byed sgo'i skor rgya tsho gsum gyis rdzong du zhib phra'i gan rgyar rtags 'dzugs byas yod pa dang / stod tsho tshorgya tshos gong gsal lam yig ji yod nang gsal las khungs gang dang gang gi dngos zog ji yin/ phar tshur rta khal mi gsum 'bor grangs ji song gi zla tshes bcas zhib phra'i tho 'god byas te lo ltar zla 6re'i mtshams bka' shag tu rdzong gtso thun mong ming 'khod kyi song khra snyan zhu re dus thog tu 'bul dgos pa dang /yang khral rigs gsar 'phar dper na pho brang yas mas sam/ gzhung khang gsar rgyag dang nyams gso/ zam rags sogs kyi ar 'ul/ ar las rgyu cha dgos mkho khral rkang thog sgrub rgyugs dgos skor bka' rgya 'byor tshe rdzong nas ma nga' khul gzhis 'bangs spyi 'thus bskongs te sgrog sbyang dang 'brel bka' dgongs dus bkag 'gal med rdzong sdod la le thogs med pa sgrub rgyugs bya rgyu'i gan rgya der yang rgya tsho gsum gyi ming rtags 'god dgos/gal te 'grub thabs med rigs mi ser gyi rgan po tsho dang rgya tsho gros bsdur byas te bka' shag la bde sdug snyan 'bul zhu dgos byung tshe rdzong gis 'gan 'khur byed kyi ma red/rgya tsho rgan po dang gtso drag gi ming tsam las don du srid gzhung nas bskos pa'i rdzong dpon gyis sa gnas de'i khral bsdu khrims ba/non tshang ma thag gcod byed kyi yod/ rgan gtsos mi ser byings dang 'dra bar cha rkyen med pa'i sgo nas rdzong dpon gyi bka' gsung ci sgrub zhu dgos pa ma zad/ rdzong dpon sger gyi khe phan dang mthun pa'i zhabs 'degs sgrub thub na rdzong dpon de'i las thog ring gdeng 'jog che tsam thob rgyu dang / gal te rdzong dpon gyi khe phan la do phog phran bu byung na khrims gcod bzed rgyu red/ dper na 216

1947lo tsam la rdzong sdod rtse drung byams pa thub bstan gyi lha sa'i shag tu skyel rgyu'i 'bru rtsam sogs nyer mkho do po kha shas mi ser gyi dos khal thog dbor 'dren byed rgyur btang zhing / smad tsho'i rgya tsho sde drug bla brang gi drung yig rta mgrin gyi bus srid gzhung gi lam yig med tshe mi ser thog rta khal skul 'ded mi chog pa'i skor nga tsho mnga' khul rgya tsho gsum gyis rdzong duji gan rgya rtags 'dzugs zhus yod pas gang byung khal ma btang na mi nagrig ces bshad pa red/ nyin shas rjes smad tsho'i rgya tsho bde chen rdzong du tshogs 'dur 'byor song ba de nyin glo bur du rdzong gis kho pa 'dzin bzung byas te rdzong thog rim pa'i nyer mkho mi ser gyis rta khal thog lha sar dbor 'dren byed pa de ltar yang da lam nga la 'gro tshod byas lugs rgyu mtshan du bkod nas rta lcag btang zhing / de min gyod don che gras srid gzhung la zhu gtugs byas pa dper na se grong la khral rten pha gzhis lug pa sgang zer ba son khal brgya skor gyi sa khang rtswa kha dang bcas 'bras spungs har gdong khang tshan gyi chos gzhis yin tshul bsnyon 'dzugs kyis rgyal tshab rwa sgreng la snyan zhus zhib dpyod bka' shag mgron brgyud7nas byas shing / zhib sar nga tshos lcags stag zhib gzhung nang gsal gzhung rgyugs stong po'i sa khang khral rten se grong gi pha gzhis yin pa khungs skyel ra sprod byas kyang lo gsum tsam nar 'gyangs rjes se grong par khral dod bogs ma sprad de sa khang pha gzhis kyi kha 'dzin har gdong khams tshan la sprade pa de ni 'os bab gtan nas med pa'i dpyad mtshams shig yin yang brtsi bkur mi zhu thabs med byung ba sogs kyi gnas tshul byung myong yod/— nga tsho'i khyim tshang dang tshal bde rdzong 'og gi khral pa mi ser byings dang /lhag par du stod tsho rgan khag bdun gyi khral pa tsho'i dbar pha mes dus nas phan tshun rgyus mnga' 'brel ba rgyun mthud la brten de khul gyi khral mi mang che 217

bas nga tsho'i gcen por cha 'jog yid ches bya yul la brtsi ba ltar nga tshos kyang khral pa tsho'i ched du sems 'khur byed kyi yod cing / skabs der srid gzhung gi lam yig 'khyer nas khral 'ul skul 'ded byed mkhan dmag mi dang / a drung / nang gzan/ sger chos kyi g.yog po don ma go sogs cikyis khral mir bsnyas bcos nag med nyes 'gel dang nyes rdung gtong ba sogs ni sa gnas gang sar yongs khyab dang 'char can lta bu yin pa de rigs 'gog thabs su spyi lo 1946lo tsam la nga tshos khral mi tshor gros 'go zhig bton pa ste/ nga tsho tshang mas khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod gtan nas byed mi rung yang / rang ngos nas khral khrims dang len tshul mthun byed bzhin par nyes rdung bzed dgos pa ni bzod thabs bral ba zhig yin gshis nges med khral 'ul skul mi'i rtsub spyod rang bzhin gyi gnas tshul thon tshe khral mi gzhon dar tshos mdun du langs nas phyi tshul dgongs dag thugs bden zhu dgos pa dang / nang don nyes rdung gtong bar yong mkhan mi de'i lag pa nas 'jus te gang ltar nyes rdung mi phog pa bya rgyu dang / le thog byung ba'i khral mi de g.yol thabs byed dgos/ lab gleng gi snyog dras rkyen pas khricha/sa khang dang srid gzhung gi las khungs gang sar gnas lugs rgyu rkyen shod rgyu nga tshos gang thub bya rgyu'i kha chad byas pa yin/ bya thabs de lag bstar byas pa nas bzung khral mir nyes rdung phog pa ha lam byung ma song nga tsho'i sa khongs nas lam yig nang gsal dos khal dbor 'dren byed pa'i dngos rigs bor brlags sam chag skyon/ chu shor sogs kyi lab gleng byung tshe thag nye rgyang la ma ltos par nga rang ngo bskyod kyis dpal 'byor thog phog mi 'os pa'i gyong gun ma 'khel tsam yong gi yod/ dper na spyi lo 1952lo tsam la rtse phyag las khungs kyi tshong pa 'bri chu gser sdud pa lha sar phyir log gyi lam 21 8

yig nang gsal dngos zog dos rgyab 200skor bod zla 10pa'i nang nga tsho bde chen sa gnas su 'khyorartezhing / ngas mi ser gyi khal ma bsdu skong3gi do po rnams khral rkang la gzhigs pa'i cha gses byas nas dos rgyab dang zung sbrel thog bde chen rdzong zhol nas rmang sa gnas bar dbor 'dren bya rgyur khral pa rnams la rtsis sprod byas pa yin/ de'i sang nyin khral don gzhan dag gi ched du nga yang rmang la 'byor skabs glo bur du mi ser gzhon nu zhig brel tshabs chen pos nga'i 'khris su rgyugs byung ba de ni rgyud smad lam pa gzhis 'og gi khral pa zhig red/ ngas ‘‘khyod 'a de dra'i dza drag gi gnas tshul gang byung ngam ’’zhes dris par/ ‘‘kha sa bde chen nas do rtsis blangs te khral mi byings dang mnyam du khal ma'i lam thag nyin phyed kyi sa cha 'di gar 'byor nas mdang nub do po de3mas rmang gzhis kyi g.yul kha'i nang mnyam 'jog srung bya byas thog da lta dos rgyab par rtsis sprod skabs mar ltang re re bzhin mar skung rgyag dus nang du phyugs zog gi lci bas brgyangs pa'i ltang gnyis thon song ba 'di skyel mkhan su yin zhes brtsad gcod byed skabs nga yin lab pa dang rgyu mtshan dris byung bar ngas do —po mnyam 'jog srung bya byas lugs kyi gnas tshul gsal bshad byas par kha lan slog byung zhes nyes rdung gtong bar shor byung ba khral rogs tshos bkag pa'i gseng du ngas bros te khyed 'tshol bar yong ba yin/ nga la dos nyes de 'dra 'khris rnye nga'i khyim tshang du dngos po ngo mtho shos khal glang dang rmos glang gcig lcogs glang rgan gsum las med ga de tsho dang bral na chags rten med ’’zer ba sogs nyams thag pa'i gnas lugs mang po shod kyi 'dug de 'phral ngas khral mi tsho'i khrod du phyin nas rtogs zhib byas pa dang bar dpang khral mi kha shas 'khrid de dos rgyab pa'i sar 'gro skabs dos rgyab pa khams pa grwa shar zhig 'dug pa 219

des nga tsho mthong ma thag ‘‘khyed tsho'i khral mis sde pa gzhung gi gsol mar lci ba dang brjes pa'i tshabs che'i byed 'dzol 'di bzhin thag gcod gang 'dra byed rtsis yod dam ’’zhes phyu pa'i phu thung sked par dkris pa dang / stod thung gi phu thung g.yas rdzes g.yon rdzes kyis gshe gshe gtong bzhin 'dug pa der ngas 'jam mkhas ngang go gsed ji ltar byas kyang nyan 'jog mi byed par ‘‘khyod tshos mi mang dpung sgril btsan shed kyi sgo nas nga la mar gyi tshab tu lci ba len re byed kyang ngas rtsis len gyi min nga tsho'i sbyin bdag kyang lha sar sngon la phebs zin song / ji 'gab khyod tshos bsam blo thongs ’’zer gyi 'dugade nas nga tsho gros mol byas te nyin shas rjes nga rang dang lam pa rgan po/ mi ser gyi 'thus mi gcig bcas lha sar yong ste rtse phyag nang bzan la mo shar (deng sang slob chung dang po'i dge rgan )sar bskyod de mi ser nas g.yo rdzus byas med pa'i khungs skyel dang / dos brgyab pas dmigs yul ngan bcangs byas pa sogs kyi gnas tshul zhib cha bshad de gang ltar skyin tshab sgrub mi dgos pa gnang rogs zhes bshad par/ khong gis ‘‘de'i skor rtse phyag las khungs nas thag gcod gnang rgyu las/ ngas thag gcod byed thabs yod pa ma red ’’ces sogs bshad de khas len byed kyi mi 'dug de nas nga tshos gnas tshang du log ste 'bri chu gser sdud kyi dos rgyab pas mi ser la nag med nyes 'gel byas pa dang sbyin bdag phyag nang gis kyang ngan rgyab byed pa sogs gnas tshul zhib 'khod kyi snyan zhu zhig bka' drung ldum ra brgyud bka' shag la 'bul rgyur nang bcar zhus te sang nyin der nga tsho log rtsis byas pa yin/ 'on kyang sang zhogs snga dro yang skyar nga tshos ma lan ma 'gyod kyis phyag nang gi sar bskyod de gnad don der khyed kyis dgongs bzhes gnang rgyu yod dam med ces bshad lan/ nga la rtse phyag las khungs 220

su 'bul rgyu'i yig ge gcig bstan byung ba'i nang ‘‘stod lung tshal bde'i khral pas rtse phyag las khungs kyi gsol mar lci ba dang brjes pa'i skyin tshab dngos mdog 'bul dgos pa smos med khar nag nyes byed gte rtsis sprod dgos pa ma zad/ rgya tsho dang mi ser dpung sgril gyis dos rgyab par rdung 'dzog gtong rtsis byas pa bcas la nyesatshuchad yan por ma song ba dgos ’’lugs sogs 'khod 'dug de'i lan dzu ngas dos rgyab pa za rngam can kha ma bud de 'drar gtugs pa las sku zhabagaphyag nang khyed sku ngo ma mjal na dgongs bzhes gnang res lam thag nyin gnyis kyi sar ched mngags yong ba don med du gyur song da ni nga tshos kyang bka' shag la dag 'bud snyan zhu zhig phul te snga 'phros rang gnas su log rgyu las thabs gzhan med lugs bshad de 'og rtsis byed skabs khong rkyang skum mi shes pa'i bzo lta zhig mthong byung / de 'phral ngas rogs pa gnyis la khyed gnyis sgo 'gram du tog tsam sgug ang zhes lab ste slar yang phyag nang gi mdun du phyin nas cog rtse'i steng bod dngul brgya lor gnyis bzhag thog mi ser ngan hrul de tshor nag med nyes 'gel mthar brkeg btang tshe khyi rgan gyang khug tu bkar na kha log gi dpe ltar khyed la mtshan don genyis med kyi rgyu las yong bzo ma mngon gshis 'dimaskor mi ser nyams thag chagaga'ajigo gi bde rtsar dgongs te mar rin sgrub 'jal ma dgos pa'i dgongs baṃzhes gnang rogs zhes 'jam bshad blo 'gugs kyi 'phros mol zhib lhongaso bgyis mthar gong gsal rtse phyag nang la shar gyis nga la ngo so zhig btang nas mar skyin sgrub mjal ma dgos par thag gcod thub song / gal srid mar skyin sgrub dgos byung na mar ltang gnyis la 'degs khal 24(rgya ma 16ṭ+wāṃ)yod par skabs de'i yul thang do skor rtsigo'abru ru khal 4ṭ+wāṃthob cing / de ni khral pa khyiyotshang mtha' zhan de 'dra'i ngos nas221

bshad na khyim tshang chags 'jig gi rtsa bar thug pa zhig red/ gnad don de rigs la rang don khyad med rgyab skyor gang thub byas pa'i dbang gis khral pa mang tshogs dang phan tshun 'brel ba gang legs yod pa ma zad/ rdzong 'og de'i dgon khag gi bla grwa dang / ga'i/sa khag sogs 'bring rim mi sna mang che ba dang yang phan tshun brel ba gang legs yod/spyi lo 1rdzo5 0lo tshun gyi gnas tshul skor/gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa'i snga rjes su (krung go'i rgyal khab yongs su gsar brjer rgyal kha thob pa nas bzung bcings 'grol dmag bod du dpung bskyod kyi lam bar chab mdo'i gnas tshul dang / tā la'i bcu bzhi pa gro mor phebs pa / bcings 'grol dmag lha sar 'byor ba )bod du dkrog gtam gyi rba rlabs nang mi mang po zhig (raphyang mo nyug tu gnas shing / lha sa'i sku drag dang 'byor phyug khag gcig gis ca dngos ngo mtho ba rnams rtse pho brang dang / se 'bras sogs la bcol ba'i skabs der nga tsho yang bya rog gi phru gu smug pa'i khrod du 'khyar ba ltar mgo thom nas bsdad yod cing / de dus nga tshor gsar brje'i dpe deb thun mong rtsa tshig bod yig tu bsgyur ba zhig lag son byung ba de thengs kha shas blta klog byas pa dang / skabs de'i tang gi mi rigs srid jus sogs mdzad phyogs yang dag pa rnams bod 'byor las byed pa dang bcings 'grol dmag gi 'go dmangs kyis lag bstar byed stangs sogs kyi gnas tshul mang po mthong thos byung ba brgyud mi khag gcig gis dkrog gtam la mgo ma 222

'khor bar gsar brje'i spyod bzang la smon sems yid ches dang 'brel rang 'gul gyis phugs mdun la bsam gzhigs byed 'go tshugs pa'i skabs der nga tsho'i lta stangs la krung go'i rgyal khab kyi 'phrul 'khor cha tshang 'dzin mkhan go min tang rtsa gtor btang zin pa dang de rjes rgyal spyi'i thog khra'o shan du a 'gog khra'o rogs kyi g.yul 'gyed la rgyal kha thob pa sogs dngos yod gnas tshul mang po'i thog nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis krung go'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la 'gog rgol byed rgyu ni dgod bro ba'i bya ba zhig yin la/ dzibod rang btsan ’’bya rgyu'i re stong byed pa ni de bas kyang 'gru ba thabs med ba'i ngos 'dzin rim bzhin je gsal du phyin pa ma zad/ de snga mi mang po'i bsam par u ru su dmar po'i lam lugs zhes par 'jigasagasnang chen po byed pa de la yang ngos 'dzin byed stangs 'gyur ldog byung ste spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brjer dad sems skyes shing / de rjes bod kyi rten 'bul tshogs pa pe cin du bskyod skabs ma'o kru'u zhis dus tshod snga phyi ma gtogs borda du spyi tshogasasaring lugs kyis lam lugs 'dzug4dgos gsungs pa dang /bod rang skyong ljongagagra sgrig u yon lhan khang tshugs skabs tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bozhi pa0sku ngo mas kyang ‘‘phyin chad bod 'di spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lam du bskyod dgos pa las/ lam gzhan yod pa ma red ’’ces gsungs pa/ gzhan yang nga tsho'i gcen pos go thos shig la nga phod kyis ‘‘nga tsho sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku drag tshor mtshon na rang 'gul gyis rta thog nas bab dgos pa de gal che yin pa las/ gzhan gyis 'bebs rgyur sgug sdod mi rung ba zhig red ’’gsungs skad de tshor nga tsho'i gcen pos ha cang mthong chen dang slob gso gting zab len gyi 'dug cing / phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos 'phel— rimadang 'gro phyogs de 'dra'i 'og nga tsho'i lta stangs la ring 223

por mi thogs par bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid dbang de rtsa thor 'gro rgyur nam langs sbar mos khebs thabs med pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/chos dad kyi thad stod lung tshal bde rdzong khul der nga tsho'i khyim tshang la chos snang dkar ba'i khyim tshang gi gras su brtsi ba dang / sngar gyi goms srol rgyun 'jags kyis nga tsho'i gcen po yang chos dad kyi bsam pa ha cang gting zab yo da pa zhig yin stabs chos dad kyi gnad don de'i skor bsam gzhigs zam mi 'chad pa byas ma/thar thog ma'i sdom tshig rob bsdus shig brnyed pa ni lo rgyus thog rgyal khab phyi nang gang sar chos lugs dar ba dang / 'phel ba/mthar nyams gud du 'gro ba'i brgyud rim ni tshan rig dar rgyas/ che chung la rag lus pa zhig yin pas bod du yang rim bzhin mi rabs kha shas kyi rjes su phal cher chos dad kyi ming tsam las lhag bzo med pa'i ngos 'dzin byas shing /der brten spyi lo 1rdzo46lo'i bar nga tsho'i khyim tshang gis dpal 'byor thog nas chos lugs kyi byed sgo lha sa smon lam la lag 'don mang 'gyed dang /de min dgon khag la mang 'gyed/ bla sprul khag la 'bul ba dang bka' chos zhu ba/ bka' 'gyur dpar 'debs sogs chos phyogs kyi byed sgo mtha' mjug la rtsis nas rgya che tsam byas shing / rang ngos la mtshon na yang chos dad skor blta stangs gong dang phyogs mtshungs khar/ da dung skabs de'i srid dbang rnying pa'i rus sungs rjes lus dang / nye skyor phyogag lhung gi lam lugs 'og sger gyi khe phan dang ma 'tsham pa'i dbang sgyur myong dgos par yi ma rangs pa dang / srid dbang gsar pa'i dmag dpung dang las bzor sgrig khrims lam srol do dam pa'i rang bzhin mthong yang skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi shugs rkyen ngan pa'i 'og tshul ldan min pa'i bag yangs spyod lam gyi rang gshis 'gyur ldog gtong rgyu'i thad goms gathis rnying pa'i bag chags 224

sel ma thub par lo nas lo bstusdo bsam gzhigs byed dgos byung myong / — spyi chogs lu'u yi skyed med dngul bun gtong mkhan la rgyab skyor zhus sko ra/ spyi lo 1952lo'i zla 2pa'i nang nga rang bde chen rdzong zhol du bsdad yod cing / nyin zhig phyi dro tshal bde rdzong sdod rtse drung byams pa thub bstan lags kyis nga 'bod mi btang don bzhin 'gro skabs rdzong khang gcig thog de'i rdo skas se'u kha shas 'dzegs 'gor ka phib gcig yod pa der rdzong dpon dang mnyam du rgya rigs las byed pa dang bcings 'grol dmag kha shas langs nas skad cha shod kyi 'dug nga der slebs 'phral rdzong dpon gyis nga la bltas nas rgya tsho slebs song bas khyed tsho skad cha gnang zhig zer ba dang /'di bka' shag nas kho tshor gnang ba'i lag 'khyer red ces nga la sprad pa de'i nang ‘‘rgya gzhung nas de khul mi ser la skyed med dngul bun g.yar mkhan las byed pa 'di tshor brdal gla yul srol sprod len thog rta khal gtong ba dang /gnas mal sogs la rogs ram byed dgos ’’zhes bka' rgya dang lam yig chabs cig lta bu thung thung zhig 'dug pa dang / skad sgyur gyis 'di ni nga tsho'i han tud krang dang de 'og 'di dang 'di zhes mi rnams ngo sprod byas te skad sgyur gnyis the ba'i mi grangs 12'dug khong tshos nga'i gnas tshul 'dri ba dang / snga 'phros nga tshor sdod gnas shig g.yar thabs byed dgo sa zer zhing / skad sgyur bod rigs lha sa ba gzhon nu gnyis po des rdzong gis thab tshang ka bzhi de'i nang nga tsho ma bzhag pas ma tshad/ rngo tshang theb chag pha 225

gi'i nang du yang sdod mi 'jug par 'dir (rebyor nas chu tshod gcig tsam song zer gyi 'dug de 'phral ngas jo+ong dpon gyi gzim chung nang phyin te kho tsho'i sdod gnas bkod sgrig gang 'dra byed dgos dgongs skor zhus lan/de tsho khyod rang nas byed dgos pa las nga'i las ka ma red ces bshad de mar don yong nas khyod tshor rogs ram byed dgos rigs spo'o gis (nga la )byed kyi red zer song / de nas ngas khyed tsho nga'i sdod sar gang 'dra 'dug blta bar phyin na zhes lab 'phral khong tsho tshang mas so so'i nyal 'jo phrag par 'khyer nas slebs byung / nga rang khral don ched rdzong zhol du yong dus sdod yul khang pa ka gcig lcam gang ma gcig yod pa de dang / de'i 'khris su spyi pa'i bka' 'gyur lha khang zhig yod pa de'i nang khong tsho'i nyal sa go sgrig byas pa dang / nga'i g.yog po des ja blugs kyang skad sgyur gnyis kyis ma gtogs gzhan dag tshos ma btung bar chu bkol ba dang / ngas khong tsho'i gdan dang / me shing / lto snod sogs go sgrig byas pa yin/ kho tshos 'khyer ba'i za bca'i lcags krin che tsam zhig kha phye ba'i nang rtsam pa 'dra ba tshwa dang se pan/ sman sma sogs bsres pa'i 'bru rigs des bag thug 'dra po zhig bkol nas nga la yang bro ba ltos dang zhes dkar yol gang blugs byung ba phyed ka tsam yang za khag po 'dug kho tshos phyogs gcig nas lto chas za ba dang phyogs gcig nas skyed med dngul bun gtong stangs gsal bshad byas ribyung / nga de nub khyim du log nas sang nyin zhogs pa gro zhib dang / sha skam po/ zho khog la phug/ bcas 'khyer te khong tshor sprad par han tud krang gis ‘‘sgrig khrims chen po gsum dang / do snang byed dgos pa brgyad ’’kyi 'grel bshad mang po brgyab nas gro zhib dang sha ma blangs pa dang zhog lab kyi rin 'bab kyang u tshugs kyis sprad byung / de nas dngul bun g.yar 226

stangs kyi byed sgo'i skon gros bsdur byed 'go tshugs nas han tud krang gis bod las don u yon lhan khang gi 'go 'khrid 'og las ka 'di mu mthud de byed dgos pas gnas skabs kyi u yon lhan khang zhig 'dzugs rgyur de'i kru'u ren ngo ma de nges par du rdzong dpon la bsko dgos pa dang / de min sa khul de nas mi gsum bzhi dgos pa dang / mi ser dogs 'drog mi 'byung ba'i slob gso rgyag rgyu r+pācas nga la bkod sgrig byas shing / de nas ngas rdzong dpon sar bcar te gnas lugs zhib phra bshad par rdzong dpon gyis nga la bshad don ‘‘rgya mir kha ya byas drags na 'gan los bzod e yong ’’zer lan/de'i thad kho tshor bka' shag gi bka' lam sprad yod pa ma zad gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun dang yang mthun pa zhig yin stabasarjes su rnyog dra byung tshe 'gan yongs rdzogs ngas 'khur rgyu byas par mos mthun thob pa dang /nye 'khor mi ser mang tshogs khag cig tshogs 'dur yong dgos pa'i skul yig btang ba yin/ sang nyin der skul yig btang ba'i stod tsho rgan khag bdun gyi rgan po rnams 'byor par skyed med dngul bun gtong rgyu'i skor ngas gsal bshad byas rjes las byed pa tsho dang rdong tsho rdzong du mnyam 'dzoms thog han tud krang gi bkod sgrig dang mthun pa byung zhing / sang nyin dril bsgrags bya rgyu dang dngul bun g.yar rgyu byas pa yin/ sang nyin der dngos su dngul bun gtong 'go tshugs skabs dngul bun len mkhan tsho'i 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul darnga / sa zhing sogs thon skyed yo chas ji yod tho 'god byed skabs mi ser rnams dogs 'drog lta bus dngul bun len phod kyi mi 'dugang tshos de skor slar yang go gsed byas pa dang 'brel thog mar nga tsho se grong gi mo bran them dud kha shas slebs pa de tsho'i gnas tshul tho 'god byas pa dang /da lta dngul rkyang blangs nas ston dus yul srol rin thang rtsis te 'bru sran 227

rigs sprod rgyu byas shing / dud tshang dka' ngal che chung nga tshos rgyus mnga' byas nas dud tshang rer nā yang sgor 20nas 100bar re g.yar ba dang /khag theg kyang ngas rtags 'dzugs byas pa yin/ de nas 'tsho bar tshad 'dra min gyi dka' ngal yod pa them dud 〈 0skor la dngul bun btang ba bcas khyon bsdoms stod tsho khul du them grangs brgya dang nyi shu skor la dngul nā yang sgor 600 0tsam bun gtong byas thog ston dus phyir 'bul thub na rab dang /de min sprod ma thub tshe phyi 'gyangs chog pa bcas gtan 'khel byas par dbul phongs mang tshogs kyis dga' bsu tshad med zhu gi 'dug de'i gong bcings 'grol dmag dang las byed pa kha shas stod lung tshal bde'i khul rtog zhib tu 'byor par zhing pa mang tshogs kyis kha ya ma byas pa dang / zhing khrod du yod pa'i mang tshogs sar 'gro dus bros 'gro ba dang zhing pa'i khyim du 'gro dus sgo khyi glod pa sogs byang skad de rigs de nas bzung mthong rgya med pa mchog ri'i zir chags pa rad/sa zhing gi gtsos thon skyed rgyu chas bogs man btang ba dang nyo tshong byas skon/spyi lo 1956lor bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes pa'i tshogs 'dur nga tsho'i gcen po rdzong 'og de'i 'thus mir bskyod pa red/ skabs de'i gros chod ltar gtsang khul du bkras lhun chos gzhis khongs kyi gzhis ka zhig la bcos sgyur gyi tshod lta gnang rgyu gtan 'khel zin pa de legs 'grub yong rgyur yid ches byas te nga tsho gzhung rgyugs khral pa khyim 228

tshang zhig gis kyang 'khos dpags la gzhigs pa'i mig dpe cung zad zhig ston thub māsger pa che khag sa zhing 'don brgya yan chad/ (son khral khri yan )yod par g.yo 'gul thebs srid snyam zhing / de 'asabyung tshe de snga bod 'dir sa mi yongs rdzogs ‘‘gzhung sger chos gsum ’’ste mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyis bdag bzung byed pa'i dbang ba'i lam lugasasmoder rim bzhin 'gyur ldogagatong rgyur skul 'ded kyi nus pa cung zad thon srid/'on kyang skabs der sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang cha 'dzin mkhan gtso bo khag cig gis gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la mngon brtsi lkog 'gal dang tha na gsar brje bkag 'gog gi ngan sems 'chang gi yod stabs nga tsho'i pha gzhis ni khyon yongs nas bltas na sa rgya chen por brtsi rin med pa zhig yin kyang 'gyur4ldog che tsam zhig btang ba yin na phyogs gcig nas srid gzhung rnying pa'i dbang 'dzin pa khag cig gi 'dod blo dang ha cang mi 'tshams stabs mig ltos shas rkyen la rtsis nas 'gog rdung mi byed pa'i nges pa med gshis/ nga tshos lhod g.yeng dang hol rgyugs byed mi rung la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas rjes su khyon yongs kyi sa zhing bcos sgyur dang rtsa ba'i cha nas mthun pa zhig byung na 'phral phugs gnyis dge yong re dang bcas ji ltar byas legasaskorwabaka' slob zhu yul zhig 'tshol bar ngayolha sarached mngags thengs gcig bskyod kyang tshod 'dzin 'pher —ba zhig ma rnyed par phyir log ste nga tsho spun mched rgan gzhon gsum po bsam gros zhib lhing thog gcen po'i bza' zlar yang zhib mol mo4mthun byung ba'i mdo don nga tsho'i—sa zhing rnams bogs mar gtong rgyu dang / thon skyed rgyu chas gzhan rnams nyo tshong byas pa'i ming thog nas sa zhing bcos sgyur dngos ni krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang —dang bod rang skyong ljongs gra ud kyi 'go khrid 'og — tu ma 229

gtogs de min sus kyang gtong mi thub pa'i skor yang skor bskyar skor gyis gsal bshad byas pa dang chabs cig zhib phra'i lag bstar bya thabs kyi 'char gzhi zhig bzos pa yin/spyi lo 1956lo'i sto na khar tshal bde rdzong rim pa'i don gcod khru'u dngos su tshugs rjes kyi go skabs dang bstun gcen pos nga tsho'i khral mi mo bran dang / nang bzan tsho rub 'dzoms thog bshad don ‘‘khyod tshos shes gsal ltar nga tsho'i khyim tshang gi so nam zhing las dang / srid gzhung gi khral rigs sgrub rgyugs sogs gtso 'gan ngas 'khur gyi yod pa dang / gcung po dbang rgyal gyis nga tsho'i khyim tshang la 'khri ba'i stod tsho rgya tsho'i las 'gan 'khur nas phyi 'gro byed kyi yod kyang / da cha nga gnyis rdzong rim don gcod khang gi las kar zhugs pa dang / gcung po a nan lha sar gzhon nu mnyam 'brel tshogs pa'i las kar zhugs pa/ dbang rgyal gyi bu ye shes tshul khrims spyi tshogs slob grwa nas gung gzhon tshogs mir zhugs rjes pe cin du slob sbyong la phyin pa (kong po smin gling du las ka'i don du rang srog shor ba )de 'og phru gu lo na phra ba bcas la brten gtso bo nga tsho'i khral rten sa zhing rgya che 'debs bkol byed rgyu dang / khral rigs sgrub rgyugs sogs rgya 'ub mi 'dus pas phyi nang gang sar 'thus/ shor yong bzo che ba dang / rgya che sa nas bshad na deng skabs krung go'i rgyal yongs dang 'dra ba bod du yang nga tsho'i bsam yul las 'das pa'i spyi tshogs 'gyur ldog ha cang chen po zhig yong nyer yod cing /de ni gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun dang mthun pa'i krung gung krung dbyang gi srid jus mdzub ston gzhir bzung rjes su ring min sa zhing bcos sgyur byed ched 'di lo tshod lta'i gnas gzhi 'dzugs rgyu dang de nas khyab gdal gtong rgyu red/ yin na yang dngos su sa zhing bcos sgyur byed pa'i dus 230

tshod ni da lta nga tshos brjod ga la thub/ snga 'phros nga tsho'i sa zhing rnams khyod tshos 'debs las byas te nga tshor yul srol gyi zhing bogagasprod rgyu dang / da ltabode ljongs su sa gan4logad gzhung tshogis khral khrims kyi 'gan dbang spyad bzhin par brten khral rten sa zhing— la 'khri ba'i khral rigs rnams khyod tshor brnyas gtser med pa gzhan la gla thabs byed pa sogasacegang tsholtar nga tshog 'gan len byas na snyam pa'i gros 'go 'don rgyur bsam gzhigs nan tan byed dgos ’’zhes bshad par nyin shas rjes kho tshos sa zhing rgya che de 'dra nga tshor bogs gto nga gnang yang thon skyed yo chas gang sa nas cha rkyen mi 'dang ba'i dka'atshongal gyi gnas tshul bshed par/ gcen pos/ de tsho'i thad nga tshos sngon tshud nas go sgrig byas zin’pas sems khral byed mi dgos/ spyir btang sa zhing bogs mar gtong len gyi 'gro lugs ni sa zhing gi bdag pos bogs len byed mkhan la zhing kha stong par rtsis sprod byed— patsholas de min bsam gzhigs gang yang mi byed pa ma zad/ nga tsho'i lag 'debs zhing kha rnams ni ha cang dul po yod stabs gzhan la bogs gtong byas tshe bogs len byed mkhan hab thob shig shig yong rgyu rang re tshang mas thes gsal red/'on kyang nga tsho ngo g.yog pha mes yang mes3kyi dus nas 'brel ba chags te da bar kha bral ma —myo4nga ba zhig yin pas ga—nas skabs khyod tshor 'tsho phan yong ba dang / phugs don spyi tshogs 'gyur ldog gi kha phyogs dang mthun thabs shig yin pa las/ nga tshos khe bzang don gnyer byas pa zhig min stabs nga tsho gros mol zhib lhongs byas te nga tsho'i sa zhing thag ride kha thor phud thag nye 'brel mtshungs khyonane+ebosdoms son khal 〈24yod pa dang / mi ser them grangs 19la mi grang/sa ra7'dug kyang mi grangs kyi rtsis gzhir bzung nas sa zhing bgo bsha' rgyag rgyu mi 'tshams pas sa zhing thad khyod tsho dud tshang so so'i 231

ngal rtsol nus shugs la dpag pa do bdag rang rang gi 'dod mos ltar bgo rgyu de dang 'brel rnga rtswa'i rtswar yang sa zhing rgya che chung la gzhigs te bgo rgyu/sa zhing legs nyes rab 'bring mtha' gsum nga tshor rgyus mnga' ha cang zhib phra yod pas mnyam 'dzoms thog nas bgo bsha' rgyag rgyu'i 'dod tshul bton par bran g.yog tshos yongs su mos mthun byung stabs dud tshang nus shugs mang bar son khal 70skor dang / nyung shos la son khal 20thob pa de tshor lo re zhing bogs yul srol dma' tshad son 'gro bogs 'gro zhes son khal re'i sar zhing bogs 'bru khal gcig re sprod rgyu/ zhing chu'i thad sngar lam bzhin res mos dang / phan tshun go bsdur/ stabs bstun mos snyom yong ba bya rgyu/ skabs der de khul zhing las gtso bo nas dang / sran ma/pad kha bcas 'debs shing / gro ni nyung shas las 'debs kyi med/ nas zhing ji yod la gting lud thengs re rgyag dgos pa de dag se grong gi ra lugs grangs 600skor dang / rta drel/ ba glang sogs kyi lud rnams zhing rgyar gzhigs nas bgo 'grems bya rgyu/ rmos mdzo dang rmos glang spus dag ngo grangs 22yod pa de dag la rer rin 'bru khal 14re rtsis te rin 'bab rjes sprod bya rgyu/ thong gshol grangs 40 shol lcags grangs 60gnya' sga/ sbar mo/ rgyal gses/ 'jor/ sbyar ma/ snod phad/ thag pa sogs tshang mar rin 'bab 'os 'tsham rjes sprod bya rgyur btsong pa dang /sa bon nas dang / sran ma/ pad kha bcas mo bran rnying pa tshor 'don rgyu yod rigs kyi kha snon dang / khyim gzhi gsar 'dzugs byas pa tshor tshang ma sprod rgyu/ de bzhin phyi lo g.yul las ma tshar bar gyi bza' 'bru dang rmos phyugs kyi gzan chag bcas yul srol skyed gtong byas pa rnams rjes su sdoms rtsis rgyag skabs khyon bsdoms 'bru khal 2000skor zin gyi 'dug232

nang du nyar ba'i nang bzan gras nas gnyis mos kyi bsdad pa dang /phyi nas glas pa khyon mi 6la lo rer sngar lam bza' 'bru ru'i khal 1rare dang gla cha lo rer ru'e rnakhal 10 6sprod rgyu dang / rjes su lo gcig 'khor mtshams ji 'gab gros bsdur bya rgyu byas par gong gsal bya thabs de tshor bran g.yog rnamasajikyis 'dod blo khongs pa'i sgo nas mos mthun byas pa red/gcen po nga gnyis rdzong don gcod khru'u ru las ka byed mus thog rang skyong ljongs gra ud dang lha sa yan lag kung ud kyi gtan 'khel gnang ba ltar spyi lo 1957lo'e zla 7pa'i nang gcen po mes rgyal nang khul du blta skor la thon pa dang gong lo'i zla 11nang blta skor tshogs ba bod du phyir log rjes gcen postod lung du log skabs nga tsho'i mo bran them dud 19yod pa'i za pha tshos mgrispo dbyangs gocig gyur gyis bogos mar gtong len byasatshopa'i sa zhing rnams rang 'jags 'jog dgos pa'i re 'dun mtha' spucig tu bton par/ gcen pos/ snga lo nga tshos lo gcig 'khor mtshams bskyar gros bya rgyu'i kha ga dan de ni khyod tshor khe phan gang 'dra yong min lta rgyu'i ched du yin zhing / da cha khyod tshor khe phan gang 'tsham byung yod pa mthong gsal la ngas dga' spro'i ngang cha rkyen med pa'i sgo nas bod ljong—sa yongs la sa zhing bcos sgyur ma byas bar rang 'jags 'jog gi yin zhes khalilen byas pa red/de rjes ljongs tang ud kyi hru'u ci kro'u ren hren dang las byed pa khag cig ched mngags se grong nang du 'tshams 'dri dang zhib 'jug gnang bar phebs pa dang / de nas gcen por gong rim rtsa 'dzugs kyi thugs 'khur gzigs skyong chen pos lha sa spyi khyab rim pa'i don gcod khang du las ka bkod sgrig gnang ba ma zad/ lha sar sdod khang cha tshang zhig gnang nas nang mi bu phrug dang bcas pa lha sar bsdad pa dang / spyi lo 1959lor ngo 233

log zing 'khrug skabs nang mi tshang ma rang skyong ljongs kyi khang chen du bsus te srung skyob gnang ba red/ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang rjes bod ljongs su gnam sa bla 'og 'gyur pa lta bu'i dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur byed 'go tshugs nas nga tsho'i sa khul der las don ru khag 'byor te zhib 'jug byed skabs nga tsho'i mo bran them dud 19mang che ba zhing pa 'bring la gnas pa dang / sa zhing sogs de snga bgos zin pa'i thon skyed yo chas byings rang 'jags bzhag thog ra lug dang / ther ge 'bru rigs/ nang chas/ khang pa sogs mang tshogs la bgo bsha' rgyag skabs las don ru khag gis ‘‘khyim tshang 'di'i mi ngo rnams ngo log zing 'khrug dang 'brel ba med pa ma zad/ gsar brje'i dpung khag nang yod cistabs tang gi srid jus gzhir bzung dngos rigs rnams blu nyo byas te khyod tshor bgos pa red ’’ces gsal bshad nan tan byas 'dugade rjes gcen po gra ud srid 'dzin kho'o la las ka bkod sgrig gnang ba dang / tshal gung thang du yod pa'i las khungs kyi zhing ra'i 'gan 'khur lo shas byas rjes srid gros su bkod sgrig gnang nas bod ljongs srid gros u yon gyi go ming gnang ba red/ spyi lo 1kha66lor rig gnas gsar brje 'go tshugs te gcen po nga gnyis 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi khungs mi spyi mtshungs lha sa'i sa khul grong mi u yon lhan khang so sor ngal rtsol byed pa dang zhib bsher 'khur skabs nga gnyis la lo rgyus kyi nyes pa bshu gzhog gral rim spyi mtshungs las med kyang / g.yon thal lam phyogs kyi rlung 'tshub nang khyod tshos rang nyid kyi nag nyes 'gebs srung byed ched spyi lo 1956lor bran g.yog la mgo skor btang nas bcos sgyur rdzun ma byed mkhan red ces ther 'don yin khul dang 9rabrel snyon 'dzugs 'gag pa bzed dgos byung /234

rjes su rang nyid la rtsa don rang bzhin gyi nag nyes med pa ma zad/ go thos su stod lang bde chen rdzong bde chen chus su de snga nga tsho'i bran g.yog rnams ri riX 'a gi shā dang / de'i nye 'khor sgyu juzhing pa mang tshogs la nga tshor ther 'don dang 'thab 'dzing byed dgos pa'i skul slong shurgos 9chen byas par nus pa ma thon stabs mjug skyong brda' 'ded btang ma byung / spyi lo 1967lor gcen por de snga gong rim rtsa 'dzugs kyis gnang ba'i khang pa de nas khang pa gzhan zhig la spo bcug pa dang / spyi lo 196ṭ+wāṃlor yang bskyar khang pa byang lta zhig la spo bcug pa red/ spyi lo 1kha70lor tang gi srid jus gzhir bzung 'thab phyogs gcige gyur gyi mi sna rnams rugebasdus gnang ste srid jus don 'khyol gyi 'go tshugaspu 'phral 'thab phyogs gcig gyur bu'u yi 'gan 'khur blo mthun dang las byed pa sa khul don gcod khang du ngo phebs kyisako gsed rim pa gnang nas de snga'i khang pa dang / dngos 'phrog pa rnams phyir bzhes rang 'jags gsol ras gnang ba dang / gcen po'i phru gu bu gsum dang bu mo 4gcig yod pa khong tshor yangatshosnga rting du las ka bkod sgrig thob nas tshang ma rgyal khab kyi las bzo yin khar/ gcen por sngar bzhin bod ljongs chab gros u yo na gyi go ming slar gso gnang ba sogs tang gi thugs 'khur dang gzigasaskyong bla med thob ste blo bde bag phebs su gnas bzhin pa'i mur spyi lo 19ṭ+wāṃ1lor gcen po de nyid dgung lo 72thog sku tshe ma zin pa bcas/ — sto 23khya

rdzong rim pa'i don gcod khru'u gsar 'dzugs byas skor/spyi lo 1956lor krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang dang /rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi thad ka'i 'go khrid 'og bod ljongs rdzong khag so sor rdzong rim pa'i don gcod khru'u re gsar 'dzugs gnang rgyu'i gtan 'bebs ltar stod lung tshal bde sa gnas su 'go khrid blo mthun khag cig ngo phebs kyis khul de'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs dang dgon sde khag cig gi las sne tshogs 'dur skong 'tshogs thog bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun gzhir bzung skabs de'i tang gi mdzad phyogs dang srid jus khyab bsgrags gnang ba dang lhag par mes rgyal skam sa chen po byings dang 'dra ba bod du yang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs gsar 'dzugs byed dgos pa de yang bod kyi gong 'og mi sna rnams kyi go rtogs sad tshad dang bstun nas dbang ba'i lam lugs bcos sgyur gyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen skrun ched bod kyi rdzong 'go gzhan dang 'dra ba 'di gar (tshal bde )rdzong rim don gcod khru'u dngos su gsar 'dzugs bya rgyu red/ de ni zhing 'brog mang tshogs khrod du mar khe si le nyin ring lugs dang ma'o tse tung gi dgongs pa'i mdzub khrid 'og spyi tshogs ring lugs lam lugs kyi khyad 'phags rang bzhin dang tang gi mdzad phyogs srid jus khyab bsgrags dang lag bstar byed mkhan yin pa sogs 'phral phugs gal che don snying ldan yod pa'i skor gsung bshad gnang ba dang / srid 236

dbang 'dzugs skrun gyi las byed 'dems bsko sogs zhib phra'i byed sgo'i 'gan 'khur tsā ud dmangs srid khru'u dang / lha sa yan lag kung ud/lha sa spyi khyab 4rim pa'i don gcod khru'u bcas nas byed dgos bkod sgrig gnang don bzhin bod zla bdun pa'i nang lha sa spyi khyab rim pa'i khru'u krang thub bstan bzang po stod lung bde chen du phebs te gza' 'khor3gnyis tsam bzhugs pa dang / dmangs srid khru'u dang / yan lag kung ud kyi 'go khrid dang las don mi sna thengs mang phebs te mang tshogs tshogs 'du skong 'tshogs thog bsam 'char bsdu len dang gros zhib nan tan byasasathar rdzong rim don byed khang gi gzhung las khang gcig dang / de 'og kho'o brgyad 'dzugs rgyu'i gros gtan 'khel ba de'i nang mi sna 'dems bsko'i thadapadon gcod khru'u'i kru'u ren skabs de'i sa gnas srid gzhung gi rgyal mtshan phun tshogs lags dang— bru'u ren gzhon pa rgya rigs li'u shol tung dang dbang rgyal/don gcod khang gi kru'u ren rgya rigs dbyang lags dang drung yig gcig bcas dang / kho'o brgyad ni/ zhing 'brog kho'o dang / dmangs srid/rig slob/ khrims 'dzin/ spyi bde/ nor srid/ 'dzugs skrun/srid 'dzin bcas kyi kho'o krang gnyis re dang u yon lnga dang gnyer pa/rtsis pa/ sne ma byan/ de min zhabs 'degs pa kha shas bcas las grub pa'i sgrig gzhi gsarasmo'adzugs legs grub byung ba red/ rī lge gong gsal las byed mi sna bsdu ba'i cha rkyen ni skabs der bod sa gnas srid gzhung srid dbang ma lag gnas bzhin pa dang mi so so'i gral rim gtan 'khel byas med pa'i gnas tshul 'og rang lo 20nas 50bar spung go'i spyi 'bangs yin pa dang / btsan brgol rgyal gces kyi bsam blo yod pa/ mang tshogs kyi cha 'jog byed pa/ bod yig shes pa bcas yin 2 37

phyin skya ser/ pho mo su yin yang rang mos yod tshe bsdu rgyu yin yang /skabs der bod kyi spyi tshogs rjes lus de 'dra'i nang grong gseb zhing 'brog mang tshogs mang che ba yig rmongs yin pa dang / bsam blo'i thog nas bcings 'grol dmag dang las byed pa'i spyod bzang la yid smon dang bsngags brjod byed pa tsam las/ spyi tshogs hril por rtsa ba'i 'pho 'gyur chen po yong rgyu'i sngon dpag thob kyi med pa red/tshal bde rdzong 'og der sger pa dang / chos gzhis grangs 20nas 40bar yod pa'i gzhis sdod de tsho tshang ma tshad mi 'dra ba'i bod yig shes pa dang / spyi tshogs kyi bya gzhag myong goms thos gsum phran bu yod pa de tsho yang sger khag spyin bdag dang / bla brang / grwa tshang bcas pa'i stang 'dzin 'og gnas yod pa ma zad/ mi sger so so'i ngos nas spyi tshogs ring lugs la ngo rgol byed sems med kyang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid dbang de yun gnas yong dang mi yong / phyin chad rang nyid 'gro lam gang du bskyod dgos sogs ngos 'dzin gsal po med pa'i re dogs ma chod pa dang bsam blo'i gzhan dbang du gyur nas phar blta tshur blta byed kyi 'dugaskabs der rang gi bsam blo'i ngos nas mtshon na mar le'i ring lugs dang ma'o tse tung dgongs pa'i slob gso thob myong med stabs gsar brje'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi go rtogs gang yang med/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i khyim tshang nang gcen po de nyid nas nga tsho dang bu phrug bcas pa'i phyin chad 'tsho ba'i mdun lam la rang don rang gces kyis bsam gzhigs byed dgos pa'i 'phros pa rgyun ldan can du yod mus khar/ rdzong rim don gcod khang ma tshugs gong gi nyin shas kyi sngon du rdzong dpon rgyal mtshan phun tshogs lags/('thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'i las byed )dang shar bde tshe stobs lags/238

(dmangs srid khru'u'i las byed )gnyis gra sgrig gnang bar phebs pa khong gnyis kyis nga— la da lta'i tang gi mdzad phyogs dang srid jus/ tshordzong rim don gcod khang 'dzugs rgyu'i dgos pa dimigasaṭ+wāṃyul sogs zhib phra'i gsal bshad gnang ba ma zad/ khyod rang ni sa gnas 'di rang gi mi yin la khyod tsho'i khyim tshang la rgya tsho dang gtso drag gi las 'gan yod pa dang zhib cha'i rgyus mnga' yod stabs don gcod khang 'dzugs rgyur phyar ba gru 'degs byed dgos —pa sogs kyi bsam blo'i las ka mang po gnang don ngas kyang gra sgrig byed sgo'i nang khong gnyis kyi bkodarasgrig la brtsi bkur zhus pa yin/ tshogs 'du'i skabs mi khag cig gis nga chotshor nang don grosa'adi byed pa dang / mi khag cig gis dogs 'drog kyibyed pa sogs la nga dang nga'i gcen pos tshogs 'du'i phyi rol du tang gi srid jus dang rang nyid kyi lta stangs drang phyogs dang ldog phyogs kyi sgo nas lhag bsam zol med kyis bshad cing / gang ltar spyi tshogs zang zing rnyog 'udzing chen po de 'dra zhig gi nang tang gi 'go khrid yang dag pa dang dad ring zhib tshags kyi slob gso'i dwog don gcod khang de 'dzugs thub pha dang / mi khag cig las khungs tshurges pare yong ba dang mi khag cig 'gog rkyen sna tshogs kyi rkyen pas ma yong ba de tshor ched mngags nga'i gcen po dang nga gnyis khag dgos te khyim tshang so sor bsam blo'i las ka byed par btang gnang ba ltar bskyod nas re gnyis tshur 'gugs thub pa dngatsho re gnyis 'gugs ma thub kyang yang rnying kho'o krang rgan gzhon sogs mi 1rkyanas 15bar nyin ltar las khungs su rtag 'byor thub pa de tshor thun mong thog gong rim gyis bkod sgrig gnang don/ las 'gan ni phyogs gcig nas chab srid slob sbyong byas te mi so so'i gsar brje'i go rtogs gong mthor gtong rgyu dang / cig shos nas sa khul de'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs dang 239

'brel ba byas te kho tsho'i re bdun dang bsam 'char nyan pa/ dkrog gtam dang dogs gnad sel rogs byed pa/ bod las don u yon lhan khang dang gra ud kyi bka' 'brel tang gi mdzad phyogs srid jus sgril bsgrags dang lag bstar byed dgos pa bcas red/nga tsho'i chab srid slob ston pa gra ud dmangs srid khru'u'i kho'o krang ye shes phun tshogs dang / bod rigs las byed pa rgya'i skad yig shes pa gnyis/ gtan sdod skad sgyur gcig de snga'i rtse drung ye shes rig bzang bcas ched gtong gnang thog slob sbyong gi nang don ni tang gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus dang / tang gi sgrig yig rtsa khrims/ mi rigs srid jus/gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun sogs zla bzhi'i ring slob sbyong byas pa dang 'brel las ka yang sne re gnyis byed thub pa bcas byung song /mtsho bod rlangs 'khor gzhung lam gsar bzo'i skabs tshal bde'i sa thog gi gnas tshul/spyi lo 1kha54lo'i dgun du/ sa mtsho bod rlangs 'khor gzhung lam thengs dang po bzo skabs lam bzo byed kyin ngang rlangs 'khor khag cig dang las mi/ rta drel/ rnga mong sogs 'bor chen yod pa'i lam bzo'i ru chen yangs pa can sa gnas su 'byor skabs bod dmag khul khang nas bcings 'grol dmag gi las byed pa gnyis mdun 'bras gro zhib sogs bza' cha gang 'tsham dang sbrags bde chen du 'byor ba dang / de rjes sa gnas srid gzhung nas rtse drung lhun grub rnam rgyal bka' shag gi bka' rgya lag 'khyer 240

dang chabs cig btang 'byor gyis mnga' khul gzhung sger chos gsumagyi gzhis 'bangs tshogs chen thog sgrog sbyang dang 'brel lam bzo'i las grwar sa gnas so sos rgyab skyor byed dgos pas sa khul 'di nas dmag sgar las byed pa gnyis dang zung 'brel las 'gan 'khur mkhan mi gcig ched la 'dzugs byed dgos pa'i bkod khyab byas pa de dag rdzong 'bangs tshang mas nga la 'gan dkri byas byung / skabs dedza lam bzo'i sgar sa yangs pa can nas bde chen du gang mas+hogs spo rtsis yod par lagomi chig stong lhag dang /rta drel/ dzongo mong bsdoms 500skor yod tshod/ de skabs gnam ga shis ha cang grang ngar tshe ba dang / las mi dang khal ma rnams byang brgyud nas yong ste zhing pa'i sa khul du 'byor skabs khal ma rtswa khar glod yul zhan pa dang /me shing 'thu yīl med pa/ las mi'i za chas mthud /ka gang 'tsham ma 0 gtogs rlangs 'khorartethog dbo ra 'dren byed ma thub stabs sa khul 'di rang nas dgos mkho 'bor chen nyo sgrub dgos pa dang / de dag 'degs gshor gyi tshad ga zhi rgya ma gsar par 'dzin dgos kyang / zhing 'brog mang tshogs tshosani 'bru rtsam 'bo gshor dang / gzan shing sogs rgya ma rnying 0ra tshad 'dzin byed dgos pa sogs ha cang stabs bde med par brten ngas sa khul de ga'i 'bo che chung mi 'dra ba khag cig dang / rgya ma che churngo mi 'dra ba khag cig rub bsdu byas te dmag sgar gyi las byed ba gnyi4dang rdzong dpon/zhing 'brog mang tshogs bcas tshang 'dzoms sar 'degs gshor byed skabs 'bru rigs 'bo gang la rgya ma gsar pa 26nas 20bar 'dug pa 'bring tshad rgya ma 2radang rgya ma rnying pa 'degs khal gcig la rgya ma gsar pa 6nas 〈bar 'dug pa 'bring tshad 'degs khal gcig la rgya ma bdun la cha bzhag ste 'degs gshor gyi tshad gzhi gtan 'be+ebs byed rgyu'i gros 'go bton par 24 rka

tshang mas mos mthun byas pa dang / rin gong thad 'bru rigs khal rer skabs de'i lha sa'i yul thang thog nas stod lung bde chen nas lha sa bar gyi brdal gla bcag pa dang / gzan pa dang me shing rgyab rer lha sa'i yul thang gi gsum cha gnyis rer 'dod nyo 'dod tshong bya rgyu'i gros 'gor tshang mas mos mthun byas song / skabs der tshal bde stod tsho'i khul 'brog pa them grangs 40nas 50bar yod pa de tshos me shing spus tshong bya rgyu khas len byas pa ltar dang / 'bru rigs thad zhing pa khyim tshang che 'bring tshos spus tshong bya rgyu khas len byas pa ltar bde chen rdzong zhol du 'byor rim bzhin ngas rtsis len 'degs mgyogs byas te rin 'bab thad dmag sgar gyi las byed pa gnyis dang nga tsho thun mong thog 'phral sprod byas pa bcas zla gnyis tsam ring ha cang brel zing che ba'i rgyab skyor gyi las ka byas shing / mkho sgrub nyo tshong gnyis po dang / mkho 'don le thogs med pa byung bar brten las grwa'i sgar sa de stod tshor yun ring tsam bsdad pa dang de nas bar tsho dang smad tsho'i sa thos tu spos kyang mkho sgrub byed stangs nga tshos lam gtod byas par gzhigs nas gang legs byung song / skabs der dmag sgar gyi las byed pa gnyis dang lam bzo'i 'go khrid bcas kyis nga la da nas bzung khyod rang yar mar 'grul zhud byed skabs rlangs 'khor thog bsdad 'thus gsungs nas kha lo par ston rgyu'i bod dmag khul khang gi lag 'khyer zhig kyang gnang byung / de lo'i bod zla 10pa'i nang mtsho bod dang khron bod gzhung lam thog rlangs 'khor shar gtong thub pa'i mdzad sgor yang dmag sgar gyis thugs 'khur chen pos nga ched 'bod kyis nyin shas ring dmag khul khag gi 'go khrid tsho dang mnyam du zlos gar dang glog brnyan sogs bltas pa dang sne len gnang ba dang / bdun gcig zhing ra'i 'go khrid li ta tu'e krang gis 242

khyod rang lha sar yong skabasalke nges par du 'di ga'i zhing rar yong dgos gsung gi 'dug de rjes nga lha sar yong sa'i rlangs 'khor de zhing ra'i rlangs 'khor zhig dang skabs 'khel nas li ta tu'e krang mjal byung bas do nub 'dir sdod dgos pa dang / sang zhogs ched mngags skyel bar btang chog gsungs pa ltar bsdad cing / de nub khong gis bod kyi gang ci'i gnas tshul dri zhib mang po gnang ba dang / khyod rang dmag sgar gyi las ka byas tshe nga tshos dga' bsu byed kyi yin gsungs pa ma zad/ sang zhogs der nga skyel bar btang bas lha sar nga tsho'i sdod gnas kyang shes rtogs byung song / de rjes nyin zhig khong gis nga 'bod par btang don bzhin 'gro skabs ta tu'e krang gis dmag sgar gyi nyer mkho dbor 'dren byed ched nyos pa'i rta drel mang po yod pa 'di dag da cha rlangs 'khor yod pās nyung du gtong rgyu yin zhing / rta drel 100nas 200bar yod pa 'di rnams phyir tshong bya rgyur khyod kyis grong gseb tu 'ded phyin na 'grig pa 'dug gam gsungs par/ ngas rta drel mang po de 'dra nyo tshong mi thub kyang nyung tsam zhig nyos chog zhus te rta 20nyos par rin gong dma' tsam dang rin 'bab thad 'bru rigs dang dngul gang bde rjes sprod bya rgyu de dag phyir tshong byas par khe bzang phring chen po byung / de rjes mu mthud khong dang 'brel ba byas stabs skabs de'i tang gi mdzad phyogs dang srid jus kyi slob gso mang po gnang bas nga la phugs phan chen po byung /spyi lo 1955lo'i lo 'gor lha sa dmag khul khang nas lam bzo'i dmag dpung 'bor chen zhig yangs pa can gyi sa mtshamasasmonas lha sa bar tsho khag bgos te rlangs 'khor gzhung lam zhing kha'i sgang du 'khel ba rnams mong che ba ri mtshams su spo rgyu dang zam chung mang po rgyag mkhan las grwa'i sgar sa 243

khag gi 'tsho ba'i 'gan 'khur ba tshos li ta tu'e krang gi bka' mngags yod ces nga 'tshol bar yong mkhan la mkho sgrub thad rgyus mnga'i rogs ram gang thub byas pa dang / lam bzo'i ru chen yangs pa can gyi sa thog nas stod lung tshal bde'i zhing khul du thog mar 'byor zhing / nga tsho'i sa zhing 'ong gling chung ngu kha shas yod pa rnams de ga'i sa ma 'brog dud tshang re gnyis la snga sa nas bogs mar btang ba bzhin kho tshos 'debs las byed pa/ de'i thog gzhung lam 'khel te nub nas shar du yod pa'i ri zur zhig bar gzhung lam thad kar bzo rtsis byas shing / skabs der zhing kha 'debs mkhan pha rgan gyis nga tsho'i zhing kha'i sgang du gzhung lam bzos na mi 'grig pa'i sdug skad mang po brgyab stabs lam bzo'i 'go khrid kyis dang len byas te byang ngos ri mtshams brgyud bzo rtsis byas skor pha rgan de nga tsho'i nang du gnas tshul shod par slebs byung / de dus nga'i gcen pos gzhung lam bzo rgyur 'gog rkyen bzos na 'grig gi ma red/ zhing kha'i bdag po nga tsho se grong ma zur gnyis yin pas nga tshos gros mol byas te gzhung lam khongs tshud pa'i sa rgyar gzhigs pa'i bogs ma bcag 'thus kyi go gsed byas pa dang / de'i sang nyin lam thag le dbar lnga tsam gyi sar ngas rta gzhon te phyin nas dmag dpung gi 'go khrid btsal thog khyed rnam pa'i 'char gzhi sngon bkod ltar zhing kha'i thog gzhung lam bzos na 'grig pa'i gnas tshul bshad par dmag dpon des nga la 'jam mkhas kyis mang tshogs kyi mos mthun med par nga tshos gzhung lam bzos na mi 'grig pa'i 'grel bshad gnang gi 'dug par ngas zhing kha de tsho'i bdag po nga tsho yin stabs mdang nub 'di ga'i zhing kha 'debs mkhan pha rgan de nga tsho'i sar yong nas zhib mol byung don nga tshos bogs ma gcog rgyu sogs 'phros pa zin pas dmag dmangs bar gyi 'brel 244

bar shugs rkyen ngan pa yong don med pa dang byang rgyud ri 'dabs brgyud lam bzo byasacatshe lam thag ring po min kyang skor kyog yin pa ma zad/ rjes su de rang la gtan 'khel thabs med par brten nyis las byed dgos pa'i las phyod la'ang gnod lugs dang / da dung 'di nas lha sa bar gzhung lam 'khel yul mang che ba zhing kha yin pas mi 'os pa'i skor kyog mang phro bzo dgos pa'i skyon cha yong rgyu'i gnas tshulazhib phra zhus shing / de nas nyi na gung zin nas nga tsho mnyam du kha lag bzas pa dngabad krang red zer ba zhig gis nga la bltas nas nga tsho'i las grwa'i sgar sa 'og ma tshor rogs ram byed mkhan gyi chus krang red ces nga'i lag pa nas 'jus te ngo shes gtong ba dang (chus krang zer ba de thos pa dang po yin )de nas khong gis nga tsho 'i las grwar khyod kyis bsam shes byas par thugs rje che gsungs pa dang dmag dmangs bar gyi 'brel rbe ni gal 'gangs chen po yin lugs skor 'grel bshad mang po gnang byung bas rang ngos la'ang sesnas 'gul thebs byubo/ rdzong rim don gocodatā' yis tang sgo 'go khridaci la / / r+sā༅ring 7 la / / /'ag las ka phran bu byas skar / rdzong 'og de'i mang tshogs kyi re 'dun dang las byed gso skyong gi dmigs yulargyubazung nas bde chen du slob grwa chung ba zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i gros 'gor gong rim nas chog mchan thob pa ltar dge rgan gcig bsdus pa dang /lha sa slob chung dang po'i zam bzhi slob grwa'i sgrig chas dang slob phrug tshor zla re skyob gso'i rogs dngul sogs gzhung gron thog slob phrug grangs 2 0nas 245

20bar la snga 'phros ka kha dang / dgu zla bslab pa dang / de'i gtso rgan rig slob kho'o krang byams pa dang g.yu sgron lha mos 'khur rgyur spyi lo 1956lo'i lo mjug tu slob chung dngos su btsugs pa dang / de 'brel zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi bu phrug rang lo bcu grangs yan chad lha sa dang mes rgyal nang khul du slob sbyong la btang ba de snga mi grangs 5las med kyang /don gcod khru'u tshugs tshun slob phrug grangs 60tsam byung song /de snga rdzong 'og der sa cha gzhan dang 'dra bar rdzong dang / sger chos gzhis khag gi zhing chu gtong rgyu dang / rtsad ma rnga rgyu/ tshar ma 'dren rgyu bcas sa bab dang / dus tshod/ gnam gshis/ lo tog kyi skye bab sogs stabs bstun gang dga' ci legs rang 'dod ltar byed rgyu yod pa dang / de dag phal cher legs sgrub ma zin bar zhing pa mang tshogs la rang dbang med pa'i rkyen gyis chu rtswa zhan sar dus thog tu son 'debs mi thub pa dang / than skyon byung skabs 'gog thabs med pa/ de min dus thog tu brnga bsdu byed mi thub pa sogs kyi gnas tshul yod stabs mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char dang re 'dun la gzhigs nas der 'gyur ldog gtong ched bzhugs mol zhib gros byed skabs don gcod khru'u'i kru'u ren rgyal mtshan phun tshogs lags nas gzhan la dpe ston lta bur rdzong gi sa zhing son khal 20 kyanas 4kya 0bar yod pa 'di dag gi dmigs bsal dbang cha med pa bzos te zhing pa mang tshogs kyi sa zhing la 'dra mnyam gyi khe dbang sprad pa dang gzhis sdod khag la go gsed byas par brten rdzong 'og der shugs rkyen bzang po thebs nas sngar lam 'dra mnyam med pa'i srol ngan de rtsa ba'i cha nas 'gyur 'go tshugs pa dang / mang tshogs kyi dga' bsu thob pa byung song /khul de'i mi ser gyi gyod don chung tsag rdzong du zhu sbyor byed mkhan yod 246

par nga'i gcen po skal bzang shes rab khrims 'dzin kho'o krang yin pa des 'gan 'khur nas bar 'dum rang bzhin gyi tshod blta lta bur thag gcod byas pa/ dper na/ nyin zhig bde chen du sdod pa dman byams pa lha mo dang lha sa nas yong ba'i tshong pa zhig 'dug pa khong gnyis rgyab 'dro rgyag bzhin tshong pa des byams pa lha mo 'khrid de rdzong du yong nas bshad don/ ngas mo la btsong pa'i pang gdan dang 'og 'jug sogs kyi rin 'bab sprod kyi mi 'dug pas mo'i lag tu yod pa'i dngos po rnams rdzong du gzhung bzhes gnang rogs gnangasna/ gal te dngul ma sprad na mo la rta lcags gtong rogs gnang zer ba dang / byams pa lha mos kho'i sa nas ngas nyos pa'i dngos po de tshor mi ri gong chen brgyab stabs ngas dngul sprod thub ma song / rin gong gcog cha byed dgos zir song / der gcen pos dngos po rnams rdzong du blangs te khong gnyis la ngang ring 'jam bshad gsedapa'agrol byas nas dngos po noms tshong pa der phyir slog sprad de rtsod gleng thag gcod thub song /yang gyod don che ba thag gcod byed thabs rtsa ba nas med pa dper na/ zho hrang grong tshor sdod pa rgyud smad grwa tshang gi mi ser khyo kun bzangatsārdzong du yong nasazubashad don/ 'bras spungs kyi khang tshan zhig la ngas bu lon 'bru khal 60'jal dgos kyi yod cing / der da lo'i skyed kha 'bru khal 12dang ngo bo'i thog 'bru khal 10'jal te de 'phros bka' 'gyangs zhus pa da dung ngo bo 'bru khal 2rkyadagos zhes 'ded sbyang rim pa byas stabs yang skyar khal 5'jal yang da dung tsha 'ded kyis nyin bcu'i tshun 'bru khal 15sprad na brjod med dang de minamikhyod kyi sgo zog la ngartatshos lag pa rgyag gi dzeyin zer gyi 'dug pas/ — nyin bcu'i tshun sprod ma thub na nga'i sgo zog nang ngos mtho shos rta rgod ma ma mas gnyis yod pa de 'phrog nyen che bas rdzong gi las khungs 247

gsar pa nas nga la rgyab skyor gnang rogs gnang zer ba'i gnad don de li'u kru'u ren la snyan seng zhus par/ li'u kru'u ren nas kun bzang khyim tshang gi gnas tshul cha tshang zhig khyod tshos rtog zhib byed dgos gsungs pa ltar dris par/ kho pa'i khyim du khong za tshang gnyis dang phru gu gsum yod pa dang / bkra shis khang gsar gzhis kyi 'ul mi'i khral rten dang bogs zhing bcas son khal 20lhag tsam yod par lo re ston 'bab 'bru khal 120yas mas thon gyi yod/ sgo phyugs ba glang bcu grangs dang ra lug bcu grangs/rta rgod ma rte'u 'byar zhig bcas yod/ phyi bun sprod 'jal byed yul ni bla brang / grwa tshang / khang tshan/ gzhis ka sogs khag lnga drug cig la khyon bsdoms 'bru khal 2 200skor yod pa lo re'i skyed kha kho na 'bru khal 260tsam thob cing lo re ston dus bun bdag re re bzhin gyi bun 'ded sgo tsar yong nas 'bru bun skyel rgyu'i dus bkag re bzos pa ltar 'gro dgos kyi yod/ de tshor rang gi khog rtsis la phal cher 'bru khal brgya re'i sar khal 1nas 2bar 'jal te phyi lo bar bka' 'gyangs zhus nas ngo chad dang skyed chad gan spos gnang rogs zhu dgos shing / da dung 'bru 'khyer shog ces tshad mi 'dra ba'i 'ded gtser byed skabs kha tsha sa de tshor yang skyar khal re gnyis bskyal rjes rim bzhin gan spos byed thub pa yong gi yod/ de 'dra'i dus tshod ni ston kha tshar ma g.yul khar dbor nas g.yul las btang ma tshar bar zla gnyis yas mas red/ g.yul las gtong rgyu de dus tshod ring tsam byas na de'i ring rtsam pa thag rgyu dang / chang tog tsam tsho rgyu yang rag gi red/g.yul las tshar nas 'bru bun gan spos byas zin pa der bshad srol la dom thag chod song zhes gnas skabs sgo 'gram du bun 'ded yong mtshams chad pa der zer zhing / nga tsho'i gras lam khar thug 'phrad skabs su yang phan tshun 248

'tshams 'dri lta busne dom thag chod song ngam zhes 'dri res byed kyi red ces zer/ khyim tshang der de 'dra'i bun 'bor chen po chag stangs skor dris par bshad don/ khag cig ni pha mes dus kyi bun rnying yin pa dang / de min nga tsho'i khral rogs grong pa dom bud yul byol du song ba'i khag theg la tshud nas ljorikhri ba yang mang po yod pa/ yang nga rang gis blangs pa sogs khag mang 'gril nas chags pa dper na/ nga tsho 'bru bun len par 'gro skabs phan tshun 'bod res byas nas mnyam du 'gro dgos shing / mnyam bskyod dud tshang gnyis gsum yod na khag theg gcig khag gcig 'khur dang /dud tshang bcu grangs yod na khag theg ma rnyed par 'bru bun rag thabs med cing / gcigo —khag gcig 'khur dang lcags thag lag sbrel gyis blangs pa gan rgyar tshud gras nas dud tshang gcig dom bud song ba yin na nga tsho bsdad pa tshos kho'i bu lon 'jal rgyu gleng med kyi sgo nas khas len byed rgyu red/ — de 'dra'i dbang gis da dung nga las bun 'bor che ba phyi khral rgyugs mkhan khrod du mang po yod/ ngas kyang da phan dom bud yul byol du 'gro rtsis byed myong yang nga'i bza' zlas —nga tsho thar yang khral rogs grong pa de tsho ni dga' nye dang spun mched rkyang rkyang yin pas de tsho'i rdog khres lci ru 'gro gi red ces khas len ma byas stabs lus song / nye ba'i lo shas nang ngas phur lcog bla brang gi 'bru khang nas 'bru khal 40bun blangs lo re ston dus skyed kha 'bru khal brgyad re phul ba dang ngo bo 'bru khal 40de snod 'dzugs byas te gan rgyar sel bcag gtong ba dang / yang dpyid ka snod 'dzugs de dag tshur blangs nas gsar zhus kyi gan rgya 'bul gyi yod/ des da lo'i son dang 'phros rtsam rgyu byed kyi yod/ bu lon gsar pa len mi dgos pa gtso bzung thog rta rgod ma de'i rte'u bed kyis da phan bun rnying gang 'tshamacasprod thub pa dang da 249

dung re ba byed kyi yod kyang gang ltar bun rnying gi 'og nas nga'i pha ma thar med la nga rang yang thar thabs med pa ma zad/ nga'i phru gu yang thar gyi ma red zer ba de dag li'u kru'u ren la zhus par/ khong gis 'di 'dra'i gnas tshul kun bzang tsam la ma gtogs phal cher e yod/ 'di la nga tshos mig dpe 'os pa'i thag gcod byed thabs gang 'dra zhig yod med bsam gzhigs byed dgos kyi red gsungs par/ de'i lan du ngas 'di 'dra'i gnas tshul ni mang dag yod pa de tshor thag gcod chen po zhig yong re'i bsam gzhigs byed mus la rim zhus chog pa dang / snga 'phros/ kun bzang gi gnad don thad khong rang gi khyim du da lta rtsam rgyu 'bru khal bcu grangs shig yod 'dug pa de bun bdag de la sprod rgyu dang / kun bzang la phyi khral med pa dang nang khral gzhis ka'i 'ul mir phru gu gtong mus stabs kho pa nga tsho'i don gcod khang gi ma chen lag rogs su nyar te zla re phogs sgor 70re sprad tshe des phru gu nang mi'i za 'bru spus nyo byas na gnas skabs 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal thag gcod thub rgyu'i gros 'gor mos mthun gyis lag bstar byas pa yin/nga tshos tshal bde stod tsho'i chos gzhis rgan khag lnga'i khongs mi ser la 'bru bun ji tsam yod med zhib 'jug byed rtsisaḥkyang bun bdag gi lag tu yod pa'i gan rgyar blta thabs med par brten rgan po rnams dang rim pas thug 'phrad byas te mngon chung gis brtag dpyad byas par mi ser them dud 140skor gyi khrod du bu lon len mi dgos mkhan bcu grangs las med pa dang / de byings du da tshang gsum cha gcig tsam nang gi bun 'bor lam rob shes rtogs byung ba dper na/ kun bde gling gi chos gzhis mi ser khag gcig lo re ston dus su bla brang gi bkar 'jug pas bun/ rtsis rgyag skabs khyim tshang gcig la 'bru bun gan rgya khag mang po yod pa ste/ rgyas 250
