dpyad gan rgya/ rgyas dpyad chad pa'i gan rgya/ bar chad ngo bo gan rgya/skyed chad gan rgya/ khag theg byas nas 'khris pa'i gan rgya/ gsar zhus ngo bo'i gan rgya/ de'i skyed chad gan rgya/ zhing bogs chad pa 'i gan rgya bcas gan khag brgyad tsam yod pa de tsho'i nang gsal bsdoms na 'bru ru khal bzhi — stong nas lnga stong tsam yod 'dug da dung bun bdag gzhan khag bla brang /grwa tshang / khang tshang / gzhis khag la bun chad mang po 'dug gang ltar khral pyokhyim tshang ji tsam rnying khungs yin pa de tshor bun 'bor che ba yod pa khong tshor 'bru bun khal ga tshod sprod dgos kyi yod dam zhes skad cha dris na grangs tshad nges gtan do bdag nas kyang bshad thub kyi med pa red/ kho tsho'i ngag rgyun la phyi bun sprod 'jal ni stong rdos thab kha bcos thub pa dang /bcu shing gis ja bskol thub pa yod zer srol 'dug (de ni skabs der rde'u rtsis gtong yas grangs ka bcu la shing dang / brgya la rgya sran/ stong la rdo yin pa der zer )yang khral pa dud tshang zhig la rgan rgon bu rgyud med pa mtha ra 'das grongs song ba de 'dra srid gzhung la snyan zhus kyis theb rtsis bya rgyu'i bka' dpyad btang ba red zer ba de ni do bdag 'das po'i rjes shul sgo phyugs dang de min dngos rigs che phra ji yod bun bdag tshang 'dzoms sar bzhag ste rin bsgyur thog 'bru bun gyi cha shas ji thob bgo bsha' rgyag rgyu der zer/ de min yul tsho re gnyis kyis bu lon sprod 'jal thub thabs bral bas bun zhib dgos skor srid gzhung la snyan zhu phul bar srid gzhung nas gzhung zhabs ser skya ched bskos kyis zhib 'jug byagamathar 'charagazhi phyag rtags dgongs don/ bun 'bor che chung dang gnas tshul la gzhigs te bun 'bru'i bsdoms 'borartogyi gsum cha gcig nas bzhi cha gsum bar tsam chag 251

yang gtong ba dang / 'phros bsdad bsdoms 'bor la skyed med rgyas dpyad lo re brgya cha gsum nas lnga bar 'jal rgyu'i dpyad mtshams btang bar phyi tshul la bltas na yang bzod de lhag che thabs med pa zhig red/ 'on kyang bu lon 'jal mkhan gyi ngos nas mtshon na/ bun 'bor 'bring gras 'bru khal 4000yod pa zhig la chag yang bzhi cha gsum btang 'phros yang chad 'bru khal 100'jal dgos pa de lo re rgyas dpyad 'bru khal 50re lo nyi shu'i ring lo tog legs nyes la ma ltos par chad med 'jal dgos la/gsar du bu lon len yul yang med par gyur zhing / de snga bun zhib ma zhus gong ston mjug nas dgun kha'i bar bun 'ded sun gtser che tsam dang gshe gshe mang tsam bzed dgos pa las nyes rdung dang khrims gtugs byed srol med/ gang lags she na/ bun bdag tsho'i gcig gyur gyi bshad srol la mi ser dom bun kye rkub rul 'di tsho bsad che rdung chung red ces shod pa ni yongs grags yin pa dang / de skabs sa gnas srid gzhung gi legs bcos las khungs nas bun skyed phran bu chung du btang ba der zhing pa mang tshogs kyis dga' bsu mi byed pa ma zad/ g.yul thag chod dus spag thag chod yas ni sngar bzhin de rang red zer gyi 'dug gang ltar bod kyi zhing pa'i sa khul du 'bru bun sprod 'jal gyi tshabs che'i don gnad 'di ni snga phyi bar gsum du sa gnas srid gzhung gis thag chod byed thabs rtsa ba nas yod pa ma red/ ci der brten nga tsho'i bsam 'char la gnad don de dag sa zhing bcos sgyur byed rgyu dang / khral bogs bun gsum rtsa chag gtong rgyu de kho na las med gshis/ des na nang don nga tshos gong rim rtsa 'dzugs la snyan seng chog mchan zhus thog nga tsho'i rdzong 'og dang / khyim mtshes gdong dkar dang / chu shur/ de min lha sa'i shar ngos rdzong gzhis re gnyis sogs nye 252

'khor mi ser gyi khral don las ka byed mkhan nga tsho dang 'dra ba'i 'brel 'dris yod pa khag gcig la ngas 'brel mthud byas thog sa khul so so'i zhing pa mang tshogs rnams rgyud skul gyis sa gnas srid gzhung la khral bogs bun gsum rtsa chag dgos skor zhib phra'i snyan 'bul dang sbrags de dag mtshams 'jog byas tshe bod ljecangs kyi mi grangs mang shos zhing pa rnams yar langs thub kyi ma red/ da lta sa gnas srid gzhung nas gnad don mang por mngon brtsi lkog 'gal byed pa dang / lhag don bod du sa zhing bcos sgyur byed rgyu de bod mi dmangs kyi blo 'dod dang 'tsham gyi mi 'dug zer ba'i skad cha de'i mthil yang yongs su rdol gyi red ces gros 'go bton par li'u kru'u ren gyis khyod tsho'i gros 'go de gzhi rgya che ba dang don snying ldan pa zhig yin pa smos ci dgos/ 'on kyang da lta'i gnas skabs la nga tshos gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun dang mi 'gal ba dang / gtso bo bod kyi mtho rim mi sna'i go rtogs sad rgyur ngang sgug byed dgos pa de tang krung dbyang gi dgongs don yin pas gong gsal don/ gnad de lag bstar mi byed pa ma zad/ de skor skad cha tsam yang phyir mi gyar ba byed dgos pa'i slob gso nan tan gnang byung / de rjes lha sa yan lag kung ud kyi ca hru'u cis kyang las ka gang ci don tshan bcicu bdun las mi 'gal ba byed dgos gsungs pa ltar de dag cam bzhag byas pa yin/ spyi lo 1956lo'i lo mjug tu rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi yig cha'i dgongs don/ tshal bde mnga' khul gzhung sger chos gsum gyi gzhis ka dang / mi ser gyi them grangs/ mi 'bor/ sa zhing rgya khyon/ son grangs/ thon skyed rgyu chas/ sgo phyugs che chung / khral bogs bun gsum gyi gnas tshul bcas tho 'god dang /tang gi mdzad phyogs srid jus dang sa zhing bcos sgyur gyi dge mtshan sogs 253

dril bsgrags slob sbyong dang gra sgrig gros bsdur gang zab byas thog mnga' khul gzhis rgan dang / mi ser spyi 'thus bcas tshogs 'dur skong nas khyab bsgrags byas pa dang / nga tsho bod rigs las byed pa rnams tshogs chung khag gnyis su bgos te grong gseb la bskyod rgyu gtan 'khel byas shing /dang thog nga tshos zhib bsher tho 'god bya rgyu der 'gog rkyen yong ba bzo che shos de tā la'i bla ma'i yab gzhis kyi zas zhim gzhis ka'i gzhis sdod rnying pa phun tshogs kyis mang tshogs khrod du ldog phyogs kyi skad cha mang po bshad yod pa dang / gzhis sdod las thog gis kyang de'i kha la nyan nas tho 'god bya rgyur 'gog rkyen yong bzor dmigs te thog mar zas zhim gzhis kar gcen po skal bzang shes rab dang tshogs chung gi mi kha shas bskyod de gzhis sdod spen lags zer ba der 'jam bshad blo 'gug byas pas tho 'god dril bsgrags byed thub pa byung zhing / de nas nga tshos gzhis ka mang che bar bskyod de byed sgo legs 'grub 'byung nye'i mtshams mtshur phu'i chos gzhis sna dkar du nga dang tshogs chung gi mi tsho 'byor skabs gzhis sdod des bla brang la dgongs skor zhu dgos zhes bshad pa dang / de 'phral nga tshos mi ser rnams skong ste dril bsgrags byas pa dang / de'i sang zhogs gzhis sdod de dang mnyam du mtshur phu dgon par bskyod skabs karma pa'i phyag mdzod des tho 'god bya rgyur mos mthun ma byas stabs de ga'i dgon zhol mi ser tshor dril bsgrags byas rjes nga tshos rdzong du phyir log byas pa yin/ 'on kyang mtshur phu'i chos gzhis sa khang mi gsum gyi yig cha gsar rnying cha tshang nga'i lag tu yod pa de tshor zhib 'jug gyis tho 'god byas pa yin/ skabs der lha sa yan lag kung ud nas gra ud kyi yig cha'i dgongs don de khul byed sgo'i skor gnas tshul snyan seng zhu bar yong dgos pa'i brda tho 'byor don ltar 254

li'u kru'u ren nged gnyis kyis ca hru'u cir nga tsho'i rdzong 'og de'i dgon pa che chung rnams phud pa'i mi 'bor zhib bsher sogs yig cha'i dgongs don legs grub zin pa'i gnas tshul snyanaseng zhus par/ ca hru'u cis rdzong 'og der gzhi rgya cung che ba'i las ka thengs dang po der grub 'bras gang 'tsham thob 'dug da dung dgon pa'i nang du mi grangs tho 'god byed stabs ma bde tshe gnas skabs ma byas na 'grig pa dang / zhib bsher zin pa rnams bsdoms rtsis brgyab ste gang mgyogs 'bul dgos pa'i bka' mngags gnang byung / de rjes spyi lo 1957lo'i lo 'gor tā la'i sku phreng bcu bzhi pa rgya gar nas bod du phyir phebs kyi lam bar rmang sa gnas su nyin gcig bzhugs song ba de nyin rtse phyag las khungs kyis nga la rdzong 'og 'di'i dgon pa ji yod la sku 'gyed gnang rgyu'i ched grwa btsun grangs 'bor chad lhag med pa'i tho len dgos pa'i bkod khyab byas pa ltar blangs pa'i tho de'i 'dra bshus shig don gcod khru'u la nyar pa yin/ de nas nga tshos tho 'god byas pari rnams bsdoms rtsis rgyag skabs mi 'bor chig khri lhag tsam dang / zhing kha son khal lnga khri lhag tsam 'dug pas cha snyom byas na mi rer sa zhing son khal lnga lhag tsamardzothob lugs sogs zhib bkod kyis lha sa yan lag kung ud la phul ba dang / 'dra ya don gcod khang du bzhag pa yin (rjes su dmangs gtso'i bcosartsosgyur skabs dpyad gzhir phan thogs byung yod skad )de rjes nga tsho'i gcen po mes rgyal nang khul du lta skor la thon pa dang / ring min rang skyong ljongs gra ud kyis krung dbyang gi bka' dgongs bod du 'di lo nas bzung lo drug ring sa zhing bcos sgyur mi byed pa'i khyab bsgrags gnang ba dang phyogasi mtshungs las khungs rnams khu bsdu byas te rgya rigs las byed pa mang che ba mes rgyal nang khul du rim bzhin phyir slog gnang skabs nga tsho'i 255

rdzong rim don gcod khang khu bsdu byas nas 'gan 'khur blo mthun tshud pa'i rgya rigs las byed pa lnga yod pa rnams kyang snga rting du phyir log bya rgyur gtan 'bebs gnang ba ma zad/ rdzong 'og de rang gi las bzo mi grangs nyi shu skor yod thog nas gcen po nga gnyis ma gtogs rang mos ltar rang khyim so sor phyir log byas pa red/las khungs khu bsdu byas rjes kyi gnas tshu' mdor bsdus/ skabs der lha sa nye 'khor gyi spyi tshogs thog rlung yan 'di 'dra zhig langs pa ste/ gsar brjer mi dga' ba'i mi khag gcig gis bod du sa zhing bcos sgyur bya rgyu ni lo drug gi rjes su'ang byed mi thub pa'i ngos 'dzin byed pa dang 'brel las byed par zhugs pa yin zer mkhan mi de tsho deng sang khyi rgan gling lag tu lus pa ltar ci bya gtol bral gyis pha ri'i lci ba med la tshur ri'i slel po yang med pa chags pa red/ da ni ma 'dod tshad pa tsha yang nyi ma bsro dgos shar song zer ba sogs khrel dgod dang zur za mang po byed cing / lhag par nga tsho'i khyim tshang ni 'phya dmod byed yul gtso'i bo gras shig tu gyur pa dang / skabs der nga tsho'i gcen po yang mes rgyal nang sar lta skor du bskyod pa nas phyir 'khor med stabs gcung po nga tsho gros bsdur gyis 'tsho thabs rnying pa slar gso bya rgyu'i mthun rkyen yod kyang rjes su gcen pos mos mthun gnang mi srid pa ma zad/ phugs mdun la bltas na yang dgos med yin pa'i ngos dzin byas te nga tsho'i don gcod khru'u yi 'go khrid blo 256

mthun li'u kru'u ren brgyud lha sa yan lag kung ud la nga dang nga'i gcung po gnyis mes rgyal nang sar slob sbyong du phyin chog pa'i re 'dun zhus pa yin/de nas nyin shas rjes lha sa yan lag kung ud du yong dgos pa'i brda lan 'byor don ltar 'gro skabs ca hru'u cis gsungs don/ khyod tsho gnas skabs sdod bzod mi bde ba'i gnas tshul byung ba nga tshos gsal po rtogs pa ma zad/ khyed tshos tang dang mi dmangs la yid ches byed kyi yod pa'ang gsal rtogs la brten khyod tsho'i re 'dun der bod las don u yon lhan khang nas yongs su mos mthun gnang ste zhib phra'i las don 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yis gnang gi red ces gsungs 'phral 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u la 'gro skabs li'i khru'u krang gis ched mngags dus tshod zur 'then lhod mjal gyis gsung don/ deng skabs bod du tang gi mdzad phyogs ni yar thon la brten rgyu de gtso bo yin pas khyod rang dang gcung po a nan gnyis pe cin mi rigs dpe skrun khang du las spo bya rgyu dang / nang mi bu phrug dang bcas pa gnas spo chog pa'i gtan 'khel gnang zhing / de nas ring min nga dang gcung po/ nga'i batshoza' zla dang / bu mo chung chung gnyis dang bu rdzi bu mo gcig bcas nga tsho mi drug spyi lo 1957lo'i ston kha lha sa nas thon te pe cin du 'byor skabs mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis sne len dang / las ka 'os 'tsham bkod sgrig gnang nas lo bzhi bsdad pa dang rjes su spyi lo 1961lor gong rim rtsa 'dzugs kyi bka' 'brel ltar lha sar las spos byas pa yin/ skabs der rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi rig gnas khru'u la las bgos gnang ba bzhin slob chung slob deb rtsom sgyur gyi las ka byas pa dang / de nas tshan se hrer zla shas sdod ring bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bod kyi zhing 'brog mang tshogs la khral 'ul skul rgyugs skor 257

gyi rtsom yig bris pa dang / de nas ljongs yig tshags khang du las ka byas shing / spyi lo 1kha65lor rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs zhol grong lhan du lo lnga bsdad rjes spyi lo 1970lo'i zla 7par gong rim gyis 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi khongs mi tshang ma rub bsdus gnang ba'i srid gros slob sbyong 'dzin grwar bsdad rjes yang skyar yig tshags khang du las ka byas pa dang de rjes spyi lo 19rdo4lor bod ljongs srid gros su lo rgyus rig gnas rtsom 'bri u yon lhan khang la las ka byas rjes srid gros rgyun las u yon du bsko bzhag gnang nas srid gros zhing 'brog u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa'i las 'gan 'khur mus bcas so /258

rtse rig gnas slob grwa chen mo'i skor/rnam rgyal sgrol dkar gyis/de snga'i bod sa gnas srid— gzhung gi dpon rigs ser mo ba rnams shes yon ldan pa yong phyir tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho nas rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu sprel (1752)lor rtse rig gnas slob grwa chen mo gsar 'dzugs gnang ba/ de'i gnas yul ni rtse pho brang po ta la'i gzhung sgo phun tshogs 'du lam brgyud gzhung sgo bar ma'i yang steng rab gsal gsum brtsegs kyi thog rtsegs bar mar yin zhing / slob khang gi rgya khyon ka ba brgyad dang / gnyer tshang ka gcig thab tshang ka gcig lcam gang ma/me shing 'jug yul ka gnyis tsam bcas 'brel mtshungs su mchis/ slob phrug sdod sa gral bzhi dang gral lhag gcig yod cing / gral gnyis pa'i gral 'gor slob grwa thog mar gsar 'dzugs kyi mdzad sgo'i skabs tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho dbu— bzhugs kyis gos bris bca' yig che mo tham 'byar ma gnang bsatshogral gnyis pa der bskal bzang gral yang zer/ slob phrug gsar zhugs dang slob grwa thon nas legs 'bul thon ja gtong skabs rten 'brel legs khyad slob phrug de gral gnyis pa de'i gral 'gor sdod du 'jug srol 'dug 259

rtse rig gnas slob grwa'i slob ma'i bsdu khongs ni ser 'bras dga' gsum dang / rme ru/ bzhi sde/ lho kha rtse thang rtse tshogs pa/ ri'u chos gling / 'phyongs rgyas ri'u bde chen dgon bcas so so grwa tshang che chung la gzhigs nas mi grangs gcig nas gsum bar grwa chag brgyab ste bsdu zhing /slob phrug de'i gras la ‘‘gzhung pa ’’zhes zer ba dang / yang gzhung zhabs rtse drung gi shag tshang dang / sde dpon mi drag sger pa/ zhing 'brog tshong rigs sogs kyi bu phrug dang blangs kyis slob grwa der zhugs mkhan yod na sngon la gong gsal dgon pa gang rung zhig la sgrig zhugs dang 'brel rtse yig tshang las khungs su snyan seng zhus te chog mchan thob mtshams slob grwar zhugs chog pa slob phrug de'i gras la ‘‘sger pa ’’zhes zer/ gong gsal grwa chag brgyab ste bsdus pa'i slob grwa ba rnams dus gcig la gsar zhugs byed cing /slob zhugs gtong sgo ja mar dang / yig chas sbyang shing sogs rtse yig tshang las khungs nas ngos sbyor dang sbrags rtse phral sde las khungs nas gtong srol dang / rang sger so sos slob grwa'i nang yod pa'i rten gtso tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa'i sku brnyan dang / bstan srung dpal ldan lha mo'i zhal thang sbug tham 'byar ma gnyis so sor mchod me dang snyan shal a she re/ yig gzugs slob mkhan rtse mkhan drung gi ngo tshab dge rgan che mo rtse drung zhig dang lho kha smin grol gling dgon pa nas phebs pa'i rig gnas dge rgan gnyis la mjal dar a she re dang / legs 'bul bod dngul srang gsum nas bzhi re tshad las mi brgal ba re 'bul dgos pa rnams dang / rgyun spyod thig rkyal dang snyug ril/ lteb gri/ tshig snag bcas gtong dgos/ yang dang blangs ‘‘sger pa ’’rnams slob grwar gsar zhugs skabs shag tshang dang khyim tshang 'byor ba che chung la gzhigs nas ja mar gtong sgo dang / slob 260

grwa'i rten gtsor mchod sprin/ dge rgan gnyis dang / rgan bdagaganyer pa/ spyi mi/ ma byan/ chu ma/ lag g.yog gad pa bcas la kha btags dang / dngul bcas sprod dgos pa ma zad slob grwar gsar zhugs dang thon pa bcas kyi skabs su spyi 'jog 'bul ba'ang rgyag dgos/slob grwa ba'i rgyun gtan 'tsho ba'i thad de snga lo mang ring sngar lam gzhir bzung lha sa gnyer tshang dang shing gnyer sogs dpal 'byor bsdu gtong do dam las khungs khag nas slob phrug gi 'tsho ba'i 'gro gron ldeng nges mngon dog gtong srol yod tshod kyang dus phyis zla re'i phogs thob mar dang tshwa phran bu tsam las de min rtsam dod dang shing dod skal bzang thang gzhir brtsis te zla re mi rer rtsam dod dngul zho gang skar lnga re dang / shing dod zho gang skar lnga re dngul bsgyur gyis sprod srol chags shing / phyis za dngos rin gong rim 'phar la brten gong gsal dngul dod kyis 'tsho thabs bral gshis so so'i dgon pa khag gi lo 'khor 'gyed phogs thog rang gi shag tshang dang / khyim tshang nas nar gtong byed dgos kyi 'dugaslob grwa ba'i lo tshad ni rang lo ṭ+wāṃnas 16bar yin pa dang / phra rgyas bzang zhing / gzugs byad legs po dgos pas rtse yib/ tshang las khungs su mi babs spyan zhu dang sprags 'os dang gnyis mi gnyis re 'char gzhi phul bar tā la'i bla ma ngo ma'i phyag rtags zhus thob dgos kyi 'dug slob sbyong gi byed sgo ni/ lo gnyis gsum tsam ring sbyang shing kho na'i thog ka kha dang zlos hral/ tshugs ring / tshugs thung bcas sbyang rgyu dang de nas rim pas sbyang 'bras lngegs nyes la gzhigs te shog bu'i thog tshugs thung dang tshugasalo khyug bar yig gzugs sbyong dgos pa ma zad gzhan yang lañtsa dang wa rtu/hor yig bcas dang / chag lo dang 'gos lo'i yig gsar sogs kyang slob 261

cing / bod zla re'i tshes 14dang / tshes 2khaso sor rtse yig tshang 'gag tu mkhan drung ngo mas zhib bsher gyis gnas tshad mtho dman gyi ming sbyar yig tshad la ang ki bkod nas rim pa sgrig thog sbyang 'bras gnyis pa nas drug pa'i bar la yis/ tshang gnyer pa ngo mas smyug gshag re gzhu srol mchis/tshes 15dang 20so sor gung seng gtong zhing / rgyun ldan nyin rer yig grangs 20ma lon na rgan bdag nas ming tho'i thog snga dgong zhib bsher gyis ma lon pa rnams la nyen brda gtong ba'am smyug gshag gzhu ba sogs nyes chad sne sel gcod pa/ snga dgong du 〈〈skyabs 'gro 〉〉dang 〈dga' ldan lha brgya ma/〉 〈gang blo ma/〉 〈shes rab snying po/〉 〈sgrol ma 'khor bcas/〉 〈〈rgyal ba'i zhabs brtan 〉srung ma dmar nag gi gtor 'bul/ gser skyems/〈skabs gsum ma/〉 〈rab yangs shes bya/〉 〈mtshan dpe'i mdzes sdug 〉 〈chu 'dzin dkar po 〉 〈dkar rtsis/〉 〈lnga pa phrod/〉 sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i rtsa ba/ 〈legs bshad ljon dbang /〉 dag yig 〈ngag sgrol 〉rtsa 'grel bcas tshigs rkang rtags bkod kyis blo 'dzin byas rjes dge rgan smin gling slob dpon nam/ rgan bdag rgan tshab skabs gang 'khel la dgong dro dpe khrid dang zhogs pa rgyugs sprod chag med byed dgos pa dang /snga dro chu tshod 5par skyor rta 'go tshugs te nyi ma/ ma shar tsam la grol rjes gral gnas dang gnyis go rim sgrig nas slob khang gtsang sbra rdog phyis rgyag dgos/de nas lam seng yar 'tshogs te dpe cha blo 'dzin skyor sbyang byed pa dang sbrags rim bzhin dpe rgyugs sprod dgos/ de nas gad res kyis zhogs ja gotong rgyu'i bskul brda gtong ba dang / nyin re'i snga dro'i skyor rtar phyi 'byor byas rigs rang 'gul gyis rgan bdag sar ngos len byed pa dang chabs cig phyi 'byor gyi dus tshod ring thung la gzhigs te smyug gshag gzhu ba 262

dang / nyi ma shar 'phral yig gzugs sbyong 'go 'tshugs te nyin dgung chu tshod 10pa'i thog de'i nyin gyi gad res des dge rgan gnyis la nyin dgung btang chog pa'i snyan seng dang 'brel snga dro'i yig phreng zhib bsher byed dgos shing / dge rgan gnyis ka bzhugs med na rgan bdag nas zhib bsher thag gcod byed dgos/ nyin dgung chu tshod 12par slob grwa tshugs te dgong dro'i chu tshod 6pa tsam la dge rgan nam dge rgan med tshe rgan bdag gang rung la nyin de'i sbyang 'bras spyan zhu dang sbrags dras bzed dras slog dang /sbyang tho zhes pa'i nag spang thog rang ming steng angabyugrangs 'god dgos/sbyang 'bras spyan zhu byed skabs ka kha yin na sbyang shing gang dang / tshugs thung dang yig chung yig phreng bzhi yan/ shog thog rnams shog bu'i phyed ma gang pa bcas yin na spyan zhur 'gro mi chog de nas yig ge 'bri mtshams bzhag nas de'i dbar du dus tshod phran bu zhig yod pa de'i ring dpe khrid dang / dpe sbyong / klog sbyong sogs byed dgos/ phyi dro'i chu tshod 〈tsam nas 10dang phyed ka tsam bar skyor rta tshugs dgos pa bcas nyin gcig ring gi slob grwa'i byed sgo rnams zin nas shag tu log chog rnam kun slob grwa'i g.yas g.yon mi gzhan gyi nang du 'gro dgos yod tshe 'gro dgos don dang bcas rgan bdag la snyan seng zhus te chog mchan thob mtshams 'gro chog pa las/ de min rang mtshams 'gro bskyod byas tshe gom pa rer rta lcag bcu re'i nyes chad gcod rgyu'i gtan 'bebs bzos yod/ de bzhin slob grwa tshugs ring snga dgong chab gsang thengasatsho2re gtong ba las gang byung 'gro mi chog slob grwa ba'i gyon chas rgyun gtan snam bu spu phrug dmar po'i phyu chen 'jol la zur bde bsdu ba las rkub sul bsdu mi chog pa dang / phu thung 263

brdzes mi chog lham zon pa'am/ shul rtse gang rung gyon pa las jur rta gyon mi chog phyi la 'gro bskyod skabs snyug khrog 'dogs dgos pa dang /dus chen skabs go snam rgya rmug gi phyu pa gyon te rgya gri phor shubs 'dogs srol yod/lo gcig nang srid gzhung gi mdzad sgo che khar 'gro dgos la/ rtse slob grwa ba rnams la lo re twa la'i bla ma'i dbyar mjal dang dgun mjal thengs gnyis re gnang srol yang yod cing / dgun mjal ni lo re'i bod zla 10tshes 25nyin rtse pho brang du gnang ba de'i nyin slob grwa ba rer gsol ras gos rgyu snam bu spu phrug dmar po spus legs bub re dang / zhwa mo dang ska rags kyi dod dngul ṭam brgyad re yod pa'i shog chag dmar dam sbyar ma re gnang gi yod/ dbyar mjal ni bod zla 5pa'i tshes 15tsam la nor gling du gnang ba dang chabs cig 'char can lo re'i yig tshad che mo yin pas de'i nyin tā la'i bla ma sku ngo mas yig tshad la zhib bsher ang ki bskyon pa'i ming tho'i shog lhe drung ja'i skabs drung yig che mo bzhi'i sar klog rjes mjal kha dang 'brel gnang skyes mjal dar a she dang / gos rgyu snam bub/ zhwa sked dod dngul/ phebs sgo gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang bcas gnang srol mchis/ slob grwa der lo gcig nang spro skyid che chung 'ga' zhig gtong ba/de yang ‘‘chu khas ’’zhes bod zla 2pa'i nang skyor sbyang dang sbrags nyin gcig dang / bod zla 5pa'i nang ‘‘spro chen ’’zhes gling kha nyin bdun/ bod zla 11par dgun skyid ces brtse pho brang nang du nyin lnga gtong ba/ pho brang po ta la'i nang spro skyid gtong ba de rtse slob grwa bar dmigs bsal gyi gzigs skyong zhig yin zhing / gong ga sal spro skyid khag la ja srub ma nyin 'khyongs dang / zhogs pa spag dang tshal tsha grang sne kha drug tsam tsha ting du 'bras 264 ci

bsil shing 'bras sres pa skyog re/ nyin dgung rgya thug dang tha zhib thog tshal sne kha bzhi/ dgong dro drug sder bzhi'i thog mog mog dang 'bras gang mos/ zhogs pa snga po dang mtshan mo 'char can thug pa 'jam thugathugs spro'i ring dge rgan gnyis phebs na gur zur du brgyab yod pas der gdan zhus kyis gsol stono leg4'bul zhu srol dang / gal te ma phebs tshe bzhugs shag so sor sku skal 'bul srol yod/ rnam kun slob grwa'i gtong sgo zhu yul las khungs khag la thugs rje legs 'bul tsho na byed gnyer pa ngo skyod kyis gsol tshigs dus re 'bul dgos pa der mjal slog ces dngos skyes rtsorgya mi chung ba re ster layoyod/ gong gsal spro skyid khag gi 'gro gron thadadzirtse yig tshag las khungs kyi ngos sbyor dang sbrags 'brel yod khungs khag nasastsod pa phud/ dus skabs gong ma'i gling kha'i lhag ma ja mar dang / 'bru snum/ tsha 'bul bcasabatsong rin dang /slob grwa'i lha mo'i skyem yon dang snyan shal gtsong rin/ de min spyi dngul bcas nas gtong gi yod/ spro skyid gtong ring snga dgong gtor 'bul gser skyems chags med thog de'i ring rgan gzhon go bab mi 'dzol ba'i thog rtsed mo'i rnam grangs a cug dang / 'bog li/ lha mo 'khrab pa/ sgrung shod pa/ sgrung glu len pa bcas byed kyi yod kyang rgyan 'dzugs sho sbag rigs gtan nas mi chogalo ltar bod zla dang po'i tshes 2nyin rgyal po lo gsar gyi mdzad chen dang / bod zla gsum pa'i tshes ṭ+wāṃnyin brgyad gtor mdzad sgo/ bod zla bcu pa'i tshes 25nyin lnga mchod kyi mdzad chen bcas mdzad chen de gsum so sor rtse drung gsum re tsam dang / drung 'khor gsum re tsam gsar bsko byed kyi yod cing / rtse drung gsar pa'i yong khungs ni rtse slob grwa'i khongs 265

nas yig tshang las khungs su yig tshad phul snga rting gi rim pa bzhin 'gro gi yod pa de nas bzung gzhung gi dpon rigs kyi khongs dngos su tshud/ sngar rtse drung ni rtse slob grwa kho na brgyud de 'gro dgos kyi yod kyang / dus phyis rim bzhin rtse drung gi shag tshang dang / sger pa khag gi bu phrug bcas gong gsal dgon sde khag la sgrig zhugs kyis thad kar yig tshang las khungs su zhabs sdod snyan dar phul te rtse drung zhus chog pa'i lam srol chags stabs shag tshang dang yang na khyim tshang 'byor pa che ba'i bu phrug la stabs bde byung ba dang /rtse slob grwa'i khongs nas rtse drung du 'gro ba'i sngar srol la 'gyur ba byung stabs slob grwa thon rgyur shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs te slob thon zhabs zhu'i dus tshod slebs kyang yun ring slob grwar sdod dgos pa'i gnas tshul rim pa thon pa dang chabs cig slob grwa de'i slob phrug gi sbyang 'bras dang sgrig lam sogs gang cir nyams chag che tsam song yod pa bcas/ /266

lha sa grong khyer nang de snga sger btsugs slob grwa khag 'ga' zhig yod pa'i nang tshan ‘‘tar khang ’’slob grwa'i lo rgyus mdon bsdus/dge rgyas pa bstan 'dzin rdo rjes/tar khang slob grwa zhes pa ni de snga rtse drung rong dpal lhun thub bstan bsam 'phel lam/ chos ldan bstan dar zhes bgyi ba khong sger gyis ske btsugs pa'i bod yig slob grwa zhig yin zhing / rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcags sprel (192rkya)lo tsam la lha sa bstan rgyas gling gi mdun phyogs su tar 'phrin dang / yig zam gtong yul las khungs shig gsar 'dzugs bgyis pa'i khang khungs nang slob grwa tshugs stabs yotar khang nyastaslob grwa zhes ming thogs/ gus rang yang slob grwar der lo ngo bzhi ring bod yig slob sbyong du bskyod cing / skabs der slob phrug brgyad cu skor yod kyang de rjes rim 'phar gyis brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod/ 'dir thog mar rgan lags dam pa'i lo rgyus ragasatsam smos na/gang de'i 'khungs yul ni lha sa'i byang phyogs lcags grong khul nas yin pa 267

dang / chung dus rtse slob grwar zhugs pa gnang ste/ ka kha dang zlos hral/tshugs ring / tshugs chung / yig chung / tshugs ma khyug khyug yig bcas bod yig dbu med kyi yig gzugs che chung tshang ma gzhung ris kyi 'bri srol ltar byang chub par mkhyen pas/ yig gzugs legs par gzhan gyis do zla med pa'i tshad du byed pa ma zad/ lañtsha dang war rtu/ hor yiga'agos lo yig gsar sogs kyang mkhyen gyi yod la/ dag yig dang / snyan sum sogs bod kyi brda sprod rig pa gang cir mkhyen rgya che ba zhig yin/rgan lags 'di nyid rtse slob grwa thon te zhabs zhu rtse drung gnang rjes rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing yos (1kha15)lo tsam la de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas rgya gar khul tar 'phrin slob sbyong du mngags gtong bgyis don/dbyin ji'i skad yig dang / tar 'phrin gtong ba'i shes bya legs par bslabs shes kyis phyir 'khor mtshams gong gsal lha sar tar gtong las khungs btsugs pa'i las 'gan bzhes shing / las sbrel bde ba shar sras sku zhabs zer ba zhig kyang yod/ tar gtong gi phyag las gnang mur snga rting thog lha sa gnyer tshang pa dang / bla phyag gi las 'gan gcig lcogs gnang /rab byung bcu drug pa'i me phag (1947)lo dza sag gi go ming thog mkhe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus dang mnyam du nan cin du ri 'gog dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob par rten 'brel zhu bar phebs/ sa glang (1949)lo bkras lhun skyabs dbying dza sag bla ma'i las 'gan lo shas bcas gnang /‘‘tar khang ’’slob grwa'i tshugs grol dang slob khrid/ sgrig lam sogs byed sgo tshang ma rtse slob grwa ba ji lta ba slob grwar thog mar zhugs skabs lo tshad rgan gzhon gyi tshad bkag med kyang / spyir btang rang lo bcu nas bcu drug (nyi shur lon pa yang re zung yod )man yin zhing / rgan lags su slob 268

grwar zhugs rgyu'i skyabs 'jug zhus te zhal bzhes thob rjes snam thig dkar po'am/ snam dkar po'i gdan sgor dang / byang shing / thig rkyal/'tshigs snag snyug ril sogs yig chas gra sgrig legs par byas te tshes cha bzang ba stabs bstun gyis slob grwar zhugs nyin rgan lags su mjal dar dang rten 'brel 'bul mtshon dngos rigs gang 'os dang / slob phrug byings la slo'adzul ja ’’zhes ja dang 'bras bsil/ 'gyed bcas gtong dgos la/ de nyin slob phrug byings rnams dgung seng du dgongs zhus kyis rgan lags kyi bka' 'khrol mtshams log chogarnam kun slob grwa tshugs grol sogs sgrig lam byed sgo'i thad/ zhogs pa nam ma lang gong slob grwar 'byor ba dgos pa dang / phyi 'byor rjes lus thebs na slug gshag gnyis gsum yan bzed dgos/ snga dro'i chu tshod brgyad par zhogs ja dang / nyin dgung chu tshod bcu gnyis thog dang /dgong mo sa srib chu tshod bcu pa tsam la slob grwa grol ba/ zla re tshes 14dang 29so sor yigatshad thengs re btang ste tshes 15dang 20so sor dgung seng 'jog gi yod/ yig tshad gtong skabs shog thog 'bri mkhan dang / byang shing thog tshugs chung / tshugs ring / zlos hral/ ka kha bcas 'bri mkhan rnams sde tshan so so'i yig tshad ang gnas mtho dma' gzhir bzung ang ki dang po nas mjug bar bkod thog ang rim bzhin rim pas snyug gshag re gzhus te ang ki rkub tu'i des mar khog la snyug gshag gzhu skabs tshang mas gad mo god cing ngo tsha slong srol mchis/ nyin re gdi res mi gnyis res gad phyis thengs gsum dang bya shing 'khru byed kyi chu len dgos pa/slob grwa tshugs skabs skad cor brgyab mi chog pa/ chudang 'tshigs snag 'pho mi chog pa dang / byang shing g.yugs mi chog pa sogs de dag las 'gal na 269

snyug gshag bzed dgos/ slob grwa'i nang sgrig khrims srung dgos tshang ma rgan lags bzhugs min dbar rgan bdag zhes slob phrug yi ge legs pa dang spyod lam bzang ba zhig bskos yod pas des nyin re ‘‘sbyang tho ’’zhes slob phrug tshang ma'i ming tho byang shing thog bkod pa'i gsham du yig phreng ga tshod bris min ang grangs bkod de yig phreng grangs tshad ma lon na snyug gshag bzed dgos/ rgyun du yig phreng mi long mkhan dang / sgrig khrims zhan pa/yig gzugs drag tu mi 'gro ba'i rigs dang / slob byol 'gro mkhan sogs kyi slob phrug rnams skabs re ka bar btags te rta lcag gzhu ba dang / yang na zhal ba'i thog bsnyal te mgo rkang mis bzung bkyig gis rgan lags dang slob phrug rgan pa gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon nas rta lcag re mos kyis gzhu gi yod pas 'jigs dngangs mi bzod pa'i ngu sgras khengs stabs bde ba shar mi rje dang / bka' chen gsal zhu ba sogs khyim mtshes tsho zhu ngor yang yang phebs te phan grogs mdzad dgos kyi yod pa sogs mdor na tar khang slob grwa ni sgrig khrims dam la dge rgan tsha gcun che ba'i tshad du byed kyi yod/de bzhin slob khrid byed srol thad/ zhogs pa nam ma langs gong slob grwar 'byor pa nas nam ma gsal bar 〈〈skyabs 'gro 〉dang / 〈dga' ldan lha rgyal/〉 〈dbyang can ma'i bstod pa/〉 〈gang blo ma 〉sogs ngag 'don byed dgos pa dang / nyi ma shar ma thag yi ge sbyor klog dang bsdus klog sogs klog dgos/ klog la byang chub pa rnams kyis 〈das/ yig ngag sgron 〉dang /〈byis pa dag yig〉 〈sum rtags/〉 〈sa mtha'i rnam bzhag 〉dgu zla cha phran sogs blo 'dzin rgyugs sprod byed dgos/ slob phrug gsar pa rnams 'bri klog cung mkhas pa'i slob rnying rer slob phrug gsum bzhi re rtsis sprad de dbu can dbu med gnyis ka'i yi ge klog stangs slob tu bcug thog klog rgyug len 27/)

skabs sgra dag gsal gsum gyi klog rgyugs 'phrod na gzhi nas dpe cha blo 'dzin byas chog yig gzugs sbyong 'bri'i rim pa ni ka kha nas khyug yig bar yin zhing / rang rang gi sbyong tshan rnams kyi yig dpe mang che ba rgan lags kyi phyag bstar ma yin pa de dag bltas ——te yig gzugs sbyong 'bri byas pa rnams rgan lags bzhugs yod na rgarne lags su spyan 'bul zhu dgos pa dang de min rgan bdag la bstan dgos/ yig gzugs ma 'grig pa rnams la dras bskyon gyi yod pa de dag thengs mang bskyar 'bri byed dgos/ nyin re ma thar yig phreng nyi shu skor 'bri dgos pa dang / thog mar ka kha gzugs yag po byung na zlos hral la phab cing / de nas rim bzhin tshugs thung /tshugs chung / tshugs ma khyug bcas la rim pas phab kyi yod/ de'ang rtse slob grwa'i srol ltar tshugs thung dang / tshugs chung / tshugs ma khyug bcas kyi 'bri stangs la dang zhen gtso bo byed pa las khyug yig gi 'bri stangs dmigs bsal gyi slob khrid bya srol med cing / che 'og chung thon zhes khyug yig ni rang bzhin gyis shes par 'dod/ yi ge'i brda dag skor la dag yig ngag sgron dang / rdel rtsis sogs rgan lags nas slob khrid phran bu gnang ba las de min rig gnas gzhan dag dge rgan zur du bsten sbyong byed dgos/ ‘‘tar khang ’’slob grwa'i rgan lags kyis dbyin yig mkhyen gyi yod pas/ lung shar byang chub dang / rma bya ba bsod dbang sogs la dbyin ji'i skad yig kyang slob khrid gnang ba mthong myong / de ltar slob grwa der lo bzhi lnga'i slob yun spyad de slob grwa thon mtshams rgan lags su thugs rje che zhu ba dang / slob phrug byings la thon ja zhes ja 'bras gtong dgos kyi yod pa las slob zhugs ring slob yon sogs 'gro gron gtong mi dgos par drag zhan su rung gi bu phrug slob zhugs chog pa bcas so/ / 271
la'u rwa thab ba ba ra

sngon ma khal gsol mkhan chung ngag dbang—chos grags dang / —rtse gnyer 'jam dpal chos 'byor gnyis rgya sog g.yul grur las don byas rjes che bas shag tshang rtse drung zhubs zhu dgos shing / phru gu zhabs dmigs 'pher ba mi ming lo grangs 'bul dgos ’’zhes bka' phab 'dug skabs der lha'u rta rwartebar phru gu med pasasto‘zhabs sdod zhu dmigs phru gu med ’’ces yig tshang brgyud snyan gseng zhus 'dug kyang slar yang yig tshang brgyud 4lha'u rta rwa bar bu med na/ spun mched bu yong rgyur zhabs sdod med na gzhung gi mtshan shas 'gro bas spun mched phru bu zhig gi mi ming lo grangs 'bul dgos ’’zhes bka' phabayar slong tsho'i bu mo byams pa chos 'dzoms pha lha'i g.yog donacegrub dbang rgyal la mna'aglur ster bar bu gnyis yod rung / dpon khungs pha lha bas khros phrol btang e yong / de min spun mched phru gu 'os babs yod pa med ’’ces zhus 'dug par 4pha lha tshong khang gi bu gnyis mi ming lo grangs 'bul dgos/ dpon khungs pha lhar 'di nas bka' khyab gnang chog ’’ces yang bskyarawāka' phab pas nga rang tshe ring dbang phyug dang / lo na brgyad la son pa'i gcung po dga' ldan phun tshogs gnyis kyi ming tho dang /nga rang slob grwar yig tshad btang ba'i yi ge bcas rtse yig tshang brgyud phul 'dug par ‘‘bu rgan pa tshe ring dbang phyug las skal 'phrod lam bzang bas dga' ldan khri zur byam4pa chos grags sar skra phud phul te ming bsgyur gyis gnangs nyin bka' bsgyur zhu bar bcar dgos ’’zhes bka' phab stabs skyed byed dang / lha'u rta rwa'i zhang zhang pha lhar bskyod de gong gsal rgyu rkyen zhib mol dang 'brel chos phrol yod pa zhus par pha lha mkhan ches 4ngo mas gzhung zhabs zhu ba las/ g.yog pos gzhung zhabs byed srol med kyang /gong sa mchog nas 'di gar phyag sam phebs byung bas zhabs sdod zhus chog ’’273

ces bshad 'dug pas pha lha tshong khang nas nga rang lha'u rta rwa'i bu tshab la slong ster gis dgong dro dga' ldan khri zur byams pa chos grags drung du skra phud phul/ ming blo bzang bstan 'dzin zhes btags/ de'i phyi nyin rtse gzim 'gag tu bka' bsgyur zhu bskyod skabs shag tshang sngon ma gnyis kyi byas rjes su mdzad chen stabs bstun ma dgos par rtse drung zhabs sdod zhu dgos pa'i bka' bsgyur btang byung /lcags bya (1921)lo'i zla 2 pa'i tshes 12nyin rtse drung zhabs sdod zhus pa yin/ chu phag (1922)lo rang lo bcu drug nas yig tshang gi las bya lo dgu tsam byas/ rang lo bcu bdun la tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i drung nas dge tshul sdom pa zhus pas ming thub bstan bstan dar zhes 'dogs pa gnang / 'bras ljongs bla ma u rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi drung nas sum rtags dang snyan ngag le'u gsum slob sbyong phran tsam byas/ de rjes yig tshang gnyer tshab tu'ang bsko bzhag byas byung / yig tshang las bya'i skabs mal 'gro gyang grong gzhis sdod bsko gzhag byung ba bogs mar btang / rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu sprel (1922)lo rang lo nyi shu rtsa lnga lor rtse gnyer las tshan dang / gun mthud spa ra gzhis sdod sprad byung / shing phag (1925)lo nas me glang bar spo sdod rdzong dpon lo bzhi byas/ sa stag (1rdzo2〈) lo nas (1kha45) lo'i bar rtse mgron lo brgyad byas pa de'i ring snga rting du 'bab zhib do dam pa dang / lcang gseb shar du yab gzhis stag 'tsher ma khang gsar rgyag gi ar po'i do dam pa/ lam zhib do dam pa/stod lung mtshur phu'i 'byed zhib do dam pa bcas byas/ me khyi (1kha46)lo nas byang spyi mkhan chung lo bzhi byas/ lcags stag (1rdzi50) lo drung yig che mo dang / bod ljongs dmag spyi khang gi spyi 'doms/ gzhung rtsis 274

zhib khang do dam pa zhor lcogs bcas byed mur lo der tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa dang mnyam du gro mor phyin/ lcags yod (1951)lor hin rdu brgyud rgyal sa pe cin du bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros zhugs 'thus mi'i gras su bskyod de 〈gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun 〉la ming rtags 'god pa'i nang zhugs/ chu 'brug (1952) lor lha sa slob grwa chung ba ang dang po'i las 'gan 'khur mkhan gras byas/ shing rta ( 1954) lor rgyal rtser chu skyon byung khul du skyobs gso'i las don byed par bskyod/ me sprel ( 1956)lor bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang khongs dmangs srid kho'o yi kho'o krang dang / de lor dmangs srid khru'i khru'u krang gi las 'gan 'khur/ lo der gzhis rtser spyi khyab rim pa'i don gcod khang gsar 'dzugs la rten 'brel byed sgo'i rang skyong gra lhan gyi sku tshab tu bskyod/ lo der lha sa slob grwa 'bring ba'i zha'o krang gi las 'gan yang 'khur/me bya ( 1957)lor nang sog rang skyong ljongs btsugs nas lo bcu 'khor ba'i rten 'brel mdzad sgor zhugs par bskyod/sa khyi (195rdo)lor tā la'i sku phreng bcu bzhi pa se 'bras gnyis su dge bshes mtshan rtags len skabs phebs sgrig spyi khyab pa byas/sa phag ( 195rdzo) lor ngo log zing 'khrug nang zhugs te 'dzin bzung do dam khongs tshud nas bod dmag khul khang gi lta srung khang du lo bzhi bsgyur bkod byas/chu yos (1962)lor gu yang glod grol thob ste nyi gtad u yon lhan 275

khang khongs mu mthud slob sbyong dang bsgyur bkod byas bsdad/shing sbrul (1965)lor zing 'khrug gi zhwa mo 'bud sa/nang gis bod rang skyong ljongs srid gros kyi u yon du bkod sgrig thob/sa lug (1kha79)lor bod rigs spun zla phyi rgyal nas lta skor yong mkhan gyi sne len u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa dang bod rang skyong ljongs srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon par bsko gzhag gnang /chu khyi (19ṭ+wāṃ2)lor ljongs chos don cus kyi cus krang gcig lcogs bya rgyur bsko gzhag gnang ba bcas so/ /276

bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyi lo rgyus/don dbang bsod stobs kyis/ bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs ni rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa byi ( 1〈rdordo)lor sne gdong rdzong khongs yar klung pho brang khul du 'khrungs pa dang / shing sbrul ( 1905) lor gzhung zhabs rtse drung zhus/ de nas rim bzhin bsam yas rdzong sdod dang rtse mgron/ rtse phyag mkhan chung bcas gnang / rtse phyag gnang skabs rtse po ta la'i shar rgyud nyams gso'i do dam gyi phyag las gnang zhing / nyams gso zhu phyogs skor 'grig med pa'i kha 'dogs kyis rtse phyagamakhan chung nas rtse drung dkyus ma'i bar gnas dbyung btang ba dang / skabs der mi gzhan gyi lta snang mthong tshul du bstan pa 'jam dbyang ni kha snyan 'dra chags kyis bcos ma'i stabs bskrun mkhas pa byed mkhan zhig min gshis sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyi bshad tshad la dang len gnang mkhan zhig min la/ skabs 'gar da dung thad kar kha lan yang slog pa sogs kyis sku bcar kun 'phel lags kyi bsam blor phog thug 'gro gzhi'i gnas tshul yong gi yod rkyen skabs de'i ar po'i do dam pa gzhan la ma byung ba'i go gnas gnas dbyung tsam gyis mi tshad par 277

mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes btang ba sogs don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i khong la god chag byung lugs shod mkhan yang byung yod/ gang ltar khong la god chag de ltar byung stabs skabs shig ring khong 'tsho ba ngan ngon la brten nas bzhugs dgos byung bas nye ltos khag nas 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen thog rogs ram dang sbrags nye ltos 'ga' shas nas ‘‘gzhung drang gnang rgyu gtso bo min par de las gal che ba ni gnas yod mi sna'i 'dod pa bskong thabs kyi bstun mkhas gnang na phan thogs che ba yod lugs ri’sogs gsung mkhan byung yod na'ang / khong gis de la yid rangs gnang gi med cing ‘‘da lam gyi gnas tshul ni dngos 'brel gnas med mi re zung gi 'dod blo dang 'tshams min dbang gis byung ba zhig yin nges stabs rgyu rkyen de dag la brten nas gzhung don la blo log gi bsam pa bcangs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yang med lugs ’’gsungs te rang sger gyi khe nyen la ma ltos par lhag bsam gzhung drang gnang gi yod pa red/lcags lug ( 1921) lor khams phyogs mda' tshab gcig gi las byar rdog thon gnang ba dang / de rjes grwa bzhi dngul par las khungs kyi las bya gnang 'dug shing byi ( 1924) lor rtse drung dkyus ma'i thog nas gnas 'phar dmag spyi mkhan chung gi las 'gan bzhes/ de ni rtse drung gis dmag spyi byed mkhan dang po yin pa dang / de rjes mkhan drung dang dmag spyi gcig lcogs kyi las 'gan bzhes/ sa yos ( 1kha2kha) lor bka' blon bla ma chang khyim pa dgongs zhu gnang tshab tu rwa sgreng rgyal tshab skabs bka' blon bla ma'i go gnas bsko ga'ag gnang / skabs der bka' bla'i go gnas zhu 'tshangs byed mkhan mang dag cig yod 'dug kyang / rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po ches khong la phyag sam gnang don ‘‘khyod rang gi gzhung 278

zhen las ka'i 'jon thang la gzhigs nas da res bka' bla gsar pa'i 'os baglekhyod rang la yod pa dang bcas bsko gzhag bya rgyu yin ’’zhes phebs pa de ni stes dbang stabs legs kyis byung ba zhig las/ zhu rten sogs rgyu dngos kyi 'gro grom/ gang yang btang med cing / rnam kun rwa sgrong rin po cher dad gus tshad med thog dbu 'og dpung 'degs kyis bstan sridasnyekyi zhabs 'degs zhu bya gang la lhag bsam g.yo med gnang gi yod stabs rwa sgreng rin po ches kyang khong la mnyes po gnang gi yod pa dang / rwa sgrong rin po che srid skyong dgongs zhu mdzad rtsis skabs su'ang khong la nang ma'i gnas lugs — gsung skabs khong gis maṇ+ḍal rte gsum dang bcas ‘‘gnas skabs rwa sgreng dgon gnasasnyu besnyen mtshams su bzhugs rgyu gzhi rkang sku gegs kyi mtshan ma sel ched thugs gal che na'ang / srid skyong gi mdzad 'khur dgongs zhu gtan nas gnang thal medasapar sngar bzhin thugs 'gan skyed bzhes yong ba dang / re zhig bsnyen mtshams su bzhugs rgyun ring gzhung don gal che'i rigs skabs 'phral yig thog gi snyan zhu 'bul 'os sam/ yang na bka' blon su rung ched mngags snyan zhur bcar chog pas mtshams 'og tu 'jog gnangacamadzad na ma 'thudapa med pa dang / de min gzhung sger las don khag bka' shag nas thag gcod thub rigs the gu sne shor mi 'byung ba'i 'gan 'khur lhod med zhus chog pa ’’zhes nang ma'i gnas lugs zhus gnang yod 'dug kyang / rwa sgreng rin po ches srid skyong gi mdzad 'khur u tshugs mthar skyel gyis dgongs zhu gnang bar rten bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyang thugs pham chen po byub yod/ 'on kyang khong sku tshe'i 'phechu9pa ma rdzogs kyi bar du rwa sgreng bla bradzogi gang ci'i don gnad skor khongacel nang ma'i bka' 'drirtabaka' slob zhu yul byed kyi yod la bstan pa 'jam dbyang4kyis dmag 279

spyi che ba dang / bka' blon bla ma'i go gnas bzung yod pas khong 'tsho bzhugs kyi ring rwa sgreng rin po che bla brang dang bcas par gang phan ci phan gyis rogs phan yang gnang bar brten rwa sgreng rin po che dang khong gi bla grwa dang bcas par dmigs bsal god chag byung med/ shing sprel lor bstan pa 'jam dbyangs 'das myo/sa dus yun ring por ma song bar de'i phyi lo shing bya lo phan po lhun grub rdzong gi ngo tshab bsad pa'i don rkyen la brten nas rwa sgreng rin po che'i thob khungs ser byes grwa tshang la god chag byung ba dang / de rjes sa gnas srid gzhung gi gtso bo'i srid 'dzin mi sna bka' blon dang /drung rtsis sogs phal che ba srid skyong stag brag skabs bsko gzhag byas pa zhe gcig la brten rwa stag gnyis kyi 'gal ba dza drag tu song ste mthar rwa sgreng rgyal zur rin po che dang / ser byes grwa tshang bcas par god chag ci che byung bas rwa bla'i zhabs 'bring khongs nas 'ga' zhig gis ngos 'dzin la gal te bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs sku tshe rdzogs med pa yin na rwa blar de lta bu'i god chag yong gi med tshul shod mkhan yang byung yod pa go thos yong myong /bstan pa 'jam dbyangs ni bka' blon khri pa yin la/ 'jon thang dang / dbang shugs ldan la blo stobs kyang che tsam yod par brten khong 'tsho bzhugs skabs dngos shugs gang sar ngo dga' sprel lad 'khrab mkhan ji snyed cig yod rung / khong gi rang gshis ni mgo bde dran 'phrul dang dus skabs dang bstun nas g.yo thabs byed mkhan gyi rigs la yid ches dang dga' po mi byed mkhan zhig yin stabs mi nyung shas kyis rang don gyi dmigs yul ma 'grub pa'i dbang gis mi dga' ba byed mkhan yang yod srid na'ang / gang ltar khong gis dmag spyi che ba dang bka' blon bla ma'i las 280

'khur byed ring bod nang khul dus bde zhod 'jags kyi rnam pa yag po yod pa sogs kyis khong la gzhung zhabs sogs mang che bas spyi mos dang /gdeng 'jog chen po byed kyi yod/khong gi khyim tshang gi khang par dang thog dmigs bsal gyi ming med na'ang / rjes su sdod khang gsar rgyag skabs sger pa nang bzhin zhabs rten pha gzhis kyi ming 'dogs yas med kyang spun mched ba mo chang ba'i skyes ming ༄ ༄la don grub dbang mo zer gyi yod stabs de dag gi ming tshig bsdus nas don dbang zhes pa'i ming btags pa yin 'dug pa bcas so/ / ji 281

ru thog rdzong dpon gyi khral bsdu byed stangs dang /phyi phyogs tshong 'brel/ khrims srol bcas kyi skor/mnga' ris sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus 'tshol bsdu tshogs chung nas/rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang gis la dwags pa'i btsan 'dzul phyir ldog byas te la bod mdza' mthun chings yig bzhag rjes mnga' ris kyi rdzong khongs dang 'dra bar ru thog rdzong gi rdzong dpon la khral rigs bsdu rgyu'i sgrig gzhi dang / khrims srol cha tshang zhig yod pa ma zad/ ru thog mi dmangs la'ang la dwags dang / gar sha phu nu bcas dbar tshong 'brel byed lam byung yod/de yang ru thog rdzong dpon gyi khral rigs bsdu ba'i sgrig gzhi dang /khrims srol cha tshang zhig yod pa ni/do gal che dpon dang / tshong dpon bzhi/ 'go pa khag bcas brgyud phyi nang gi khral rigs bsdu len byed kyi yod/ khral bsdu ba'i tshad gzhi ni/ leb gzhung zhes bzos nas mi gcig dang / rta gcig282

g.yag gcig ra lug bcu/ sa zhing son bre bcu bcas rer g.yag mgo re rtsis pa/ g.yag mgo bcu rer leb re rtses nas khral rigs bsdu len byed kyi yod cing /khral gyi rnam grangs ni bal khral/ le na khral/ ra lug bcu rer ṭam dkar gcig re/ tshwa lug rgyab bcu re la ṭam dkar gcig re/ g.yag rer ṭam dkar gcig re/ phru gu re skyes dus byis par sman steranyazhes ṭam dkar gcig re dang / de bzhin rdzong dpon la gzhung lug ces phyi rgyal la tshwa tshongagatong rgyu'i khal lug lnga brgya lug phad rang 'grigs dang lug pa mi lnga bcas gtong dgos/ gus pa tsho nas rdzong dpon la dmigs bsal gyi mar khral 'jal dbos pa dang / g.yag pa mi hreng bzhi 'don dgos kyi yod/rdzong gi sku tshab khag bzhi la skya ser tsho pa lnga nas gur dang thab la gdan chas cha tshang sgrig dgos pa dang / sku tshagekhag nas sa srung 'gag sgo btsugs te sa cha gzhan gyi mang tshogs dang / phyi rgyal gyi tshong pa sogs kyi sa nas tshong khral bsdu yi yod pa ma zad/ ru thog rdzong khongs ma yin pa'i mang tshogs tshwa len sar yong mkhan gyi sa nas kyang rgyab tshwa/ rgyab lug brgya re nas lug phad gcig re bsdu yi yod/ phyi rgyal gyi tshong pa'i sa nas dngul lor phud/de min zog rigs dngos po mtha' dag la lnga bcu'i sa nas gcig khral la bsdu yi yod pa red/ de min khral rigs chung gras su gro ma'i khral/ sol ba'i khral/ bsangs kyi khral/ btsag gi khral/ dkar rag dang / sa nag khral/ bul tog khral/ phyag ma'i khral/ gser dpon la gser sogs mi nyung ba zhig sprod dgos pa ma zad/ mi yi rna cog la'ang khral bsdu myong 'dug pa bcas yin/de bzhin rdzong dpon dang bla phyag sku tshab khag nas ngo tshong yin zhes kha 283

btags dang ja sgam/ shog bu/ spos chag chang rtsi sogs dngos rigs sna tshosas la rin gong ldab kha shas spar te dbang bshed kyis 'bam tshong spus sgyur byed kyi yod la/ ming 'dra min sna tshogs thog nas nyes chad 'gel gyi yod pa red/bong gsal gyi khral bsdu rigs sna tshogs mi 'jal ba dang / phyir 'gyangs sogs byas mi chog pa ma zad/ rdzong 'og mi ser dang / dgon 'og mi ser bar la pho mo'i gnyen sgrig byed pa'i rang dbang med par phan tshun mna' ma dang / mag pa 'gro dgos na mi bdag la mi tshab sprod dgos shing / gal te mi tshab med par gnyen sgrig byas pa yin na rang khyim du yo da kyang dpon khungs so sor khral 'jal dgos pa ma zad/ phru gu skyes na'ang bu pha bdag dang / bu mo ma bdag zer nas pha tsha bu brgyud du dpon khungs so so'i mi rtsa bdag sprod byed kyi yod la/ lung pa phan tshun la spos sdod mi chog pa dang / lhag par du mnga' bdag dang / de'i rgyug khyi/ bod dmag sogs kyis bud med btsan g.yem dang / nyes rdung / tha na dmar gsod btang ba sogs kyang mang dag cig byung yod nga/ sogs mdor na rang lus la rang dbang gtan nas med pa red/phyi phyogs kyi tshong 'brel lam srol ni/ ru thog rdzong mi dmangs kyis la dwags dang / sa/ra sha/ khu nu bcas dang chong 'brel byas chog la/ de las gtso che ba la dwags yin pa/ 'ams gle dang / gu yul/ rub shos/chu yul/ brag dkar/ cem bre/ sag gri/ shes chu shod/ slel hi mi/shug pa can/ ser po la pa/ li kher/ skyur bu can pa/ ti mur sgang pa/ dkar skyil/ gsham ma/ nub ra/ 'bal sgo/ sa khu sogs yul tsho brgyad cu gya bzhi tsam nas 'brang khag brgya lhag dang / gar sha 284

'brang khag drug cu skor/ khu nu 'brang khag bcu skor bcas 'brang re la mi grangs lnga nas brgyad kyi bar yong gi yod la/ tshong lam gyi sgo gtso bo ni la dwags nas tshong layokhag gsum tsam yod pa gcig ni bkag gzhung brgyud lcags khang dang / ra pang / ti nga rtse/ dge rgyas bar dang / gcig ni la dwags nas byang la brgyud chu yul nas re chob/ ru thog rang bang /ting rtse stod ma bcas yin zhing / gzhan du byang la brgyud grang rtse smug leb/pang gung nas dpod byang brgyud ru thor nas leb ra b.rawācas yin/ gar sha'i tshong lam spu kha brgyud bkag gzhung nas lcags khang dang / ra pang /ting rtse sogs dang / khag gcig bkag gzhung nas mdze bo la rgyab ste chos brgyud ru thog dang / dbod byang / ru thor bar 'gro yi yod cing / khu nu'i tshong lam rong chung nas rtsa mda' brgyud sgar bkris sgang nas lcags khang dang / ru thog ra pang sogs la 'gro yi yod/ tshong zog gartsa bo ni tshwa 'bru brje tshong bya rgyu yin la / phyogs mtshungs kho tsho4spu bal dang / phyugs rigs/ mar/ 'phyur ba/ pags pa sogs kyang nyo yi yod/ tshur nang 'dren bya rgyu ni 'bru rigs dang / ras cha/ tha mag shing cha/mngar cha/ zhing las yo byad chung gras/ lcags rigs sogs yin/lhag par du za 'bru brgya cha brgyad cu tsam phyi rgyal nas nyo dgos kyi yod pa red/tshong rgyag sa'i sa cha khag gtan 'khel yod pa ni/ phyi phyogs nas la dwags slel dang / shes chu shod/ cem bre/ sag gri/ brag dkar /chu yul/ gar sha'i rdo zam/ bzang dkar / gsum mdo/ khu nu'i cang na'o/ ram pur bcas su dbyar ston gnyis la tshong ra btsugs nas brje tshong byed kyi yod/ ru thog khul du lcags khang (gshag sgang )/ red chos/ dbod byang / ru thor/ leb ra (da lta'i rdo dmar chus/) ra 285

pang leb ra/ ting rtse stod brag sgor sgor/ leb ra bcas su tshong dus tshugs kyi yod cing / leb ra zhes pa de khral rigs bsdu sa yin la tshong brgyab sa yang yin/ dus tshod ni bod zla lnga pa'i mjug nas bod zla drug pa'i mjug bar yin zhing / bod zla bdun pa'i nang zla ba gcig ring ru thog rdzong du tshong dus gcig sdud kyis tshugs kyi yod pas tshong ra shin tu 'khrug po yod/ phyi rgyal gyi tshong pa brgya phrag kha shas yod pa de tshos gcig sdud kyi tshong rar tshong rgyag gi yod pa ma zad/ tshong pa mang che ba rang rang gi pha mes thog gi mdza' bo ngo shes grong pa so so'i sar phyin nas tshong rgyag pa'i goms srol yang yod pa red/ mdza' bo ngo shes phan tshun tshong 'brel dang lag rtags sprod res/ phan tshun ngo shes 'gyur ldog gtong mi chog pa bcas byed kyi yod/ nga tsho'i mang tshogs nang du kho tsho'i ra lug bcol bzhag pa'ang mang po yod/ mang che ba ni skye med 'chi med yin zhing / bal spu/mar sogs mnga' bdag gi she khral las yang ba yod/ 'bri rer mar nyag bcu tsam dang / ra ma rer mar nyag gsum re tshad gzhi bzos pa dang /da dung kho/ tsho'i sa nas skyed med dngul gyi bu lon mang dag gcis/ g.yar tshab la bal spu sprod kyi yod/ rin gong mang che ba gcig gyur yin zhing / phan tshun mi su 'dra zhig gis kyang yul gong bshig pa yin na so so'i khongs nas brtsad gcod gtong ba las rang snang gang shar byas chog gi med pa bcas red/ /286
bzang pha sa sa

srid gzhung gis pha 'das po'i byas lar phran la lto phogs mthun rkyen du dwags po lha gsol gzhis sdod sger 'dzin lo gsu ma sprad pa ‘p+tar spyi lo 1kha56lor dwags stod lha gso' du 'byor nas gzhis sdod gsar rnying rtsis sprod len byas rjes lha gsol 'du khongs gtso rgan mang tshogs bcas kyis gzhi sdod rnying pas lo drugre ring 'jal byed 'bo dang / 'degs byed rgya srang /khral 'bab bsdu deb sogs rdzun bzos kyis khral 'ul 'phar ma bskul byung zhes gyen ldog gi rtsod pa langs par rang nas bar 'dum gyis gzhis sdod rnying pa la mo shar rtse phyag nang tshe dbang stobs rgyal nas khral 'ul 'phar ma bskul bsdu byas pa rnams rtsis byas 'bru khal 12 0 0dang // dngul srang 2 0 0 0 0gzhung rgyugs mi ser rkang 'ango/na la sa/zhigs te bgo 'grems bya rgyur phyir slog byas thog khrims khang dang mang tshogs la dkar gsol bya rgyu'i thag gcod byas pa yin/ de mjug tā la'i bla ma sku thog na rim dgung grangs 2 5dgung skeg lor chos 'khor rgyal bla mtshor mtsho 'jal la phebs srol ltar twa la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chos 'khor rgyal du phebs rgyur gra sgrig byed sgo ste chos 'khor rgyal gyi gzim chung dang dgon pa khag la nyams gso'i las gra tshugs rgyu'i ar po'i do dam pa rim bzhin bya rig pa dang /las bya rgya mtsho gzhis sdod rtse drung bcas chos 'khor rgyal du 'byor nas dwags snang rdzong gzhis ngo ma dang gtso rgan rnams la ar po'i 'ul mi dang /sa rdo shing bcas cha gses bya rgyu'i ched du 'phral 'byor dgos pa'i yig chung dza drag btang 'byor byung ba dang dus mtshungs bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes te dwags kong khul spyi khyab don gcod khang kong po nying khrir 'dzugs gtan 'khel nas dwags snang rdzong gzhis ngo ma dang /gtso rgan 'phral 'byor dgos pa'i brda tho dang sbrags rgya rigs las byed mi 288

gsum 'byo ra pa bcas gal che'i gnad don nyis 'doms la brten chosaske 'khor rgyal du ngo bskyod byed mi dgos pa'i dgongs zhu4kyis gtso drag —ngo tshab tu btang ba —dang rang nyid dang spyi 'thus mi gcig dwags snang rdzong gzhis lnga'i 'thus mi bcas nga tsho mi grangs 2 2mnyam skyod kyis tshogs 'dur nyin 2 tsam zhugs skabs sbyi khyab don gcod khru'u gsar btsugs thog tshogs 'du'i dgongs don gzhir bzung rdzong rim don gcod khang 'dzugs rgyur gtan 'khel don bzhin nga tsho dwags snang rdzong gzhis lnga'i 'thus mi rnams phyir log thog rdzong gzhis khag so so dang / lha gsol gzhis bcas su yang rdzong rim don gcod khang gsar 'dzugs mdzad mi spyi khyab don gcod khru'u nas rgya bod 'go khrid dang las byed bzhi tsam phebs te don gcod khang gsar 'dzugs gnang skabs lha gsol gtso rgan re gnyis nas mang tshogs kha 'khyer gyis don gcod khang 'dzugs rgyu dang 'gan 'khur mi sgru'adems rgyu slob grwa ba gtong rgyu sogs la gang byung gi ngo rgol zing cha slong rtsis byas par nga rang nas bkod 'doms bya rtsis yang rgya rigs las byed pas gsung don mi ser la go rtogs med pas nga tshos khog yangs bya dgos pa sogs nga rang la slob gso dang las byed par ltos med gang byung bshad par bzod bsgoms byas song ba ma zad/ mthar 'jayobashad blo 'gugs kyis rdzong rim don gcod khang btsugs nas 'gan 'khur mi sna 'dems sgru ga dang slob grwa ba 15tsam btang ba yin/ de'i lo mjug tu spyi khyab don gcod khru'u dang rdzong rim don gcod khang khu bsdu gnang song ba dang / spyi lo 1957lo'i lo 'gor rang nyid lha sar bod sa gnas srid gzhung la spyi lo 1956lo'i 'grig 'bul rtsis zhur 'byor skabs sa gnas srid gzhung gis gsar btsugs legs bcos lasakhungs kyi 'go pa rtsis dpon rnam sras gling da nga / 'bum 289

thang drung yig che mo ba chos 'phel thub bstan gnyis nas brjod don khyong rang lha gsol gzhis sdod sger 'dzin byas sis mi 'grig rdzong gzhis tshang ma gzhung 'dzin byas zin pas khyod rang 'di lo nas gzhung 'dzin byed dgos zhes bka' phab nas gzhis sdod nga rang gi thog rtse phyag nang 'chi med mgon po dang / mi ser spyi 'thus dwags po sgo bston gyi pha don grub gsar bskos kyis gzhung 'dzin byas te spyi lo 1kha57lo lo 'khor gyi rtsis zhu zhus pa yin/spyi lo 195〈lo'i zla 2pa 2pa'i nang bod ljongs sa khul gang sar khams jag gis bstan srung dmag yin zhes rta drel dang / me mda'/ dngos rigs sogs 'phrogs bcom ci che byed pa'i 'bir grags khyab dus nga rang la me mda' ring thung 7dang / rta drel ngo grangs 26yod pa khams jag gi bcom 'phrog dogs zon gyis rta drel ri khug tu sbas pa dang / me mda'i spo tog dang mde'u bcas so sor kha bral nas bzhag kyang spyi lo 1kha5ṭ+wāṃlo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 24nyin e lha rgya ri khul nas khams jag go 'jo dang / sde dge nas yin zhes gri dang / me mda' 'khyer ba'i rta pa bdun snga dro'i chu tshod dgu tsam la nga rang sdod gnas lha gsol gzhis khang nang 'dzul yong ste sgo khar khams pa gnyis dang / thog steng khams pa gcig so bltar bsdad nas khams jag mi bzhis gri dang me mda'i sdig mo byed pa ma zad/ me mda'ibya gzhug gzhus te nga tsho chu bzhi sgang drug gi bstan srung dmag mi yin/ rgya dmar mthar skrod gtong byed kyi mtshon cha a me ri ka nga/nga / go min tang gi sprod rgyu yin yang da lta 'byor ma byung khyod rang gi me mda' ji yod nga tshor g.yar dgos/ slad phyi rgyal nas me mda' sprad mtshams khyod kyi me mda' phyir sprod bya rgyu'i 'dzin sprad 'thus zhe phran gyi mthong sar me mda'i nang mde'u lnga cha gcig blugs te brang khog la sdig skabs nga rang nas bshad don 2( )0

me mda' re zung yod kyang gzhung mda' yin la nga rang gi srog srung byed rkyang yin pas khyod tshor mi sprod thag gcod yin zhes bshad de phan tshun zang zing dang skad cor rgyag skabs gzhis sdod las sbrel 'chi med mgon po dang mi mer rgan po sogs yong nas khams par de ltar ma mdzad 'phros mol byas 'thus bshad pa dang las sbrel gyis nga la khyed rang bu phrug mang bas me mda' sprod rgyur dgongs bzhes ma gnang tshe srog la thug nyen che zhes bshad pa dang sbrags rjes su a ri dang go min tang gis me mda' sprad mtshams khyod rang gi me mda' phyir sprod bya rgyu'i 'dzin ngos nas bzos chog ces lam sang 'dzin yig bzos nas phran la sprad de me mda' spa li gcig dang / mde'u dgu do bdag nasarīkhas len byed dbang med par 'phrogs khyer gyis skabs phral khams jag rnams dwags smad phyogs su thon/ de'i sang nyin dwags po khyum pa khul du 'phrog bcom byas stabs khul der sdod pa'i yul khams dang /khams jag rta pa bdun phan tshun 'dzing res kyis khams jag mi gnyis bsad pa dang / 'phros rta pa lnga bros byol song 'dug yang de'i sang nyin yul khams mi gsum phran sar yong nas khyod rang la me mda' ji yod nga tshos shes gsal la nga tsho yul khams rnams dwags khyum du 'dzoms nas yul lung srung bya byed kyi yin pas dwags snang rdzong gzhis mi drag nas me mda' ji yod g.yar bsdu bya rgyu yin gshis/ khyed kyi me mda' nga tshor g.yar dgos zhes dang thog lugs mthun gyi skad cha shod rgyu dang rjes su gri dang / me mda'i sdig mo byed cing nga rang dang las sbrel nas me mda' yod pa khams pas 'phrogs song khyod tsho khams rigs gcig pa yin pas nang mol byed dgos nga tshor me mda' med/ yul lung srung rgyu'i bsam pa yod na nga tsho rdzong gtso gnangs nyin go bsdur byed par yong rgyu yin zhes bshad mthar yul khams 291

rnams phyir log nyan tsam byung song / de'i sang nyin dgong dro lha rgya ri nas khams pa rta pa gcig rgyugs yong ste skad cha tshig gcig kyang bshad long med par gzhis khang thog steng du 'dzegs nas me mda' gcig rgyab 'phral khams jag rta pa rer me mda' ring thung gnyis re dang / rta drel gnyis re yod pa'i rta pa 25lha gsol gzhis khang du yong nas lha rgya ri khul sogs la khams jag gis gang sar me mda' dang / rta drel dngos rigs 'phrog bcom byas 'dus/ la lha gsol khu'/ du'ang 'phrog bcom bya rtsis 'dug pas nga tsho khams jag rjes 'ded du yong ba yin jag pa gar song shod dgos zhes kha g.yar nas mtshan mo chu tshod 12par bsdad nas 'jigs bskul gyis steng shod bar ga/sum la gang byung gi me mda' kha sgrig nas brgyab pa dang / srin bu mi sha la brngam pa ltar za 'thung zin mtshams dwags bhum du 'byor nas khayul khams mi brgyad 'dzin bzung gis rta lcag gzhus te do dam byas song ba dang /khams jag me mda' 'phrog mkhan rta pa lnga rjes 'ded byed khul gyis gong gsal khams jag nang khul gyis bsad pa'i mi gnyis po de rgya mi'i so pa red ces mgo lag mtshan mo de rang la dwags bhum nas lha gsol brgyud mi ser skul nas rtsed thang du skyel bar btang ba sogs kho pa tshos dwags po'i khul du 'jigs bskul zang zing bzos pa ma zad/ dwags po'i bhum par khams jag gi dmag sgar dang phogs khang btsugs nas bsdad song / dwags snang rdzong gzhis tshang mar dmag phogs dgos lugs bshad de rdzong gzhis khag nas 'bru rigs 'phrog bcom dang / nga tsho lha gre/sol gzhis su khams jag rta pa bcu grangs dang mi dmangs 'thus mi rdzun ma'i khongs gtsang pa'i jo lags zer ba zhig yod pa de bzhin khams jag gi phogs gnyer yin tshad kho pa bcas kyis nga tsho gzhis sdod gtso rgan la 'bru rigs dgos zer btsan 292

shed bshad kyang nga rang nas lha gsol gzhis ni gzhung 'dzin yin/ da lam sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' rgya 'di 'byor don deng skabs mi ngan re zung nas sangs rgyas bstan si kha 'khyer gyis rgya bod gros mthun dang / mthun sgril gtor bshig gang sar byed kyi yod tshad la khyod rang gzhis sdod nas kyang rang tshugs ma zin pa'i byed las shar tshe nyes pa drag po gcod rgyu yin zhes gsal bas nga tsho gzhis sdod rnams g.yog tshad las dpon tshod med cing lha rab 'bru sprod mi dgos pa dang / gal srid dgos nges yin tshe lha sar sa gnas srid gzhung la snyan 'bul gyis bka' lan ma 'byor b.rartebaka'aglu ske—'byangs gnang rogs zhes bshad mthar snyan 'bul dus tshod nyin 10sprad byung ba/ de nas snyan phul bang chen btang yang bka'aspun ltar bzhag bang chen kyang phyir log yong mkhan med stabs khams jag rta pa bcu phrag yang yang yong ste khyod rang—de snga rgya mi'i phogs bzan yin pas rgya mi'i phyogs su langs kyi yod dam zhes gshe gshe bta nga nas rdung la khad tsam byas te 'bru rigs dgos zhes dza drag btsan bshad byas pa dang / nang khul gzhis sdod nged gnyigokyang bsam pa ma mthun par gyur/ mi ser spyi 'thus don grub kyi tshab sgo ston mag pa stobs lags zhegapar gzhigasdod gnyisadabogatso rgan 'du 'dzoms sar khams par 'bru rigs sprod dgos kyi red bla ma'idhe mar bla ma'i khyis zas pa red/ da cha mi re zung gi bkag 'gog bya gi yod tshe bsam blo gcig ma gtogs gtong rgyu med ces tshogs 'du'i sar rgya lcog steng mur mdzog bzhus nas nga rang ladamigs te 'jigs skulartebyas byung ba ma zad/ phyi nang gnyis nas ngo rgol byas stabs rang nyid kyi tshe srog gonyen kha che bas kho pa tshor thabs mkhas kyi bstug rgyu las bya thabs med stabs dbang med du gyar zhing / de nas 'bru khal 50yiskor 'phrog khyer byas pa dang /293

nga rang sger la snyad 'dogs kyis snga rjes su rta drel brgyad/ rta chas/dngos rigs za chas sogs 'phrog bcom byas pa dang / las sbrel dang spyi 'thus la 'phrog bcom bsnyas bcos rtsa ba nas byas ma song / mi ser gyi sa nas kyang 'bru rigs dang rta drel dngos rigs gang byung 'phrog bcom byas pa ma zad/ bud med rang lo 15nas 16dang / sbrum ma la yang btsan g.yems byas pa grangs las 'das shing / da dung kho pa tshos 'jigs bskul gyi dkrog gtam ched bzos kyis lha rgya ri dang / dwags bhum du dmag sgar btsugs zin zhing / rtsed thang sgang sbugs dmag 'thab kyis len grab yod/mda' dpon dkar chung dang / rtswa gnyer snying lags nga tshos 'dzin bzung byas zin/ srog thog tu gtong rgyu red ces dwags po stod smad gang sar 'jigs bskul rim pa byas pa dang / de rjes 'ol dga' khul du khams dpa' shod nas yul gyar yong ba'i 'jam dbyang mkhyen brtse zer ba'i bla ma 'khor bcas dang / phyugs rigs mang po yod pa'i khams jag skyes pho mo sbra gur 40tsam 'ol dga' rgyud du lo gcig lhag tsam bsdad de mi ser la 'phrog bcom dang / 'od zer gyang sa khul gyi rlangs 'khor 'gro lam rgyud la gnod 'tshe btang ba/ lho kha rong rgyud du zing bslangs kyis bcings 'grol dmag dang 'thab mthar kho pa tsho pham ste sems can rgyu dngos sogs sngon la chos 'khor rgyal brgyud rgya tshar btang nas khams jag rta pa 60tsam gyis yang skyar bcings 'grol dmag la 'dzings rung slar pham ste rgya tsha rgyud du bros yong nas rgya tsha nub phyogs sogs mi ser sa nas 'phrog bcom gyis bros 'gro khar bcings 'grol dmag rta pa 2 0rjes 'ded du chos 'khor rgyal brgyud rgya tshar 'byor nas mi ser dang khams jag gnyis 'khrug 'dzings skabs bcings 'grol dmag nas go skon blo 'gugs kyi dril bsgrags byed 294

skabs mdze+etshogs kyi khrod yib bsdad khams jag gcig gis me mda' brgyab ste lan krang bsad stabs bcings 'grol dmag rnams nas phar rgol byas mtharakho pa tsho chu rab med kyang shi ma pham gyi rab brgal dus chus khyer nas shi ba dang bsad pa bcas mthar khams jag gi 'go pa 'phrin las zer ba sogs mi 56tsam dwags po la thog zungs mkhar3sa lam zhor rta drel dang me mda' 'phrog bcom gyi rtsa ri'i nang broyothar ba las de byings tshang ma rtsa med btang ba dang / khams pa tshos btsan 'phrog byas pa'i sems can dang dngos rigs rnams rgya tsha khul gyi mi ser la phyir sprod byas te bcings 'grol dmag rnams chos 'khor rgyal brgyud rtsed thadze+edu phyir log2song ba dang /yang de mjug 'ol dga' nas khams jag pho mo rta pa bcu dgus dar dmar zhig khyer te rgya tsha ko sar 'byor nas ko gru gtong mkhan med stabs glemasamadar me mda' brgyab nas ko gru gtong dgos zhes bshad parardar sdod yul khams tshong pa zhig yod pa des dwags snang rdzong gzhis dang mi ser la gnod 'tshe gtong rgyu med pa'i kha chas byas nas rdzong gzhis khag lnga po nas rtsam khal ga nyis re dang mar khal gcig ja sbag gcig lug gcig bcas bsdus nas sprad de lha ga sol brgyud lha rgya rir song ba de dang gong gsal khams rigs tsho lha rgya ri'i sa khongs chu mdo gyang du nang 'khrug brgyab nas phan tshun gsod res btang nas rta pa bdun lhag pa mtsho snar bros song 'dug yang chos 'khor rgyal nas rgya tsha brgyud khams pa chab mdo ba rta pa 20dang /rmas pa mi 15bcas lha rgya rir 'gro mkhan lha gsol du 'byor rjes dga' ldan pa'i grwa pa zing slong rta pa 120'byor song bas khams jag rnams kyis bshad don kong po rgya mda' khul gyi lam bzo'i babs tshugs su bcom 'phrog byed par bskyod nas rgya bod lam bzo'i bzo pa 2rkyatsam las med kyang kho 295

tshos dmag 'thab gra sgrig kyi khang pa'i sa 'og tu so khung 'dzing rag btsan stabs nga tsho chab mdo ba rta pa 100tsam yod kyang dmag 'thab pham nas nga tsho'i mi 65tsam shor ba dang rmas ma 15dang lhag bsdad mi 2 0tsam la thug song / khyod tshos kha sngon kha chas ltar dpung rogs la yong rgyu yin kyang ma yong bas dmag 'pham dgos pa'i rkyen rtsa khyod tshor thug yod brer nas nang 'khrug rgyag rtsis byed skabs dga' ldan pa'i dmag spyi yin zer ba'i grwa pa bla rgan zhig 'dug pa des nang 'khrug mi rgyag lha rgya rir 'byor nas skad cha byas 'thus zhes 'jam bshad kyi grwa pa rnams lam seng thon song / de rjes khams pa rnams gcig mjug gnyis 'thud thon song bas skabs der sa khul yas mas gzhis gtso mi ser sogs nas za chas dang / rta drel gzan chag sogs btsan 'phrog byas pa dang / de mjug lha rgya ri nas khams jag gi 'go pa bya ma tshang zer ba'i khams pa gcig dang / a mdo/ sde dge ba sogs khams rigs sna tshogs dang / bod dmag sku srung dmag sgar gyi dung pa dmag mi gnyis bcas rta pa 100tsam yong nas lha gsol gzhis kyi nye sar gur phub nas zhag gcig bsdad song bas rta drel gyi chag 'bru khal 〈0dgos pa khyod tshos rang 'gul gyi sprad na dang de min nga tshos lag pa rgyag rgyu yin zer khams pa'i phog/sa gnyer khams pa gnyis gzhis khang du yong nas lde mig btsan 'phrog 'jigs skul dang sbrags kho pa tshos lag pa rgyab nas 'brul khal ṭ+wāṃ0lhag tsam 'phrog thog sang nyin der thon song zhing / khams jag de dag ni bcings 'grol dmas gi mtha' bskor nang tshud nas byang lam nas bros ma thar bar bsdad pa rnams kyi dpung rogs su 'gro mkhan red ces zer ba dang / de'i skabs nga rang gi las sbrel 'chi med mgon po lha rgya ri'i e gong po khang gsar du sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtsis dpon rnam sras 29()

gling 'byor yod pas mjalazhurabyumar khal bdar gtsig khyer nas song ba phyir log skabs tsis dpon rnam gling ngu gi 'dug pa ma zad dwags snang rdzong gzhis tshang mar bka' rgya btang zin khyod tsho lha gsol nas dmag bskul rgyag dgos zhes brjod kyi 'dug zer ba dang 'brel gzhis khongs mi drag dang /dgon sde khag bcas nas mi grangs 60sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'gro khar yul lha gsol nas thon kyang dwags po po thang la 'byor skabs rtsis dpon snam gling dang khams jag rnams bros zin pa gzhi nas shes te tshang ma phyir logs slebs byung ba dang / de rjes lhun rtse nas a drung ched btang gi dwags snang rdzong gzhis so sor bka' rgya re 'dug pa de'i nang don lho khul rdzong gzhis rnams lhun rtser tshogs 'dzoms dgos pas lha gsol gzhi sdod ngo ma/ gtso drag rgan 'thus bcas 'phral du yong dgos pa las ka kor mi chog ces 'khod 'dug pa dang / yang lha sa nas sa gnas srid gzhung rtse phyag las khungs kyi a drung gcig ched gtong ṅgas khyod rang gzhis sdod ngo ma 'di lo'i sgrig 'bul rnams grangs tshang rtsis zhur a drung 'di dang mnyam du yong dgos zhes bka' rgya dang bcas 'byor bas gzhis sdod gnyis dang mi ser spyi 'thus bcas gros bsdur gyis lhun rtse dang lha sa so sor mi su 'gro ba ma mthun pas mthar lha gsol gzhis khang du lha mo'i dgon khang la zan brtag zhus thon ltar nga rang lha sar rtses zhur 'gro rgyu dang / las sbrel lhun rtser dwags snang rdzong gzhis rnams dang mnyam du 'gro rgyu thag chod song bas phyag sbrel lhun rtser thon pa dang nga rang gzhung rtsis zhu byed mar ltang 55dang / kham ltar sger gyi mar phyur sogs khal rgyab 1〈0dang a drung bcas rgya tsha brgyud lha sar sngon btang gis rang nyid bza' tsho bu phrug bcas rta drel 1rdolhag bsdad la mar phyur rgyab chas dang bcas spyi lo 195rdolo'i zla 11pa'i nang dwags po 297

lha gsol nas rgya tsha dang / chos 'khor rgyal brgyud 'ol dga' rdzing phyir 'byor skabs sngon du btang ba'i a drung la khams jag rta pa 110thug nas mar rnams 'phrog pas a drung bros song ba dang / dngos po 'phros rnams rdzing phyir bzhag 'dug pa rnams rdzing phyi grwa tshang dang / mi ser 'du spyir rtsis sprad nas rang nyid lha skyod skabs lha sa khul nas bros yong mkhan mang ba dang lam bar bros mi dpung hrag los dang khams jag gi 'phrog bcom byed mus la brten nga rang bza' tsho bu phrug lam bgrod dka' bas gnas skabs 'ol dga' dmag dpung la'i nub ngos kyi ko gshong ri shur nang nyin 2 0tsam yib bsdad kyang da dung lha sa'i lam bar thar dka' ba'i gnas tshul 'og lha gsol du phyir log mi byed dka' med byung / lha gsol du 'byor skabs las sbrel khams jag dang mnyam du yar klung pho brang du rtsis dpon snam gling sar skyod de nang mi lha gsol du bsdad 'dug cing / nga rang lha gsol du 'byor nas bza' zla bu phrug dang dngos rigs me mda' bcas ri khrod cig tu bzhag nas rta drel rnams ri khug shing nags gseb tu sbas pa yin/ nga rang nyin mo gzhis khang du yong nas sa zhing gi srog rtsa mi ser so sor rtsis sprod kyi sa zhing 'debs las byed bcug pa dang / gzhis kyi 'bru rigs khal 2000lhag tsam yod pa dang / de bzhin bcu brgyad bkar 'jug gi 'bru khal 400 skor 'dug pa rnams khams jag mi khyar gyis 'phrog bcom byas dogs khar mi ser rnams lo 'khor gcig ring khams jag gis 'phrog bcom byas stabs za 'bru dang son rtsa med rkyen 'bru rigs ji yod tshang ma mi ser rnams la bgos 'grems byas nas gan rgya blangs te slad gzhung rtsis zhu dgos byung na gan rgya gzhir bzung rtsis zhu dang / de min khyod tshos zas na 'grig zhes bshad pa yin/ de mjug lha rgya ri nas a mdo rta pa 120yong nas 298

gzhis sdod dang mi ser la 'bru rigs dgos lugs bshad kyang 'bru rigs med stabagami ser nas za chas rta drel dngos rigs 'phrog bcom byed bzhin song ba dang / yang las sbrel 'chi mgon gyis dwags po nas khrid yong ba'i g.yog gcig yar klung nas phyir log gis brjod gsal las sbrel khams jag dang mnyam du yar klung chos sde gong la bros nas bcings 'grol dmag gi rjes 'ded dang 'dzing skabs me skyogs brgyab nas shi gson ji byas ha go ma byung nga rang rang yul du log pa yin zhes zer ba go thos byung yang las sbrel kho pa 'chi skyon med par deng skabs rgya gar rda ram sar las zhabs dgongs zhus kyis rgan chos byas nas bsdad yod tshad dang khong da lo rang lo 72la slebs yod pa red/ yang lhun rtse nas mdo spyi shod drung 'byor rgyayokyis a drung ched mngags mdun dwags snang rdzong gzhis khag la bka' rgya re btang 'byor nang gsal khyod rang gzhis sdod ngo ma 'di lo'i rtsis zhur yig rigs tshang ma khyer nas gnyal g.yul rgyal lhun rtser phral du yong dgos zhes gsal yang dwags snang rdzong gzhis gcig kyanga'agro mkhan byung ma song de nas spyi lo 195'alo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 4nyin nga rang gzhis su sa zhing 'debs las skor sogs mi ser la las bgos byed bzhin skabs rgya tsha brgyud nas khams jag 'bor chen thon gyi 'dug pa de tshos mi bsad 'phrog bcom gang byung byed kyi 'dug ces 'bir grags che bas skabs der las sbrel gyi bza' zla dang g.yog po bcas mtshan mo de rang du rta drel dang dngos rigs ji yod mnyam khyer gyis mi ser spyi 'thus sgo ston stobs kyi nang mi dang bcas mnyam du bros zin 'dug phran rang ri khrod du sngar bzhin bsdad pa dang / gzhis su mi ser rta thab gad pa bcas bzhag pa yin mtshan mor khams jag rta pa 100tsam 'byor song zer dus nga rang la bsnyas 'dogs ji 'dra zhig bshad yong bsam 299

nas bsdad pas sang nyin zhogs pa der nga rang gi bu rgan pas ri rtse nas blta skabs gzhis khang phyi nang tshang mar bcings 'grol dmag mis khengs 'dugakha sa 'byor ba'i khams jag rta pa 100'byor pa de rnams khams pa ma red khams chas spras pa tsam las bcings 'grol dmag gi rta dmag red 'dugad dung nga tsho'i sdod gnas ri khrod 'di la mtshan mo dmag mis blta bar slebs yod bzo 'dug khang pa'i rgyab mdun du 'gyig lham gyi rkang rjes gang sar 'dug zer ba ltar nga rang ri rtser song nas blta dus gzhis khang phyi nang tshang mar bcings 'grol dmag gis khengs 'dug nga sa skabs der nga rang la 'jigs snang gsar pa zhig skyes byung / ri brgyudatshonas lha gsol gzhis kyi gtso drag de pho phun dbang gis rta drel gnyis khrid de phran sar 'byor nas nga la gnas skabs lho phyogs su g.yol tsam byas na lesas zer byung yang de lan phran nas mi g.yol thag chod yin/ da phan lo gcig tsam ring 'di khul khams jag gi 'grul lam 'khel bas btsan shed 'jigs bskul gyis 'phrog bcom byas pa las nga rang gi dang du blangs nas rgya bod gros mthun dang / rgya bod mthun sgril la gtor bshig gi bya bar rgyab skyor byas rigs ni med/ da lta dmag 'khrug gi dus skabs yin pa dang / nga rang bod sa gnas srid ga/zhung gi bsko 'dzugs byas pa'i gzhis sdod yin stabs ji byed mi shes kyang bcings 'grol dmag gis srid jus gzhir bzung dbye zhib tan tan byed nges red/ nga rang sems thag gtsang bcad kyis bcings 'grol dmag gi dmag sgar la 'gro gi yin zhes bshad/ de ri nas mar babs 'gro skabs gtso drag phun dbang gis me mda' dang srung ba yod dam zhes dris byung bar lan du lus la 'chang 'chang pa yod zer bshad de dogs zon ngang mar babs nas yong ste bza' zla bu phrug yod sar 'byor 300

nas lan rda 'byor min dris par gang yang zer mkhan mi 'dug zer bas la ma sang nga rang gi am phrag tu kha btags gcig blugs nayogazhis khang du bskyod/ der bcings 'grol dmag gi rta dmag rnams bsdad 'dug pas khyod rang gang nas0yin zer dris byung bar ngas sa gnas 'di'i rdzong dpon yin khyed tsho'i 'go khrid su red dam dris par 'dir 'go khrid med gsham gyi mi tshang de'i nang 'go khrid yod pa red zer ba ltar sgo ston khang par phyin dusargya rigs rta dmag gi chas gyon pa'i pho gsar bod skad shes pa zhig 'dug (skad bsgyur ting tsi hud/) des gnas tshul nyan nas bod skad brgyab ste khyo da— rang khyim 'di'i pha yin nam zer ngosanas min/ sa gnas 'di'i rdzong dpon yin zhes bshad par khyod rang nyin gnyis 'dir bsdad mi 'dug gang du song ba yin zhes khong khro'i rnam pa bstan nas gshe gshe btang stabs nga rang sems nang mi dga' ba'i 'du shes skyes te kha btags ma bton par nga rang babo' zla bu phrug bcas ri khrod dutribasdad yod 'di khul khams jag glu'agrul lam 'khel bas tshe srog la nyen zon zur g.yol du bsdad pa yīnamizhesabashad mthar bcings 'grol dmag lo na mtho tsam zhig 'dug pa (yid thon thon krang sbad spu )des skad bsgyur brgyude bshad don khyed rang 'di khul rdzong dpon yin nam/ 'dir bsdad pa yag po byung / nga tsho bod ljongs dmag don bka' sdom u yon lhan khang gis zing 'khrug lhing 'jags gtong rgyudzodang mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas gtong rgyur yong ba yin/ khyed rang ri la bsdad nas khag po byung shag chang thung lto zo zhes bshad nas chang zas kyi sne len gnang rjes dmag don bkag sdom mu yon lhan khang gibaka' rgya 'dir yod pa'i dgong sa don 'di khul lag bstar bya dgos pa yozad/ khyim 'di'i nang me mda' mo gsar gyi mde'u bcu chag gnyis 'dug khyed rang nas 301

rtsis len dgos/ nga tsho do nub rdzam khul du dmag sgar phyir 'then byed kyi yin/ sdod gnas khang pa g.yar dgos pas khyed nas yi ge gtong dgos pa dang sang nyin khyed rang dmag sgar la yong dgos bshad byung ba ltar dmag mi rnams 'phral mar thon song zhing / sbad spu'u thon krang gis khyed rang sdod gnas gang du yin nam mnyam du lta bar yong gi yin bshad nas sku srung dmag bcas mnyam skyod kyis gzhis khang du slebs skabs las sbrel gyi khang par bltas song / de'i nang ma'o kru'u zhi sku par si thag chung chung zhig kho tsho'i nang mis bros 'gro khar dbral nas rgya lcog steng du bzhag 'dug pa thon krang nas mthong 'phral 'dir gnad don yod pa red/ twa la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen gyi sku par skyon med bzhag 'dug pa/ ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku par dbral bar gnad don yod pas khyed nas gang yin shod dgos zer bar ngas 'di ni nga'i sdod gnas min las sbrel gyi khang pa red/ las sbrel nang mi bros khar dbral nas bros zin pa red/ da lta bsdad med pa red zer shod skabs khyod rang gi sdod gnas gang du red dam dris byung ba ltar nga rang gi sdod gnas la khrid pa yin/ der dngos rigs dang khang pa tshang ma bsngogs bsher byas 'dug pas 'di nang dngos rigs bor rlags byung min blta dgos/ dmag 'khrug dus skabs song stabs mtshon cha yod med bsngogs bsher byas pa red/ nga tshos mngar cha phran bu bed spyod kyis nad par ster dgos byung ba de'i rin dwo yang 20dang / rwa lug 20bshas btang rin dwo yang ṭ+wāṃ0yod ces sprad byung / sang nyin khyed rang mar yong dgos zhes zer nas thon krang dang sku srung bcas thon song ba dmag sgar la sdod khang rdzam mi ser nas gra sgrig bya dgos zhes yi ge lam seng btang ba yin/ dmag don bka' sdom u lhan gyi bka' rgya gzhis khang gi rtsa tshig sbyar sar sbyar nas de'i 302

nub ri khrod du log pa yin/ sang nyin nga rang la me mda' ring thung drug dang me mda'i mde'u 10rkya0lhag tsam yod pa rnams khyer te mi ser gyi spyi 'thusas gcig khrid nas rdzam bcings 'grol dmag sgar la bskyod pa yin/thon krang dang chab srid u yon/ kre ta'o yon sogs mnyam du bsdad sar me mda' dang mde'u bcas rtsis sprad par thon krang nas phangs sems skyes byung ngam zer bar phangs sems skyes byung gang lags she na gzhung gi rtsis mda' min nga rang sger gyi yin/ dmag don bkag sdom u yon lhan khang gi bka' dgongs la brtsisagabakur gyis ma sprad na mi 'grig pas sprad pa yin zhes bshad zin mtshams sbad spu'u thon krang nas khyed rang la bya dga' yin zhes ja sgam gcig dang / kha btags gcig mi ser spyi 'thus la ja sbag gcig dang / kha btags gcig sprad nas da khyed gnyis log na 'grig zer ba ltar log rtsis byed skabs thon krang nas khyed rang la gnod 'tshe yo nga ba'i zhed snang mi 'dug gam zer bar phran nas mtshon cha ni rtsis 'bul zhus zin/da lta sa khul phan tshun zing slong jag pa gtsang 'phyag zin med pas nga rang gi bde 'jags la blo dogayophran bu 'dug kyang bya thabs bral ba red bshad par thon krang nas tog tsam sgug dang dmag mi btang chog zer nas bcings 'grol dmag mi 200dang lan krang gcig tar gtong mkhan gciga.em rje gcig bcas sanyam du btang nas kho tsho gzhis khang du nyar dgos khyed rang bde 'jags la phan thogs yong gi red ces zer ba ltar mnyam skyod 'gro ṣar thon krang nas khyed rang nyin bdun ngal gso brgyab rjes dmag sgar la yong dgos las ka yod zer ba ltar dmag mi rnams gzhis khang du nyar nas nyin bdun song mtshams dmag mi gnyis nga rang 'bod par btang 'dug pa ltar dmag sgar la 'byor 'phral thon krang nas khyed rang dmag sgar 303

du bsdad nas mi byed bzhi'i srid jus dril bsgrags bya dgos pa dang /'di khul mi ser bros song ba rnams phyir log yong dgos kyi yi ge gtong dgos bshad pa bzhin phan tshun gang sar yi ge gtong ba dang / srid jus dril bsgrags byas rjes las sbrel gyi nang mi dang mi ser spyi 'thus sgo ston gyi nang mi/ de min mi ser 'jigs nas phan tshun g.yol bsdad pa tshang ma phyir log pa dang / ri khul du yul khams yib bsdad khag cig bcas snga rjes phyir log pa la mi byed pa bzhi'i srid jus lag bstar byas pa dang yul nang mtshon cha ji yod rtsis 'bul zhu dgos kyi dril bsgrags byas nas nyung shas ma gtogs tshang mas rtsis 'bul zhus song ba dang / de rjes rta dmag rnams lhun rtse khul du zing 'khrug lhing 'jags gtong bar thon mtshams rdzas mde'u za chas 'gel byed rta drel khag cig sha shed zhan pas rta drel dgos lugs bshad pa ltar nga rang gi rta drel lhag ma 1rdoyod pa rnams dmag sgar la sprad pa yin/ dmag mi khag bgos nas snang shan / skyems stong / sku rnam bcas so sor skyod pa dang / nga rang dang kre ta'o yon gcig lan krang gnyis/ tar gtong mkhan gcig em rje/ dmag mi 200tsam bcas lha gsol dang / rgya tsha khul du zing 'khrug lhing 'jags yong rgyur sa khul so sor dril bsgrags dang / mi ser la gnod 'tshe gtong mkhan khams jag lhag 'phros la go bskon blo 'gugs byed par thon nas zla gnyis tsam ring sa khul so sor mi ser la dril bsgrags byas nas khams jag zing slong mgo btags zhu mkhan mi grangs khakyalhag tsam dang / klad rnying khregs bzung gi tshur rgol byed mi khams jag rta pa bzhi tsam gyi mgo sgur rtsa ba nas ma byas stabs dmag don gyi nyes chad bcad nas mi gcig bros shor ba phud mi gnyis bsad pa/ mi gcig rmas nas 'dzin bzung byas nas kho pa tshor me 304
