mda' ring thung lnga dang mde'u 160/ rta drel brgyad/ za chas/ gla rtsi rta sgro gang / dngul gyi 'bras spang gsum/ kho pa tsho phyi rgyal du 'gro chog pa'i de snga rgya gar gyilku tshab lha sa bde skyid gling khar sdod mkhan gyi sprad pa'i lag khyer 'dra par sbyar ma bcas 'dug pa dang / rmas ma khams par skabs 'phral sman bcos kyes drag skyes byung ba bcas gong gsal khams rigs rnams dang / dwags snang rdzong gzhis khag nas 'dzin bzung dang mgo btags zhus pa khams jag khyon mi grangs 4rkya0skor zla gcig tsam dmag sgar la nyar nas dngos rigs ji yod so sor phyir sprod byas nas lha sar btang song ba dang / dwags snang rdzong gzhis lnga'i sa khul la zing 'khrug lhing 'jags gtsang ma chags nas shan mi dmangs srid gzhung btsugs pa dang / dmag sgar lhun rtser spo skyod gtan 'khel gyis nga rang dmag sgar dang mnyam du 'gro dgos gsung byung yang rang ngos gnas yul la lhing 'ardzags gtsang ma chags song bas 'gro mi dgos pa bshad pa ltar de ga'i mi dmangs srid ga zhung la ngo sprod kyi shan du dgas snang rdzong gzhis lnga'i gtso rgan po sogs mi grangs 22tsam ched bkugs kyi tsu'u krang khyed rang nas byas te slob sbyong bya dgos zer ba ltar zla gcig dang nyin 17ring slob sbyong gi phan tshun rogs ram byas nas bsdad pa yin/ de rjes nga rang shan mi dmangs srid gzhung nang spos nas shan gyi las byed dang mnyam du zhing pa gros tshogs gsar btsugs byed pa'i nang yig 'bri dang / sa khul du slob sbyong byed mir dril bsgrags rogs ram gyi las ka byas nas zla gcig tsam bsdad pa yin/ spyi lo 1959lo'i zla ba rdopa'i nang khyed rang mes rgyal nang blta bskor slob sbyong du 'gro dgos gsung pa ltar rtsed thang kronabyu chus 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u la ngo sprod yi ge stsal ba khyer te rtsed thang du nyin shas 305

bsdad rjes shan khag gi gzhi rim las byed shang krang dang / kru'u ren/kre hru'u sogs mi grangs 10dang / grwa nang bsam pho'i gzhis sdod 'chi med bstan rgyal dang rgya bod skad sgyur mi gnyis bcas lha skyod kyi ljongs yongs kyi kron chus khag dang / grong khyer bcas kyi blta bskor 'gro mi gzhi rim rgya bod las byed bcas mi grangs 92dang mtho 'bring mi sna nga gnyis the bas mi grangs 2 0bcas khyon mi grangs 112spyi zla 9pa'i tshes 10la mes rgyal du krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes nas lo bcu 'khor ba'i mdzad gzigs tshogs pa dang / blta bskor slob sbyong bcas la dus tshod zla drug ring 'gro rgyu'i go skabs bzang po de lta bu byang bar brten tang dang rgyal ri ji ///stekhab kyis dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi dbye zhib gnang byung bsam pa'i tshong thag pa nas yid ches skyes pa dang / lhag par rgyal sa pe cin du tang dang rgyal khab kyi dbu khrid ma'o kru'u zhi dang / kra'o an la'e/ kru'u te/ li'u hra'o chi sogs kyi mjal 'phrad thob pa dang / rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs rnams nas spun zla lta bu'i thugs 'khur gzigs skyong chen po thob pas mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i dro skyid kyi 'tsho ba longs su spyad de dga' spro'i ngang spyi lo 1960lo'i zla 2pa'i nang bod du phyir log rjes lho kha chab srid gros tshogs nang chab srid dang 'tsho ba'i bkod sgrig gnang nas da bar 'tsho zhing gnas mus lags pa bcas so tsho306
sa mdza ba ba ma rgyal

lags kyi (thob rgyal sman ri/ bon po'i chos lugs/ dgon pa'i grwa pa yin pa ) dge phrug tu nyar zhing bkra shis lhun po'i grwa sar chos zhugs byas te paṇa chen thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dpal bzang po las bar ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa nod de chos ming du blo bzang thub bstan zhes 'dogs gnang ltar phyis mtshan yongs grags su de ltar du 'bod/ de rjes rtse dgon khang grwa tshang (paca/ chen rin po che'i mchog zhabs grwa tshang yin ) gi sgrig khongs su zhugs/ dgung bgrang nyi shu rtsa lngar par bla brang rtse gsol thab kyi ma che mor (rim pa lnga pa'i rtse drung las tshan pa )bsko gzhag gnang ba ltar de nas rtse ma che mo'i las 'gan gnang / dgung lo so drug pa bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu phag lor (spyi lo 1kha2 2) phyi ltar du paṇa chen rin po che nas ched mngags bka' dgongs ltar khal kha (phyi sog hal ha ) rje btsun dam pa'i gsol dpon bsko gzhag byas pa yin zhes mgron gnyer chen mos spyi 'gre'i lugs ltar bka' bsgyur byas mod/ nang don ni paṇa chen rin po che ring min bod kyi byang phyogs brgyud nas/ rgya sog yul grur phebs rgyur byang rgyud phebs lam du thugs ma/kho khag sa rim la gzhigs nas sngon tshud kyi gra sgrig las ka byed par ched mngags btang ba bzhin phyi'i lta snang du khal kha'i gsol dpon dngos yin khul gyis paṇa chen rin po che nas thon phyag mjal zhu'i 'gro lugs yang spyi lugs ltar byas/ phebs lam gyi thugs mkho khag gzhis rtse nas 'dam sa skya phying lung sgar thog (deng sang dpal mgon zhan khongs ) bar bla khongs gzhis khag so sos lam yig ltar rta khal gyis skyel 'dren byas shing / de nas mtsho sngon stod sog gi khul du ma slebs bar rta drel ched gnyer gyis skyel 'dren byas/ dge rgan rang nyid phebs thon ma gnang gong shag dngos nas tsan dan dmar po las grub pa'i gnas bstan 308

bcu drug dge bsnyen ha zhang dang bcas pa'i sku'i snang brnyan shin tu byon legs pang mtho phyed gnyis tsam yod par rten khri bkod legs rang 'grigs da lta'ang bla brang rtse gzim chung nyi 'od kyi rten gras su yod pa sogs paṇa chen rin po cher dad 'bul zhus pa'i dngos rigs phud/ de byings shag gi ca dngos tshang ma tshong 'gyur gyis bod dngul ṭam rdo bcu bdun tsam zhig zin pa des lho kha khul lce bde zhol nas snam phrug do po bzhi bcu skor dang /gzhan yang spos sogs bsgrubs/ thugs mkho dos khal dang bcas pa 'od yug la rgan zhes pa'i byang la brgyuganas 'dam skyar btang / dge rgan rang nyid 'od yug nas lha 4brgyud de rgya la ba sku phreng bcu gsum par khal kha gsol dpon gyi ming thog nas 'byor thog chabs cig gi mjal phyag zhus te slar byang —phyogs su kha bskor nas 'dam sa skya brgyud de lam du zhugs thogabakra shis lhun por bka'i mngags bya zhib bkod dang rjes su mthun par thugs mkho rnams byang brgyud gsang lam dmigs btsugs byas pa'i 'dus mdo sogs khag so sor rim pa byas nas brag phug btsan zhing gsang rgya mi mngon bar thub pa yod pa sogs rnams su bskungayote gsang ba'i rtags kyi mtshan ma dang bcas te rim 'jog byas/ de'i tshe na mtha' yas byang thang du bgrod par bya ba'i yul gyiphyogs gang zhig yin cha mibyed pas nyi zla'i 'char nub la balhos nas shar nub sogs kyi khyad par 'byed dgos pa dang /smig rgyu'i dra ba4khyab ste lam ngo ched dka' ba'i gnas skabs su lam gyi cha rgyus la mkhas pa dag gis sna drangs te ched du dmigs pa'i phyogs su zhugs shing / dka' ba brgya phrag gi khur po re re bzhin dwang sa du blang4te mthar ngo g.yog ltos bcas tha'i ji nor zhes pa'i stod sog gi sa'i char bde bar 'byor/ de'i tshe sog po'i dpon 'go rnams ni ring min paṇa chen rin po 309

che phyogs der chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur rgyu'i skor sgros rtsam med par glo bur du paṇa chen rin po che sku 'khor nyung bsdus dang bcas phebs pas de 'phral dpon 'bangs tshang mas bzhugs yul dbu gur 'bul gshoms sogs bkur ste rim gro'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod par ma zad/dpon po rnams khal kha gsol dpon gyi 'gram du ched kyis yong nas khyed kyis sngon 'tshud nas paṇa chen rin po che 'di phyogs phebs kyi yod pa'i gnas tshul nga tshor ma bshad pa ni ha cang thabs sdug red/ nga tshos phebs bsu tsam yang zhu rgyu ma byung ba 'di shin tu nongs so zhes yus smras kyang byas zhes gsungs/ de nas paṇa chen rin po che gar phebs sar zhabs zhu gnang zhing / mi ring bar rtse mgron gnyer che mo bsko gzhag gnang ba de'i lo dus ma nges shing / go ming rjes 'brel gyi las 'gan ni phyi rgya'i mchog dman gang zhig gis paṇa chen rin po cher mjal bcar dang / chos zhu/ sa gnas kyi sde dpon che phra dang bcas pa'i kha 'dzin sne khrid dang yar snyan seng zhu rgyu'i rigs dang / mar 'tshams 'dri gnang rgyu dang mjal kha'i dus rim bkod sgrig byes kyi dus yin par brten rim pas ston 'khor rgya cher phyin pa'i bzhugs sgar khyon yongs la bka' bsgyur rgyu sogs ci dang ci yod pa de dag dwangs ba dang dad pas khur du blangs shing / lhag par nang sog khul du paṇa chen rin po che dang lhan du rgyun ring bzhugs pas sog skad kyang mkhas thag chod mkhyen/ paṇa chen rin po cher dad ldan khag dang lhag par skabs de dus krung dbyang srid kyi mnga' dbang sgyur ba po go min tang gis bkur bzos rgya chen po byas pa dang / krung dbyang dpon rigs gang zhig dang / lhag par cang ce hri'i mdun du'ang phebs myong bar gsungs/ de sngon skabs gang du'ang phar dpon chen sogs dang ldan khag la gnang rgyu'i 310

ched dulhan pa'i7sku par tshang ma ni bgres sha can dang gzi mdangs med pa sha stag byung bas da lta rang gi dad rten du yod pa'i tshos gaji ser mad ngas 'phro ba 'di yin no zhes gsungs shing / re zhig na paṇa chen rin po cher ched du gsol btab zhus pa 'edi lta ste dad ldan khag nas tshur dngos po'i 'bul ba ni khri 'bul stong 'bul yong ba 'di lta bu yang phar gnang rgyu ni ljags sa byin rten dang sku par tsam re yin pas da phyin sku par 'di yagapo zhig bzhes rogs gnang zhes nang nye'i gsal 'debs zhus par 'o na da lta par pa skad thongs shig gsungs pa dang par pa 'byor ma thag sku par bsgron pas de nas bzung sku par tshang ma sku sha 'byor po dang gzi byin lham mer 'phro ba zhig byung lugs gsung myong / mtsho sngon dang / nang sog pe cin sogs su rgyun ring tsam bzhugs pa ma zad/ rgya nag gi zhing chen gzhan 'ga' zhig la'ang phebs myong ba red/ me glang (1927)lor paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa sku gshegs rjes sku gdung gdan zhus kyis khams skye mdo nas rim pas bod nag chu dang / 'dam gzhung / mar rkyang / 'od yug lha bu/ shangs rnam gling bcas brgyud nas lcags 'brug lor gdan sa bkra shis lhun por phebs 'byor thub/ de skabs bkra shis lhun po'i bla brang gi phyi nang 'dzin dbang mtha' dag gzhung bskos dza sag bla ma blo bzang rin chen te yongs grags su (skyabs dbyings 'brug rgyal zer ) las bya gzhung mgron thub bstan mchog grub dang / phun tshogs rgya mtsho/ skal bzang lhun grub/par khang sogs kyis dbang bsgyur byed kyi yod pas de dag gis 'go byas pa'i 'og sku gdung za ma tog re zhig kun gzigs rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang du gdan bzhugs thog mchod sdong gsar pa srid gsum mdzes rgyan gsar du bzhengs rgyu'i rdo shing ar po'i las gra do dam pa'i 'gan 'khur 311

gnang ba ma zad/ phyi'i gtsug lag khang rmang bcas legs par grub pa'i rjes su gser zangs rgya phub las grwa'i bzo rigs kyi 'go 'dzin gnang thog rang sger gyi gser gang yod kyang zhal 'debs su phul/ dngul gdung gi rgyu 'gro'i do dam las khungs gdung 'bul khang gi gtso bo'i 'go 'dzin gras byas shing / sku gdung dang lhan bcar sku chas gras su rtsa che'i hor gos rnying ma dang / sku gdung gi rgyu 'gror dmigs pa'i gser do po bcu gnyis/gzhan yang rgya dngul sogs dang / khra rigs rtsa che'i gras sogs mdo smad bzhugs sgar nang sgang nas lag 'dzin dang sprags rtsis sprod byas pa ltar slar bzhugs sgar phyir phebs mtshams zur du rtsis zhu zhu dgos yod lugs rgyu mtshan bshad nas don du sku chas rnams dza sag bla mar rtsis sprod ma byas shing /mchod khang gi rgyu 'gror 'os rigs rnams btang ba phud de byings lhan bcar phyag mdzod sgang zhes par zur bkar byas/ sku gdung gdan zhu'i skabs su mgron gnyer chen mo'i ming 'khur byed mus la bkra shis lhun por 'byor mtshams gzhung bskos dza bla nas kyang go ming rang 'jags su bzhag ste mgron che'i las khur mu mthud byas/ mchod sdong srid gsum mdzes rgyan rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bzhengs legs grub byung ba'i bdag rkyen du lha rtse rdzong dang ngam ring rdzong lo lnga re'i kha 'dzin sprad pa ma zad/ do dam las grwa'i lo rgyun phogs thob rtsis lam ltar 'brur phab nas 'bru khal stong phrag kha shas kyang mnga' khongs rdzong gzhis khag la cha gses kyis sprod len chog pa'i bka' 'dzin yang sprad/ de ltar thog mtha' bar gsum du rang gi lto gos chos gsum gyi bdag po paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i sri zhu legs par bsgrubs shing / gzhung bskos dza bla las bcas kyis kyang mig lam du 'gro po byed pa dang / mi tshang mar bstun mkhas dang / drang tshugs/ las don hur 312

bsgrub/ lhag par las dkar nag gi blang dor tshul bzhin du byed pa/btsan shed za bed gtan nas mi byed pa/ rang sger gyi dpal 'byor 'du 'god bya rgyur 'dun pa med par 'dod chung chog shes kho nar bsten pa dang /mchod 'bul dang / sbyin gtong bya rgyur spro semasawe ba bcasakyi dbang gis rang gi shag tshang yang grwa rkyang rang ga ba lta bu zhig las mtho riyosku drag gi khyim tshang rnam pa gang yang mngo du med pa de ltar lo ngo mang po 'das pa'i mthar paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po mdo smad zi ling gis mdor sku glu bltamalopa dang / krung hwa min go srid gzhung gis ched du sku tshab btang ste a mdo rje sku 'bum dgon du paṇa chen rin po che gser khrir mnga' gsol gyi mdzad sgo gnang zhing / de rjes ring por ma thogs—par gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og go min tang gi log spyod srid dbang rtsa gtor btang thog krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes rjes ma'o kru'u zhi dang tang krung dbya nga gi byams brtse'i thugs 'khur 'og paṇa chen rin po che ston 'khor rang gdan bkra shis lhun por phebs gtan 'a khel ba bzhin bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen rin po che'i gdan zhu gnyis pa'i gras su rim bzhin don khang bsod nams stobs rgyal dang / phebs 'go don khang skal bzang bde skyid sogs dang mnyam du bod lcags yos lo'i zla 11nang bkra shis lhun po nas thon te nag chur gdan zhur bskyod/ bod chu 'brug lo'icizla gnyis pa ra paṇa chen rin po che nag chur zhabs sor 'khod nye'i skabs nyin gcig gi sar mtshams zhur bcar ba dang / mgron che'i las 'gan sngar musaltar bgyis te skabs de'i mdzad sgo mtha' dag sngar lugs ltar go rim ma 'khrug pa mdzad/ gzhung sgor gyi dos khal mang che ba 'dam gzhung brgyud nas gtsang du btang / paṇa chen rin po che ston 'khor nag chu nas rim gyis lha ldan du 313

phebs rgyu'i lam bar du rwa sgreng bla brang nas lde 'chang blo bzang nyi ma ched btang thog bka' gdams pa'i gdan sa byang rwa sgrong du gnas gzigs su spyan 'dren zhus don bzhin rwa sgreng du phebs/ skabs der chibs bsu ser sbreng dang thab bsu sogs kyis mdzad sgo'i rim pa legs par bskyangs/ de nas stag lung dang 'phan po brgyud nas lcags ri phra mo zhes pa'i bzhugs sgar du bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas sngar srol ltar bka' blon zur khang pa sogs paṇa chen rin po cher phebs bsu dang 'tshams 'dri mjal phyag tu 'byor par paṇa chen rin po ches bka' blon rnam par 'tshams lan bka' bsgyur sogs zhur bab legs par bsgrubs/ de nas paṇa chen rin po che lha sar phebs gong re zhig sku 'bum thang zhes lha sa'i shar phyogs kyi sa'i char bzhugs sgar nyin gsum bca' ma mdzad/ de skabs twa la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa dang thog ma'i zhal 'dzoms gnang rgyu'i mdzad rim gtan 'khel ltar dge rgan de nyid rtse mkhan mgron che ba pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan gyi bste gnas su ngo phebs kyis mdzad sgo dngos gzhi gnang phyogs thad kyi go bsdur gnang / sku 'bum thang bzhugs sgar nas lha sar chibs bsgyur nyin phebs 'byams thog ston 'khor chibs hrag rgyas pa'i lugs su byas/ krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi thab bsu dang / bod sdod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi dpon dmag gi phebs bsu zab rgyas gnang ba'i mdzad sgo dang / sngar lam bod sa gnas srid gzhung thab bsu'i thog rtse shod kyi 'tshams zhu dang / bka' blon rnam pas gtsos gzhung zhabs ser skya gtos che mjal phyag tu bcar ba'i mdzad sgo/ lha sar rtse pho brang po ta la dang / nor gling skal bzang pho brang so sor tā la paṇa chen rnam gnyis mjal 'phrad snga rjes dang / dkar spro'i mdzad sgo legs par bsgrub/ de 314

nas gan pa la brgyud gtsang ljongs su chibs bsgyur skabs phebs lam du sa gnas so so'i mjal bcar ba mchog dman mtha' dag gi 'tshams zhu'i mjal dar 'bul slog dang / gnas gzigs sogs mdzad sgo khag gi bkod sgrig stangs 'dzin zhu sgo rnams legs par bsgrubs/ gzhis rtse'i nye 'dabs lhan lnga legs 'gro'i bzhugs sgar nas phyi nyin bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sar paṇa chen rin po che zhabs sor 'khod rgyur phebs bsu zhu sgo'i zhib gsal brda tho btang / de nas gsang sngagaso gling du bkras lhun bla brang gzhung nas thab bsu mjal gur rma bya chen mo zhes pa sgron phub kyi sar zhabs 'bring yongs rdzogs dang / grwa tshang lnga'i mkhan slob bla sprul khagardzong gzhis khag sogs kyi chibs bsu dang gzhis rtse rdzong sdod dang / kha bal mi sna mjal bcar sogs mdzad sgo'i go rim khag 'chug med legs par gnyer/ de nas myang chu'i zam pa shar gyi nub sne dang por rtse mgon khang pa ‘‘dga' ldan srid gsum rnam rgyal gling ’’zhes tshogs yongs nas ser sbreng gis mtshon bkras lhun gdan sa'i nub ngos che can rgyal sgo'i bar phebs lam g.yas g.yon gnyis su lha sde mi sde'i ser sbreng dang bro gzhas sogs phebs bsu'i bkod pa tshar du dngar ba'i khrod paṇa chen rin po che phebs 'byams nang phebs bzhugs thog chibs zhabs chibs hrag rgyas pa dang bcas chibs bsgyur te chu 'brug bod zla 5pa'i tshes 1nyin pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por zhabs 'khod dang / phebs gdong dkar spro'i mdzad sgo legs par bskyangs / de nas khri phebs dngos gzhi'i mdzad sgor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku tshab mkhan drung twa bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen ngo las bcas nas gzhung gi rten 'brel dkar spro ston chen dang / bla brang gzhung gyi dkar spro ston chen sogs mdzad sgo yongs rdzogs 315

phun tshogs lugs legs su grub/ de ltar paṇa chen rin po che nag chu nas lha sa dang / gan pa la/ rgyal rtse bcas brgyud gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sar zhabs sor legs par 'khod pa'i bar gyi mdzad sgo mtha' dag gi nang du mgron gnyer chen mo'i 'khur 'khri'i 'gan babs zhu sgo tshang ma lhur len legs grub zhus pa ma zad/ shing rta ( 1954) lor paṇa chen rin po che mes rgyal nang sar chibs bsgyur gnang skabs kyang lhan bcar chibs zhabs gras su phebs/ shing lug ( 1kha55 ) lo'i lo mjug tu mgron gnyer che mo'i las gnas 'phos te gzim dpon mkhan po'i las gnas su bsko grezhag gnang / spyi lo 1956lo ste bod me sprel lor rgya gar srid gzhung gis gdan zhu ltare bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa sku mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya 'khor ba'i dus dran mdzad sgor paṇa chen rin po che rgya gar du chibs bsgyur skabs lhan bcar chibs zhabs gras su phebs/gzim che'i las 'gan ni paṇa chen rin po che'i sku'i na bza' nyer spyad rnams bdag gces do dam bya rgyu gtso bo'i thog rgyum/ du sku gam du nar mar bcar sdod dang / rtse mdzod sbug gi las ka'ang bod me phag ( 1959)lo bar gcig lcogs 'gan 'khur gnang / lo der bod kyi mtho rim log spyod shog khas bslangs pa'i drag po'i ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang ba dang chabs cig dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byed 'go tshugs shing / de skabs na tshod rgas pa'i skabs kyis paṇa chen rin po che mes rgyal nang sar phebs skabs chibs zhabs su bcar rgyu sogs sku bcar zhabs 'degs zhu ma thub par rang khyim du ngal gso dal sdod gnang /spyi lo 1rdzo60lo'i zla ba 2pa'i tshes 1rdonyin gzhis rtse kron hru'u yi li'u kron yon gyis 'go khrid pa'i bkras lhun dgon du dmangs gtso'i bcos 31(〉

bsgyur las don ru khag ched du 'byor te dgon par dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul spel skabs dgon nang du mtho rim mi sna khag cig la so so'i nag nyes la gzhigs pa'i 'gag pa 'thab rtsod dang khrims gcod sogs ci rigs pa 'phog yod kyang / gzim che de nyid la mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char nyung ba dang bcas dgag 'thab khrims gcod sogs gang yang ma 'khel bar rang khyim du sngar bzhin bde bar gnas thab pa byang mthar spyi lo ༄ ༄1kha64lor snyun 'das su gyur pa red/ ) 317

mnga' ris sgar dpon gnyis la nang khrul — rgyugs dgos skor/mnga' ris sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus 'tshol bsdu tshogs chung nas/nga dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur ma byas gong sgar dpon nang khral zhes pa'i khral rigs rgyug phyogs te/〈 1〉nang khral zhes pa ni g.yog po zer ba'i yul sde'i rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang gis mnga' ris dbang bsgyur rjes srid dbang sra brtan dang mtha' mtshams brtan srung yong ched sog po'i dmag mi nyi shu rtsa lnga mnga' ris sku srung du bzhag par/ de'i 'go 'dzin du thu chi ji thang kha shos zer ba'i go gnas sprad de mnga' ris su bca' sdod byed bcug (sgar 'char can gyi rta gzhung nang gsal dgung ru dang po de yin pa red/) sog dmag rnams yun ring de gar bsdad stabs sde tsho de'i bu dang / bu mo 'brel ba byung nas so ga smad zer ba'i sde zhig chags pa red zer srol yod/ de nas bzung dmas/ mi nyi shu rtsa lnga gtan 'jags kyis sgar depon gyi bka' ltar rdzong khag so sor bka' rgya bskyel rgyu sogs gar dgos khral 'ul pa zhig tu gyur pa red/ rgyal po nye skor gyi khral zhes pa'i dpe ltar nang khral sog smad 318

pas 'khri sgrub byed dgos pa ste/ sgar dpon gnyis la gzhung lug chig stong la lug pa them dud drug gis lo re'i dgun dpyid gnyis la tshwa len thengs gnyis dang / dbyar ston gnyis la tshwa tshong thengs gnyis bcas las 'gan grub dgos pa dang rgyun du lug 'tsho skyong byed dgos kyi yod pa ma zad/bor brlag gyur te mgo rwa lags gsum rtsis sprod byed yas med tshe rkang tshab 'jal dgos/ so rug them dud bzhi nas she khral ma mo rer she mar nyag lnga dang / ra ma rer mar nyag lnga re/ phyugs phrug gson tshad ma gcig bu gcig yin pa/ sems can bor brlag song ba dang / spyang khyis bsad pa/shi ba sogs la pags pa rwa tham sbyar ma rtsis sprod yas med na/ re re bzhin tshab skyin sprod dgos pa dang / ma gcig bu gcig gi phyugs tho nang gsal gyi dngos yod phud/ chad pa rnams la rkang tshab sgrig dgos/ lug dang ra'i bal spu med pa rnams la rin phab kyis dngul sprod dgos/ dper na so rug them dud gcig la cha mtshon nas bshad na/ kho rang sger la'ang ra lug brgya lhag tsam dang / g.yag bco lnga yan/ rta lnga drug tsam yod na'ang lo gnyis gsum tsam la gong gsal ra lug rta g.yag rnams chad khrar shor nas mgo ma thug par sde phan tshun la chad khra'i mthun rkyen re slong du 'gro dgos thug pa'i gnas tshul mang po byung 'dug sgar dpon gnyis la 'bri 'tsho mkhan them dud bzhi yod pa 'bri be'u ldan rer she mar khal gsum re dang / yar ma rer khal gnyis phyur ba khal bre gsum/ rtsid pa khu lu ma tshang ba rnams la dngul phab kyis rin sprod dgos pa dang / bor brlag dang / shi ba/ spyang khyis zas pa sogs kha pags pa dang / rwa tham rtsis sprod yas mede na re re bzhin tshab sgrig byed dgos/ rta khal sa tshigs khag gsum la grong pa gsum sdod dgos/ sa tshigs re la ru'i khal drug re 'gro 319

ba'i sa zhing yod kyang zhing rtswa rnams sgar dpon gnyis la 'degs rgya chig stong brgyad brgya rin med sprod dgos pa ma zad/ rtswa chad na rin phab kyi dngul sprod dgos/ sgar dpon gnyis dbyar sa dgun sar 'gro bskyod skabs sne len nyin bcu gnyis zhu dgos pas khang pa/ gdan chas/ thab chas bcas la gla phab phyogs rer dngul sum cu re rtsis bsdoms dngul drug bcu la dngul rer ṭam dkar gnyis re rtsis bsdoms ṭam dkar brgya dang nyi shu dang / rta thab me shing / bzhu mar 'jal zhu bcas sprod dgos/ sgar dpon gnyis la skam shing sgrug mi gnyis/ rdo sur/ rdung 'bud mi gnyis/yig skyel mi gcig khrung zhu bu mo bzhi/ rngod 'thag bu mo gnyis/ shon ma bu mo dgu/ chang g.yog bu mo gnyis bcas gtong rgyu'i khral rgyugs dgos thog sgar dpon gnyis kyis srus sgyur ja dang / bod zog sna tshogs la rin gong chen po byas te 'bam tshong len dgos pa/ de dag la rin 'bab 'jal sprod ma thub na rta g.yag ra lug sogs la rin gong brtsi 'gro bka' gang gnang gis 'jal sgrub byed dgos kyi yod/ 〈 2 〉 gzhan yang khral rigs sne len sgrig cha sogs 'grigs min gyi don du mi la nyes rdung gtong gi yod pa/ dper na spyi lo 1rdzo40lor ha sag kha pa thog nas sgar dpon gyi rta drel tshang ma 'ded skabs bod dmag bcu tsam dang / bka' shod kyi g.yog po blo bzang nam mkha' dgra lag tu shor ba ma zad/ sgar dpon gyi las tham chung ba de yang la dwags la 'khyer phyin pa red/ de'i rjes 'ded la bka' shod pa'i phyag mdzod phyin te tshur log skabs sgar dgun sar sog smad kyis sne len sgrig cha cung zad gra 'grigs min skor sog smad kyi mi rgan gsum la rta lcags lnga bcu re btang ba red/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du phebs rjes sa gnas srid 320

gzhung gis legs bcos las khungs zer ba btsugs te spyi lo 1952lo tshun sgar dpon gnyis gzhung 'dzin bum pa sib blug yin zer nas sgar dpon gyis dngos zog 'bam tshang spus sgyur byed srol bzhin med par phyin pa dang /gong gsal she khag gi phyugs phrug gson tshad ma gsum bu gnyis zer ba dang /dngul bun skyed kha lnga drug 'gro/ 'bru bun skyed kha bdun brgyad 'gro bar yang du btang ba ma zad/ bcings 'grol dmag dgun sar phebs nas sog smad khul lo re bzhin son 'bru skyed med bun gtong gnang ba dang /rtswa shing sogs la rin 'bab rda yang sprod pa lhag par dbul phongs rnams la skyed med dngul bun btang ba sogs la brten rim bzhin mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba sngar las tog tsam yag tu song zhing / spyi lo 1959lor dmangs ga tso'i bcos bsgyur byas te gong gsal gyi khral rigs mtha' dag med par bzos shing nga tsho sog smad mang tshogs kyang bod ljongs yongs dang 'dra bar zhing bran lam lugs kyi lcags sgrog las grol nas rang khyim rang bdag dang rgyal khab kyi bdag por gyur pa red/ gong gsal sngar gyi bshu gzhog lam lugs rtsa med btang rjes dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byed skabs mi dmangs rnams sngar gyi gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog 'og nas thar ba'igyidaga' sems kyis sog smad mi gcig kyang phyi rgyal la phyin med pa'i thog dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur yang legs sgrub zin pa red/〈 2〉phyi khral skor/ phyi khral zhes pa sgar dpon gnyis dang gser gzhung gnyis/ rdzong khag bzhi/ tshwa sho sogs la sdod sgrig gdan chas cha tshang ba gra sgrig byed dgos pa/ de yang mnga' bdag la zhabs zhu byed bde ba'i ched du yul tsho bgos nas 'gan len dgos shing / dper na 'du khongs tsho gsum zhes gnam ru/ mar lhas/ chu bi/ dga' dga'/321

glang bcu bcas tsho gcig la khral rkang sum bcu so gnyis dang phyed/ sku gnyen/ glang ngar/ grwa tshang mi ser/ ngo log bde mchog gzhung pa/ chos sde bcas la khral rkang sum bcu so lnga dang phyed/ sog stod dang /sog smad gnyis la khral rkang nyi shu rtsa brgyad bcas bsdoms khral rkang dgu bcu go drug yod pa/ de'i 'go byed 'du khongs 'go pa bzhi yod pa ni sog stod 'go pa gcig sog smad 'go pa gcig gnam ru tsho pa la 'bo/ pa gcig grwa tshang mi ser tsho la 'go pa gcig bcas 'go pa ba'i bcas kyis 'gan 'khur nas mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyi gnya' gnon bshu gzhog dang len byed dgos pa ste/ sgar dpon gnyis dang / gzhung tshong /gser dpon/ rtsa mda' tshwa tho/ shing thog 'phar sgrub/ byang bsam yas kar me dang / lho bsam yas kar me bsdu mkhan khag gnyis/ bo gdong rgan chen/ sa bcud bum skyel a drung / dngul rta a drung (gzhung tshong dngul len mkhan )ru thog tshwa sho/ ding ri rgya phog (gor sha'i chings dngul bsdu mkhan ) bcas la bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sbug dam dang /bka' tham sbyar ma'i bka' gtan gzhir bzung sgrig cha khang mig bco brgyad la gdan lcog dang / skyod chas/ me shing bcas dang / thab g.yog mi nyi shu/ gser dpon/ gzhung tshong tshwa sho la rta g.yog mi gsum/ de min rngod 'thag byed mi bsdoms bco lnga/ lo gcig nang rta 'ul brgya dang bcu med lnga yas mas dang / dos khal bdun cu tsam/ dos mi bdun cu bcas dang/ de min sgrig khang nyams gso dang / ko sbang srung mi/ rgyun bu dras mi/ do po rgyag mkhan so gas mi grangs brgya dang nyi shu tsam/ rtsa mda' tshwa sho la khral tshwa lug rgyab dgu rer ṭam dkar gcig re/ tshwa lug bco lnga la ṭam dkar gnyis re/ gso lug bzhi la ṭam dkar gcig322

gzhis ra gzhis lug zhes ra drug la ṭam dkar gcig re/ lug bzhi la ṭam dkar gcig dang / tshwa tshong 'gro skabs kyi ra lug grangs tshad nas phyir log skabs grangs tshad ma lon na mgo khral zhes lug rer ṭam dkar gnyis re bcas sprod dgos/ yang la dwags lo phyag nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung la rten 'bul shing thog dang / kha che sha skam/ 'dur ma bcas 'bul mi thengs gcig la rta 'ul bcu gsum dang / dos khal gnyis brgya/dos mi bcu/ phyir log skabs sgar dbyar sa nas la dwags nyi ma mun sa cha bar rta 'ul bcu gsum dang / dos khal ma brgya/ dos mi bcu/ thab g.yog gnyis/ sgrig cha dang me shing bcas gtong dgos/ yang ho mi lo phyag lo gnyis nang thengs rer rta 'ul lnga dang / khal ma bzhi bcu/ dos mi gsum/ sgrig cha/ me shing / thab g.yog mi gcig bcas dang /yang lo gsum pho nya zhes khu nu nas a ka ru 'bul mi la sgar dbyar sa bar rta 'ul gcig dang / khal ma gsum/ lho dod tsha bog sar mar spor do/rtsam pa bre gang re sprod dgos/ sgar dpon gnyis la tang thung mi brgyad/chang ma gnyis/ sgo ra ba gcig thab chen mi gnyis/ sgar dbyar dgun gzhung khang la lo ltar nyams gso bye da mi sum cu so gnyis kyis dus yun zla ba gnyis tsam byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ dbyar sar khang gnyer gnyis dgos pa gnam ru nas gtong rgyu dang / dgun sar khang gnyer gnyis dgos pa sog smad kyis gtong dgos/ 'du khongs rtsis rgyag skabs dang / bzhi zlar rtsis rgyag skabs sgar dpon gyi ngo tshab gnyis dang /'du khongs bla dpon gnyis/ 'go pa bzhi bcas nas lo 'khor rtsis rgyag nyin bdun ring gi mi chen zhabs gla dngul gcig dang / (dngul rer ṭam dkar gnyis re/)mi chen gsol dod dngul bco lnga/ mi dmangs lto dod 323

dngul nyi shu/ sgrig chas gla dngul lnga/ rdo'u gtong mkhan la nyin rer dngul lnga re rtsis nyin bdun la dngul bsdoms sum cu so lnga bcas sprod dgos/ bod zla bzhi pa'i nang sgar lha mo khang du bkra shis sgang dgon gyi zhabs brtan bka' 'gyur zla ba gcig klog ring thab g.yog gnyis dang /me shing ldeng nges gtong dgos/ gong gsal du khongs rtsis rgyag skabs khral gyi ming sna tshogs yod cing sog smad la khral pa nyung ba dang / khral rkang che bar brten lo rer dngul 'bab dngul lnga brgya/ drug brgya tsam chad pa de sgar dpon gyis len pa'i rde'u thog nas sog smad la bkab ste dngul rer ṭam dkar gnyis re rtsis lo ltar 'jal sgrub dgos shing / gal srid 'jal sgrub ma thub na/ gan rgya bris nas phyi lo bzhi lnga 'gro'i skyed kha dang bcas 'jal dgos kyi yod/ bzhi zur gsar rnying gnyis kyis rtsis rgyag la 'brong pa/ gtsod tsho/ rgya srug ru thog bcas the dgos kyi yod pa red/sgar dpon gnyis nas gzhung pa ma zan nas bcu kha bral bsdus zhes lo ltar ra lug bcu re'i sa nas ra lug gcig re/ g.yag ngo grangs re'i sa nas ṭam dkar gcig re/ le na 'degs khal brgyad bcu/ mar 'degs khal brgyad bcu/ lu tshar lnga brgya bcas dang / dkar stong sha rgyu zhes g.yag gcig dang / lug nyi shu bsdu len byed cing / khral bsdus ngo g.yog drug la sdod sgrig cha tshang dang / sdod yun ring sha mar thud sogs mang po zhig sprod dgos kyi yod pa red/ ru thog a gnam byang ma tsho pa nas bdun brgya tshar gsum zhes pa'i khral ste ṭam dkar bdun brgya dang / bal rgyab bdun brgya/ mar nyag bdun brgya/ dpon g.yog drug la sdod yun zla ba gcig la cha bzhag nas gsol dod gzhung gnyer gnyis la ṭam dkar bcu re dang / g.yog po bzhi la ṭam dkar lnga re/ khyim du re nas thud 324

rdar re dang / kha btags re/ lam 'khel yul sde rnams la ngo tshong zhes pa'i rin thang 'os mtshams min pa'i dngos zog spus bsgyur gtong ba/'bong pa zang phug sa tshig la sdod sgrigs/ rta thab cha tshang thog sgrig dod zhes ṭam dkar brgya dang nyi shu/ mjal zhu lug sha khog gcig dang kha btags gcig dge rgyas nas lo gsum rer leb dngul zhes sgor lnga brgya lhag tsam/ ru thog nas bcu kha zhes pa'i dngul sgor brgya/ spu hreng rdzong khongs nas rtsam khag zhes lo ltar 'bru khal brgya/ dkar dum bzhes dod ces sgar 'char can gyi chang rgyur 'bru khal brgyad cu spu hreng tsho drug la phad rin zhes ja sbag drug sprad de/ spu phad nyis brgya bsdu ba/ de bzhin rtsam pa dkar po dang / ser po/ chu 'dur bcas khyon bsdoms spu hreng khral bsdu tshur log skabs khral bsdus dngos po g.yag rgyab brgya dang brgyad cu tsam yod pa/ de dag thams cad sru hreng nas sgar dbyar sa bar rta zam sa tshigs rim pas skyel dgos/ sgar dpon gsar 'byor skabs bka' gtan yod pa'i dpon khag dang / dgon sde/ yul tsho sayin na'ang bka' gtan khung btsan yod med la gzhigs pas ṭam dkar brgyad nas ṭam dkar nyis brgya bar bka' gtan sgrub chag ces sprod— dgos pa ma zad/'bul rta'i 'dod ces ṭam dkar drug cu re sprod dgos/ thab gsar spus bsgyur zhes yul tsho rer ja sgam gsum nas bzhi bar spus bsgyur btang ste lugs mthun gyi rigs las ldab mang pos mtho ba btsan shed kyis len pa bcas so/〈 4〉khral rigs dang / bu lon bsdu mkhan gyi skor/ mnga' ris bskor gsum nas gzhung ja ja sgam lnga brgya la ja sgam rer rin sgor drug brgya re rtsis nasakābasdu ba dang / gzhung 'dzin bum pa sib blugs ma byas gong 325

sgar dpon gnyis gsar slebs skabs thab gsar spus bsgyur zhes dngos rigs sna tshogs tsho pa so so dang / mi ngo so sor spus tshong gtong ba'i rin 'bab srid gzhung gi mnga' ris bskor gsum la rgyun ldan 'bul tshan so so'i khral rigs sna tshogs kyi dngul khral rnams sgar 'char can skabs bskor gsum 'dzoms sar dus gcig la sprod dgos de dang chabs cig 'bam tshong gi dngul 'bab rnams sprod dgos par brten mi mang che bas 'brog las yongs 'bab ji yod sprad kyang mgo ma thug par phyi rgyal rong pa'i sa nas bun g.yar gyis rta g.yag ra lug sogs gta' mar 'jog pa dang / kha shas skyes med 'chi med du bzhag pa/ kha shas skyes yod 'chi yod du bzhag pa/kha shas khral 'jal dmigs med par phyi rgyal la bros byol du 'gro dgos pa/kha shas zla gcig tsam thon skyed bzhag nas ri la bros dgos pa sogs kyi gnas tshul ha cang mang po thon gyi ciyod pa red/ der brten mang tshogs kyi dpal 'byor nyams rgud du 'gro ba lta ci smos/ mi la rdung rdeg sna tshogs kyis mi ni khyim stong gi gnas tshul yang mang po byung yod/sgar dbyar sar phyi rgyal gyi tshong 'dus tshugs pa'i skor/ bod zla lnga pa'i zla mjug tsam nas bod zla dgu pa'i zla mjug tsam bar nyi ti rong pa/skyo gnam rong pa/ khu nu/ rgya gar khams pa (bod rigs)/ spi ri/lcags nag la dwags/ ga sha sogs nas tshong zog ras cha sna tshogs dang 'go snam/ ther ma/ bu ram/ sbi li sogs mngar cha sna tshogs/'bras/ gro zhib/ 'bru/ bra phye/ dzo skor sogs 'bru rigs sna tshogs/spi ti nas rta/ tshos sna tshogs/ shing 'bras/ sba sho rgun 'brum/ snum nag ya snum/ a rag dkar po dang / smug po/ kha che sha skam/ ga bur/ dom mkhris sogs sman rigs sna tshogs/ gser dngul/ g.yu 326

byur/ mu tig gzi sogs nor bu'i rigs kyi rgyan /cha sna tshogs bcas pa khyer yong gi yod pa ma zad/ so so'i ngo shes la lag rtags sprod pa dang /de bzhin mnga' ris phyogs nas zhing 'brog tshong pa sa phyogs kun nas 'tshang ka shig shig gis yong ba/ gzhan yang dbus gtsang phyogs nas gser dpon dang / tshwa sho/ gzhung tshong pa bcas der yong nas rang 'dod ltar tshong rgyag gi yod/ bod phyogs nas thon pa'i tshong zog gtso bo ni bal sogs spu rigs dang / lug rta/ snam bu spu phrug zhwa mo rgya se/dkar yol/ gdan/ skra shub/ bod rum smag khran smag shog bcas yod pa de dag bal dang / le na/ spu bal/ ra lug rta sogs dang brje res byed kyi yod cing / rgya gar gyi tshong don gar sha dpon zhes pa de'ang zla ba gcig tsam sdod kyi yod la/ phyi rgyal tshong pa rnams log khar rang gi ngo shes so sor dngal dang tshong zog lhag ma ba lon du gtong 'jog raring riring byas nas log 'gro gi yod wa bcas so rī 327

mtsho sna'i tshong 'dus khag gsum gyi lo rgyus rags rim/ sbub rnga5 sbub chos —/ rnga5 bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'dir sngon ma sangs srun dgus bzung ba'i yul gru rgyun du na bun gyis gtibs pa mtsho dang skyes shing gis sa/nga ba'i nye sar brag ri'i ba gam brtsegs pa'i sna zhig mthong ba de'i byang na ne+e ra g.yu mtsho/ lho na skye chen g.yu mtsho gnyis kyi sne mor gyur pas mtsho sna zhes grags pa'i yal de bzhin lho mon yal dang bod kyi mtshams/ sbas yal skyid mo rir mi rigi pa rirang ljongs sam sa gzhi gser gyi yol go dang 'dra ba/ de'i shar phyogs na gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku'i gnas dom tshang / lho na gsung gi gnas gzig tshang /nub na thugs kyi gnas stag tshang / byang na yon tan gyi gnas sgom pa phug chu 'go na 'phrin las kyi gnas dkar po zangs grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi'i ya gyal gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i phyag rjes khra lam mer yod la ri brgyud ni stod mnga' ris dang 'brel ba'i ljongs/ spang ljongs yangs shing rgya che la dbyar dus me tog sna tshogs bzhad de tshon khra can gyi khra tshom bkod pa ltar yid du 'ong ba/ phyogs mtshams kyi sa 'dzin lhun po kun tu rab dkar ka shi'i 328

ras gos kyis bar mtshams med par klubs pa ltar mdzes la brjid chags pa/yan lag brgyad ldan gyi 'bab chu lhung lhung du rgyugs pa ni g.ya' chu/gangs chu/ rdza chu yod la tsha nus can gyi chu yang yod/ g.yas g.yon ri 'debs kyi dri ldan shugs pa ba lu su lu sogs kyi gseb nas phyugs rigs dkar nag ra rtse ngom zhing skad sgra sgrog pa'i yul ljongs der sngon tshong dpon nor bu bzang po bod ljongs nas lho mon yul dang / 'brug yul sogs la tshong gi bya bar phebs dus tshong shag mdzad de thog ma'i tshong 'dus byung tshul de ltar yin par grags shing / de nas bzung phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas rang rang yul thon dngos zog rnam grangs du ma 'khyer te brje res kyi tshong 'dus tshugs pa'i srol dar/ ngag rgyun du tshong dpon nor bu bzang po mon yul du phebs dus g.yu drel gyi zhog do gcig mtsho nang du lhung pa red ces skye chen g.yu mtsho'i nang g.yu 'dra ba'i rdo pha bong zhig yod/ lo gcig nang tshong 'dus khag gsum tshugs srol yod pa ste/ zla 5pa'i tshes 15nas tshes 25bar dang / zla 5pa'i tshes 25nas zla 7pa'i tshes 15bar/ zla 11pa'i tshes 15nas tshes 2 5bar bcas dus tshod so sor nyin bcu re tshugs/ skabs der tshong 'dus la yong mkhan gras/ lho 'brug pa dang /mon pa rigs/ lha sa ba/ rtsed thang / dwags kong / yar lung khul/'phyongs rgyas/ gnyal byar sbyor gsum/ e lha rgya ri sogs yul gru khag nas so so'i dngos rdzas thon khungs ji yod dang / yul lung so so'i lag rtsal khyad chos kyi dngos rigs sna tshogs 'khyer te brje tshong byed pa'i tshong 'dus gra rgyas sne mang phun sum tshogs po zhig 'tshogs srol yod/ tshong 'dus der yong mkhan tshong 'grul khag gcig rang rang gi gnas tshang la sdod cing khag gcig spang thang la gur 'phub ste sdod mkhan de tsho nam mkha'i skar 329

tshogs ji bzhinatshospang gshongs der khra lam mer khengs/ mon 'brug rnams ni sngar lam bzhin gnas khag ces pa khral pa che gras kyi khang pa rang la sdod dgos pa ma zad/ mon nas thon pa'i dngos zog dang bza' bca' rnams kyi 'jal byed 'bo bre dang / 'degs byed rgya srang gi tshod 'dzin gnas khag gi mi snas byed pa las zog bdag la dbang cha med/ tshong 'dus de'i ring mi tshogs che la 'khrug cha dod cing / bza' khang yod la/ de bzhin ja khang / chang khang sogs kyang yod/ bar bar la spro gseng bya yul spang gshongs g.yu yi bcal du bkram pa'i steng dkar dmar khra gsum gyi me tog khra 'tshom bkod pa 'dra ba'i yid 'ong rang byung gi mdzes pa'i steng ro bcud ldan pa'i zas rigs sna 'dzoms 'khyer nas spro gseng dang rtsed 'jo byed pa/g.yas g.yon du bsil zhing 'jam pa'i rgyugs chu dang / gzugs khams la 'khrod pa'i tsha nus chu tshan yang yod la sgyu rtsal gyi glu gzhas dang lha mo'i 'khrab ston yang byed srol yod/ de bzhin dgon pa rtse dang / 'gro 'dul gling btsun dgon/ brag lha bkra shis lha khang sogs su rten mjal dang chos kyi byed sgo spel yul yod/ tshong 'dus snga rjes su khag gsum gyi khrom ra'i thog yul phyogs so so'i thon khungs kyi dngos zog rnam grangs dper na/ 'brug yul dang mon nas thon pa'i bza' bca'i rigs kham bu/ rgun 'brum/g.yer ma/ a shong / so lo dmar sngon/ sga se/ sga rmug ban ta li shi/ smon cung / kong po/ tsha lu/ se 'bru/ hong kwa'o/ bur shing /mar/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi/ phyur rul/ 'bras a su/ dmar 'bras/chu 'bras/ sman 'bras/ sung sung sba ra/ mog ru/ 'bras 'ba' phye/shab li/ 'bras yos sogs yod/sman rigs gras a ru/ ba ru/ skur ru/ gla rtsi/ dom mkhris/330

spo dkar/ gu gul/ tsan dan dkar dmar/ ne+e ge/ tir/ dbang lag shu dag me tog tsam pa ka sogs so/ khyim mkho'i dngos rigs gras/ smyug zeb/ shing phor/ ko la/'dzab phor/ dkar shing / smyug phyar/ cha sgam/ rgya lcog zangs chas sna tshogs/ tshos sna tshogs/ 'bu ras/ a thi kha dmar/ kha dkris/ sha pa khra'o/ 'ja' sgrig i sga bu/ pang thag lham sgrogashog bu/ smyug mdong / stag lpags/ gzig lpags/ rgya lpags/ kha sha'i pags pa/ gung lpags/ khra pang gi lcog rtse/ shing dkrol/ sgron thal/ shing chas gdung ma/ mdong mo/ zo bo/ ja mdong / smyug khrog smyug hril/ sig mda' smyug rmod mdzob lar sogs dang /dwags kong dang byar nas/ mar/ kham star/ phyur zhibo/ phyur skam/rtsam phor/ slang lcog rdo khog sgye phyar/ sle'u/ rta drel/ mdzo/gla rtsi/ shwa ba'i khrag rwa/ yar lung / gnyal sogs nas 'bru/ snum/rtsam pa/ gro zhib/ rta chag snam bu/ spu bal/ sha phrog rta drel/bong bu/ g.yag lug sogs mtsho sna'i tshong 'dus khag gsum po der yul gru so so'i dngos zog rnam grangs mang la bod rigs mang tshogs la spyod go che ba sogs kyi khyad chos mi 'dra ba du ma yod stabs bod rigs mang tshogs rnams kyis so so'i mkhos 'byor la gzhigs pa'i mkho dngos rgya nom pa nyo sgrub kyis rang yul du phyir log byed/ mtsho sna'i yul gru der de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid 'dzin khrims snon byed pa mtsho sna rdzong rtse shod gnyis te/ rdzong rtse dga' ldan shar byang gnyis nas yong dgos pa dang shod ni gzhung zhabs shod drung gcig yong srol zung sbrel gyis khral bsdu khrims snon byed pa dang / da dung zur du mtsho 331

sna 'bras sgrub ces bla phyag jo lags gcig gis so so'i khyab khongs la khral bsdu khrims snon byed/ 'brug yul dang / mon nas thon pa'i 'bras tshang ma 'bras khang rang gi bsdu nyo byed pa las khrom ra'i thog 'bras nyo tshong mi chog gal ste khrom ra'i thog 'bras nyo tshong byas na 'bras khang nas nyes chad mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes dang 'brel khrims gcod gtong gi yod cing / tshong pa dang 'grul par 'bras dgos na 'bras sgrub rang gi sa nas nyo dgos/ rdzong 'bras gnyis kas tshong 'dus ring bskor bskor zer ba'i mi gnyis dang skor g.yog mi kha shas btsugs te khrom srang la myul zhib byas nas za sgo brdab bsig dang skog rngan len pa/ snyad 'dogs sna tshogs kyis dngonu/ zog 'phrog pa'am nyes chad gcod pa/ tshong pa dang mang tshogs khag gcig 'dzin bzung gis rdzong gi khrims chad myangs dgos pa yang yong gi yod/yang rdzong 'bras nas 'brus/ pa dang / mon pa/ de min tshong rigs bcas tshong 'dus la yong sa'i sa 'gag sha 'u dang / shar nub kyi lam brgyud sa 'gag la tshug pa zer ba'i mi sna btsugs te dngos zog bsngogs bsher gyis zog phud len gyi yod cing / rdzong 'bras ngo las rnams bod zla 11pa'i zla mjug mon du bskyod de phyi lo'i bod zla 4pa'i tshes 15tsam bar mon du sdod ring mon pas rta thab gzan shing gi khral 'ul rgyugs dgos/ rdzong 'bras ngo las rnams mon du sdod ring gcis/ nas khral bsdu dang / gnyis nas tshong mkhos thabs len byed/ dgun dus mon phyogs la 'gro sa'i la tshang ma sa/ngas kyis yongs su 'gag nas 'grul mtshams chod/ bod zla 4pa'i tshes 15nyin nas gangs rnams mi ser nas ched mngags bshag ste rdzong 'bras ngo las rnams mtsho snar 'byor pa dang chabs cig mon nas dngos zog dod khal khri phrag kha shas mi ser nas sa rim skyel gyis bdal gla skar gcig tsam yang 332

med par sgal par 'khur nas bskyel 'dren byed dgos/ shar am pa ta la yan bod kyi sa cha snyon med yin par brten rgya gar ba'i mi sna ched mngags rta dbang la yong nas dgun dus mon du yod pa'i rdzong rtse shod gnyis dang /'bras sgrub pa/ mon rta dbang / bla gnyer drug sbrel lhan sar tshong ra go ha phra'i sa gla rgya gar gyi sgor mo stong phrag mang po bod phyogs la sgrub sprod byed kyi yod pa rgan rabs rnams kyis dngos su mthong myong yod pa red/ rta dbang thog mar dbyin jis btsan 'dzul dang / de rjes hin rdus btsan 'dzul byas rjes rim pas sagla sprod len byed mtshams chad pa ma zad/ rta dbang gtso bor byas pa'i mon la 'og yul gsum hin rdus btsan bzang byas ༄pa red/ 4333

shel dkar gling pa'i bka' blon mi 'gyur lhan grub rgyud bcas kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/dge rgyas pa bstan 'dzin rdo rjes/shel dkar gling pa ni de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs sger pa drag 'bring dkyus gsum yod pa las drung dkyus sger pa chung khag gi gras shig yin zhing / zhabs rten pha gzhis sam khyim tshang chags yul shel dkar rdzong 'og gling zhes pa'i sa gnas su yod/bka' blon mi 'gyur lhun grub kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/shel dkar gling pa'i thog ma'i mi rgyud 'byung khungs ni sngar gor bod sde gzar skabs ding ri ru dpon zhig la dmag don byas rjes su gzhung zhabs zhu 'thus byung skad las/ mi rabs gong ma tsho'i lo rgyus zhib pa zhu rgyu med kyang / kho bo mes po mi 'gyur lhun grub de nyid ni dgung grangs bco brgyad phebs lor zhabs sdod zhus rjes snga rting du sa dga' zhib dpyod pa'i las bya 334

dang / rdzong dga' rdzong / gnya' nang sho pa/ de nas bka' drung dang bka' blon bcas gnang zhing / de yang gang nyid nas brtsam pa'i 〈rang tshul brjod pa'i gtam dpyid kyi nyi ring phud thabs 〉zhes pa'i deb gcig yod pa kho bos chung dus blta klog yang yang bya myong ba de'i nang khong gi khyim tshang gi 'khos ka dang / bu spun rgan gzhon gnyis bde sdug gi khyad par che tshul/ khong rang nyid kyis sa gnas srid gzhung skabs kyi rdzong sdod dang /las sne rim pa gang zhig gnang yod med thad kyi gnas tshul 'khod pa zhig yin gshis rtsom yig de'i rjod tshig dang rjod don rang gi blo ngor gang nges ji ma ji bzhin gsham du 'god rgyu yin/ 〈rang tshul brjod pa'i gtam dpyid kyi nyi ring phud thabs 〉zhes pa'i nang don du ‘‘dpyid kyi nyi ring phud thabs su/ bsod nams khyad par las brtsams pa'i rang tshul blun gtam smras pa 'dir/ gson dang skabs re khyad mtshar yong / de yang rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos ‘lha chos lta zhog mi chos bya bzhag kyang / lam du rgyugs min bsod nams la rag pas/dkon mchog mchod dang ngan slong sbyin gtong sogs/ legs byas spel ba'i tshogs chen gsog pa gnad ’ces gsung pa ltar/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam du 'jug par sngon bsags bsod nams kyi stobs chen po zhig dgos pa smos ci/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bde sdug thams cad kyang rang rang gi bsags skyabs bzang ngan gyi 'bras bu'i rjes su 'gro ba mthong chos rang nyid kha thabs zhan pa'i ngang tshul 'di gas mtshon te de yang / pha ma chung dus nas bral ba'i bu spun rgan gzhon gnyis las gcen po dbang 'dus tshe ring ni/ chad bun rgya 'ub mi bsdus pa'i dug sbrul rang khyim du nyal bar skrag ste sger nor rgyas nang pa'i go mag tu phebs shing rang lo bco 335

lngar son pa'i da phrug rang gcig pur khyim gyi 'gan 'khur phog ngo bo dang 'don zhabs tshang ma gcig mtshungs 'tsho gos shin tu dman pas g.yas len g.yon 'jal gyi chad bun skra grangs chu gnyer bzhin zug pa rnams 'ded len byed mi rgyun chad med par yong ba dag la sang 'bul gnangs 'bul gyi mgo sgud lce bsnar gyi dus 'da'/ 'don zhabs rnam/sa zas gos kyi spros pa gzhan lta ci/ mi zas rtsam pa yang lo 'khor 'khyongs pa za rgyu med par/dpyid ka gro ma dang / dbyar kha za tshod/ ston dus gcig pu rtsam pa phran bu za rgyu rnyed pas lung tshan yas mas kyi mis/ gling pa rnams kyi mi tshang ma'i kha dog ni/ rigs gsum mgon po'i sku mdog dang mtshungs so zhes 'phya mod byed pa thos/ rang nyid lo na bcu bdun du son skabs zhabs sdod zhu rgyu'i grabs gshoms ched lha sar yong ste sdod rgyun ring ngo g.yog gi zas gron dang / rtsis phrug gsar zhugs skabs dang zhabs zhu'i skabs kyi gyon chas dang / rta dang sgar chas 'gro song tshang ma gcen po nor nang pa mchog nas bstsal zhing / dga' ldan khri zur rin po che nas kyang rogs phan gang che mdzad/ lo ngo phyed gnyis tsam ring rtsis khang gi las bya dang / phyugs gnyer tog stong (tog gnas thob rjes rim pa de mtshungs kyi rdzong sdod byed par 'gro chog pa yin ) bsko gzhag gnang byung / de'i phyi lo gnas drug pa'i sa rdzong nyams su dga' ba khyung rdzong dkar po'i sne mo las 'dzin par bsko gzhag byung ba ltar thon phyag zhus te sa gnas su bskyod skabs bdag nyid yul der 'byor rgyu'i snga ltas lta bur btsa' than gyi gnod pas ston 'bras lam du ma lhongs stabs gzhung sa'i khral 'bab 'bul rgyu lta ci/ chab 'bangs tshang ma za son med pa'i gnas su thug gshis/ bsod nams dman la bar chad nges par sdang ba'i dpe bzhin mi 'dod thog babs de lta 3 36

bu ang /sha rus gcig pa'i gcen po nor nang pa ni srid 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i mi smon rang skyid du yod pa ste/ gtsang ljongs nor 'dzin yangs pa'i gzhir/ bsod nams rgyas mthus phyi nang kun/ longs spyod kyis bkang rmugs 'dzin lha'i/ mnga' thang dpal la 'gran par mchis/ zhes pa'i gtsang ljongs pa yi thig ler kun gyis yid smon byed pa'i ma gzhis lte ba de dang nye ba'i sar gzhis lag legs po zhig kyang yod pa ni/ spang ljongs me tog khra tshom rgyas pa'i steng / sha pho khrag ra'i 'od mdangs ngoms pa bzhin/'dzad med 'bru gter sbyin pa'i zhing sa bshin/ 'di la 'dod pa'i re ba mi 'god du/ de bzhin lha sa'i shar phyogs nye 'dabs su/ lha yi grong khyer sa steng la/ gsar du 'phos pa 'dra 'o zhes/ bdag bos yong yang bsngags pa bzhin/ lha dbang dpal la 'gran pa yod/ ces pa'i gzhis ka legs po shig kyang skyo bsnon kha 'dzin du yod pa bcas gzhis ka yas mas de dag nas nye mkho 'bru rigs sogs char ltar 'bab cing / gcen po nor nang pa mchog kyang mkhyen dpyod yangs pas gzhung sa'i gnad che'i las khungs su phyag las mdzad par mjal bcar skabs skyabs zhu'i tshogs kyang bgrang du med pa yod pa ste/ pad ma'i tshal la bung ba'i tshogs/ bskrad kyang yang yang 'khor ba ltar/ 'bul 'khyer phyogs mi de'i drung du/gshom min go skabs bsten pa mthong / zhes pa ltar gtam don gnyis thad nas bdag lta bu ni 'gram chu ldang ba'i gnas su mchis mod do/ 'on kyang thugs yid gcong pa'i gtam tshig kyang thos pa ni/ gcen po nor nang pas rgyal rtse snyan grong jo lags su gnang ba'i phyag bris nang ‘'dir ni cher rlom mang pos phyogs phyogs nas/ bkol phyir 'then pa'i hrul yang su zhig gis/337

byams gzigs lhan pa glan te 'judwa 'gro ma'i/ mal stan tsam bzhin bdag gi dpe ru 'dug ’ ces dang ‘bla dpon pha rol gnon pa'i bsam gtan gyis/ zhi drag mdzad pa'i bzlas brjod la 'grus pas/ bar med phyag phyi'i 'brang phreng bdag mnyes te/ da ko lus sems srad bu chad la nye ’zhes sogs 'khod pa/ 6'dir ni ’zherngashrī gnas dang gang zag nor nang pa rang bstan zhing / ‘cher rlom mang po ’ste bla dpon mang pos g.yas g.yon gang sa nas las la bkol zhing ‘hrul yangs ’te shin tu ngal bas dub kyang bla dpon ‘su zhig gi byams gzigs lhan pa ’ste/ gzigs bskyangs gnang mi med pas bdag ni ‘'jud 'gro ma ’ste smad 'tshong ma'i 6mal stan ’ ral po dang 'dra'o zhes gsungs sam snyam pa bcas kyi kun rtog gi snang ba ji snyed cig 'char ba'i mur yang bsam par 〈rgyal po bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs brjod 〉las ‘bsod nams bsags na bde bar 'gyur/ de phyir mis ni bsod nams bya/ de yang yang nas yang du bya/ de nyid la ni 'dun par bya ’ces gsungs 'dug pas rang nyid tshe rabs sngon ma nas bsags skyabs dman pa'i 'bras bur longs spyod 'bul zhing bya ba gang byas lam du mi 'gro ba'i myong ba rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu 'di byung ba yin la/ tshe 'dir yang byis pa rang mnyam rtsed grogs gzhan dang sdebs te srin 'bu brgya phrag re btus te rdo bcom gyis yang yang bsad pa sogs dkar min gyi las ji snyed bsags pa phyi ma ni de bas sdug bsngal che ba myong rgyu gdon mi za bas bshags sdom tshogs bsags la cung zad 'bad dgos pa bsams te/ gling gzhis ngos 'dzin ma thub bar bogs mar btang ba'i dngul 'bab ṭam rdo bcu skor lon pa de lha ldan smon lam chen mor mang 'gyed du btab ste dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo bar byas/338

de'i phyi lo rdzong dga' rdzong 'phos te gnya' nang sho pa bsko gzhag gnang ba'i bka' rgya 'byor pa ltar rang gzhis dang sa khad mi 'gyangs shing / sa gnas kyi zhu byar 'thus shor ma byung phyin bzos bde gu yang dge sbyor phran bu yang 'grub khom byung song snyam pa'i yid gsos su gyur/ de nas gnya' nang sho pa rtsis len gyis lo 'khor gcig ma song gong slar yang bka' rgya zhig phebs gsal/ ‘khyod rang la gnas drug pa'i bka' shag drung yig bsko gzhag song ba las 'khur rtsis len du 'phral bcar dgos rgyu ’ zhes phebs pas/ da ni rang nyid 'khos zhan lha sa gser za dngul 'thung gi lung par sdod gnas mdzo pho'i sna khug tsam yang med cing / gzhis chung 'khu ma bsdus de yang lha sa nas nyin zhag nyi shu skor gyi sa khad 'gyangs pas nye mkho 'bru tsam sogs 'byor rgyu ni spros pa bral/ rang nyid shes yon dman pas bla dpon mdun sar rtag bcar lus sems gnyis brel las gtam don gnyis mtshungs yong rgyu dka' bar bsams te ‘lha rabs bka' drung las 'khur rtsa dgongs thugs rje che ba/ de min gnya' sho'i las 'khur lo dus 'phro bskyangs chog pa ’zhes snyan zhu zhig btang ba'i bka' lan du 6khyod da nas zhu gsal don smin ma bde bas gnya' sho las mjug rtsis sprod du ngo tshab do chod bzhag ste khyod rang lha sar 'phral bcar dgos ’zhes phebs pa ngan 'gal ma nus par de 'phral lha bcar gyis bka' drung las 'khur blang pa'i gnas tshul 'di ltar/ bka' drung go ming ha cang mi dma'i bya gdang steng du tshe sngon las kyi 'dzegs kyang bka' shag dam phrug phab rgyag sogs kyi g.yar khral dus tshod bya skad rgyag rgyu tsam ma gtogs/ gzhung sa'i zhabs 'degs nam 'phangs spyod pa'i re ba lta ci mnog chung rang don khang steng 'dzegs la'ang gshog rtsal rab dman khyim bya rgod po 'dra ba bdag ni skad 339

kyang mi snyan 'dzer 'dzer smra/ zho gsum bsod btags sbang skam ster mi 'dra re ba 'chol/ (tshig rkang 'dildi 'go rnams brjed 'dug ) nad gcong drag po'i ze phrog lce bas mgo bo non kyang 'dod chags sred zhen zhi dus med par na chung bya mo gar 'gro'i rjes su bar med rnyeg kyang don med rang nyid ngal bar zad ’’ces sogs 'khod pa rang blor gang nges de trem 95gas/mes po'i sku tshe'i smad kyi lo rgyus gang thos zhus na mes po mi 'gyur lhun grub de nyid bka' drung gi las 'khur yin mos su lcags khyi ( 1kha10 )lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 2nyin tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa dang / srid blon bshad zhol chang gsum/ bka' blon gsar byung pa dang / bka' tshab bla ma gung thang bstan 'dzin dbang po/ bka' tshab bsam pho bcas re zhig rgya gar du phebs dgos byung skabs mes po de nyid kyang chibs zhabs su mnyam bcar gnang dgos kyis bka' sbug dang / rdo rje gling khul du lo ngo gnyis lhag tsam bzhugs ring lung pa'i tsha grang dang 'tsho ba'i goms gshis sogs gang gi thad nas mi yul du sdod bag mi phebs pas yon tan dge mtshan du mas phyug pa'i gangs ljongs sa yi lte ba 〈lha sa dran pa'i glu dbyangs 〉dang rang gzhan skye bo'i spyod tshul mtshon pa'i ka phreng so so nas tshig rkang brgyad re yod pa'i ka bshad cha tshang 〈nyams len gnad du bsdus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi go don gsal bar bkral ba'i snying po/〉 〈〈sa byi yod 'don drang thig mthong ba 'dzum shor 〉sog rtsom 'bri gnang 'dug chu byi ( 1kha12 ) lochor bka' lon sbug nas bod du phebs khar bka' blon bsko gzhag gnang 'durge pa tshur lam yar 'brog bsam sding dgon du bka' 'gyur mjal dar dang /bka' blon gyi gsar mjal stabs bde zhus/ lha sar rang bdag gi khang pa 340

med stabs phying gur nang glang mthong gi khang pa g.yar glas kyis bzhugs pa sogs bstan rgyas gling dgon gnas dar rgyas skabs kyi dge slong bdag gi zhang po ye shes rnam grol lags kyi ngag sgros las thos pa ni gling pa'i zhabs pad de nyid ni mtho snyegs che nyams kyi spobs par med par nyam chung drang gdan gyi rigs la dga' mos gnang mkhan zhig yin pa dang dgong mo chu tshod gnyis pa tsam gyi bar zhal 'don bzlas brjod la brtson pa dang zhogs pa bka' shag tu phebs ka bar du gzim mal nang du bzhugs pas skabs re las don skor gzhung zhabs ser skya mtho dman ci rigs ngo 'phrad du yong skabs btsugs phrug dkar po zhig nang bzhugs mus su ngo 'phrad gnang rkyang gis mdzes chos spam bzo gtan nas med cing / nyin gcig gnam ru'i 'brog pa zhig gis rtswa za'i bdag thob skor snyan zhu zhig 'bul rgyu yod pas bden skyabs yong ba zhus nas ‘‘da lta'i skyabs rten dang thugs rje legs 'bul gang zer yang 'di yin ’’zhes bsod btags gcig dang / ṭam dkar gnyis phul ba de'i gshis rgyud drang po'i gtam brjod la mnyes te ‘‘mi drang po zer na 'di tsho red ’’ces gsungs te rogs phan gang yong gnang song gsungs pa sogs dran gyi 'dug mes po de nyid dgung lo sum cu so brgyad shing lug ( 1kha19)lor 'das grongs gyur 'dug bka' blonartemi 'gyur lhun grub kyi gcen po dbang 'dus tshe ring ni sger nor rgyas nang pa'i go mag tu bskyod de zhabs sdod zhus/ nag chu 'go pa sogs las tshan 'ga' shas dang / de rjes bka' shag drung yig rgyun ring gnang zhing / rig gnas lo rgyus la mkhas pas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa nas bzung srid skyong na rim gyi 〈srid lo 〉dang / 〈tham deb/〉 〈yig bskur rnam bzhag 〉bag ma gtong len skabs kyi 〈gnyen yig sgron me'i 341

bstan bcos 〉rang gi bu phrug la 〈blang dor lcag 'debs kyi bslab bya 〉gzhan yang chab shog gi rigs kyang mang du mchis pa sogs khong nyid kyang bod kyi rig gnas la mkhas pa'i go bar 'dzegs pa zhig yin par nges/mes po mi 'gyur lhun grub de nyid la rigs rgyud ming sring gsum yod pa las bu rgan pa kho bo'i skyed byed mgon po dbang phyug thog mar rtsis zhugs byas kyang / zhabs zhu ma gnang bar gzhis bzhugs lta bur bzhugs/ de rjes ma tshang nas zur thon byas/ bu mo bde chen chos sgron yar 'brog gling dbon pa'i mdun mar ster/ bu 'bring ba 'chi med rdo rje shel dkar gling pa'i ming thog sras rnam pa'i ming bzos dang bcas zhabs sdod zhus/(bka' blon byas pa'i bu phrug zhubs zhu byas na sras rnam pa'i go ming sprod sro' bzhin ) snga rjes su mda' pa rdzong dang / chibs dpon che mo byas pa dang de rjes grwa bzhi mda' dpon byas te rmar khams dang / sa ngan sogs kyi sa srung du lo mang bzhugs/ shing phag ( 1kha25) lo lha sar 'byor te rtsis dpon dang bde zhib las khungs kyi do dam gcig lcogs byas/ rang lo 45chu rta ( 1942)lor 'das/khu bo 'chi med rdo rje'i bu rgan pa bsod nams stobs rgyal zhabs sdo da zhus te bka' shag shod pa dang / ar rdza be sog 'go pa/ zhol kanyer sogs las tshan rim par byas rjes chu lug ( 1942) lo las zhabs dgongs zhus kyis chos mthun gyi bya bar zhugs te deng skabs bal yul khul du mtshams sgrub dge sbyor gnang mus su bzhugs/ bu chung ba tshe dbang rnam rgyal de snga zhabs zhu byed myong ba dang da lta yod mus bcas kyi lo rgyus rob bsdus gang dran tsam mo/342

phran dge rgyas pa bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i lo byurgyus mdor bsdus/phran dge rgyas pa bstan 'dzin rdo rje ni gong du smos zin ltar sger shel dkar gling pa'i bka' blon mi 'gyur lhun grub la rgyud 'dzar ming sring gsum byung ba'i nang tshan bu rgan pa mgon po dbang phyug gi bu phran yin zhing /phran gyi skyed byed de nyid shel dkar gling pa'i rgyud 'dzin zhabs zhu ma gnang bar zur thon gyis shel dkar bar mtsho zer bar bzhugs te khyim tshang la ‘‘shel gling zur pa ’’zhes 'bod kyi yod/ phran rang lo bcu bdun thog dge rgyas pa'i go mag tu bskyod de rtsis zhugs dang de nas rim bzhin zhabs sdod zhus par ‘‘dge rgyas pa ’’zhes zhabs ming thogs pa da lta'i bar rgyun 'jags su 'bod pa las/ rtsa ba'i rdo brag sprul sku 'jam dpal blo bzang botsas pa'i mjug rkyen gyis bza' zla 'das grongs gyur stabs nga tsho mnyam du ma mthun par gyod gtugs 'dod pa tha dad bgyis khar/ dge rgyas gzhis su bskyod myong med pas gnas tshul zhib phra zhu rgyu med kyang rob tsam zhus na/dge rgyas pa'i pha gzhis gnas yul chu shur rdzong 'og sbud bde zer bar yod 'dug sger pa 'bring gras yin pa dang / drung drag 'bring dkyus gsum du dbye ba'i nang tshan drung dkyus ‘‘sger pa rta rkyang ’’zhes pa'i gras yin 'dugarkang 'don phyed gsum gyi sa las medari skad 'dug rgya sbyong dmag gcig dang / ‘‘rgya shing brngod gsum ’’gyi khral rigs phal mo che 'khri gi 'dugagazhis khang nyis thog ba glang rta bong sogs 'jug yul khor khyams gang 'tsham 343

yod skad dang / mi ser them dud bdun tsam yod tshod/ gzhis kyi 'bab yong ji yod gsal po mi shes kyang dge rgyas gzhis nas lo ltar lha sar nyer mkho gro rtsam/ snum/ kham star sogs bong rgyab bcu skor lo re thengs gnyis re bskyel 'dren yong gi 'dugarang nyid rang lo bcu bdun rtsis phrug pa'i skabs gser sdong dge legs 'dod 'jo gsar bzhengs skabs kyi las bya byas/ de nas zhabs sdod zhus rjes grwa bzhi dngul khang las khangs kyi las bya dang / nag cha ja ༄༄ rirabakhral bsdu dam dang / byang spyi'i las bya gcig lcogs byas rjes/ mdo smad spyi khyab bka' blon lha klu'i las bya'i khongs su bskyod de gad dmar sa gnas su sho khral bsdu dam dang / nga dang dmag sgar dang mnyam du 'khru 'dul do dam byas/ de nas sog phog khang dang / gyod zhib las khungs kyi las bya/pe cin tā la'i don gcod khang gi las bya/ bka' shag drung yig bcas kyi las 'gan 'khur myong ba bcas so 344
blo bzang pha sa sa

tshang bcu gsum re shog bzo dang / par skrun gyis sgrig 'bul zhu dgos pa de yin zhing / de'ang shog sgrub kyi byed sgo'i lag 'khyer ni shog bzo'i 'ul mi rgyal rtse tsho drug nas khral 'ul bskul chog pa'i bka' gtan gcig dang /rgyal rtse tshong spyi dang rdzong lhan la shog sgrub pas bka' bstan sgrig 'bul zhu sgor rogs ram rgyab snon byed sgo'i skor gyi bka' rgya gcig bkras lhun bla brang la bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur par rgyag byed sgo'i dus tshod la gzhung par do dam shog sgrub ngo g.yog 'byor mtshams snar thang par khang la sger chos su yin gyi par mtshams 'jog dgos pa dang / dus yun ji 'gor la bkras lhun bla brang nas ngo g.yog rnams la sdod sgrig dang rta thab/ zan shing sogs sngar lam ltar rogs ram dgos skor rtse gzim 'gag dang yig tshang las khungs kyi bka' rgya dang sbrags rten gos rgyan bzhi sked khra yug gcigaras dkar 'thums ldan 'gag dam 'byar ma gcig 'brug rgyal por rten gos rgyan bzhi ras dkar 'thums ldan yig tshang las khungs kyi rtags tham 'byar ma gcig dang / 'brug khul nas bka' bstan par rgyag gi shog rgyu shog shing bsgrub rgyur rogs ram rgyab skyor yong ba'i rten gong gsal dang sbrags yig chung gcig rgyal rtse khul gyi gzhung sger chos bcas kyi sbyar lcang gling kha khag nas bka' bstan sgrom rgyug dang / shog bzo'i sgrom bzo byed shing chag brgyab chog pa'i sbug dam 'byar ma'i bka' gtan gcigagazhung sger chos bcas kyi 'brog khul nas bka' bstan bsgril ras ‘‘ral 'bol ’’zhes pa snam sag rgyug 'dom lnga brgya skor khral rkang nas sngar srol rin 'bab sne sel sprad nas bsdus chog pa'i bka' gtan gcig lho brag do rdzong khul nas bka' bstan par rgyag gi snag tsha bzo byed sgron thal khal gnyis re yod pa'i snag zom grangs brgya dang drug cu dang / chur rtsa dang 346

dmar btsos bcas nyo bsdu chog pa'i lho brag do rdzong la bka' rgya gcigargyal rtse khul nas dmar btsos dang / shog bu/ snag tsha bcas sger gyi nyo tshong mi cho ga pa'i sbug dam 'byar ma'i bka' gtan ras bsgril gcig lho byang tshong 'khos bya rgyu'i tshong zog 'gel byed shangs rgya mtsho nas rnam gling dang rgyal rtse brgyud phag ri bar dos khal brgya dang drug cu skor dang / rta 'ul gsum gyi lam yig rgyal rtse nas snar thang bar phar tshur bka' bstan 'gal byed dos khal drug cu dang / rta 'ul bzhi/ lho brag nas rgyal rtse bar snag zom sogs 'gel bya dos khal lnga bcu nga gnyis dang / rta 'ul gcig rgyal rtse nas lha sa bar dbus 'bul lam yig la dos khal brgyad cu dang / rta 'ul bzhi bcas bskul chog pa'i bka' lam yod pa dang /bka' bstan bsgrub dmigs su rtse phyag mdzod las khungs nas ma rtsa ‘‘zog rtsa ’’zhes sa gnas srid gzhu nga gi dpon rigs sogs go gnas phab ste rgyu dngos gzhung bzhes btang ba'i dngos rigs gyon chas dang / grwa chas/zhwa lham sogs sna tshogs la rin bsgyur gyi bod dngul srang chig stong tham pa ri ba'i dngos po lo ltar sprod lam gyis tshong 'khos thabs len byas te tshong rtsis khe 'bab lo re ldab gsum 'bul dgos pas dngul srang sum stong tham pa yin zhing / bstan 'gyur pu ti nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga yod pa cha tshang lnga la cha tshang rer rin dngul srang nyis brgya bdun cu don lnga re dang / bka' 'gyur pu ti brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga re yod pa cha tshang lnga la cha tshang rer rin dngul srang nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga re/ 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum cha tshang rer pu ti bco lnga re yod pa cha tshang gsum rer dngul srang drug cu re bdun dang zho lnga re ba'is gong gsal bka' bstan cha tshang bcu gsum la dngul srang nyis stong bdun brgya bcu med gnyis dang zho lnga thob 'phros dngul srang 347

nyis brgya dgu bcu go bdun dang zho lnga dngul rtsis zhu dgos/chu sprel lo skyed byed de nyid rgyal rtser bskyod nas shog sgrub rnying pa rtse phyag nang tshe dbang lags kyi sa nas shog sgrub pa'i ngo g.yog las shag dang /'ul mi'i sdod shag shog bzo'i las khang bcas par khang pa ka ba sum cu skor dang / shag 'khor ka ba nyi shu/ shod khang ka ba sum cu/ sgo rwa phyi nang ka ba nyi shu skor yod bcas rtsis len gyis sngar lam ltar tshong spyi dang /rdzong lhan khang la bka' rgya dang / bka' gtan spyan zhus dang 'brel rta thab zan shing bkod sgrig dang / phag rir tshong pa gcig gsar 'dzugs kyis 'brug yul du shog rgyu sgrub mi ched btang thog 'brug rgyal la gzhung bstsal rten yig 'bul mngags dang 'brel shog rgyu nyo sgrub kyi las 'gan sprad/shangs khul du skyed byed nyid ngo bskyod kyis shangs rnam gling khul nas 'bru khal lnga brgya skor nyo sgrub byas te (skabs der khal rer rin dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga re yas mas yin pa ) shangs rgya mtsho dang / ri ldig khul la bod zla 10bi'i nang byang pa tshwa tshong ba dang tshwa 'bru brje tshong gis 'bru khal rer tshwa khal gnyis yul srol skakha/ bzang thang gzhi byed mus bzhin bsgrubs thog rnam gling dang rgyal rtse brgyud phag rir lam yig nang gsal dos khag gsum la bgos nas btang ste phag rir 'byor 'phral 'brug par sil 'tshong skabs phag bre rer zho bdun skar lnga yas mas byas te btsong pas tshwa khal rer dngul srang bco lnga nas bcu drug bar tsam byung zhing / shog rgyu shog lpags zhes shing lpags hrob rdzog nyos nas dos khal skul gtong gis rgyal rtser las shag tu bskyel 'dren byas/shog bzo'i las grwa'i las mi ni sngar lam bka' dgongs ltar rgyal rtse tsho drug nas 'ul mi khyon mi grangs brgya dang nyi shu zla ba gsum ring khral 'ul 348

bskul rgyu yod pa dang / shog bu bzo stangs thad las grwa tshug sa yul shog sgrub las shag ma khang khul du shog lpags rdzog byed rdo'i tho ba drug yod pa tho ba rer mi gsum res mi gnyis nas rkang pas tho ba gnon rgyu re bskor dang /mi gcig gis shog rgyu chur spangari nas tho 'og blugs rgyu dang ar log rgyag pa/tho ba drug pos rim bzhin zhib rdzog waṃn rjes shing gi mdong mo'i nang zho ltar dkrog ste rdza kho'i nang bsags nas shog sgrom nar mo gru bzhi'i rgyab ras dkar sag shing gzer brgyab nas sbyar ba'i shog sgrom bzhi re shong ba'i chu yur nang bcug ste de'i nang shog zho skyog ltar blugs nas chu yur phan tshun mi gnyis re kha sprod du bsdad thog shog sgrom nang shog zho blugs pa rnams shing gi khe rag gis snyoms dkrug byas te shog tshad srab thub shog bzo'i dbu mdzad kyis zhib rtog tshad gzhi ltar zin mtshams skam yul shog thang du nyi skam chogatong dgos pa dang / skam zin mtshams shog bzo dbu mdzad dang mi gnyis kyis shog ras dang shog bu gnyis kyi dbar shing leb bcug nas kha 'phral ba bcas byed dgos/ de ltar byas te zla ba gsum bzhi tsam ring shog bzo byas kyang bka' bstan cha tshang bcu gsum gyi shog bu mi 'dang bas 'brug yul dang / stod khul khun po/ wa lung / shar pa sogs nas shog bu kha snon 'bor chen nyo dgos byung ba rnams dang bcas/ bka' bstan pu ti'i shog tshad ltar shog dras brgyab ste pu ti ltar shing sgrom nang thag pas bsdams nas pu ti'i g.yas g.yon la ril ma bsregs pa'i so rdog gis brdar te 'khod snyoms thogachur rtsa dang / dmar btsos bcas kyi khu ba byugs nas nyi skam btang zin mtshams 'brog khul nas khrul bsdus kyi bkasde bstan bsgril 'thum rgyag byed ras 'bol zhes pa snam sob kyis bsgril thog phyogs gnyis shing sgrom rgyun sdem 349

brgyab ste gzhis rtse bkras lhun khongs snar thang par khang la dos khal thog nas skyel 'dren byed dgos nga/ dang / bkras lhun bla brang du gzhung rtsal bka' rgya yig chung rten gos rtags 'byar phul te 'byor phyag zhus nas bka' 'khrol rjes snar thang du bskyod nas zla ba gsum mam bzhi tsam par rgyag byed dgos shing / par rgyag byed mkhan snar thang dgon gyi grwa gzhon brgya tsam la nyin re gla cha dngul skar lnga re dang / rtsam dod dngul skar phyed brgyad re rtsis khyon nyin re gla lto bsgril ba'i dngul zho gang skar phyed gsum re dang /nyin ltar ja thengs re gtong dgos pa ma zad/ sngar srol snar thang dgon la dge 'dun nyis brgya skor yod par brtsis nas mang ja gcig dang / sku 'gyed dngul zho gang skar lnga re par rgyag 'go 'dzugs skabs dang mjug bsgril skabs dus gnyis 'bul srol dang / bkras lhun bla brang nas gzhung par do dam ngo g.yog gsum la par rgyag dus tshod ring ja rtsam snum sha/zan shing pacas sngar srol phogs thob sprod lam mchis/ par rgyag zin rjes bkras lhun bla brang du thon phyag zhus nas dpe cha rnams do po rgyag rgyu dang /dos khal bcas snar thang mi spyi nas gzhis rtse bar bskyel rgyu sogs khral 'ul bskul nas dgun dus zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang lha sar dbus 'bul rtsis zhur bskyod dgos pa de'ang rtse 'gag tu 'byor phyag zhus te rtse phyag mdzod las khungs su lo re'i rtsis zhu'i skor gong bkod ltar zog rtsa dngul srang chig stong la ldab gsum gyi tshong rtsis zhu dgos pa red/phran gyi skyed byed kyis shog sgrub las khur byed ring lo dang po gnyis pa gnyis la lho byang 'tshong 'khos thabs len gyi tshwa tshong 'brug yul la rgyugs po ma byung ba dang / gong tshad chag pa/ shog bzo'i las grwa gzhi rgya che tsam byas kyang par shog ma ldeng bas shog bu 'bor chen nyo dgos kyi rin gong mtho 350

la/ ngo g.yog gi zan gron che zhing / dos khal rnams la dpyad bdal tsag tsig song mang ba/ snag tsha dang / chur rtsa/ dmar btsos/bka' bstan bsgril ras ras 'bol zhes pa snam sob bsdus pa rnams dang bka' bstan gyi sgrom shing / shog bzo'i shog sgrom bzo byed shing chag brgyab pa bcas la'ang sngar srol rin 'bab sprod dgos la/ lhag par lo ltar bka' bstan cha tshang bcu gsum re bsgrigs 'bul zhu dgos pas lo dang por cha tshang bcu gsum grangs tshang rtsis 'bul zhu thub pa byung yod kyang / lo gnyis par cha tshang lnga las 'bul ma thub pa ma zad/ lo gsum par rtsa chad du gyur zhing / bka' bstan cha tshang rer rin gnad che yang rtsis zhur rtsis thang chung ba dang / skabs der pha lo na chung bas 'tshong 'khos thabs len sna tshogs bya rgyu sogs kyi nyams myong med pas tshwa tshong kho na las ma byas pa dang / phag ri'i tshong pas lkog za byas nas tshong rtsis kha gsal ma brgyab pa/g.yog gcig lha sar lo gnyis pa'i sgrig 'bul rtsis zhu'i dos rgyab par btang ba des kyang lha 'byor mtshams sgrig 'bul bka' bstan cha tshang lnga phud pas rgya gar dang 'brug yul khul dang / rgyal rtse khul nas thon khungs dngos zog nang gi nye mkho dang gzhung rtsis zhu rgyu'i ma gnad dngul srang nyis khri skor gyi dngos po rnams bag med longs spyod byas te tshong rtsa gtor ba ma zad/kho pa rgyal rtser phyir log nas pha la dug ster te gsod rtsis kyang byas rung gsod ma thub pa'i mthar 'brug yul la bros 'byol du song ba dang /skabs der shog sgrub pa'i rta drel sogs sems can yang shi chad mang po byung ba'i rkyen ngan sna tshogs 'phrad stabs lo gsum par gzhung 'bul rtsis zhu rtsa chad du gyur te 'a 'ub ma 'dus pas rtse phyag mdzod las khungs la rtsis chad bka' 'gyang dang / shog sgrub sprod 'gyang lo drug 'phar ma zhus thog slad 351

lo ltar bka' bstan cha tshang bcu gsum re sgrig 'bul zhu ma dgos par lo gsum re'i thog cha tshang bcu gsum re 'bul 'thus dang / lo re'i tshong rtsa'i rtsis zhu ldab gsum gyi khe 'bab la gzhung mkho'i dngos zog gzhan dag 'apul 'thus bcas kyi bde sdug snyan 'bul zhus par don son bstsal thob byung yang lo gsum gzhung rtsis zhus pas rtsis chad dang / sger gyi ma rtsa ji yod 'thor zhig song ba/ gzhung rtsal lo re'i zog rtsa zog ro las med pa sogs la brten ma rtsa rang khongs nas gra sgrig byed dgos gshis/ khyim gyi skyes ma'i rgyan cha g.yu byur spa phrug dang / gser gyi ga'u/ rna rgyan sogs se ra sngags pa grwa tshang la gta' ma ldab zin bzhag nas dngul srang nyis khri lnga stong tham pa bun g.yar thog shog sgrub kyi shog bzo'i las grwa tshugs ma dbo/sa pas 'ul mi mi grangs nyi shu lo 'khor gtan sdod kyi gla dod nang khul slog sprod thog de byings 'ol mi brgya skor gyi gla cha nyin re dngul srang gsum re 'ul mi gtong khongs so so nas sprod pa/ 'ul mi ngo rgyugs ma dgos pa'i gla dod len 'thus kyi rgyal rtse tsho drug mi spyir gros bsdur mos mthun byung bcas kyi dngul 'bab dang gzhung rtsal zog rtsa bcas kyis ma rtsa byas te 'brug yul dang / stod khul gor khongs 'khun po ba dang / shar pa/ wa lung pa sogs kyi tshong pa gzhis rtse khul du shog tshong yong dus lo ltar shog bu legs zhen sna tshogs 'bor chen nyos nas lo gsum re'i thog bka' bstan cha tshang bcu gsum par rgyag gis sgrig 'bul zhu dmigs byas pa dang / shog lhag rnams rgyal rtse khul du tshong pa chung khag la tshong bcol khe btsong byas pa dang /de min gzhis rtse khul nas dbang ldan grum se dang / zon lham/ ko chas sna tshogs/ gzhis rtse'i phing / lcags dang / zangs kyi snod chas sna tshogs bsgrubs nas rgyal rtse khul dang / phag ri/ lha sa sogs la tshong 352

bsgyur byas pa/ rgyal rtse khul nas snam shad ma dang / rum gyi kha gdan/zla gam/ pang gdan bcas nyo bsgrubs byas pa rnams dang / nang la skyes mas zhing las bar gseng 'ul mi gtan sdod grangs nyi shu bskul nas bal las dang / 'thag las byas pa rnams bcas lha sa khul la tshong bsgyur byas pa/ phag rir tshong pa skyes ma'i spun mched gnyis bzhag nas tshong khang btsugs te gtso bo 'brug par tshwa tshong dang / zhor du 'brog yul gyi thon zog 'bras legs zher dang 'bras rngos legs zher/ shing 'bras sos pa sna tshogs/ rgun 'brum nag po skam po/ shog bu sna tshogs/ se paṇa dmar po dang sngon po/ 'bu ras legs zher/ sga khra sna tshogs/ dmar btsos/rgya tshod bcas nyo bsgrubs kyis rgyal rtse khul dang / lha sa/ gzhis rtse/shangs rnam gling dang / rgya mtsho khul tshong bsgyur dang / rgya gar khul du skyed byed 'di nyid dang / phag rir bzhag pa'i gong gsal tshong pa re 'khor gyis lo ltar rgya zog 'bras legs pa sman 'bras dang / ka la bya na'abras/ ras cha sna tshogs/ ther ma/ 'go snam sna tshogs/ shing 'bras kha bsur dang / mngar kham/ byi ril sbo dkar/ shel dkar rta so ma dang / rting par/ bu ram rting par/ rgun 'brum dkar po/ bye ma ka ra/ dar lcog tshos sna sogs bsgrubs nas lo re'i rtse phyag mdzod las khungs la zog rtsa'i khe 'bab rtsis khur gzhung mkho'i dngos po rtsis zhus lhag 'phros rnams lha sa sogs la tshong bsgyur byas pa/ shangs khul du lo ltar tshwa 'bru khal lnga brgya drug brgya skor brje tshong gis pha rir tshong 'khos byas thogazhor du shangs khul nas bal dang pags rigs bsgrubs pa dang / shangs rnam gling khul nas lcags chas dang / zangs chas sna tshogs mngags bzo byas nas rgyal rtse khul dang / phag ri/ rgya gar bcas la yul phan tshun 353

thon khungs yod med brje tshong byas te rin thang yul srol ltar khe gyong rtsis bsnan gyis 'bel nyo dkon tshong gi tshong gnyer byas pa/ rgyal rtse khul du spom mda' tshang gi las tshab dbang khang zhes mi tshang che khag cis/ yod pa der sa gnas srid gzhung gi so nam las khungs kyi sa zhing mang po 'dug pa nas son khal brgya dang lnga bcu skor 'gro ba'i sa 'ing bogs mar blangs nas 'ul mi gtan sdod mi grangs nyi shu yod pa zhing las byed bcug ste lo re sa rab son khal re nas khal brgyad re tsam dang / zher ba nas khal bzhi re tsam thon pas cha snyom khal drug re rtsis pa'i khal dgu brgya skor thon pa nas son khal brgya dang lnga bcu dang / bogs ma khal brgya dang lnga bcu/ lo 'khor zan song khal nyis brgya skor bcas bsdoms khal lnga brgya phud pa'i khe 'bab 'bru khal bzhi brgya yas mas tsam gyi yong 'bab byung ba bcas tshong gnyer dang /sa zhing 'debs las/ khyim tshang nang skyes mas zhing las bar gseng 'ul mi bskul nas snam bu/ rum/ btsug phrug 'thag las byas pa sogs kyis lo drug nang khe 'bab che tsam byung ba khyon shog sgrub las thog lo dgu ring lo sngon ma gsum gyi rtsis chad dang / lo gsum thog bka' bstan cha tshang bcu gsum re 'bul rgyu'i tshong rtsis zhu sgo bcas gzhung rtsis chad med 'thus tshang byung ba ma zad/ de sngon ma rtsa 'thor ba rnams kyang slar gso dang / khyim tshang la khe phan che tsam byung bas rtse phyag las khungs nang phyag mdzod nang zan gzhan gyi shog sgrub las 'dzin la yong 'bab chen po yod pa'i mthong tshul byung bar brten shog sgrub gsar pa zhu 'tshang che bas gsar bsko byas pas skyed byed las bsgyur gyis las mjug lo gnyis ring rgyal rtser bsdad nas mjug bsgril te chu lug ( 1942)lor lha sar phyir log byas pa red/ de ltar skyed byed de nyid kyis shog sgrub las 'dzin thog mar gnang skabs phran 354

rang rang lo drug lor rgyal rtser pha ma dang mnyam du skyod pa dang rang lo bdun la slebs skabs rgyal rtse dpal dgon chos sde'i spyi gnyer phan bde glang zhes pa khyim ming pig ra shar chen zhol sger gnyer slob grwar lo bzhi slob sbyong byas nas lo bcu gcig son skabs slob grwar yag po ma skyod pas skyed byed kyi mdun g.yog lta bur nyar nas shog sgrub kyi byed sgo'i nang pha mas mig 'khrid dang / bshad 'khrid byas stabs de snga'i mthong thos myong tshor rang blor 'jags pa rnams da lam yig thog nas lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi tsam du phul ba lags theṭa/ /

de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dmag phogs 'go 'doms zhol spyi phogs khang zhes pa'i sgrig gzhi dang / 'gan dbang / khyab khongs sogs skabs de'i dngos don mdor bsdus/gzhis rtse sa khul srid gros u yon spen pas/spyi lo 1kha46bod me khyi lor mkhan chung bkras mthong blo bzang rnam rgyal de nyid la spyi phogs khang gi 'go 'doms bsko gzhag byas rung zla shas song rjes mkhan chung de nyid gzugs gzhi nad gcong gi rkyen pas dgongs zhu'i snyan zhu phul bar spyi phogs mkhan chung gsar pa bsko gzhag ma byung bar ngo tshab gnyer pa bzhag 'thus chog pa byung don ltar rang nyid sger bkras mthong gi zla gras kyi khongs shig yin gshis/ shod 'gag tu mkhan chung de nyid dang mnyam du bka' bsgyur zhu bar bskyod skabs bka' bsgyur dgongs don lo gsum ring rim bzhi lcags sprag dang mnyam du spyi phogs khang gi las 'gan khur dgos byung /spyi phogs khang zer ba'i las khungs de'i tshugs yul zhol shar sgo'i steng 356

du yin pa dang / las khungs de'i gtso bo'i 'go 'doms ni mkhan chung gcig dang / rim bzhi gcig de'i gsham du las don sgrub mkhan mkhan rim so so sger nas btsugs pa'i gnyer pa re dang / gzhung bskos las bya rtse drung gcig dang / shod drung gcig 'bo kha ba rtse gnyer tshang nang gzan khongs nas mi gnyis dang / gar pa'i khongs nas mi gnyis/gad pa khang gnyer gcig 'thus mi gcig pho g.yog dang / gar dgos btang thung rgyug mkhan bud med lnga skor bcas las grub pa zhig red/skabs der dmag phogs sprod dgos thad lha sar bca' sdod ka dang sku srung dmag sgar khongs phyogs 'gro phud gtan sdod dmag grangs bdun brgya skor dang / kha dang grwa bzhi rgya sbyong dmag sgar la 'go dmag bsdoms mi grangs chig stong tham pa/ go mdzod srung bya tha dang dmag mi grangs lnga bcu lha sar gzhis rgyal ding gsum gyi dmag sgar so so'i khang srung mi grangs lnga bcu skor/ pu li si zhes lha sa'i bde srung da dang dmag sgar gyi brgya dpon gcig dang / lding dpon/ dmag dkyus bcas mi grangs nyis brgya lnga bcu skor dgon sde che gras khag gcig dang / dmag sgar khag bcas kyi sman rtsis slob phrug mi grangs lnga bcu skor bcas la zla re phogs thob star chags 'gro dgos pa ma zad/ mdo smad sa srung sogs dmag sgar so so'i khongs nas nad 'das yul byol gyi tshab gsar dmag spyi khang du lag ther zhu bar yong mkhan ji yod la lha sar sdod rgyun dang lam phogs/ de bzhin lha sa brgyud phyogs mtha'i dmag khongs gzhis 'khor ram de min gnad don gyi rkyen pas lha sar yong mkhan dmag mir dmag spyi khang gi ngos sbyor yod phyin lha sar sdod yun ring gi phogs dang / lam phogs bcas sprod dgos/phogs thob kyi tshad gzhi ni dmag sgar so so'i ru dpon mi gcig la 357

dmag dkyus mi grangs lnga'i phogs thob dang / brgya dpon la gsum skal/lding dpon la nyis skal/ ka dang sku srung dmag sgar la sngar nas yod mus lding dpon las cung go gnas dma' rung phogs thob thad lding phogs dang mtshungs pa sba' cha'i dge rgan me car mi grangs bzhi skor/ rwa stag don rkyen skabs nas gsar du bskos pa dmag spyi khang gi ngos spyor dgongs don ‘‘rang srog 'dor nus dgra 'thab byas rjes 'jog mkhan ’’zhes kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar la sku srung dmag sgar dang 'dra ba'i lding phogs sprod yul me car gsum tsam bcas par phogs thob sprod dgos pa ma zad/ ru dpon gyi khongs nas las tshan pa'i go gnas yod pa kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi ru dpon skal bzang la thab brten 'bru ru'i khal bdun cu don lnga sprod dgos pa sogs skabs sbyar las gzhi rtsa'i mi grangs gtan 'khel med/ dper na nad 'das yul byol sogs kyi gnad don ji byung nges med stabs dmag sgar so sos zla re'i nang dngos yod dmag grangs ji yod he bag med pa'i phogs gzhung bkod de dmag spyi khang la 'bul dgos pa dang / dmag spyi khang nas der zhib 'jug zin rjes dmag sgar so so'i dmag 'bor dang /phogs thob 'bru dngul ji thob ngos sbyor btang ba gzhir bzung spyi phogs khang nas sprod dgos/ nad 'das yul byol gyi tshab gsar mi grangs ji yod la lag ther zhus pa'i nyin der phogs sprod srol med stabs zhag ro phud ces de'i sang nyin nas brtsis pa'i zla 'phros nyin grangs la gzhigs pa'i phogs sprod rgyu dang / mjug ma'i zla bar dmag sgar su 'dra zhig yin rung dmag sgar de rang dang gcig mtshungs kyis phogs 'dra bsnyoms dgos pa red/phogs thob kyi grangs tshad ni mi rer phogs 'bo zhes gtan tshigs mkhar ru'i bre bco brgyad re 'gro ba'i phogs 'bo gnyis re dang / ja mar/358

tshwa bul/ shing dod bcas par mi rer dngul srang do zho drug skar phyed drug re sprad de dmag sgar so so'i rgyun gtan rngod thag bya rgyu ka dang sku sru nga dmag sgar gyi 'go dmag rnams shun gdong dkar rdzong khongs dang / kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi 'go dmag rnams nyang re dang / dog bde khul sogs nye 'khor du yod pa'i chu 'khor yod khungs so sor byed mus de ltar yang /me phag lo rwa stag dbar gyi 'gal ba dza drag tu gyur nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi rgyab tu ser byes grwa dmangs langs te dmag 'khrug byung skabs lha sar gtan sdod dmag sgar phud 'phar du phyogs mthar yod khongs nga dang rgyal rtse dmag sgar dang / ta dang / tha dang bcas kyi khongs nas dmag mi khag gcigarwa sgreng brgyud ga dang ru dpon las mtshan sbud khang pa'i khongs nas lding khag gcig bcas glo bur du bkod 'gugs byas shing / gong zhus ltar rgyun gtan dmag sgar so sor 'bru phogs dang / ja mar tshwa bul bcas par dod sprod srol de ltar yang don rkyen de'i skabs bka' dgongs su dmag sgar so so'i phogs thob snga 'phros zla ba gnyis kyi ring rtsam pa dang / ja mar mngon rdog sprod dgos gshis rngod 'thag bya rgyu zhol las khungs kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i shun gdong dkar rdzong dang nyang re/ dog sde/ 'brom stod/ra ma sgang / tshal bde chen gzhis bcas kyi khongs gzhung sger chos gsum bka' gtan btsan dmigs la ma ltos par chu 'khor ji yod la dgos 'bru sprad de rngod 'thag byed bcug ste dmag spyi khang gi ngos sbyor dgongs don rtsam pa dang / ja mar mngon rdog sprod dgos pa de yang ja ji dgos ja tshwa las khungs dang / mar ji dgos rtse shod phyag mdzod nas mkho sprod byed srol yod snyam pa las nges gsal rang zhu rgyu mi dran/dmag phogs dgos 'bru len yul gtso bo gzhis rtse'i khongs skam skyed 359
