'bru phogs dang / zhib 'phar/ bco brgyad/ de bzhin pa snam dang /rgyal rtse/ lho kha gri gu khul sogs kyi bkar steng nas 'don 'dren chog pa dang / dmigs bsal dza drag dgos gtugs byung skabs bka' shag gi bka' 'khrol 'og chu shur khul sogs nye 'dabs mchod 'bru'i khongs nas 'dren chog gi yod/dgos 'bru 'dren thengs rer ngo tshab a drung gnyis re zung sbrel gyis gtong dgos shing / mi 'gro'i thad rtsa ba'i khri khungs rtse gnyer tshang nang gzan dang / gar pa/ phebs byams pa bcas khongs nas gtong srol yang mi de'i gras gtong skabs dgos 'bru dus thog mi 'byor la/ gal te 'byor rung lam bar rkun shor ram/ bor zag mang khar mi khag gcig gis gzhung 'bru rang mtshams bed spyod byed pa sogs don du 'bru ru'i khal lnga brgya tham pa 'don 'dren du btang ba'i dbang du song na ma mthar ru'i khal bzhi brgya skor chad kyi yod/ de bzhin dgos 'bru dus thog 'byor min byung tshe dza drag gi bka' lam zhus te gar 'phrad bar gyi lam 'khel zhes 'khod pa'i bka' lam dang sbrags gdong bsu'i a drung ched mngags gtong dgos kyi yod/thengs shig drag re'i ched phogs khang do dam pa rang khongs kyi zla gras gnyis bka' lam dang sbrags dgos 'bru 'dren len du btang yang sa gnas kyi tsho dpon dang phar khag tshur dkri'i thog don du 'bru ru'i khal drug stong gi khongs nas ru'i khal chig stong nyis brgya skor rtsa ba nas chad pa sogs 'bru 'dren mi 'gro snga rjes kyi byed bab 'thus tshang ma byung stabs spyi phogs do dam pa dang / dmag khag so so'i 'go khrid gros bsdur gyis phyis 'byung gi 'bru 'dren mi 'gro'i thad drag res dmag sgar so so nas lding bcu do chod re 360

gtong rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas 'bras su dgos 'bru chad pa'i gnas tshul lhad med la dus thog so sor 'byor thub pa'i phan 'bras nges can thon yod/gnas tshul gzhan zhig la lha sa khul gyi las khungs dper na zhol las khungs kyi gtong 'bru dang / ar po'i las khungs/ zhabs brtan khang sogs kyi 'bru 'dren bka' lam dgongs don du do po so so'i kha mtshams kyi rtags thel la rtsa 'dzin byed dgos pa las gang byung rang mtshams gshor 'jal byed chog gi med/ 'on kyang dmag phogs dgos 'bru de thog mar bkar khang ga 'dra zhig nas rdog chas rgyag skabs nas 'go btsugs te do po rer ru'i khal gnyis dang bre bcu re he bag med pa 'jal gshor gyis kha mtshams so sor rtags thel rgyag dgos pa dang / de nas sa gnas gzhan zhig tu rtsis len skabs do po gcig la skyon shor byung yod pa'i dbang du song na do po de rang zur du gshor 'jal byas te do po de'i kha mtshams ma long bar kha gsab byed du 'jug chog pa'i spyi phogs khang la dmigs bsal gtan 'khel yod pa dang / lag rtsa'i nang dngos 'brel dos skyon song nges rigs la phan tshun gnyis lo'i gshor 'jal byed pa las der brnyas 'phar ma'i brdab gsig btang mi chog ces kha gsal 'khod yod stabs rtsis len skabs sa gnas de rang du bka' dgongs bzhin de ltar lag len bstar tshe 'bru chad yong don med/ 'on te 'bru 'dren sngon mas de lta bu'i 'bru chad yong gzhi lam thag ring zhing bskyel ('dren thad gna' rabs kyi khal bong kho nar brten dgos stabs bor zag dang / rkun shor gyis lam 'khel mi ser thog brdab mnar che la gzhung gun yang tshabs che yong gi yod /dgos 'bru'i thad sa gnas gang 'dra zhig gi bkar steng nas 'don 'dren byed rung bkar khang de'i ming gsal 'khod kyi bton chog bka' rgya 361

dang / lam yig bcas kyi 'char zin bzos te spyan zhur 'bul dgos pa dang / bka' zin la chog mchan thob 'phral gtsang bshus kyis ngo mar bka' tham zhus phab zin 'phral 'bru 'dren ngo tshab gtong dgos pa dang chabs gcig dgos dngul ji dgos skabs so sor bka' 'dzin zhus te grwa bzhi glog 'phrul khang gi rtsis steng nas zhu dgos/dmag spyi khang gi ngos sbyor dgongs don dmag sgar khag la phogs thob sprad zin rjes ngos sbyor rmang gzhi'i thog dmag 'bor dang / 'bru dngul gyi grangs tshad/ zla dus tshes grangs bcas go rim sgrig ste rtsis zhu'i bka' 'dzin phogs khang rang khongs nas bzos te ngos sbyor dang chabs cig mgron drung su rung zhig brgyud dam zhur phul bar bka' 'dzin ngo ma dang / ngos sbyor la ghan ti'i sel chag dang 'brel phyir sprod srol mchis/dgos 'bru dgos dngul dang / ja mar mngon rdog sogs mkho sprod byed skabs spyi phogs sbrel por slar rtsis zhu'i ched du sprad pa'i bka' tham lag 'dzin zhig yod pa de'i thog skas mtshams so sor 'bru dngul phon 'bor ji sprad lag 'dzin der brjod 'god dang chebs cig dgos 'bru 'dren yul bkar khang sogs khungs so sor bka' rgya dang / slar rtsis zhu'i 'bru 'bor gyi bka' 'dzin/ bka' lam bcas sprod srol 'dug pa bcas so/362

la dwags gzhung tshong skor rags tsam gleng ba/mnga' ris sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus 'tshol bsdu tshogs chung nas/ la dwags gzhung tshong zhes pa ni/ de ༵ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi tshong las shig red/ de yang thog mar rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang gi dus su la bod dmag 'khrug mjug sgril te 'dum 'grig byas par la dwags rgyal po bod du lo phyag skyabs 'jug 'bul du 'gro rgyu dang / bod nas kyang gzhung tshong khal ma nyis brgya'i ja bcas la dwags su gtong rgyu'i chings gan bzhag don ltar lo ltar ja sgam lnga brgya tham pa dang / de dang chabs cig dar kha/ chang rtsi/ spos chag sogs bod zog mang po zhig rta 'ul khral bskul mnyam 'khyer byas te mnga' ris skor gsum gyi mi dmangs la rin gong ldab kha shas spar nas btsan shed kyis nyor bcug ste bshu gzhog tshad med gtong gi yod pa red/ de bzhin sgar dpon dang / rdzong dpon/ phyag mdzod/ gnyer pa sogs spyi sger sna tshogs la ngo bsgyur kha g.yar gyis bod zog sna mang rnams la rin gong ldab kha shas sam tha na ngo tsha khrel med kyis ldab bcu tsam spar nas 'tshong mkhan yang yod la/ gal te spus sgyur de dag ma nyos pa yin na snyad 'dogs sna tshogs kyis nyes chad de las che ba 'gel gyi 363

yod pa de ni bod spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lam lugs ngan pa'i mtshon rtags ngo ma zhig red/ bod zla dgu pa'i zla mjug la slebs dus la dwags la song ste tshong rgyag pa dang 'brel mi gzhan gyi gdan thog tu rang skyid po gtong ba'i dpe bzhin rta 'ul bskul te dgon pa khag la gnas mjal spro 'cham dang 'brel dgon pa khag sogs la 'bul ba skyel ba'i lugs srol gtan 'jags su chags yod pa de yang thog mar khrig se dgon dang / he mi dgon/ pi thub dgon/ ma gro dgon bcas so sor ja sbag gnyis re dang / la 'gir dgon dang / ri rdzong dgon/ sgang sngon dgon bcas so sor ja sbag gcig re sprod dgos shing / lo re'i dang ma gro dus chen skabs lha nag rengs sku phebs sar gzhung tshong gis lo ltar mdung gnyis re 'bul dgos/bod zla dang po'i tshes gcig nyin la dwags tog rgyal po la lo gsar bkra shis bde legs zhu bar 'gro skabs gzhung tshong nas tog rgyal por rten 'bul bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i chas gos/ gos chen stab ril gnyis/ ja sbag bzhi/ bal sba kris bcu drug (sba kris re la nyag bcu gnyis re rtsis pa'i sba kris bcu drug la nyag brgya dang dgu bcu go gnyis yin/) bka' rgya sbug tham sbyar ma gcig bcas bstar sprod byed skabs tog rgyal pos bka' rgya mgo thog tu bzhag ste phyag gsum 'tshal thog bka' rgya kha phye nas de'i nang yod pa'i tā la'i bla ma'i srung mdud ske la 'dogs pa sogs byed dgos kyi yod/ ka shi rmi ra la ja sbag bzhi dang / bal sba kris bcu drug sprad rjes tshur 'bul lan du bod sa gnas srid gzhung la 'dur ma bubs bzhi dang /kha che sha skam lcags krin bzhi/ tig gcig bcas 'bul gyi yod/ de'i skad bsgyur la ja sbag chung gnyis dang / bal sba kris bcu drug bka' rgya tham sbyar gcig bcas sprad thog gzhung tshong nam log bar skad bsgyur kho par 364

kha zas dang / thab g.yog mi gcig la bal sba kris bcu drug dang lto chas/do po rgyab mkhan mi gcig la bal sba kris bcu drug dang / ja sbag chung gnyis bcas sprod dgos/ de bzhin la dwags rgyal po nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung la 'bul byed shing 'bras yag shos do po gnyis dang zhu yig gcig he mi dgon pa nas shing 'bras yag shos do po gnyis/ khrig se dgon pa nas shing 'bras yag shos do po gnyis/ pi thub dgon nas shing 'bras yag shos do po gnyis/ ma gro dgon nas shing 'bras yag shos do po gnyis/ri rdzong dgon nas shing 'bras yag shos do po gcig sgang sngon dgon nas shing 'bras yag shos do po gcig la 'gir dgon nas shing 'bras yag shos do po gcig bcas gong 'khod ltar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung tshong brgyud phan tshun skyes sprod res byed kyi yod/ yang dgun dus bar tshong (dus phyis gzhung tshong gsar 'phar zhig yin pa )phyir log skabs la dwags nas sgar dgun sa bar rta 'ul gnyis dang / khal ma brgya dang sum cu gtong srol dang / dbyar dus gzhung tshong phyir log skabs la'ang la dwags nas sgar dbyar sa bar rta bcu dang / khal ma gnyis brgya dgu bcas la bdal gla la dwags sa kar gzhung nas dbyin sgor stong nyi shu rtsa gcig gzhung tshong la sprad de gzhung tshong gis dos mi so sor bdal gla sprod srol yod pa bcas so/ /365

de sngon bod ljongs nang khul dang / bod hin bar gyi tshong las byed srol dang / phyir gtong nang 'dren sogs kyi skor rags tsam/ljongs rig dngos do dam u lhan rtsom sgyur sde tshan gyi lhag pa don grub kyis/spyi lo'i dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs bzhi bcu'i dus dkyil du kho bo lo chung gi bung bar dwangs shel lta bu'i gshog pa chung ngu zhig skyes nas cung phra ba'i dir dir gyi sgra dang bcas 'phur te/ bod ljongs nor 'dzin gyi skyed tshal du tshong las kyi pad ma ji ltar bzhad pa 'dren byed lam du snang ba rags tsam gleng na/ dang po/ bod sa khul gyi lte ba'i tshong ra dang / lha sar yod pa'i tshong las pa'i sgrig gzhi'i skor/ bod kyi lte ba'i tshong ra skor/ bod ljongs nor 'dzin gyi lte bar gnas pa'i grong khyer lha sa ni chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung bcas 366

kyi lte gnas yin/ grong khyer der phyogs mtha' dag nas mi sna 'ardus mite gnas mjal dang / tshong las/ yul skorlor bcas byed mi ha cang mang bar brtenarmo lha sa khul gang sar dngos zog gi khrom ra sna tshogs smrod pa'i nang tshan b.re bskor khor mo yug tu sgobasten tshong khang bar mtshams med bo lgeyorda la/dngoso zog sna tshogs pa'i khrom ras sa gzhi dog por byas yod / de yang bar bskor byang rgyud du ni pa la'i tshong pa dang / shar du pe cine gyi tshong pa/lho ru kha che ka shi rmir gyi tshong pa bcas dang / bod rigs tshong pa rnams nub phyogs dang / de min phyogs gsum du 'dres te gnas yod/ de dag las yul— thon dngos zog (snam bu so/gas ) dang / hin rdu nas nang 'dren byas pa'i nyer mkho'i yo byad/ mes rgyal nang khul nas thon pa'i (dkar yol sogs ) dngos zog bcas ma tshang ba med pa dang / bar skor nub byang sha gsar sgang du rwa mo che pa'i lug sha dang lug gi nang cha/ byang ngos khrom gzigs khang du nang khrom sna tshogs dang / rgya zog shar ngos thal spungs sgang du rta khrom dang / bong khrom/ 'ong stod zhing khar nang khrom dang yul thon rdengos zog sna tshogs kyi zhogs khrom zhes zhogs pa'i pe cin chu tshod dgu dang phyed ka tsam nas chu tshod bcu gnyis tsam bar ha cang gi 'khrug cha dod pos khrom bton tshong las byed kyi yod/ g.yas g.yon thog brtsegs can gyi khang pa'i 'og dkar mdzes tre hor tshong pas 'thung ja sna tshogs bton pa/sha khrom 'og ces rgyal sgo byang lta thog ldan ra ba'i nang lha sar yod pa'i hu'e rigs khag gcig gis sgrog rtse bstar du bsgrigs nas tshags sha tshong ba dang /de'i phyi rol du tshal 'debs mkhan tshos tshal rigs sna tshogs tshong ba/g.yas g.yon gyi sgo bsten tshong khang dag la zhor zas sna tshogs sil tshong rgyag pa/ de bzhin tshos sna pa ra bcas su sgo bsten tshong khang bstar du bsgrigs 367

pa sogs/ mdor na gang sar tshong khang dang / khrom gyis khengs yod/gzhis rtse ni gtsang khul gyi grong rdal che shos yin la/ 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren gyi 'bab tshugs kyang yin/ lcags shog thog ldan gyi khrom stegs dbus su rgya zog dang/ dkaratshozhing phra la lhad med pa'i gzhis rtse'i phing /de bzhin ne+e pa la dang ka shi rmir/ a mdo/ yul mi bcas kyi sgo bsten tshong khang yang yod/ rgyal rtse ni bod kyi snam chas dang rum gyi thon khungs gtso bo yin/ spyir btang rgya zog gi khrom phud da dung gtsang rum dang /pang gdan/ rgyal rtse'i shad ma sogs yod/ phag ri grong rdal ni bod kyi mtha' mtshams su gnas pa'i 'grims 'grul skyel 'dren gyi 'bab tshugs gtso bo zhig yin/ rgya zog sna tshogs kyi khrom dang tshong khang yod la/'brug yul gyi thon khungs gtso bo bza' bya'i rigs dang / de bzhin sga khra/slo ma sogs yod/ gro mo shar gsing ma ni bod dang 'bras ljongs kyi sa mtshams su gnas yod stabs/ ne pa la dang / hin rdu'i tshong pa bcas kyi sgo bsten tshong khang yod pa ma zad/ khrom 'don mkhan gyi gras su 'brug pa'ang yod/ de bzhin lho kha'i rtse thang / kong po'i nying khri/ spo bo'i spra rmog byang gi nag chu/ khams kyi chab mdo/ da dung tshos sna dang pu hreng /mnga' ris bcas su gang 'tshams kyi khrom ra yod cing / tshong 'dus 'tshog yul/ 'dam gzhung dang / yar 'brog stag lung / lho yul bye rag sogs la lo ltar tshong 'dus 'tshogs te dngos zog brje tshong 'khrug po zhig byed kyi yod/ gong gsal tshong ra dang tshong 'dus 'tshog yul de tshor yul babs dbang gis rang rang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos re yod/lha sar yod pa'i tshong pa'i sgrig gzhi ni tshong rigs spyi'i 'go pa rwa sbom sa gsum (rwa sgreng dang / spom mda'/ sa 'du bcas ) yin/ 'on 368

kyang lha sar yod pa'i khams rigs tshong pa rnams gcig nas las rigs dang / gnyis nas rang rang pha yul gcig pa'i la zhen gyi dbang gis rang bzhin gyis chags pa'i sgrig gzhi yod pa de'i 'go gtso de dgakhrod nas stobs 'byor ldan pa'i tshong pa zhig gis byed pa ste/ spom mdas 'go gtso byas pa'i rmar khams dang sa 'du/ rgya nag tshang gis 'go gtso byas pa'i dkar mdzes/ tre hor khams pa/ a 'brug dang ja ma tshang gis 'go gtso byas pa'i li thang pa/ tsha sprul tshang dang chos drug tshang gis 'go gtso byas pa'i go jo ba/ dam pa blo gros dang a bag gis 'go gtso byas pa'i tshab rong pa bcas yin/ 'on kyang sgrig gzhi de dag 'du 'dzoms mang nyung dang 'og nas gong la brtsi bkur che chung sna tshogs yod/ dper na spom mdas 'argo gtso byed pa'i rmar khams pa'i sgrig gzhi de yang yang 'du 'dzoms byas te gling gtong / lha gsol gyi byed sgo spel gyi yod la spyi dngul kyang gang la gang 'tshams yod pa ma zad/ 'og nas gong la brtsi bkur yang che tsam byed kyi yod/ da dung dbang 'dzin tshong las pa dang ser mo ba'i tshong las pa'ang yod/ rgyal sprul bla brang yin la tshong rgyag mkhan yang yin pa'i rwa sgreng bla brang dang / sku drag yin la tshong rgyag mkhan tsha rong / spom mda'/ sa 'du/ dgon pa'i spyi dngul gyi tshong rgyag mkhan tre hor dar rgyas dgon pa dang dkar mdzes dgon pa sogs dang dgon grwa'i khrod nas sger tshong pa/ser smad rgyal rong mkhan zur/ 'bras spungs go bo snyan grags/ bla brang yin la tshong las pa tre hor grong gsar bla brang / lag shes bzo las pa'i nang nas kyang re zung gis tshong rgyag gi yod/ gong gsal gyi sgrig gzhi dag khams rigs tshong par ma gtogs dbus gtsang gi tshong par med/ 'on kyang hin rdur tshong rgyag mkhan dbus tshang gi tshong par rang yul la zhen pa'i 369

chags sdang gang 'tshams yod/gnyis pa/ bod kyi yul zog hin rdur phyir gtong byed pa dang / hin rngu'i ru pi'i thog nas phyir tshong byed pa'i skor/rang re'i bod ljongs 'di ni 'brog las ha cang dar rgyas che ba'i sa gnas shig yin/ 'brog khul nas thon pa'i dngos zog la phyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ha cang dga' po byed kyi yod/ 'brog thon dngos zog spyi dang /lhag par bal ni bod kyi tshong las ma rtsa gtso bo zhig yin/ bal gyi thon 'bor che shos byang rtswa thang khul dang / de min stod khul dang / yar 'brog snye mo sogs nas kyang gang 'tshams thon thub/ bal gyi spus tshad rab 'bring tha gsum du dbye ba ste/ snye mo sogs nas thon pa'i bal la yul bal zhes rab la brtsi zhing / de ni dkar zhing 'jam la chu 'dzin gyi phung po lta bu zhig yin/ byang rtswa thang nas thon pa'i bal la byang bal zhes 'bring du brtsi ba ste cung rtsub tsam yin rung 'od che la bal sna ring ba dar si lhug por spungs pa lta bu zhig yin/ stod nas thon pa'i bal la stod bal zhes tha mar brtsi ba bcas yin/ 'dir thon 'bor che shos byang rtswa thang nas thon pa'i bal gzhir 'dzin nas gleng na/ bod zla bdun pa'i nang 'dam spyi rim zhes tshong 'dus shig 'tshog gi yod pa de'i skabs tshong pa bal sgrub pa tshos bal nyo'i dus skabs legs shos shig tu brtsis te 'brog mkho'i dngos zog 'thung ja dang bu ram/ 'go snam dmar ljang sogs 'khyer nas 'brog pa dang thabs 370

len gyis dngos zog dang blwa brje tshong byed pa'am dngul thog nas bal sgrub pa sogs la brten nas 'du long che ba'i tshong 'dus der zhugs pa dang /tshong 'dus grol rjes tshong mjug bsdad na slar yang nag chu dang / a mdo sogs sa gnas su bskyod nas zog tshong bal nyo'am/ dngul sprad de bal sgrub nyo byed cing / stobs 'byor ha cang che ba dang cung stobs che ba'i tshong pas byang khul du bca' sdod bal nyo'i tshong phrug bzhag ste rtag tu bal sgrub kyi yod/ bal nyo ba'i thabs shes ni sil nyo dang / sdebs nyo ste bal sgor gtsig gnyis tsam (lug gcig gi bal la bal sgor zer ) re byas te nyos nas bsags rjes mon do rgyag pa/ ('degs khal bcu gnyis kyi ljid tshad ) yang lug la grangs ka brgyab nas bal nyos te mi glas nas bregs pa/yang na 'brog dud phyug po'am/ bal sgrub tshong pa'i sa nas mon do mang po sdebs nyo byed pa sogs yin/ rin gong ni hin rdur bal gong che chung la ltos te 'phar chag 'gro ba dang / gal te hin rdur bal gong 'phar tshe bal bdag gis rang gi bul la chu rgyag pa dang sa bsres pa sogayolhad btang ba de ni bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe zhig la ‘‘rgya gar la rnga ma 'gro che bas ra gzhug la tshos brgyab ’’ces pa ltar yin/ bal nyos te bal do brgyab zin rjes gzhis rtse dang 7ga ri brgyud hin rdu'i ka sbug bar bdal gla btang ba dang yang na lha sa nas phag ri brgyud ka sbug bar bdal gtong byed cing /phyir tshong bya rgyu ni bod du bod rigs tshong pa nang khul gcig la gcig btsong gis rdo lag shug byas pa'i rigs mi gleng bar hin rdu'i ka sbug tu 'byor rjes de ga'i tshong par btsong pa'i skor gleng na/ ka sbug tu tshong ra yod pa'i hin rdu'i tshong pa stobs 'byor che ba ka ra mon/ she ri ram ar jun ha si/mig chen/ ka lu ram/ bal po zhwa mo dkar po sogs red/ bal tshong 371

yul yang dud tshang de dag yin/ khong tshos bal gyi srus tshad bltas rjes phan tshun gong sgrig ste 'degs 'gyogs byas nas sdepas tshong bya rgyu de red/bal tshong ni tshong thengs re zung gis phyug po dang dbul por 'gyur ba'i ya yud che shos kyi tshong las shig yin/ dper na/ spyi lo 1951lo yas mas su dang thog bal richa/ 'phar te mon do rer hin rdu'i ru pi 2rdo0nas de rjes glo bur du ru pi 60bar mar chag pa red/ gal srid bal nyo mkhan med skabs bal 'jog yul khang pa g.yar dgos pa sa khang gla bal do la gzhigs te 'phar chag med par sprod dgos la/ bal do'i khog tu gzha' yod na gnam gshis tsha ba'i rkyen gyis rul skyon yong ba bcas tha na bal rul g.yugs te khang gla rtses rgyag byed dgos pa sogs ha las hon 'thor gyi gnas su gyar gyi yod/ de min mkho ba'i tshong zog gla rtsi dang / g.yag gi rnga ma/ 'phyi ba'i pags pa/ phag spu/ tha na gro mo dang kham bu nas thon pa'i zhog khog 'brug nas thon pa'i slo ma/ phyur skam sogs kyang 'gro gi yod/ gla rtsi ni bod nas nyo skabs bub che chung gis rin gong dang de bzhin rnga ma yu 'byar/ phag spu 'degs 'gyob/sa bcas yin rung / phyir tshong skabs gla rtsi'i snying po bton pa/ rnga ma'i rtsid spu breg nas yu ba g.yugs pa/phag spu ring thung dbye ba bcas byas myo/sa 'degs 'gyogs byed pa red/ de dag gi rin gong ni cung brtan tsam yin/372

gsum pa/ hin rdu nas be+ed mkho'i dngos zog nyo ba dang bod du tshong ba'i skor/bod thon gyi yul zog phyir tshong byas pa'i rin 'bab hin rdu'i ru pi de dag gis bod mkho'i dngos zog nyo rgyu ni de mjug 'di mthud kyi bya ba zhig red/ bya thabs de la khag gnyis yod pa ste/ bal mang po tshong rgyu yod mkhan gyi tshong pa khrag cig gis dngos zog ma nyos par ru pi rnams tshong pa gzhan dag la gong bsgrigs bod dngul dang brje mkhan yang yod (de la dngul brjes rgyag pa zer/) gcig shos kyis bod mkho'i dngos zog nyo gi yod/ dngos zog de dag gi khrod nas gtso bo ras cha yin/ snaka sbug tu nga rang gis mthong ba ltar na si kri ker zhes pa'i ar 'dam thog brtseg can gyi khang chen nang nyin ltar ras cha do po rgyag pa dang / mi khag cig gis nyin ltar de gar yong nas nya pas chu khar dol btsugs nas nya sgug pa lta bu'i sgug nyan byed pa dang / mi khag cig don chen lon mdog gis kha ngo 'dzum 'dzum byed/ mi khag cig gis ba phyugs brlags pa'i mdog ltar 'khyer nas khro tshig tshig byed/ de ni hin rdus bod mkho'i ras cha 'tshong mkhan du btsugs pa'i sgrig btsugs shig red 'dug der gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur ba gzhung gi las byed pa gcig dang / de 'og ka sbug tu yod pa'i hin rdu'i tshong pa'i gras drung yig gnyis tsam dang / ras cha spel te sprod mkhan/ka sbug tu gtan sdod bod rigs dbul po dang / pag ras dbul po bcas mi grangs bcu tsam gyis do rgyab dbor 'dren byed mkhan bcas las 373

grub pa zhig red/ sgrig 'dzugs de'i 'gan 'bab las ka ni gong du bshad pa ltar bod mkho'i ras cha mkho 'don byed mkhan zhig yin rung / 'gam dbang la rten nas rngan len khe zas pa zhig yin pa ni bltas pa tsam gyis shes thub/ gang lags she na/ ras cha'i par mi kri thon mkhan mang che ba ni ka sbug tu gtan sdod bod rigs gnas tshang khag sogs red/ de dag gi sgrig 'dzugs de'i gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur gzhung gi las byed pa der 'bul ba gya nom pa btegs pa'i dbang gis kho tsho'i re ba skong ba las/ dngos 'brel bod mkho'i ras cha nyo mkhan gyi spyir btang tshong pas re skul snyan zhu ji tsam phul rung rgyu rngan rjes 'bras kho na las drang bzhag byed mkhan med/ 'on kyang bod kyi tshong pa 'byor ldan khag dang / de min kha shas kyis kho pa tsho'i nye 'grogs brgyud 'bul ba btegs thub na gang la de 'tsham gyi pā se thob thub/de'i 'gro lugs ni rang ming dang / rang nyid bod kyi tshong pa yin lugs/ma dngul la gzhigs pa'i ras cha do po ga tshod dgos min sogs bris te snyan zhu 'bul dgos/ de rjes nyin ltar 'on seng byas nas rang ming 'khod pa'i par rmi kri don min blta dgos/ gal srid par rmi kri don na de'i nang 'khod pa'i do grangs gzhir bzung de ga'i las byed pas legs nyes spe' te spras pa'i ras cha rtsis blangs nas khong tsho'i rtsis khra'i nang gsal ltar ras rin sprad de do po rgyag dgos/ ka sbug gtan sdod ma dngul med pa'i gras yin na par mi kri'i nang gsal ras cha do rer bod du ras cha 'phar chag la gzhigs te hin sgor 50nas 70tsam bar sprod dgos pa/ bye ma ka ra dang / tha mag kyang snyan zhu phul te nyo dgos rung de dag cung nyo stabs bde tsam yin/ de min zhor zas rigs/ lcags rigs/ ther ma/ shel chas/ spos dkar dang / ba so'i ca lag 'go snam sogs ka sbug tu 374

yod pa'i hin rdu'i tshong pa'i sa nas phan tshun gong sgrig gis nyos chog yang na grong khyer ka li ka tar bskyod nas nyer mkho'i yo byad sna tshogs dang /dbyibs dang / tshos gzhi dpe gsar can sna mang nyos te bod du 'dren mkhan kyang yod/ sa khul de tshor gong bsgrigs babs lta mkhas la/dogs zon dang / spyang grung ldan pa zhig med na gyong gun phog nyen shin tu che/ hin rdu nas nyos pa'i ca lag gras su hin rdu nas thon pa'i ras cha sogs dang / dbyin ji nas thon pa'i rkang 'khor sogs/ ri pin nas thon pa'i lcags kyi tho ba sogs/ shang kang nas thon pa'i kog man sogs/su'e tseranas thon pā'i chu tshod sogs yod/ dngos zog lha sar 'byor rjes sdebs tshong dang / bsil tshong / yang na sa gnas gzhan du dbor nas tshong thabs dang zog la zog brjes sogs thabs shes 'dra min yod/ gtso bo dngos zog de khrom du 'bel dkon gyis rkyen pas rin gong 'phar chag yong gi yod/ sdebs tshong bya rgyu ni tshong pas tshong par dngos zog btsong pa dper na/ bod zla bdun pa'i nang kong rtse ra pa'i tshong pas mdo smad nas jo ril dang bu ram/ phing sogs lha sar 'tshong bar yong skabs kho tshor smad phyogs su 'dren rgyu'i ras cha dang / sring skud dgos pa skabs de dang bstun nas ras cha dang / sring skud 'bor chen sdebs tshong byed pa red/de dang de lta bu'i rigs la sdebs tshong zer/ sil tshong ni grong gseb myul ba'i skor bskyod tshong pa'am/ lha sar bca' sdod khrom 'don tshong par dngos zog do po'am/ rdar tshan (grangs bcu gnyis ) re zung 'tshong ba dang / yang na lha sar khrom bton pa dang / sgo bsten tshong khang la brten nas bed spyod mkhan la re zung ngam/ gang dgos 'tshong ba sogs yin/brin dka' ba dang khrom rar 'bel ba'i ca lag khag gcig gnas skabs nyar 375

te rjes su dkon po byung mtshams 'tshong ba bcas so/ dus skabs so so'i nang lha sa'i khrom zog rin gong 'phar chag yong gi yod pa dper na/ bod zla bdun pa'i nang smad phyogs tshong pa slebs skabs ras cha sogs dang bod zla dang po'i lha sa'i smon lam skabs su 'thung ja dang / de min zhing 'brog la mkho ba'i rtsag rtsig dngos zog rin gong 'phar ba dang / gzhan yang 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren mi bde ba'i dbang gis dngos zog dus thog la ma 'byor bas rgyun ring dkon por gyur pas zog gong 'phar gyi yod pa red/bzhi pa/ dngul brje dang 'dza' thang gi skor/ nyo tshong de ltar byed skabs phyi nang gi dngul brje res bya rgyu ni tshong las kyi lhu tshigs lta bu yin pa dang / dngul gyi 'dza' thang 'phar chag dang bal gong 'phar chag ni gcig la gcig rten lta bu yin/ hin rdur bal gong 'phar skabs hin rdu'i ru pi'i yong 'bab mang bas bod dngul ru pi brje 'grul byed skabs ru pi'i 'dza' thang chag pa dang / bal gong chag skabs ru pi'i yong 'bab nyung bas bod dngul dang brje skabs ru pi'i 'dza' thang 'phar ba sogs yin/ tshong las byed skabs 'jal byed dang / 'degs byed kyi tshad 'dzin sa ni med du mi rung ba zhig yin zhing / hin rdu'i 'jal byed ni sga ci yin pa dang / de'i gzhal bya gtso bo ras dang / 'go snam/ther ma sogs red/ hin rdu'i 'degs byed gtso bo ni gsher yin pa dang /'degs bya gtso bo 'bru rigs yin/ gser dang sman ris/sa 'degs byed ni to la zhes dbyin sgor gyi lci tshad la zer/ rdog grangs thad ngo grangs bcu 376

gnyis la rdar tshan dang / de bcu gnyis la mgur su gcig ces zer/hin rdu'i ru pi gcig la a na bcu drug dang a na rer pad shag bzhi/ pad shag rer pa yi bzhi yin pa bcas 'dir rags tsam 'bri dgos don ni skabs de'i tshong las dang 'brel ba yod pa'i dbang gis yin/ bod ljongs lha sa'i khrom rar hin rdu nas thon pa'i bu ram sogs gsher la 'degs pa dang / bod thon gyi mar dang bal sogs khal la 'degs kyi yod pas khal gcig la nyag nyi shu dang / khal bcu gnyis la mon do gcig bcas yin/da dung 'bru rigs gshor byed ru'i khal gang la bre nyi shu/ bre gcig la phul drug yin/ gzhis rtse khul chos 'bo zhes bre brgyad 'gro ba'i 'bo yang yod 'dug tshad 'jal ni ras kha gang zhes ras sogs kyi kha zheng tshad 'jal gru bzhi ma zhig gi tshad la zer/ sha la sogs pa 'ga' shas la spong tshod kyang byed kyi yod/ bod dngul thad kha gang gnyis la skar lnga dang / gsum la skar phyed brgyad/ bzhi la zho gang / drug la trang ga zho bcu la srang gang / srang lnga bcu la rdo tshad gcig bcas kyi brtsi srol yod pa lags so/ /lnga pa/ 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren dang tshong las bar gyi 'brel ba'i skor/'grim 'grul skyel 'dren ni tshong las dang kha bral du mi rung ba zhig red/ de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas de'i thad sna 'jog spu tsam yang mi byed/ chu sgrol la brgyab dang / phred lam/ klung brgal sogs mang che ba ni rang bzhin du chags pa'i lam bu red/ 'ong kyang tsha rorozla 377

bzang dgra 'dul nas lha sa'i nub ngos khri zam du mi phyugs bde bgrod thub pa'i lcags zam dang / snye thang nub kyi ri 'gram nas cung bde ba'i lam bu zhig bzo skrun byas yod/ bod dang hin rdu'i bar phyi gtong nang 'dren ni dre'u dang / bong bu/ g.yag mi bcas la rten dgos shing / dngos zog rdab chag nyung la myur bgrod stabs bde bcas kyi khyad chos ldan pa ni dre'u red/ bdal thob rim pa yang mtho po yin/ dre'ur 'gel rgyu'i dngos zog ni chag sla ba dang ma gnas che ba/ lha sar rin gong 'phar bzhin pa bcas kyi tshong zog yin pa dang / bong bu ni dngos zog chag skyon nyung la mgyogs tshad 'bring tsam la brten cung chag sla ba'i dngos zog 'gel zhing / bdal gla'i rim pa'ang 'bring tsam dang / g.yag ni rang bzhin 'drog sla ba dang 'grul bzhud dal bar brten/ dngos/ zog chag skyon yong yas med pa dper na/ ras dang / 'bru rigs lta bu dang ma gnas chung ba/ gnas skabs phyir btsong bya rgyur brel ba med pa bcas kyi tshong zog yin la bdal gla'i rim pa'ang dma' shos yin/ mis dbor 'dren bya rgyu'i dngos zog ni bong che ba dang hin rdu nas bod du 'khyer mi chog pa/ chag grum ha cang shor sla ba bcas yin/ ('khyer mi chog pa ni hin rdu'i 'gag sgo las g.yol te lam khug brgyud 'khyer thabs ) bdal gla'i rim pa ha cang mtho po yin/ dngos zog rnams ka sbug gam/ yang na 'bras ljongs nas phag ri bar dre'u dang / mis ma gtogs de min 'gel khal lam 'khor lo'i rigs med/ phag ri nas lha sa bar gyi dbor 'dren bdal gtong skabs do bdag dang do 'dren gnyis bdal gong bsgrigs pa dang / 'byor tshes gros mol byas te gtan 'khel byed pa/ 'byor 'gyangs kyi chad pa nyin rer ji ltar 'gel ba bcas gros bsdur gnyis mos byung rjes/ do 'dren 378

pas do rtsis zab nan gyis bdal dngu la phyed 'bab lag sprod thog phyogs gnyis pos tshig don gtan 'khel gyi gan rgya 'dra gnyis 'jog pa dang /bar dpang dang 'brel ba'i 'gan len the'us mnan te 'dra gcig do bdag dang / 'dra gcig do 'dren pas nyar nas slad dngos zog chagaskyon dang /bor brlag rku 'khyer/ dus 'gyangs sogs byung na bdal 'bab 'phros bsdad nas bcog rgyu byed/ phag ri nas lha sa bar bdal gla gtong stangs ni/ ring bdal dang / thung bdal/ ha cang gi thung bdal sogs rigs 'dra min yod/ ring bdal ni dre'u dang / bong bur phag ri nas lha sa bar thad kar gtong zhing / thung bdal ni g.yag dang bong bur sna dkar rtse bar gtong ba dang / sna rtse nagobaskyar du khal ma glas te lha sar 'a bebs pa/ ha cang gi thung bdal ni/ bong bu dang g.yag la phag ri nas khango dmar bar dang de nas khal ma glas te nying ro'am/ sna rtse/ de nas dpal di'am/ nya srog de nas gzhung kor chu shur/ de nas khal ma glas te lha sar 'bebs pa bcas yin/ bdal khe ba zhes pa ni rang nyid la sems can med kyang tshong pa'i sa nas bdal gla blangs te 'gro song mkhas gtong gis khe bzang za mkhan la ze ra/ de ni gong gsal gyi kha chad gros mol zin myo/tshams ṇi par do rtsis sprod rgyu yin/ bdal gla'i rim pa ni mtho shos ring bdal dre'u/ de 'og 'bring bdal bong bu/ de 'og thung bdal/de 'og bdal khe ba/ de 'og ha cang gi thung bdal bcas yin zhing / de lta bu'i sems can la brten nas dbor 'dren byed dgos stabs do po de dag dre'us phag ri nas lha sa bar nyin bcu tsam la dbor 'dren byed thub la nyung mthar nyine rer lag pa thengs re gnyis ma 'chang thabs med la brten nges par du do chas legs la/ yang lci med pa/ char chu 'gog thub pa 379

bcas 'ig dgos kyi yod/ dngos zog gi ñdzid tshad ni gsher sum cu so brgyad nas bzhi bcu'i bar tsam la ras cha lta bur mtshon na/ nang du ras bsgril dang / de'i phyi ru ras kyis btums nas lcags shan brgyab ste rkun 'gog zha nye'i the'us gnon pa dang / dbyar ka rtswa ras steng ster par gyis btums pa/ yi tsi sogs shing sgam ster par gyis btums te lcags shan nam rgyun bus bsdams pa/ rgya gar ja ril bdun re bstar du byas te shing pags gis btums pa grangs bco brgyad re bsil rwa gru bzhi nang shing pags kyis btsangs brgyab nas blugs par rtswa ras kyis btum pa'i 'tshems bu'i steng rkun 'gog snum nag byugs te rgyun bus bsdams pa bcas so/ sna mang dngos zog gi rigs ni lcags sgam dang / shing sgam spus legs nang dngos zog yang lci spel te btsangs brgyabs nas/ nang du g.yo 'gul med pa bzos thog sgo phyi rtswa ras dang / ster par gyis btum pa ma zad rdab shor 'gog pa'i shing sgrom bzos pa'i steng du lcags shan dang / rgyun bus bsdams pa sogs byed/ phyir gtong ljid tshad 'degs khal bcu gnyis yas mas yin zhing / bdal gong 'phar chag ni phyir 'dren mang tsam yod na/ nang 'dren rgya zog gi bdal gla chag pa dang / phyir 'dren bal nyung tsam yin na rgya zog bdal gong 'phar ba bcas gcig chag gcig 'phar yin/tshong pa che khag gis phar tshur dngos zob/ dbor 'dren rang sger dang / ro mo ba/ de min 'byor phyug khag gi dre'u'i thog byed cing / de min tshong rigs 'bring chung tshos bong bu dang / khal g.yag sogs yin pa de dag gi skyel 'dren byed mkhan la dka' ngal sna tshogs shig 'phrad pa ste/ lcags zam gru khar sgrol bya'i mi dang / dngos po/ sems can mang ba dang /sgrol byed kyi ko gru nyung ba'i dbang gis rtag tu 'tshang ga rgyag pa dang / tha na 380

mi gsod kyi gyod gzhi yong ba dang / yang na 'byor pa che chung gis thub tshod gtong ba/ dper na rgyu dbang gnyis ldan nam/ rgyag res kyi rkang 'dzin pa drel pa khag gis/ bong rjes par dbang yod bshad nas rang nyid slebs ma thag gru shan nang du dre'u bcug rkyang gis bong rjes pa nyin shas sngon nas slebs rung gru la mi thar ba dang / gal te rgyu mtshan bgrang na khams rigs drel pa dag gis gri mgo 'phur/ me mda' ldir/ ki sgrasmosgrogs pa sogs gcan gzan gtum po lta bu'i rnam 'gyur ston pa'i mdun du bong rjes pa de dag gi gam du ri bong slebs pa lta bur gyur/ gnas tshul des rkyen pas tshong par dngos zog dus thog tu rtsis sprod ma thub stabs 'gyangs chad 'khri ba dang / da dung la steng dang / khug lam du rkun jag gis rgyu nor 'phrog pa ma zad srog shor ba'ang yod/ kha rlung bu yug grang ngar che ba'i khrod du lha sa nas sgang tog bar nyin bcu bzhi tsam 'grul bzhud byed dgos/ drug pa/ phyir gtong nang 'dren gyi tshong zog la bod hin srid gzhung gnyis nas do dam byed pa'i skor/bod dang hin rdu'i dbar phyir gtong nang 'dren gyi tshong zog la bod hin srid gzhung gnyis phyogs nas do dam byed kyi yod/ bod phyogs nas phag rir khral bsdu las khungs btsugs pa dang / da dung gro smad pi pi thang du bod kyi 'gag sgo btsugs te ri klung rtsa tshig bkrams te bsad mi chog pa'i ri dwags kyi lpags pa 'khyer yod med dang rin gnyis las grub pa'i ṭam dkar/ ṭam bcu'i sgor mo/ srang gsum sgor mo sogs dang de min 381

dngul dkar gyi rigs 'khyer yod med zhib bsher dang / bod mkho'i dngos zog khongs su nyal tha dang / skabs re rdo tha dang / tha mi kha'ang 'khyer mi chog hin rdu srid gzhung gi 'gag sgo dza leb la brgyud a ra ka ra dang / rna thos la brgyud hin 'bras sa mtshams rong sbug zam kha dang /sgang tog na/sa bod phyogs su mal le bco lnga'i sa spo/na dor mal le bcas su btsugs te bod nas hin rdur nyal tha dang / dngul dkar/ me mda' dang / mde'u sogs/ dang / hin rdu nas bod du 'bras dang / gro zhib/chu tshod/ rdo snur// sbag sbag a rag me mdel sogs bkag sdom byed rung / 'gag sgo'i do dam par chang rin sprod pa dang / ngo shes gtong ba/ mi hreng gis khug lam nas dbor ba sogs dardos shugs brgyud gsum gyi sgo nas dbor thabs byas te 'khyer mi chog pa'i dngos zog bod du mi nyung ba zhig slebs kyi yod/bdun pa/ nga rang ka srug tu thog mar slebs pa'i skor/spyi lo 1947lor rang nyid bgrang bya bco lngar son skabs thog mar ka sbug tu slebs byung / skabs der ka sbug khrom ra'i nyog a mi ri ka'i rkang dmag dang / rta dmag gi dmag gos ther ma dang / 'go snam/ ras spu shur bcas las grub pa dang / stabs bde'i dmag gur dang / gur thag si shan ri mo'i nang rkang bzhi dang bdun byas pa/ hog se'i thag pa leb rno//rtswa ras kyi zur dang mthil la thag leb btang ba sogs kyis khengs 'dugadamag gos de gras gsar rkyang dang / kha babs/ rnying song bcas sna 382

tshogs 'dug par rin gong yang khe tsam red/ gong gsal gyon chas de tshos bod rigs kyi lusaldor che skyon 'dug rung tshong pa tshos mang po nyos nas do po rgyag pa ma zad lhag par si shan de dag bod kyi tshong pa tshos ha cang mang po nyo gi 'dug ka sbug tu rgyun gtan gyi dngos zog ha cang 'bel po 'dug la skabs der bal gong yang dal po'i sgo nas 'phar bzhin 'dug pa bcas so/ka sbug tu yod pa'i hin rdu'i tshong pa (ka yan zer )tsho'i tshong rgyag stangs ni khe bzang de tsam chen po ma thob rung / dngos zog mgyogs tsam btsong ste ma dngul 'khor rgyugs mgyogs tsam yong ba bya rgyu de red/ kho tshos bod rigs tshong pa gsar 'byor nyo cha rgyag mkhan rnams la rgyun mkho'i bod skad gang shes brgyab nas ngo stod sprel lad dang / tha mag rkang re dang / ja mngar mo sogs kyi sne len byas nas lag yod dngos zog tshong thabs dang /tha na lam du 'gro skabs skad btang ste dngos zog tshong thabs dang / cha rkyen 'dzoms na mgo bskor gtong rgyu'i grab gshoms kyang byed kyi yod cing /de gar rgyun sdod bod rigs tshos 'grul khang gnyer ba dang / do po rgyag pa/ratshophag gso ba/ pa ras tshos zan chag tshong ba/ rta dang drel gyi rmig lcags bzo ba/ bod mkho'i dngos zog blugs snodarī kyi shing sgam bzo ba/gong nas phar tshur do po dbor 'dren sogs ri grong de'i mi mang che ba bod kyi tshong pa dang / drel par brten nas 'tsho thabs byed mkhan red 'dugari 383

brgyad pa/ phyir gtong nang 'dren gyi tshong las 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba'i skor/bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob rjes bod kyi tshong las la'ang rnam pa gsar pa zhig thon pa red/ spyi lo 1951lor mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du bskyod pa'i lam bar dang / bod ljongs khul du slebs rjes ‘‘sgrig khrims chen po gsum dang do snang byed dgos pa brgyad ’’la brtsi srung zhus nas rgya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs tshos dang bas kun nas blangs te mi shugs dang / dngos shugs kyis rgyab skyor zhus pa thams cad la gcig nas gnyis su bgrang ste dwo yang dkar po sprad nas gun med rtsis rgyag gnang ba dang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas bod kyi 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren thad thugs 'khur che bzhes gnang ste/ gron dngul dwo yang 'bor chen btang nas rlangs 'khor 'gro lam bzo skrun gnang ba bcas kyi rda yang rnams bod ljongs sa khul yongs sur khyab yod skabs/ lha sar mi dmangs dngul khang btsugs te nā yang rer hin sgor 2dang a na 10re byas te lha sa mi dmangs dngul khang ka ta krung go'i dngul khang brgyud nas hin sgor sprod rgyur dngul brjes rgyag rgyu yod gshis/ rgyun gtan dang mi 'dra ba'i hin sgor 'dza' thang brtan la hin bod kyi dngul brje stabs bde khar de sngon brin tshong ma thub par ka sbug tu lus bsdad pa'i bod tshong khag gi bal rnams rang rgyal srid gzhung gis spus gzigs mdzad pa sogs kyis bod rigs tshong pa'i lag tu hin sgor mang po yod stabs/ ka sbug tu yod pa'i hin rdu'i 384

tshob pa rnams kyis bod mkho'i dngos zog la de bas do snang dang / de bas dran 'khrul che ru song ste/ 'tshems las pa glas nas bod rigs pho mo dang /ser mo ba bcas kyi gyon pa dang skyes pa'i ko lham shud rtsi sogs tha na sgo sge'i gsham bu yan chad nas 'tshems te btsong pa dang/ ka sbug dang ka tar yod pa'i phyir sdod rang mi tshos/ phag sha bsnyal ma dang / phag pa'i sha rgyangs rgyu ma 'bor chen bod kyi tshong par btsong stabs/ tshong las la cha rkyen gsar pa zhig bsnan pa red/ da dung rang re'i rgyal sa pe cin du krung go dang / hin rdu gnyis nas krung go'i bod sa gnas dang / hin rdu'i dbar gyi tshong las gros mthun la ming rtags bkod rjes phyogs gnyis po'i phyir gtong nang 'dren byed mi chog pa'i nyal tha phud de min dngos zog bkag 'gog med par btang ba'i tshong las 'phel rgyas chen po byung bas rgyal khab gnyis po'i dpal 'byor spel res la de bas shugs snon thebs te/hin rdur bod nas yulaci thon dngosazog phud/ da dung de las rin thang che ba dwo yang mgo can khri phrag mang po btang skabs hin rdu bas bod kyi tshong par grogs 'dris bya rgyu de kho tsho'i las rim ang dang por 'jog pa dang / bod kyi sa khul spyi dang / lhag par lha sa khul du hin rdu'i 'bras dang gro zhib/hin rdu brgyud thon pa'i su'e tse'i lag 'dogs chu tshod/ dbyin ji'i rkang 'khor dang / sbag sbag sgra bsdu 'phrul 'khor sogs sna mang dngos zog gis yongs su khengs shing / da dung khams bod dang / mtsho bod rlangs 'khor 'gro lam thog rlangs 'khor shar gtong thub nas dngos zog gis byur bur khengs pa'i rlangs 'khor bstar phreng ring po de/ 'dzam gling gi yang rtser gnas pa'i bod du thog mar slebs te/ rgya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs tsho'i 'dren byed kyi lam du snang skabs spro sems rab tu 'khol ba'i ngang nas 385

bkra shis kyi bya ba der ngo 'dzum pad ma bzhad pa lta bu'i sgo nas dga' 'bod byed pa red/ de dang phyogs mtshungs lha sa nas gzhis rtse/ de nas rgyal rtse brgyud gro mo shar gsing ma bar gyi rlangs 'khor 'gro lam legs 'grub byung nas bod kyi tshong pa 'ga' shas kyis nyin rdu nas dbyin ji'i rlangs 'khor nyos te sgang tog nas shar gsing ma bar rlangs 'khor 'gro lam med pa'i nyin gsum gyi sar mi hreng gi stabs sla brgyab ste shar gsing mar lhu sgrig gis skyel 'dren bya bar zhugs pa 'di ni rgod phrug gshog rtsal rdzogs te nam 'phangs gcod pa lta bur snang / bod kyi tshong las dang / 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren de cha yongs su tshang ba'i chu shel dbang po lta bur gyur rjes/bod kyi tshong rwa khag dang lha sa'i khrom rwa gra rgyas phun sum tshogs pa'i kun da yongs su bzhad nas/ hin rdu dang mes rgyal nang khul nas thon pa'i dngos zog gis khengs pa ni/mang mang nyin mkho'i dngos zog byur byur spungs/ /gang gang bod rgya mi rigs mdza' sems che/ /de de 'du 'dzi'i gnas phyogs lha sa ni/ /yang yang yid la 'char zhing spro ba 'phel/ /zhes pa lta bu lags so/ / —386

lha son sdod pa'i brag g.yab bla brang gi lde 'chang bla med kyi lo rgyus rags bsdus/thub/ bstan chos sku nas rgyu cha mkho —'don byas pa dang bsod nams dar rgyas kyis bris/lde 'chang bla med dang nga (thub bstan chos sku ) gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba'i thad nga rang rwa stod nyag re khams tshan gyi don du lha sar rgyun sdod dgos shing / bla med ni khams tshan gyi sbyin bdag yin pa dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku drag khag cig dpal 'byor thad khong la brten dgos pa sogs gang cis che brtsan rnams dang dang mthun lam yod par brten khams tshan gyi zhu don gang ci bla med 'tshol dgos pa dang nga dang pha yul yang gcig pa song stabs bla med la bcar btugs kyis 'brel 'dris yag po byung zhing / rbal po'i tshong khang sogs nas ca lag nyo sgrub dgos rigs kyang nga rang mngags gtong gnang bas ngas kyang 'gan 'khur lhod med kyis rogs ram gang thub byas par brten khong gis nga la nye po gnang nas chung dus kyi lo rgyus shod pa dang mig sngar khong gi'is don cha rgyus kyang zhib tsam yod par brten khong gi lo rgyus rags bsdus shig bkod na snyam/lde 'chabaglamed ni bragagayab bu dgon shog lhong dze+ekha tshang du skyes 387

shing / khong lo na gang 'tshams son nas lha sar grwa rgyun du yong ste 'bras spungs nyag re khams tshan du chos zhugs byas pa red/ de nas yun ring ma song bar khong grwa sa'i sgrig khongs nas 'then zhing / skabs der khong la ma rtsa rgya dngul sgor mo brgya skor zhig yod pa de dag gis 'bri gung nas gro ma nyos te lha sar btsong pa dang / yang lha sa'i nub ngos gtsang 'gram du gnas pa'i jun sa khul nas nya sha skam po sdebs nyos rgyab 'khur gyis mon/ rta dbang dang / mtsho sna nas sgog 'phor dang / phor pa/ dmar tshos / gzar bu/ ja zog sga ser/ rgya tshos/ ri la khra'i cog ce sogs dang brje tshong byed ring skabs re lam 'khel gam pa byang thang sogs nas lto thengs re gnyis slong dgos kyang byung lugs gsungs myong / de nas bong bu gcig nyos te gong bzhin dngos zog nyo tshong lo shas byas rjes ma rtsa gang 'tshams 'phel rgyas byung ste khal rgyab bcu grangs longs pa'i tshong zog nyo sgrub kyis mtsho sna nas brdal glar btang ste rtsed thang nas rtsis len byed pa sogs tshong 'khos 'thab len lo bcu tsam byed ring khe 'bab gang legs byung ba red/de nas khong gi sring mo rgan pa'i bu lha sar bos nas 'bras nyag rer chos zhugs grwa tshang chos mdzad gi gtong sgo btang / blo gling grwa tshang gis chos mdzad der gnyer tshang zhesatshopa'i 'gan 'khur du bcug ste phan po sogs gnyer tshang gi gzhis kar nyag re'i grwa shar kha shas g.yog por btang / lde 'chang bla med kyis tshong khag mang por ma rtsa sprad de bal tshong shugs che brgyab pa ma zad/ da dung tshong las gtso bo dngul tshong yang rgyag gi yod pa red/khong gis tshong las byed ring pham nyes byung ba'i lo rgyus med tshod khar tshong las ji byas lam 'gro chen po byung ste/ lha sdod bal po'i tshong rigs khag la ma rtsa g.yar ba dbyin sgor khri gnyis shu/ sum cu/ bzhi bcu tsam med pa 388

med tshod/ yang rgyal nang dmag 'khrug dang / ri 'gog dmag 'khrug skabs su rgya gar nas ras cha phon chen nyos te yun nan sogs su btsong ba'i rin dngul rgya gar du dbyin sgor dang dngul brjes rgyag gi yod pa red/lde 'chang bla med 'byor pa che stabs sku drag che khag dang / bla brang che khagaspom mda' tshang dang / sa 'du tshang la sogs pa dang dga' nye byed pa ma zad/ kun gling dang rwa sgreng bla brang dang de bas nye po byed pa red/ bal tshong khag la 'brel 'dris che stabs gser sa phag dang / leb lcug sogs 'bel po yod/ rnam kun khyim tshang che khag la dngul bcol ba las rgya gar dngul khang la bcol srol med/ bal tshong rgyag skabs bal do stong phrag gnyis gsum tsam ka sbug sgo tham du bcug nas rul skyon mi 'byung ched gla mi 'ga' shas nyar nas a log rgyag tu bcug cing / bal gong 'phar mtshams tshong bsgyur byas par khe bzang ldab mang po yong gi yod pa red/ de bzhin rgya gar nas byu ru dkrugs ma sgam do po nyo sgrub byas pa rnams sku drag dang 'byor ldan khag la tshong gi yod/ de nas khong gi spun mched thub bstan sbyin pa ka sbug tu bzhag ste lha sa nas bla med kyis bal dang pags rigs nyo sgrub phyir gtong byas te tshong lam ha cang rgyugs pa'i khe bzang chen po byung bar brten ma rtsa chen por gyur zhing / khong nas tshong las shugs chen byas pa'i 'byor stobs che rung rgyu dngos khab skud tsam la'ang seratshosna che ba'i nyar tshags do dam zab nan byed cing / 'on kyang rnam dkar dge las la dag snang gtong phod ha cang chen po yod pa/ dper na gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum dang / bkra shis lhun po bcas pa'i dge 'dun rer 'bru ru'i khal re'i thebs rtsa ba'/ga pa dang / gzhan yang gdan sa chen po gsum gyis gtsos dgon sde khag la mchod bsnyen sku 'gyed sogs rgya che phul ba4ma 3skye9

zad/ khong nyid 'byor phyug tu gyur pa nas bzung lo ltar smon lam/ chen mor sku 'gyed chag med 'bul ba phud/ khong ma gshegs bar smon lam chen mo kho nar thebs rtsa bzhag pa rim gsags kyis dge 'dun rer dngul srang sum cu tsam longs pa dang / 'bras spungs tshogasatshochen 'du khang sbug tu gser zang sa kyi gdugs dkar sku 'dra byon legs gsar bzhengs byas pa/yang lha mthong shan /b.rari lcags zam chen po zhig skrun rgyun 'go 'doms bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas bya rgyu dang / rgyu cha dang 'gro song tshang ma bla med sger nas gtong rtsis kyis snyan zhu phul bar chog mchan thob ste 'go 'doms tsha rong dza sag bsko gzhag dang 'brel lcags zam phyi rgyal nas nyo 'dren bya rgyu'i rin 'bab bod dngul rdo tshad bzhi stong dgos phebs ltar khas len zhus 'dug 'on kyang skabs der rgyu rkyen ji yin gang ltar lcags zam skrun rgyu don 'khyol ma byung ba red/ de bzhin rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur khong gi lo grangs dang mtshungs pa par 'debs kyis khams bod dgon sde khag la thengs re bklags rgyu'i 'gro gron gyi theb rtsa dang sbrags phul ba dang / brag g.yab bu dgon byams pa rang byon gyi spyan sngar tshogs chen dge 'dun zhal grangs chig stong sum brgya skor la byams smon nyin bdun gyi gtong thebs phul 'dugade rjes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsu/ma pa'i sku bcar kun 'phel lags dang tshong 'aprel byas te thun mong thog tshong las byas par khe bzang yong 'bab je cher song bas bla med ni lha sar skad grags che ba'i tshong pa zhig chags 'dug tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa dgongs pa rdzogs rjes sku bcar kun 'phel lags bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas do dam byas pa'i zhor du bla med kyang btson 'jug gis mkhar dbang sgo thel brgyab pa red/skabs der ngas rwa stod nyag re khams tshan gyi tshogs 'du'i thog bla med ni 390

khang tshan gyi sbyin bdag chen po yin pa ma zad/ brag bla'i mi khongarngag phan yod kyi mi sna zhig kyang yin par brten da cha khong btson du bcug par khams tshan nas rogs ram gnang 'os kyi gros 'go bton kyang las sne tshang mas bla med kyi zhor du bka' nyes yo nga rgyur skrag nas nga dang bsam pa mthun mkhan gcig kyang ma byung / ngas slar yang dge bshes ngag dbang don grub la nan zhus mthar khong gis rogs ram gnang rgyur khas len dang 'brel nga dang mnyam du snang rtse shag mi dpon mdun bcar nas skyabs rten dngul srang bcu re phuzho ba dang / btson srung la chang rin sprad nas nyin bduske ring lto chas skyel bar bskyod cing / go skabs de dang bstun nas bla med la ‘‘khyed nyid btson 'jug dgos don gang yin nam nyes pa tshabs chen yin na ma gtogs mgyogs myur thag gcod yong thabs rwa stod khams tshan nas snyan zhu 'bul rtsis yod ’’lugs skor lkog tu skad cha dris pa'i lan du ‘‘sku bcar kun 'phel dang tshong 'brel gyi phan tshun dbye mtshams rtsis rgyag zin pa'i rtsis tho yig rigs kha gsal nga yi khyim du spyan zhur phul chog yod la/ gzhan gyi nyes pa gang yangartsomed pas nyag re khams tshan dang 'bras spungs blo gling grwa tshang nas snyan zhu 'bul rogs/ ngas rjes su sku drin rim gsol zhus chog ’’ces brjod kyi 'dug de don ltar ngos nas 'bras blo gling lho pa mkhan po'i sar bcar nas btson khang nas bla med kyi brjod don zhib zhu dang / bla med ni grwa tshang gi sbyin bdag dang khong gi spun mched kyis gnyer tshang las 'gan khur rtsis sogs gang ltar khyed tshos rogs ram gnang 'os zhus kyang bka' nyes yong dogs kyis rogs ram gnang tsis mi 'dug de rjes dge bshes ngag don nged gnyis bka' blon khri smon gyi sar bcar nas bla med btson 'jug gnang 'dug par skyabs 'jug gang drags dang / ma shes bka' 391

slob zhus par khri smon nas ‘‘bka' shag gis bla med do dam dgos lugs bka' btang med kyang / gsham du drung rtsis de tshos byas pa 'dra khyod tshos snyan zhu phul na 'grig gi red ’’ces brjod byung / de phral snyan zhu bris te bka' shag tu phul ba dang / slar yang 'bras spungs lho pa mkhan por sa dbang khri smon sar bcar lugs dang snyan zhu phul lugs zhus pas khong gis kyang dus tshod dang bstun nas zhu rtsis yod lugs gsung don ltar tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms thog zhus yod tshod 'dug bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas bla med kyi zlos zhib drung yig chen mo dom po ba dang rtsis dpon klung khang ba gnyis bsko gzhag gis zhib 'jug bka' dpyad btang don bla med ni nyes med dkar 'don glod grol gtong rgyu dang / kho pa btson 'jug skabs am phrag nang gser leb lcug gsum bcug pa de dag gzhung bzhes gtong rgyu las de min mkhar dbang yongs rdzogs phyir sprod bya rgyu yin zhes bka' dpyad sgrogs sbyang dang 'brel de don rtsa tshig kyang sbyar 'grems byas song /de rjes bla med nas bka' drin gsab ched 'bras blo gling grwa tshang gi dge 'dun rer 'bru khal re dang / bod dngul srang gsum re'i sku 'gyed gtong thebs rdo tshad chig stong lnga brgya dang / rwa stod nyag re khams tshan la mang ja gcig dang / ja sgam bco brgyad gser zangs kyi 'phan mgo/ li ma'i bka' gdams mchod rten gnyis bcas phul ba red/ lha sdod brag bla'i mi khungs spyi dang lhag par brag bla'i las bya byas zin pa'i mi rgyud chad na de'i mkhar dbang yongs rdzogs brag blar dag pa bka' gtan gyis chod pa ltar bla med la mi rgyud med thog rgyu stobs che bas lde 'chang zhig bskos na blo ldan shes rab sku phreng dgu pa mchog chos zhugs mdzad so+o'i mthun rkyen yong rgyur dmigs te bla med la brag bla'i lde 'chang gi go gnas sprad pa red/392

skabs 'phral bla med nas lde 'chang khri 'don byed 'go tshugs te srid skyong rwa sgreng mdun bcar nas mjal dar nang mdzod dang maṇ+ḍal rten gsum phul zhingaka srid skyong nas kyang thugs snang gtsang ba'i bka' mol dang sog chas gyon stangs tshun bka' slob gnang ba dang 'brel kha btags a tho zhig g.yogs pa de gyon bzhin khyim du phyir 'byor skabs gdan sa gsum dang /rtse shod drung rigs kyi sku tshab/ tshong pa khag brag g.yab kyi mi ser sogs mang pos rten 'byung legs 'bul rgya che phul song / lde 'chang bla med nas kyang brag g.yags skyabs mgon lha sar phebs skabs zhabs zhu gzab gzengs zhu rtsis kyi bzhugs yul gnas chung khang gsar zhes pa gsar rgyag byas pa ma zad/ brag bla'i lha sa'i las don mtha' dag don gcod 'gan 'khur lhod med sgrub kyi yod pa red/ de nas lo shas song mtshams lde 'chang bla med la nad gzhi phog nas lus khams ma bde yang tshong las rgya cher btang ba dang / rwa sgreng tshong par dbyin sgor khri sum cu so drug sprad nas rin 'babab phyi lo zla ba bzhi pa'i nang gser rkyang len rgyu byas pa red/ de lor rwa sgreng dbu lnges mkhar dbang gzhung len skabs dang 'khel bas gser len khungs med par gyur gshis rgya gar khul yod rwa sgreng tshong pa'i lag nas gser len thabs su lde 'chang bla med ngo bskyod byas kyang don son ma byung stabs sems khral che rkyen nad gzhi je sdug song ste sman bcos rim 'gro gang drag byas kyang ma phan par 'das grongs song zhing / skabs der 'das po'i srun mched thub bstan sbyin pa nas 'das mchod dang rgyu dngos kyi bdag gnyer lo gcig tsam byas rjes thub bstan sbyin pa yang grongs pa red/ de nas lde 'chang 'das po'i phyi nang snod bcud tshang ma g.yog rigs kha shas kyis bdag bzung thog lde mig thad skabs rer 'bras spungs nyag re khams 393

tshan la phul ba dang / skabs rer phyir blangs pa sogs kyis rdo don rgyu dngos 'thor gyar 'gro ba'i gnas tshul thon pa dga' 'bras nyag gsum gyi 'thus mis shes rjes 'thus mi gsum gros bsdur thog lde 'chang 'das po'i rgyu dngos yongs rdzogs brag blar bdag pa'i rgyu mtshan rtsa 'dzin khungs dag zhu rgyu yod kyang gnas skabs dngos po 'thor gyar mi 'byung ched bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas dam bsnan yong ba'i snyan zhu zhig yig tshang brgyud phul ba yin/de nyin dgong mor brda tho 'byor don sang nyin chu tshod bcu pa'i thog 'thus mi gsum dang lde 'chang 'das po'i g.yog blo bzang rgyal mtshan can ser skya gnyis bcas rtse yig tshang du 'byor dgos zhes gsal 'dug de'i phyi nyin dus thog rtse yig tshang du bskyod skabs ‘‘khyod tsho'i snyan zhus ltar khang pa dam bsnan bya rgyu dang khyod tsho'i 'gro song dgos mkho 'di gar snyan seng dang 'brel blangs 'thus dang / spun thub bstan sbyin pa'i dge rtsa gtong phyogs thad 'char snyan zhig 'bul dgos ’’zhes bsgrags byung / de 'phral 'thus mi gsum gros bsdur gyis 'bras slungs tshogs chen dge 'dun rer sku 'gyed dngul srang gsum re dang / blo gsal gling grwa tshang gi dge 'dun rer sku 'gyed dngul srang bzhi re/ 'bras spungs nyag re khams tshan la sku 'gyed dngul srang lnga dang zho gsum re'i thebs rtsa/ de bzhin se ra dang dga' ldan tshogs chen/ rwa stod dgon bcas pa'i dge 'dun rer skye 'gyed dngul srang gsum re/ gtsug lag khang jo bo'i spyan sngar mchod sprin stong tshar/ rgyud smad dge 'dun rer sku 'gyed dngul srang lnga re dang gsol ja/thug pa mar 'debs/ ra mo che jo bo'i spyan sngar mchod sprin stong tshar/rgyud stod dge 'dun rer sku 'gyed dngul srang lnga re dang gsol ja/ thug pa mar 'debs/ dus 'khor mchod thebs rdo tshad chig khri/ 'phags pa 394

lo ke shwa ra'i spyan sngar mchod sprin stong tshar/ rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang la sku 'gyed srang lnga re dang gsol ja/ bzhes thug smon lam chen mor thebs dngul rdo tshad sum khri/ gdan sa chen po gsum dang mnyes thang rwa stod grwa tshang bcas nas dge bshes zhal grangs bdun cu don lnga dang don drug re lo re mos mtshan btags kyi thebs dngul rdo tshad sum khri/ 'jang dgun chos gtong thebs rdo tshad brgyad stong tham pa bcas 'bul rgyu'i 'char snyan la chog mchan thob pa bzhin 'thus mi ngo skyod kyis bsnyen bkur mchod 'bul 'phral sgrub zhusnya pa yin/ (gong gsal 'thus mi gsum nicho —'bras spungs nyag re khams tshan dang dga' ldan nyag re khams tshan/ rwa stod nyag re khams tshan gsum gyi sku tshab la zer/) 'thus mi gsum gyis brag g.yab mi ser 'go pa'i 'gan yang 'khur dgos yod/ sngar srol ltar na brag blas mi ser 'go pa re bsko gzhag gis lha sar gtan sdod brag bla'i mngags bya tshang ma bsgrub dgos pa dang / lha sar brag bla sger gyi mi ser them dud chig stong skor dang kong po sogs su them dud chig stong skor yod pa de dag gi 'go tsho dang / mi bogs mi re nas dngul sung gang zho lnga re lo ltar bsdu len sogs kyi las 'gan sgrub dgos pa/ de sngon mi ser 'go pa bu tshe ring sngon yod dang /spor kyog zer ba rjes 'byor gnyis mthun min gyis gzhung gtugs zlos gyar bka' dpyad du kho pa gnyis ka las 'gan gnas dbyung btang ste tshab gsar khams tshan gsum gyi 'thus mis mi ser 'go pa byed dgos byung ba red/de rjes 'bras blo gling grwa tshang gi phyag sbug kong po ye shes phul byung dang / lho ji phyag sbug gnyis nas bla med kyi rgyu dngos za 'dod rngam sems kyis lkog tu bslu thabs la brten nas dngul dngos lon thabs byas pa/ dper na/nyin gcig glo bur du 'thus mi gsum phyag sbug tu yong dgos ches pa'i sharda 396

tho 'byor don bzhin skyod skabs bla med kyi don gnad ni nga tsho nang khul gyi gnas tshul yin gre/shis gzhung gtugs zlos gyar dgos med la klong 'bebs (gyod thag nang khul nas gcod thabs la zer )zhus nas nang 'dum byas na dge mtshan yod lugs dang / 'dum gan zhig kyang bzos zin lugs brjod byung / ngos nas 'dum gan la bltas pas bla med kyi rtsa ba'i rgyu rtsa blo gling grwa tshang la bdag pa dang / de nas brag blar thugs mkho gang mchis 'bul 'thus bkod 'dug gal te 'bras blo gling la de ltar rang bdag gi dbang cha byung yod na spyi yi rtsa 'dzin ltar mi bdag brag g.yab bla brang nas bla med blo gling grwa tshang chos gzhis kyi mi khongs su sprad pa'i mi khrol lag 'khyer nges par du yod dgos kyang de ltar gtan nas med thog bla med la brag bla'i lde 'chang gi go gnas dang las 'gan yod pa bcas red/ 'on kyang skabs der 'thus mi gzhan gnyis nas de tsam gnad 'gag med tshul gyis 'dum gan la ming rtags bkod song yang / nga rang nas khas len ma byas par lam sang phyir thon nas srid tshab blo bzang bkra shis dang / klu khang ba gnyis kyi sar bskyod de 'dum gan gyi tshig don snyan phul klong 'bebs bstsal na 'grig thabs med lugs zhus pa yin/ de nas nyin shas song mtshams phyag sbug gnyis nas 'thus mi gsum mnyam 'khrid kyis srid tshab gnyis kyi sar klong 'bebs zhu bcar skabs srid tshab gnyis nas ‘‘bla med kyi mkhar dbang brag blar bdag pa las gzhan pas rtsod 'os med kyang / phyag sbug la las ka zhig dgos kyi yod na 'thus mi gsum dang mnyam las byas na 'grig kyi red/ rwa stod kyi 'thus mir zur du skad cha zhig 'dug pa gdong gtugs kyis bshad na legs lugs ’’brjod song / nga rang nas 'dum gan gyi tshig don dang nam rgyun phyag sbug nas tshul min gyi byed lugs tshang ma 396

gsal bshad byas par de lan tshig gcig kyang shod kyi mi 'dug de nas nga tsho thun mong thog las ka byed bzhin skabs 'gro song gi mthun rkyen yin ze phyag sbug so sor gser leb lcug lnga re dang / nga rang la leb lcug lnga/g.yog blo bzang rgyal mtshan la leb lcug gcig dga' ldan 'thus mir leb lcug gcig 'bras5nyag re 'thus mir leb lcug gcig 'di'i skor phyag sbug la mthun 'gyur gyi bya ba sgrub mkhan 'bras nyag re dge bshes co co sger la leb lcug lnga bcas so sor bgos song / skabs der 'di 'dra'i bya ngan sbas gsang byas na 'gan blos bzod min snyam ste ngas rtse yig tshang las khungs su gnas tshul snyan zhus dang 'brel 'phros bsdad gser dngul yongs rdzogs mdzod sbug nas spus gzigs kyis rin 'bab brag blar rjes bstsal yong thabs zhus pa yin/ skabs der zlos zhib dmag spyi mkhan chung dga' brang dang zhi bde rtse mgron gnyis bsko gzhag dang 'brel ngo yod gser srang bzhi stong bzhi brgya tham pa mdzod sbug la spus tshong zhus rin rdotsho tshad lnga brgya lag sprod kyi 'phrosarjes su stsal 'thus brjod byung / phyag sbug nas gnas tshul de shes rjes khyod rang gcig pus gser tshong byas pa ma tshad gser rin sger nyar 'os min yin brjod byung bar de lan ngos nas 5thog mar nga tsho thun mong thog gser rgya 'degs byas par gser srang bdun stong drug brgya zhe bdun yod pa nas da lta gser srang bzhi stong bzhi brgya las mi 'dug cing / da phan gser dngul mdzod khang gi lde mig khyod tshos nyar tshags byas pa ma red dam/ gser srang sum stong nyis brgya zhe bdun ma tshang ba de sus 'khyer song bam/ nga'i lag tu yod pa'i dngul ni mdzod sbug dam bsnan yod pas nga rang nas dngul rtsis 'bul skabs khyod tshos gser ma tshadze+esta de yang khungs skyel dgos ’’zhes bshad pa yin/ skabs der blo ldan shes rab 397

sku phreng dgu pa mchog lha sar chos zhugs mdzad sgor phebs 'byor grub cing /sngar lam mdzad sgo legs sgrub ched sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' blon nga phod dang mkhan drung twa bla ma legs ldan/ kun gling dza sag sos/sa 'tsho 'dzin gdan zhus dang 'brel de sngon sku phreng rgong ma rim pa'i mdzad lam gzhir bzung 'tsho 'dzin rnam pas tā snyelar gzim chung mjal kha dang / smon lam tshogs phebs kyi 'bul tshan/ gtsug lag khang jo bo'i spyan sngar mchod sprin stong tshar/ smon lam 'dus tshogs la gsol ja thengs gnyis dang /bzhes thug gcig sku 'agled nā yang dkar po gnyis re/ 'bras blo gling grwa tshang la gsol ja dang dge 'dun rer sku 'gyed nā yang dkar po gsum re/sbug 'jog gser dngul maṇ+ḍal mda' tshad lhag tsam yod pa cha gcig dang /dngul ting / ja sogs/ ṭam dkar re'i gtong thebs/ 'bras spungs nyag re khams tshan la mang ja dang / dge 'dun rer sku 'gyed rda yang dkar po bzhi re dang / sbug mdzod mchod chas bcas 'bul rgyu dang /de bzhin dga' ldan dang / se ra/ rwa stod sogs kyi tshogs chen dang /grwa tshang / khams tshan bcas la mchod bsnyen rgyas bsdus gong gsal 'bras spungs dang phyogs mtshungs gtong rgyu sogs kyi 'char gzhi bzo ba gnang song /brag g.yab nas nā yang dkar po do rgyab brgya dang nyi shu skor dang shog sgor khri sum cu tsam/ ja mar sogs do rgyab sum brgya skor 'byor yod lugs drung ra nub blo brtan nas ngos la brjod byung / de dag gi ma 'dang bar 'tsho 'dzin lde 'chang bla med de nyid kyi rgyu dngos nas snga g.yar zhus pa mdzod sbug gser rin khongs nas rdo tshad sum khri lnga stong dang / gser leb lcug bdun/ rgya dngul rta mig bcu drug ja sgam bdun cu don lnga/ ja mo can seng ge lam par sgam nyi shu rtsa lnga/ mar lha khal brgya tsam/ 'bru ru'i 398

khal brgya dang sum cu skor bcas blangs pa red/ de nas nyin gcig bka' blon lha klus ‘‘bla med kyi zlos gzhir gzhung nas bka' dpyad gnang bde med pa sogs kyis yun ring 'gor gzhir brten ngos nas sems bzang bar 'dum gyis brag blar rdo tshad drug khri yong rgyu byas na 'grig min ’’zhes bka' 'dri gnang yang lam seng gzhu lan 'bul bde ma gyur bar 'gyangs song /de rje nyin gcig gtsug las/ khang drung ja'i thog phyag sbug gnyis dang /'thus mi gsum/ g.yog blo bzang rgyal mtshan bcas yong dgos zhes pa'i brda tho 'byor don bcar bar rtse mgron gnyer chen mo brgyud bka' dpyad btang don brag blar bod dngul rdo tshad sum khri lnga stong dang / chos zhugs mdzad sgor g.yar ba'i dngul dngos skyin tshab ma dgos pa/ 'bras blo gling grwa tshang la rdo tshad chig khri/ khams tshan gsum so sor rdo tshad lnga brgya re/shog lhong la kha tshang la rdo tshad lnga brgya bcas bstsal te 'phros yod dngul dngos khang pa dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs gzhung bzhes kyis 'dzugs rtsis yod pa'i chos thebs las khungs su gnang rgyu dang / gser lkog bgos byed gte lho pa phyag sbug la nyes pa smon lam chen mor sku 'gyed bod dngul srang gang zho gang re dang kong phyag la srang gang re/ co co nga rang gnyis so sor zho gang skar lnga re bcas 'bul dgos pa dang / gong gsal mi bzhi ge sa'i sgrigs khongs neyo dbyung song / chos thebs las khungs zhes pa ni sa gnas srid gzhung nas lo shas sngon du rtsa 'dzugs byed 'go brtsams shing / dgon sde nyag phra'i rigs nyams gso dang / bdag med nad gcong / rgan 'khogs/ dbang po skyon can/ chos byed kyi gang zag mtheb dras rku rgyag byed mkhan sogs gcig sdud bsdu rub kyis de dag gi 'tsho gos 'deng nges nar gtong bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi yod 'dug 'on kyang cha rkyen ji bzhin 399

tshang min gyis dngos su lag bstar ma thub mur lde 'chang bla med kyi mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes kyis chos thebs las khungs de 'phel rgyas dang 'thus tshang du gtong rgyu'i mthun rkyen du gyur te srid skyong stag brag phyag mdzod dza sag dang / rtsis dpon rnam sras gling pa/ phur bu lcog gi phyag mdzod sogs ngo 'a/sa cha tshang zhig bla med kyi gnas chung khang gsar nang las khungs btsugs nas bla med kyi mdzod khang yig rigs sogs la zhib 'jug skabs 'phros bsdad dngul dngos dang bun btang gan yig bcas yod rigs gras su sa dbang zur khang la gser dngul snga g.yar song ba rdo tshad stong phrag kha shas dang / de min sku drag khag dang dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi tshong pa khag kha che/ bal ngo// rgya rigs/ byang brgyud bco brgyad bla brang gis gtsos pa'i bla brang khag sogs la dngul g.yar song ba'i gan rgya dang 'dzin shog bcug sgam kha shas 'dug byang la 'chi med she 'bri bzhi brgya/ lhag tsam dang / rtsed thang phur 'bras spungs sngags pa grwa tshang gi gzhis ka'i thog 'brog khag gcig gnas chung khang gsar nang phya sgam mchod gshom shing khrol rtsi can nang nang rten li ma'i sku mang po dang / gser ljang rdung mar rin po che du ma'i phra rgyan can gyi rgyab sa/ khru gang gi tshad tsam lnga dang /gser kong / gser dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal sogs mchod chas kyi rigs du ma/gzhan yang gdan lcog dang yol ba/ bla bre/ thab tshang gi mkho dngos sogs mang legs/ 'phrul mda' ring thung bcu drug gzi dang byu ru/spo shel/ gser sogs smyug slo gang tsam/ dbyin sgor khri 'ga' shas/rgya dngul rta mig dang sa phag bcu khog sogs sgro ba lnga bcu tsam/ dos khang chen po zhig gi nang ja mar/ pags rigs/ tshong chas sogs ca dngos kyi khengs 'dug de min da dung lde 'chang bla med 'tsho sdod skabs rgya 400

gar du btang ba'i tshong pa 'phel rgyas sogs kha shas la tshong rtsa bod dngul rdo tshad khri bzhi bcu yas mas yod tshod/ 'bras spungs blo gling grwa tshang dang /nyag re khams tshan du bcol bzhag byas pa'i rgya sgam ko dmar gyis btum pa lcags dkrol gser tshags can gyis shan pa drug cu skor dang / lcags sgam mang po/ gzhan yang do po khang pa kha shas yod 'dug pa de dag bod dmag brgya tham pas nyin shas ring dbor song / skabs der nga rang gi bsam blo'i nang brag g.yab blo ldan shes rab sku phreng rim pa'i dus su brag g.yab bla 'bangs nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung la lhag bsam cher skyed kyis zhabs 'degs sgrub par brten de sngon rgya bod nang zing skabs ma dgon dang bu dgon gdan sa chen po gnyis kyis gtsos dgon khag bzhi bcu zhe lnga khron dmag gis mer bsregs phyi nang snod bcud nyam chag song rigs rnams sa rta tshun nas bskyar gso byas kyang sngar rgyun lta bu'i 'thus tshang byung med pa dang /blo ldan shes rab sku phreng dgu pa lha sar chos zhugs mdzad bzhin sogs gang nas bltas kyangasgyubod sa gnas srid gzhung nas skyong 'os che rung / de las ldog pa'i chos zhugs gtong dmigs mthun rkyen gtso bo lde 'chang bla med kyi rgyu dngos de yang gzhung bzhes btang ba ma zad/ 'bras blo gling grwa tshang gi mdzod phyag dang dgobashes co co ngan pa kha mthun lde mig nyar tshags kyis lkog dang dngos nas gser dngul grangs med 'khyer bar ma ltos par da res kyang rdo tshad chig khri sprod rgyu'i bka' bcad btang ba sogs byed phyogs drang po rtsa ba nas mi 'dug snyam byung ba ma zad/ de skor brag g.yab ser skya tshang mas gleng dgos pa zhig kyang byung ba dang / nga rang nas lo mang ring dka' ngal brgyab pa'i 'bras bu stong zad du gyur song bsam pa bcas las gzhan gyi bya thabs dben pa bcas so/ /401

rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur nga// gling dpon pad ma skal bzang / dga' bde blo bzang tshe brtan/ tshe dpal/ tshe rgyal/zlo lko1 rmaṅgesgo rkenespra dze+elho༈:t+yā oṃlko ༈tram̐ṭ+wāmak+ṣu.oṃdze+e oṃ klo zhu dag gtan 'bebs/ ldan lhun sangs rgyas chos 'phel/phosnye1 ṣ+ka3 ṭ+wāklotshitram̐r+sākha byang jus 'god pa/ karma rdo rje tshe ring /dh+ra༈khro7snye༈ zo tshopar zhus 'gan 'khur pa/ tshe ring mtsho mo/r+sā༈1ṣ+ṭhasna1 mi4rwaṣā7bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/(spyi'i 'don shāngs 20pa )bod ljongs srid gros lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha u yon lhan khang gis rtsom sgrig byas/mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun zhing 'grems spel byas/(pe cin ho phing li byang lam ang 14pa/ sbras ang 100013kha par ang grangs 64234411—6511)mi rigs dbe+e skrun khang gi skul 'odapar sgrig khang nas par bsgrigs/ti zhin par khang nas par btab/1998lo'i zla 11par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/1998lo'i zla 11par pe cin du par thengs dang po brgyab/deb tshad/ 850྾1168 1(32 dpar shog12 75dpar grangs 0001ge2500 deb rer sgor 14 30
